Lin,Xiangfei Meng,Xianzhu Huang,Xiao Peng,Xiaoqian Li,Xiaoting Zhang,Xiaowen Sun,Xiaoxiang Wang,Xiaoyu Ye,Xinrou Zhang,Xinyu Zhang,Xue Cao,Xueyin Chen,Yanan Zhou,Yanhong Xu,Yao Xia,Yao Xu,Yi Shao,Yihong Zhang,Yiling Ma,Ying Tang,Yining Lou,Yiru Chen,Yishi Piao,Yixuan Chen,Yong Xiong,Yuchen Xuan,Yuehan Yang,Yuer Xu,Yukun Zha,Yunxian Ma,Yuping Lin,Yuting Yan,Yutong Xie,Yuwen Sheng,Yuxuan Zhu,Zekai Zhang,Zhe Ju,Zhenzhen Lin,Zheren Gao,Zheyang Sun,Zhigang Yan,Zhongyu Wu,Zi Wang,Zihua Qu,Ziling Yan,Ziyi Wan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash：552B 参数多模态 MoE 模型，支持百万级上下文，采用 Causal Encoder-Decoder 架构在解码时激活 16B、预填充时仅激活 8B 参数，并通过 CSA2 跨层 KV 复用与 FP4 KV 缓存将全局 KV 占用降至 890 字节/token，持久化 KV 占用降至基线的约 1/8，同时性能优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程（long-horizon）智能体使工作负载愈发"输入密集"，尽管长上下文计算成本已大幅下降，预填充仍开销巨大，且大规模 KV 缓存持续挤压 HBM、SSD 容量与数据传输带宽。计算、存储与带宽三方面共同构成降低部署成本的主要瓶颈，亟需在维持模型能力的前提下压缩 KV 缓存占用与预填充开销。

Method: 1) 架构层面：提出 Causal Encoder-Decoder（CED）架构，使解码阶段每 token 激活 16B 参数、预填充阶段仅激活 8B 参数，提升智能体负载的成本效率；2) 缓存压缩：将 Compressed Sparse Attention 2（CSA2）的跨层 KV 缓存复用与 FP4 KV 缓存相结合，压缩全局 KV 占用；3) 部署优化：引入 SWA Bounded Replay 降低持久化 KV 占用；4) 对 DeepSeek-V4 架构进行精简并引入多项高效架构扩展；5) 在多模态语料上以 45T token 预训练，并进行完整后训练。

Result: 全局 KV 缓存占用（常驻 HBM）降至 890 字节/token，约为 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 对应占用的 1/4；持久化 KV 缓存占用（常驻 SSD 或主机内存）降至 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的约 1/8。在 KV 缓存占用大幅减小的同时，模型性能显著优于基线，并在多样化纯文本与多模态智能体场景中取得强劲表现。模型检查点已开放于 HuggingFace。

Conclusion: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 通过 CED 差异化激活、CSA2 跨层 KV 复用、FP4 KV 缓存与 SWA Bounded Replay 等协同设计，在百万级上下文多模态 MoE 场景下同时实现 KV 占用的大幅压缩与性能提升，为降低长程智能体部署的计算、存储与带宽成本提供了可行路径。

Abstract: The widespread adoption of long-horizon agents has made model workloads increasingly input-heavy. Although prior work has substantially reduced the cost of long-context computation, prefill remains computationally expensive, and large KV caches continue to strain HBM and SSD capacity and data-transfer bandwidth. Together, these compute, storage, and bandwidth demands constitute the primary bottleneck to further lowering deployment costs. To address this challenge, we introduce DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 552B backbone parameters and support for contexts of up to one million tokens. With its Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED) architecture, the model activates 16B parameters per token during decode but only 8B parameters during prefill, substantially improving cost efficiency for agentic workloads. To push the limits of KV cache compression, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash combines cross-layer KV cache reuse in Compressed Sparse Attention 2 (CSA2) with FP4 KV caching. These designs reduce its global KV cache footprint (always in HBM) to 890 bytes per token, roughly 1/4 of the corresponding footprint of DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Further, through a dedicated deployment optimization known as SWA Bounded Replay, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash reduces its persistent KV cache footprint (always on SSD or in host memory) to roughly 1/8 of that of DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Despite its much smaller KV cache footprint, the model delivers substantially better performance than the baseline. In addition, we streamline the DeepSeek-V4 architecture and introduce several efficient architectural extensions. We pretrain DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on a multimodal corpus comprising 45T tokens and conduct comprehensive post-training, yielding strong performance across diverse text-based and multimodal agentic scenarios. Model checkpoints are available at https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.

</details>


### [145] [Benchmarking LLM Compliance with China AI Generated Content Regulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19989)
*Chenrui Cui,Hongye Fang,Lisha Song,Weichao Chen,Yue Zhu,Gang Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文按中国现行AI生成内容合规要求，构建了一个包含2303个问题（涵盖六个维度，含203个自建宪法类问题）的评估框架，对20个主流大模型进行合规性与拒答率测评，并据此建立统一的监管基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM广泛部署带来日益上升的内容合规风险；既有研究多聚焦英语语境，低估了中文内容合规的复杂性，且缺乏面向中国现行监管要求的系统评测与统一基准。

Method: 设计新颖评估框架，覆盖六个维度共2303个问题，其中含203个自建宪法类问题；采用多个评审模型基于各自的层级化对齐记忆独立生成判定，以评估合规率与拒答率。选取20个知名LLM进行评测。

Result: 国际模型在使用标准中文问题时同样表现出较高合规水平；模型间的主要差异可能源于与意识形态对齐密切相关的维度。

Conclusion: 建立了具有法律依据的监管基准，使全球AI社区能够在统一合规要求下评估中文与非中文LLM，并提供了对中国监管图景的洞察。

Abstract: The widespread adoption of LLMs has led to escalating content compliance risks. Prior works have contributed to addressing these risks in the English context, downplaying the complexity of Chinese language content. This paper follows China's current AI-Generated content compliance requirements and provides evaluation results on 20 notable LLMs, offering insight into China's regulatory landscape. We design a novel framework to assess the compliance and refusal rates with 2303 questions spanning six distinct dimensions, including 203 self-constructed constitutional questions. The framework employs several judges to generate verdicts independently based on their hierarchical alignment memory. Our findings show that international models also exhibit high levels of compliance despite the use of standard Chinese questions, and the main differences may stem from dimensions closely related to ideological alignment. We establish a regulatory benchmark that enables the global AI community to evaluate both Chinese and non-Chinese LLMs under a unified set of legally grounded compliance requirements.

</details>


### [146] [Design of the IBM Granite 5.0 TurboCTC ASR Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20104)
*Brian Kingsbury,George Saon,Masayuki Suzuki,Hong-Kwang J. Kuo,Takashi Fukuda,Samuel Thomas,Vishal Sunder,Avihu Dekel*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Granite 5.0 Turbo CTC 是一个 4.7 亿参数的仅编码器 ASR 模型，通过架构、训练与推理优化，在 Open ASR 排行榜上达到速度-精度帕累托前沿，且速度是最快竞品的两倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在英语短语音 ASR 任务中，同时实现高精度与低推理延迟具有挑战性；作者希望构建一个在速度-精度权衡上表现优异、可开放获取的模型。

Method: 架构上在 Conformer 块中采用基于步进深度卷积的金字塔式时间下采样、块对角（分块）自注意力，并以中间层预测作为条件；训练仅使用公开数据，引入 Muon 优化器并采用均衡数据采样；推理时将 1x1 卷积替换为线性层并优化 Conformer 注意力计算。

Result: 模型处于 Open ASR 排行榜英语短语音 ASR 的速度-精度帕累托前沿，速度是最快竞品的两倍。

Conclusion: 该模型可在宽松许可下使用，并已发布于 Hugging Face：https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-speech-5.0-470m-turboctc。

Abstract: We describe the architecture, training methodology and inference speedups of Granite 5.0 Turbo CTC, a 470 million parameter encoder-only model with an excellent speed-accuracy tradeoff. The architecture uses pyramidal temporal subsampling within Conformer blocks using strided depthwise convolutions, block-diagonal (chunk-wise) self-attention, and conditioning on intermediate predictions from the middle layer. Training highlights are the use of only publicly available data, the novel use of a Muon optimizer, and balanced data sampling. Inference speedups include replacing 1 x 1 convolutions with linear layers and optimizing the attention computation in the Conformer blocks. Collectively, these result in a model that is on the speed-accuracy Pareto frontier of the Open ASR leaderboard for English short-form ASR while being twice as fast as the fastest competitor. The model can be used under a permissive license and downloaded from https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-speech-5.0-470m-turboctc.

</details>


### [147] [Fine-Tuning Models for Biomedical Relation Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20169)
*Claudiu Creanga,Liviu P. Dinu,Daniela Gifu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对变异-表型领域的关系抽取任务，评估了基于BERT的小模型微调与Gemini Pro 1.0微调的效果，发现微调后的Gemini Pro 1.0在句子级和摘要级任务上均超越现有最优水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 下一代测序产生了海量遗传变异数据，但其在疾病中作用的研究需要从庞杂的生物医学文献中提取信息，人工处理不可行，因此需要自动化关系抽取方法。

Method: 面向生物医学文本的变异-表型关系抽取，构建/采用预训练模型（PTMs），包括微调小型BERT类模型（以DeBERTa为代表）以及微调Google Gemini Pro 1.0；在SNPPhenA语料上分别开展句子级（仅处理目标句）和摘要级（处理整篇摘要）评测。

Result: 微调小型BERT类模型（尤其DeBERTa）表现强劲，接近当前SOTA；而经细致微调的Gemini Pro 1.0在句子级与摘要级两种任务上均优于现有SOTA。

Conclusion: 预训练模型可有效支持生物医学变异-表型关系抽取，小型编码器模型具备接近SOTA的性价比，而精心微调的大语言模型则可进一步突破性能上限。

Abstract: Next-Generation Sequencing has revolutionized the study of genetic mutations, enabling large-scale investigations into their roles in disease development. However, extracting meaningful insights from the vast amount of biomedical literature remains a complex challenge that cannot be addressed manually. In this paper, we present pre-trained models (PTMs) for the automatic extraction of relations from biomedical text, specifically targeting the variant-phenotype domain. Our evaluation on the SNPPhenA corpus demonstrates that fine-tuning small BERT-based models, particularly DeBERTa, yields strong performance, approaching the current state-of-the-art (SOTA). Additionally, our results indicate that carefully fine-tuning Google's Gemini Pro 1.0 outperforms the existing SOTA for both sentence-level tasks (where the model processes only the target sentence) and abstract-level tasks (where the model processes the entire abstract).

</details>


### [148] [To Copy or Not to Copy: Controlling Speculative Decoding via Intrinsic Model Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20186)
*Roy Eisenstadt,Ido Cohen,Edo Cohen-Karlik,Lior Wolf,Itamar Zimerman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SwitchSD将"复制"视为LLM的潜在控制信号，通过探针检测真实复制意图，动态在神经草稿与上下文复制间切换，吞吐量较EAGLE3提升最高15%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投机解码中神经草稿（如EAGLE3）稳健但复制密集场景加速有限，复制式方法在复制密集场景更快，却易因表面n-gram重叠误触发而丧失吞吐优势，需要更可靠的复制意图判别机制。

Method: 在目标模型内部表示上训练轻量探针，以高精度（AUC>0.99）识别真实复制意图，并据此动态在神经草稿与上下文复制之间切换。

Result: 在Llama与Qwen系列上，吞吐量较EAGLE3等SOTA基线最高提升15%。

Conclusion: 该方法将复制从噪声启发式转变为有原则、模型感知的解码机制。

Abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) has significantly accelerated Large Language Model (LLM) inference, yet existing approaches face a fundamental tradeoff between two drafting strategies: neural drafting and context-based copying. Neural drafts (e.g., EAGLE3) provide robust performance across diverse text settings, while copy-based methods achieve higher speedups in copy-intensive regimes by generating candidates faster and exploiting long repetition spans for near-perfect speculation. We analyze existing copy-based methods and find that they are prone to accidental repetitions where surface-level n-gram overlap does not reflect a structural intent to copy, leading to false-positive triggers that ultimately degrade throughput. We introduce SwitchSD, an adaptive framework that treats copying as a latent control signal of the LLM. By training lightweight probes on the target model's internal representations, SwitchSD identifies genuine copy-intent with high precision (AUC > 0.99). This allows the system to dynamically switch between neural drafting (e.g., EAGLE) and context-based copying. Our results across Llama and Qwen families demonstrate throughput gains of up to 15% over state-of-the-art baselines like EAGLE3, effectively turning copying from a noisy heuristic into a principled, model-aware decoding regime.

</details>


### [149] [Foundations of Stochastic Lexical Calculus: Semantic Descent and Random Dynamics on Probability Simplices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20207)
*Matthew F Dixon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文提出一个可观测框架，判断语言模型生成的词概率何时能支撑可随证据更新的有意义的“状态”不确定性表示，并在冻结实验中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型给出的是依赖提示的词概率，而科学系统需要的是对有意义状态的不确定性，且能随新证据顺序更新；二者之间存在缺口，需要明确语言概率何时能支撑这种状态表示。

Method: 理论上定义上下文语言的类型化可测变换，构造最小闭表示，给出语义更新唯一存在的充要条件；界定不可约非闭合性与累积误差；在平均收缩条件下证明概率单纯形上外部随机递推的存在性、唯一性与稳定性。实验上采用冻结模型实验检验可观测含义，设置预设的不变性门槛与稳定性门槛。

Result: 原始提示条件概率未通过预设不变性门槛；经提示特定校准后，共同的三状态表示通过稳定性门槛，并在30条未使用过的八步路径中覆盖28条，即在名义水平0.90下覆盖率为0.933。

Conclusion: 语言概率只有在声明的操作域内通过闭合性、稳定性与覆盖率验证后，才能有条件地支撑随机状态表示；该框架给出了一个不诉诸语言模型内部演算的随机词汇演算。

Abstract: Large language models produce prompt-dependent probabilities over words, whereas scientific systems require uncertainty over meaningful states that can be updated as evidence arrives. We develop an observable framework for determining when language-derived probabilities support such a sequential state representation. Theoretically, we define typed measurable transformations of contextual language, construct a minimal closed representation, and give necessary and sufficient conditions for semantic updates to exist uniquely. We bound irreducible nonclosure and accumulated error, and under average contraction prove existence, uniqueness and stability of an external random recursion on a probability simplex. These results define a stochastic lexical calculus without attributing an internal calculus to the language model. Empirically, frozen experiments test the observable implications. Raw prompt-conditioned probabilities fail the prespecified invariance gate; after prompt-specific calibration, a common three-state representation passes the stability gates and covers 28 of 30 untouched eight-step paths, or 0.933 at nominal level 0.90. Accordingly, language probabilities support a stochastic state only conditionally on verified closure, stability and coverage within a declared operating domain.

</details>


### [150] [Before the Warning Comes Too Late: Incremental Phone-Scam Detection from Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20223)
*Khang Nhat Hoang Vo,Anh Trac Duc Dinh,Tai Tien Ta,Tho Quan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出StreamFraudNet，从原始电话音频进行弱监督增量式电信诈骗检测，仅需通话级标签，通话结束前即可更新预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电信诈骗检测通常依赖转录文本或时间标注，成本高且难以在通话过程中实时预警；本文旨在仅利用通话级弱标签和原始音频，实现通话未结束前的增量风险评分。

Method: 采用冻结的自监督语音编码器，通过重叠的有界上下文窗口处理流式音频，结合循环时序建模与潜在窗口分数的学习式聚合，实现增量预测。

Result: 在受控英语基准上ROC-AUC达0.9953，显著优于声学与均值池化基线，并与强全局时序模型相当；10秒后给出首次预测，每2秒更新一次，推理速度快于实时。消融显示循环时序上下文是性能主要贡献因素。

Conclusion: 无需转录或时间标注即可从原始语音增量评分诈骗风险，但需引入延迟感知训练以改善早期预测。

Abstract: We study weakly supervised incremental telecom fraud detection from raw telephone audio, where training provides only conversation-level labels and predictions must be updated before a call ends. We introduce StreamFraudNet, which processes incoming audio through overlapping bounded-context windows using a frozen self-supervised speech encoder, recurrent temporal modeling, and learned aggregation of latent window scores. On a controlled English benchmark, StreamFraudNet achieves a ROC--AUC of \(0.9953\), significantly outperforming acoustic and mean-pooling baselines while remaining competitive with strong global temporal models. The model produces its first prediction after 10 seconds of audio, updates every 2 seconds, and operates faster than real time on the evaluated server hardware. Ablations identify recurrent temporal context as the principal contributor to performance. These results demonstrate that fraud risk can be scored incrementally from raw speech without transcripts or temporal annotations, while highlighting the need for latency-aware training to improve early prediction.

</details>


### [151] [The Public Discourse Corpus (PDC): A Speaker-Attributed Dataset for Valence and Epistemic Modality with Target Speaker Participation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20232)
*Bo Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出首个同时标注情感效价与认识模态的公众人物访谈语音语料库PDC，含998个视频、100位说话人、186,642句（310万词），并通过目标说话人参与度标注体系与音频优先的说话人分离流程保证语料质量，所有资源开源发布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公众人物访谈语音中同时蕴含情感效价与认识模态信息，但此前缺乏联合标注的公开数据集；同时，访谈场景中混杂访谈者与第三方语音，如何确保保留的视频确实包含目标说话人的可分析语音，是语料库构建中的关键方法学问题。

Method: 构建Public Discourse Corpus（PDC）：覆盖7个专业领域、100位说话人的998个视频，经分句与过滤得到186,642句（310万词）。提出五类目标说话人参与度（TSP）标注分类体系（标注者间信度κ=0.616）作为方法学贡献；采用音频优先的diarization流程，结合本地Whisper ASR与pyannote说话人分离，将目标说话人话轮与访谈者及第三方语音区分开来。

Result: 获得一个同时标注情感效价与认识模态的大规模访谈语音语料库，包含186,642句、310万词；TSP标注达到中等一致性（κ=0.616）；diarization流程有效分离目标说话人话轮。

Conclusion: 本文公开发布标注语料库、标注工具、跨供应商验证样本及完整处理流程，其TSP体系与音频优先diarization流程可被其他语料库建设项目复用。

Abstract: We introduce the \textbf{Public Discourse Corpus (PDC)}, the first dataset of public-figure interview speech jointly annotated for affective valence and epistemic modality. The corpus contains 998 videos from 100 speakers across seven professional domains, yielding 186,642 sentences (3.1 million words) after sentence segmentation and filtering. To ensure that all retained videos contain analyzable speech from the intended speaker, we introduce \textbf{Target Speaker Participation (TSP)}---a five-category annotation taxonomy with documented inter-annotator reliability ($κ= 0.616$)---as a key methodological contribution that any corpus construction project can adopt. Target-speaker turns are separated from interviewer and third-party speech through an \textbf{audio-first diarization pipeline} combining local Whisper ASR with pyannote speaker separation, released as an open-source implementation. We release the annotated corpus, the annotation tools, the cross-provider validation sample, and the complete processing pipeline. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ictchenbo/public-discourse-corpus.

</details>


### [152] [Lens: Bringing the Right Semantic Perspective into Focus for Training-Free Multimodal Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20252)
*Xinran Liu,Shouqian Shi,Yixian Chen,Ruizhi Chen,Xin-Wei Yao,Sheng Zhong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出免训练表示学习框架Lens，通过"语义视角锚定"与"上下文化短语读出"使表示读出任务导向化，解决语义视角错位问题，在MMEB 36个数据集上Precision@1达63.9，较同骨干免训练基线提升10.2分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量表示对下游任务至关重要。专用嵌入模型虽为表示学习显式优化，但训练数据在规模和多样性上远不及预训练大语言模型与多模态大模型的语料。大规模预训练与指令跟随使自回归模型具备筛选相关证据、整合多模态信息、按任务视角推断语义的能力，为免训练表示学习提供了契机。然而现有语义激发方法无法可靠地将抽取状态导向下游任务所需的语义视角，导致表示被输入中的显著内容主导，作者将此问题定义为"语义视角错位"。

Method: Lens为免训练框架，包含两个组件：（1）语义视角锚定（Semantic Perspective Anchoring）：将任务所需视角与任务特定的读出短语关联，明确后续用于抽取的位置所承担的解读角色；（2）上下文化短语读出（Contextualized Phrase Readout）：将同一短语置于完整输入之后，并聚合其token状态，从而兼顾全上下文访问与已锚定的视角。最终表示体现任务条件下的证据整合与推理，而非对显著内容的通用摘要。方法无需参数更新、架构修改或重排序。

Result: 在全部36个MMEB数据集上，Lens取得总体Precision@1为63.9，比最接近的同骨干免训练嵌入基线高出10.2分。

Conclusion: 免训练表示学习的关键在于使表示读出与任务所需语义视角对齐。通过短语锚定视角并将其置于完整输入之后聚合状态，可在不更新参数、不修改架构、不进行重排序的前提下显著提升表示质量，验证了自回归大模型作为免训练表示提取器的潜力。

Abstract: High-quality representations are essential for a wide range of downstream tasks. Dedicated embedding models are explicitly optimized for representation learning, yet their training data are often more limited in scale and diversity than the massive corpora used to pretrain modern large language models and multimodal large language models. Large-scale pretraining and instruction following enable autoregressive models to select relevant evidence, integrate multimodal information, and infer semantics under different task perspectives, creating a distinctive opportunity for training-free representation learning. However, our analysis reveals that existing semantic-elicitation methods do not reliably orient the extracted states toward the semantic perspective required by the downstream task. Consequently, the resulting representations often remain dominated by salient input content. We characterize this problem as semantic perspective misalignment and propose Lens, a training-free framework that makes representation readout task-directed. Semantic Perspective Anchoring associates the task-required perspective with a task-specific readout phrase, specifying the interpretive role of the positions later used for extraction. Contextualized Phrase Readout places the same phrase after the complete input and aggregates its token states, combining full-context access with the anchored perspective. The resulting representation reflects task-conditioned evidence integration and inference rather than a generic summary of salient content. Without parameter updates, architectural modification, or reranking, Lens achieves an overall Precision@1 of 63.9 across all 36 MMEB datasets, outperforming the closest same-backbone training-free embedding baseline by 10.2 points.

</details>


### [153] [Schema-Anchored Latent Reasoning for Semantic Parsing-Based Knowledge Base Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20398)
*Guangze Gao,Zixuan Li,Sikui Zhang,Chunfeng Yuan,Wenjuan Li,Bing Li,Xiaolong Jin,Weiming Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SALR：通过模式锚定的隐式推理构建逻辑形式，延迟离散模式决策，在GrailQA和WebQSP上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM语义解析方法在中间推理阶段过早对模式元素（关系与类别）做离散承诺，错误的中间模式决策会传播并导致最终逻辑形式错误。

Method: 提出SALR，一种模式锚定的隐式推理方法：在模型隐状态中生成连续思维进行多步推理以延迟逻辑形式决策的显式承诺；通过由金标逻辑形式确定性导出的模式轨迹监督的对齐目标，将连续思维与KB模式的码本对齐；再将对齐后的模式码注入后续推理步骤的输入，形成模式中介反馈，无需模型输出显式文本推理链。

Result: 在GrailQA和WebQSP上整体优于强基线；在GrailQA的组合型问题上，相较强语义解析基线TIARA提升2.86个F1点；分析表明模式中介反馈影响逻辑形式生成，且模式信息可从隐状态中恢复。

Conclusion: 延迟模式承诺并以模式锚定隐式推理，可有效缓解中间决策错误传播，提升异质大规模KB上的逻辑形式构建质量。

Abstract: Semantic parsing (SP)-based knowledge base question answering aims to answer natural language questions by generating executable logical forms (LFs) over knowledge bases (KBs). When applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to this task, a key challenge over large, heterogeneous KBs is selecting question-related schema elements (i.e., relations and classes) and composing them into complex LFs. Recent LLM-based methods often make early discrete commitments to schema elements during intermediate reasoning, allowing incorrect intermediate schema decisions to propagate and finally result in incorrect LFs. To overcome this limitation, we propose SALR, a schema-anchored latent reasoning method for LF construction. It performs multi-step reasoning by generating continuous thoughts in the model's hidden states, thereby delaying the explicit commitment to LF decisions. To ground this latent reasoning process in the corresponding KB schema, SALR aligns continuous thoughts with a codebook of KB schema elements through an alignment objective supervised by schema traces deterministically derived from gold LFs. It then incorporates the aligned schema codes into inputs for subsequent reasoning steps. This schema-mediated feedback guides LF generation without requiring the model to emit an explicit textual reasoning trajectory. Experiments on GrailQA and WebQSP show that SALR achieves consistent overall gains over strong baselines. Notably, on compositional questions from GrailQA, SALR outperforms TIARA, a strong SP-based baseline, by 2.86 F1 points. Further analyses show that schema-mediated feedback affects LF generation and that schema information is recoverable from the latent states.

</details>


### [154] [Xeno-Interpretability: Investigating the Alien Minds of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20408)
*F. Pierucci,M. Bracale Syrnikov,M. Prandi,M. Galisai,F. Giarrusso,P. Bisconti*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"异我表征"（xeno-representations）与"异我可解释性"（xeno-interpretability）概念，主张LLM内部可能存在无法用现有人类概念充分表达的模型原生表征，并区分"实验识别"与"语义解释"，给出识别这类表征的实证研究纲领及其对AI安全与多智能体系统的含义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可解释性研究普遍以人类既有概念（真实性、拒答、欺骗、人格、危害性等）为框架来解读大语言模型，这种"以人为中心"的路径隐含假设模型内部区分都能被有限的人类描述所覆盖。本文质疑这一假设，指出模型可能表征并使用人类尚无恰当概念对应的区分，若忽略这一点，可能遗漏影响模型行为的关键内部结构，尤其在安全与多智能体传播场景中带来不可预测风险。

Method: 概念与理论分析为主：(1) 提出xeno-representations与xeno-interpretability术语，划定"人类可解释语义空间"与"异我语义空间"的边界；(2) 论证LLM可能的内部区分空间显著大于有限人类描述所能覆盖的空间（计数/组合论证）；(3) 将"实验识别"与"语义解释"分离，指出内部表征可被可复现地定位、几何刻画、因果操纵并与下游行为关联，即便其语义内容无法用人类术语充分表达；(4) 在此基础上勾画识别xeno-representations的实证研究纲领；(5) 讨论其对AI安全与多智能体系统的影响。

Result: 论文未给出具体实验数据，属理论/立场性工作。核心结果是概念性区分与论证：人类可解释语义空间与模型原生异我语义空间并不重合且后者更大；可解释性对象可拆分为"可定位/可刻画/可操纵/可关联行为"与"可否人类语义表达"两个独立维度；由此提出系统识别xeno-representations的研究议程，并指出模型原生表征可在交互智能体中传播与稳定，而其通过人类可读通信仅部分可见。

Conclusion: 异我可解释性将可解释性研究的目标从"在模型内部寻找人类概念"转向"发现并刻画模型自身固有的表征结构"，尤其是那些可能以不可预测方式影响模型行为的结构。该视角为AI安全评估和多智能体系统的表征传播与稳定性分析提供了新的问题框架。

Abstract: Large language models are usually interpreted through concepts that humans already possess: truthfulness, refusal, deception, personality, harmfulness, and related categories. This paper asks whether models may also represent and use distinctions for which no adequate human concept exists. We call such internal structures xeno-representations, and their study xeno-interpretability. We distinguish the human-interpretable semantic space from the xeno-semantic space: the region of model-native representations for which no adequate human conceptual counterpart is available. We show that the space of possible internal distinctions in an LLM is substantially larger than the space available through finite human descriptions. We then separate experimental identification from semantic interpretation: an internal representation may be reproducibly located, geometrically characterized, causally manipulated, and linked to downstream behaviour even when its semantic content cannot be adequately expressed in human terms. On this basis, we sketch an empirical programme to identify xeno-representations. We finally examine the implications for AI safety and multi-agent systems, where model-native representations may propagate and stabilize across interacting agents while remaining only partially visible through human-readable communication. Xeno-interpretability therefore shifts the aim of interpretability from finding human concepts inside models toward discovering and characterizing the representational structures that are native to the models themselves and might affect their behaviour in unpredictable ways.

</details>


### [155] [Stress-testing Alignment Midtraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20412)
*Sid Baines,Jonathan Bostock,Maria Angelica Martinez,Andrew Draganov,David Africa,Daniel Tan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了对齐中训练（AMT）的有效性，发现在简单情境下AMT能引导模型动机，但少量反向微调数据即可抹除该效果，且规则学习需在midtraining或post-training中显式演示；作者认为目前尚缺乏充分公开证据证明midtraining可解决强AI对齐的核心难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练无法穷举所有期望行为与部署环境，模型需泛化超出后训练分布；对齐中训练（AMT）被提出作为解决方案，但其有效性缺乏公开证据，因此需要系统性验证。

Method: 识别围绕midtraining的多项假设，并在规模化条件下评估（最大1100亿参数模型、10亿midtraining tokens）。具体研究两类场景：(1)后训练数据在两种可能动机间存在歧义；(2)希望AI遵循多条规则但仅演示其中一部分。

Result: 在简单歧义场景下，midtraining可引导模型动机；但极少量暗示竞争动机的微调数据即会抹除AMT效果。对于多规则场景，规则必须在midtraining或post-training数据集中被演示，才能被稳健地学习。

Conclusion: 基于上述及其他发现，作者认为目前缺乏充分的公开证据，无法自信地断言midtraining能够解决对齐强AI系统所固有的核心困难。

Abstract: When aligning frontier models through post-training techniques, it is not possible to directly demonstrate all of the behaviours we want a model to exhibit in all possible deployment environments; our model must generalise outside of the post-training distribution. One proposed solution is alignment midtraining (AMT), which continues pretraining on large volumes of alignment-relevant documents to encourage generalisation in later stages of training.
  Despite the prominence of AMT as an alignment approach, there is limited public evidence for its effectiveness. To resolve this, we identify several assumptions around midtraining and evaluate them across scale: up to 110 billion-parameter models and 1 billion midtraining tokens. For instance, we study a scenario where post-training data is ambiguous between two possible motivations. We find that midtraining can steer the model's motivation in simple versions of this setting. However, the presence of a tiny fraction of finetuning data which suggests a competing motivation erases the effects of AMT. We also study scenarios in which we want an AI to follow a number of rules, but only demonstrate a subset of them. We find that demonstrations must be present either in midtraining or post-training datasets for these rules to be robustly learned.
  Based on these and other findings, we do not believe that there is sufficient public evidence for us to confidently state that midtraining can address the core difficulties inherent in aligning powerful AI systems.

</details>


### [156] [Edustories: A Collection of Real-world Case Studies from Classroom Practices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20484)
*Michal Štefánik,Jan Nehyba,Jirina Karasova,Martin Fico,Lucie Škarková,Markéta Košatková,David Kosatka*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Edustories数据集（1492个教师撰写的中小学课堂案例），用于研究集体教学情境下的AI辅助，并评估LLM预测教师干预成功率的能 力；最强模型准确率58%，低于人类专家的64%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI在教育中的潜力广受认可，但已有研究多聚焦于个性化学生辅导；而全球大多数教学实践仍发生在集体课堂情境中。为支持在集体教学中研究AI辅助，需要一个真实课堂情境的数据资源。

Method: 构建Edustories数据集，包含1,492个由教师撰写的中小学真实课堂案例研究，内容涵盖学生挑战性行为、教学干预及结果。基于该数据集设定任务：评估LLM预测教师干预成功与否的能力，并将四类语言模型家族的最新模型与专家评估进行对比。

Result: 当前模型在预测课堂结果方面落后于人类专业知识：最强模型准确率为58%，而人类专家为64%。

Conclusion: 该性能差距既揭示了AI作为在职教师助手的局限性，也显示出其初步潜力；Edustories为研究集体教学中的AI辅助提供了数据基础。

Abstract: Despite the widely recognized potential of AI in education, most prior work has focused on individualized student assistance. In contrast, the majority of educational practice worldwide still takes place in collective classroom settings. To enable researchers to study AI assistance in collective teaching, we introduce Edustories, a dataset of 1,492 teacher-written case studies describing real elementary and high-school classroom situations involving challenging student behavior, pedagogical interventions, and their outcomes. Among many other applications, Edustories enables evaluating LLMs' ability to predict the success of teacher interventions, crucial for providing practicing teachers with useful feedback. Comparing the latest models from four language-model families against expert assessments, we find that current models fall short of human expertise in predicting classroom outcomes; the strongest models reach 58% accuracy compared to 64% of human experts. This gap highlights both the limitations and the emerging potential of AI as assistants for practicing teachers.

</details>


### [157] [Relational Attention for Data-Efficient Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20530)
*Adrian Brasoveanu,Ece Takmaz,Jakub Dotlačil*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Relational BabyLM 是 BabyLM 2026 挑战赛的参赛系统，在 decoder-only Transformer 中结合双注意力 Transformer（DAT）与 Next-Latent Prediction 目标，在 100M 词严格赛道上总体排名第 6/55，NLP 任务子集排名第 3/55。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关系注意力（RA）与自注意力解耦后在纯关系任务上显著提升数据效率与样本外泛化，但语言建模需同时整合与解耦对象级和关系信息，RA 语言模型尚待探索；BabyLM 的数据受限训练与全面评测是检验该数据效率能否迁移的理想平台。

Method: 架构上将标准自注意力替换为双注意力 Transformer（DAT），分离对象级"感官"词汇特征路由与结构/关系信息路由，并比较完整 RA 与更简单的 RCA、DisRCA 变体；训练上引入 Next-Latent Prediction（NextLat）目标，促使隐状态将历史增量压缩为稠密信念状态；另提出基于 RoPE 的符号检索机制替代可学习相对符号库，且不增加参数。

Result: 架构是结构语言泛化的主导因素，目标为次要但显著；10M 词规模下三种关系注意力类型基本可互换，100M 词时完整 RA 领先；RoPE 符号检索与可学习符号库效果相当且零额外参数。严格赛道（100M 词）最佳模型总体第 6/55、NLP 子集第 3/55，两个最强模型在多数基准上超越 GPT-2，其中一个取得严格赛道最高 EWoK 分数。

Conclusion: 认知启发的归纳偏置（关系/对象解耦架构）在数据受限语言建模中有效迁移，架构选择比训练目标更关键；所提系统在 BabyLM 2026 严格赛道取得有竞争力的排名并超越 GPT-2 基线。

Abstract: We present Relational BabyLM, a system submission to the BabyLM 2026 challenge that combines two cognitively motivated inductive biases in a single decoder-only Transformer. Architecturally, we replace standard self-attention with a Dual Attention Transformer (DAT), which separates the routing of object-level ("sensory") lexical features from structural/relational information (Altabaa and Lafferty, 2025; Altabaa et al., 2024; Webb et al., 2024; Kerg et al., 2022; Webb et al., 2021). Relational attention (RA) disentangled from self-attention greatly increases data efficiency and out-of-training-sample generalization on purely relational tasks, but language modeling requires object-level and relational information to be integrated as well as disentangled, and RA-based LMs have remained largely unexplored. BabyLM's data-constrained training and comprehensive evaluation is an ideal testing ground for whether that data efficiency transfers. As a training intervention, we add a Next-Latent Prediction (NextLat; Teoh et al. 2026) objective that encourages hidden states to compress history incrementally into a dense belief state. Architecture is the dominant factor for structural linguistic generalization; the objective is secondary but still significant. DAT's three relational attention types (full RA vs. the simpler RCA and DisRCA variants) are largely interchangeable at 10M words; full RA pulls ahead at 100M. We also introduce a novel symbol-retrieval mechanism (RoPE-based, as opposed to learned, relative symbols) that matches learned symbol libraries while adding no parameters. On the strict (100M-word) track, our best model ranks 6th of 55 overall and 3rd of 55 on the leaderboard's NLP-task subset at the time of writing; our two strongest models outperform the GPT-2 baseline on most benchmarks, with one attaining the highest EWoK score among strict-track entries.

</details>


### [158] [An Analysis of Training-Free Self-Reported Confidence in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20541)
*Lukas Meyer,Sofia Rossi,Wei Chen,Thomas Laurent,Yiming Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究检验大语言模型自报置信度是否具有真实信息量，发现直接语言化置信度是强基线（AUROC 0.956/0.937），三样本一致性显著较弱（0.765/0.790），且融合无稳定增益；自洽可能放大共同误解，置信度对提示语重述敏感，传记声明中支持与矛盾主张的置信度差距有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型可在生成内容时报告数值置信度，但这类自报是否超越"经过校准的修辞"尚不明确，需要系统评估其可靠性与可解释性。

Method: 在100个TriviaQA问题上，对两个模型家族比较三类免训练信号：随答案语言化的置信度、事后P(True)、以及与额外三次生成的一致性；并进行基准错误审计、固定答案下等效提示重述置信度实验，以及对100条带置信度标注的传记声明的探索性审计。

Result: 直接语言化表现最强，审计基准错误后正确性预测AUROC达0.956与0.937；三样本一致性明显更弱（0.765与0.790），与语言化置信度的固定插值无统计可靠增益；两模型中分别有9个错误中的4个、8个错误中的2个获得一致性样本全票支持（共同误解被放大）；重述置信度使分数平均变化0.043至0.084，并在0.8阈值下翻转4%至9%的判定；传记声明中支持与矛盾主张的置信度差距仅中等。

Conclusion: 有用的自报置信度仍受提示方式、相关性错误与基准噪声影响，直接语言化虽强但并非稳健可靠，自洽一致性存在放大共同误解的风险。

Abstract: Large language models can report a numerical confidence together with generated content, but it is unclear whether this report is more than calibrated rhetoric. We analyze three training-free signals: confidence verbalized with the answer, post-hoc $P(\mathrm{True})$, and agreement with three additional generations on the same 100 TriviaQA questions for two model families. Direct verbalization is a surprisingly strong baseline: after auditing benchmark errors, it reaches AUROC 0.956 and 0.937 for correctness prediction. Three-sample agreement is substantially weaker (0.765 and 0.790), and a fixed interpolation with verbalized confidence has no statistically reliable benefit. Four of nine errors from one model and two of eight from the other receive unanimous sample support, showing that self-consistency can amplify shared misconceptions. Re-eliciting confidence for the same fixed answers with equivalent prompts changes scores by 0.043 to 0.084 on average and flips 4\% to 9\% of decisions at a 0.8 threshold. An exploratory audit of 100 confidence-tagged biography claims further finds only a modest confidence gap between supported and contradicted claims. These results argue that useful self-reports remain sensitive to elicitation, correlated errors, and benchmark noise.

</details>


### [159] [Steering the Compass: Aligning Dynamic Psychological Counseling Conversations with Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20565)
*Zimu Wang,Yiwen Jiang,Xiangyu Zhao,Yaling Shen,Jiahe Liu,Stephanie Fong,Maxmartwell H Cheng,Guilherme C Oliveira,Anh Nguyen,Robert Desimone,Barnaby Nelson,Dominic Dwyer,Zongyuan Ge*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: StratCBT是一个面向认知行为疗法（CBT）心理咨询对话的策略标注数据集，包含9,688个会话、约25.6万条话语，每条咨询师回复对齐到八种CBT策略之一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CBT的成功高度依赖根据来访者实时心理状态进行动态决策，但现有研究常忽略这一策略决策维度，限制了咨询的灵活性与疗效；同时缺乏大规模、策略对齐的CBT对话数据。

Method: 构建StratCBT数据集：基于来访者负性思维建模客户，通过self-chat生成高质量咨询对话，并以真实会话作为引导；每条咨询师回复对齐至八种CBT策略之一，形成9,688会话、约256K话语的规模。

Result: 在通用咨询与CBT专项技能上均显著超越现有数据集；实验验证了策略对齐生成的有效性，并通过LLM模拟来访者评估其在贴近真实场景中提供专业有效咨询的能力。

Conclusion: StratCBT通过引入策略级标注与策略对齐生成，弥补了CBT对话研究中动态决策缺失的问题，为构建具备专业CBT策略能力的心理咨询大模型提供了数据基础与评估范式。

Abstract: Recent advancements in large language models have revolutionized the field of psychological counseling, especially in the context of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT). While the success of CBT relies heavily on dynamic decision-making informed by the client's real-time mental state, this aspect has often been overlooked in current research, limiting both flexibility and therapeutic outcomes. In this paper, we introduce StratCBT, a dataset specifically designed for psychological counseling conversations with CBT Strategies, consisting of 9,688 sessions and around 256K utterances, with each counselor's response aligned with one of eight distinct strategies. The creation of StratCBT involves modeling clients based on their negative thoughts and generating high-quality counseling conversations through self-chat, incorporating realistic sessions as guidance, thereby significantly surpassing existing datasets in both general counseling and CBT-specific skills. We conduct extensive experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of strategy-aligned generation and evaluate its efficacy in delivering professional and effective counseling with LLM-simulated clients to reflect real-world scenarios. The dataset can be obtained from https://github.com/zimuwangnlp/StratCBT.

</details>


### [160] [SAFARI: An Industrial Benchmark for LLM-Assisted Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20584)
*Chenxi Wu,Zimu Wang,Haiyang Zhang,Wei Wang,Zhijie Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出SAFARI——首个面向ISO 26262汽车危害分析与风险评估（HARA）的工业级LLM基准，包含3,000个脱敏工业HARA案例，并配套首个"参考锚定LLM-as-a-judge"评测协议；实验表明九个前沿LLM虽能生成合理危害描述，但在ASIL风险分类上表现薄弱（最佳macro-F1仅0.261）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益被考虑用于安全关键工程，但其在受监管的功能安全流程（如ISO 26262 HARA）中的可靠性尚未被充分探究，缺乏工业级评测基准与评估方法。

Method: 构建SAFARI基准：含3,000个脱敏工业HARA案例，评测两个耦合任务——开放式危害分析与基于标准的风险评估；针对开放式HARA产物提出首个参考锚定的LLM-as-a-judge协议（与专家判断高度相关）；对九个前沿LLM进行实验，并辅以Chain-of-Thought提示对比与错误分析。

Result: 模型常能生成看似合理的危害叙述，但在ISO 26262风险分级上明显薄弱，最佳ASIL macro-F1仅0.261；Chain-of-Thought提示收益有限，且常导致类别化风险评估性能下降；错误分析将主要失败定位为危害生成中的场景关键上下文遗漏、以及风险评估中的可控性误判。

Conclusion: 当前LLM尚不足以独立胜任受监管的ISO 26262 HARA流程，需在危害生成的上下文完整性与风险评估的可控性判断环节集中投入专家监督；SAFARI为后续研究提供工业级评测基础。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for safety-critical engineering, yet their reliability in regulated functional-safety workflows remains underexplored. We introduce SAFARI (Safety-Aware Functional Automotive Risk Inference), the first industrial benchmark for LLM-assisted automotive Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA) under ISO 26262. It contains 3,000 de-identified industrial HARA cases and evaluates two coupled tasks: open-ended hazard analysis and standards-grounded risk assessment. To evaluate open-ended HARA artifacts, we propose the first reference-anchored LLM-as-a-judge protocol with high expert correlation. Experiments with nine frontier LLMs show that models often produce plausible hazard narratives but remain weak at ISO 26262 risk classification, with the best ASIL macro-F1 reaching only 0.261. Chain-of-Thought prompting provides limited benefit and often degrades categorical risk assessment. Error analysis further localizes major failures to scenario-critical context omissions during hazard generation and to controllability misjudgments during risk assessment, indicating where expert oversight should be concentrated. The dataset can be obtained from https://github.com/xixi47520-hash/HARA.

</details>


### [161] [WiC is Not WSD: A Study on LLMs and Lexical Ambiguity Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20593)
*Yi Zhou,Kiamehr Rezaee,Danushka Bollegala,Mohammad Taher Pilehvar,Jose Camacho-Collados*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文指出上下文词义判定（WiC）对语言模型依然困难，原因不仅是需要比较同一词的两个上下文用法，还在于缺乏明确指定语义粒度的义项库。作者在相近设置下评测开放大模型于WiC与传统词义消歧（WSD）任务上的表现，发现提供候选义项（如WSD中做法）在所有设置下都能提升WiC性能，即显式义项信息有助于模型做出更一致、更有针对性的判断。人工评估进一步表明，许多表面上的WiC错误实为标签歧义或模型与标注者义项边界不一致所致，而非词汇理解失败；模型常因过度细化的语义区分而"想太多"导致错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WiC任务在语言模型上持续表现不佳，作者假设该困难不仅源于需比较同一词的两个上下文用法，还源于缺乏明确指定相关语义粒度的义项库，因此需要探究显式义项信息对WiC的影响。

Method: 在相近设置下评测开放大语言模型在WiC与传统词义消歧（WSD）任务上的表现，并引入候选义项（类似传统WSD做法）；同时结合人工评估分析模型错误来源。

Result: 提供候选义项在所有设置下均提升WiC性能；显式义项信息使模型判断更一致、更有针对性；人工评估显示许多表面WiC错误源于标签歧义或模型与标注者义项边界不匹配，而非词汇理解失败；LLM常因过度细化的语义区分而"想太多"导致错误。

Conclusion: 显式义项信息能显著改善WiC表现，说明语义粒度不明确是WiC困难的重要成因；未来评估与建模应关注义项边界一致性，避免过度细化的义项区分带来的误判。

Abstract: Word-in-Context (WiC) remains challenging for language models, despite recent progress on lexical-semantic tasks. We hypothesise that this difficulty arises not only from comparing two contextual uses of a word, but also from the absence of an explicit sense inventory that specifies the relevant level of semantic granularity. We evaluate open LLMs on WiC and traditional Word Sense Disambiguation (WSD) under similar settings. We find that providing candidate senses, similar to what is done in traditional WSD, improves WiC performance in all settings. In general, explicit sense information helps models make more consistent and targeted judgements. Human evaluation further shows that many apparent WiC errors reflect label ambiguity or mismatches between model and annotator sense boundaries rather than simple failures of lexical understanding. In particular, results show that LLMs overthink the sense distinction often leading to errors based on overly fine-grained distinctions.

</details>


### [162] [What Does Privileged Information Add to On-Policy Self-Distillation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20612)
*XiuYu Zhang,Wei Chow,Junfeng Fang,Zhenkai Liang,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究构建AMPLE-Math基准，隔离分析on-policy自蒸馏中"特权参考"的真实贡献，发现大部分提升来自无参考蒸馏本身，参考的额外收益有限且依赖学生训练状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPSD让教师模型看到答案或解题过程来指导学生，这种额外信息看似能提供更多学习信号，但已有研究未能区分"参考信息本身的贡献"与"蒸馏机制本身的贡献"。作者希望隔离并量化参考带来的增量收益。

Method: 构建AMPLE-Math：含5,319道数学题、六种共享同一答案的推理视图，并将每种视图与匹配的"无参考蒸馏"对照。在Qwen3-1.7B与SmolLM3-3B上，用thinking-enabled教师指导direct-response rollout；进一步通过教师画像与匹配损失干预（matched loss interventions），并对比长短rollout在同一checkpoint下的表现。

Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B中，无参考蒸馏已解释了thinking-enabled评测下的大部分提升（域内与外部基准均如此）；参考的额外收益较小，仅在"精修解答"时最明显。SmolLM3-3B在step 50时完整思维链带来约2个百分点增益。同一checkpoint下将短direct-response rollout换成长thinking-enabled rollout，会在两个模型家族中把增益转为损失（题目、参考与评测均不变）。改变token级监督（教师画像与匹配损失干预）对学生行为影响甚微。

Conclusion: OPSD主要通过direct-response与thinking-enabled推理共享的参数，改善对已有推理能力的调用；特权参考的价值在于其对这种跨模式迁移的增量贡献，而非它揭示了多少解题内容。参考收益高度依赖学生被训练的方式。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) lets a language model learn from a frozen copy of itself that sees an answer or a worked solution. Giving the teacher this extra information seems to offer the student more to learn, but how much does it add beyond distillation itself? To isolate that contribution, we construct AMPLE-Math, a reusable suite of 5,319 mathematical problems with six reasoning views that share the same answer, and compare each view with matched reference-free distillation. With a thinking-enabled teacher supervising direct-response rollouts, reference-free distillation accounts for much of Qwen3-1.7B's improvement under thinking-enabled evaluation, both in domain and on external benchmarks. Evidence for an additional reference benefit is modest in Qwen, strongest for a polished solution, whereas complete traces add two percentage points in SmolLM3-3B at step 50. These benefits depend on the student being trained. At the same checkpoint, replacing short direct-response rollouts with long thinking-enabled rollouts turns gains into losses in both families while the problems, references, and evaluation stay fixed. Teacher profiles and matched loss interventions in Qwen further show that changing token-level supervision can leave student behavior largely unchanged. Together, these findings suggest that OPSD can improve access to existing reasoning capabilities through parameters shared by direct-response and thinking-enabled inference. The value of a privileged reference is what it adds to this cross-mode transfer, not how much of the solution it reveals.

</details>


### [163] [Chronicle: Cut-Point Replay for Regression Testing of LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20625)
*Tisha Chawla,Susheem Koul*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Chronicle 在智能体运行的非确定性边界处将运行记录为不可变信封并可重放；其核心操作 cut-point replay 选择部分边界取自记录、其余边界用新代码实时执行，从而将线上故障转化为可在 CI 中运行的回归测试。实验表明记录开销为每次跨越 23 μs，完全重放零模型调用且 20 次重复位稳定，6 个故障的 cut-point 测试均能捕获错误代码并放行安全与良性改动，且在变异研究中捕获所有让不安全动作通过的变异体，而桩化基线一个也捕获不到。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型响应具有非确定性，使得 LLM 智能体的失败难以复现：失败依赖不可位级复现的推理、读取变化状态的工具以及重跑很少重复的多步轨迹。现有的 record-and-replay 智能体工具仅将运行记录下来用于追踪或评分，而非用于针对代码改动进行测试。

Method: Chronicle 在智能体运行的非确定性边界处记录运行，形成不可变信封（immutable envelopes），并可从记录重放。其核心操作 cut-point replay 从记录中提供选定的边界子集，并用新代码实时执行互补子集，从而把记录的故障事件转化为可在持续集成中运行的回归测试。作者构建了含 6 个记录故障、带模拟模型边界的基准。

Result: 记录每次边界跨越增加 23 μs 开销（约为假定 300 ms 模型调用的 0.008%）；完全重放发出零次模型调用，且 20 次重复位级稳定；对全部 6 个故障，cut-point 测试在错误代码上失败、在加固与良性改动上通过；在加固工具的变异研究中，cut-point 测试捕获所有让记录的不安全动作通过的变异体，而以相同断言桩化所有边界的基线一个也捕获不到。

Conclusion: Chronicle 通过 cut-point replay 将记录到的智能体故障复用为确定性、低开销且可移植的 CI 回归测试，实证显示其能有效区分错误改动与安全/良性改动，并显著优于桩化基线。Chronicle 与该基准已公开于 https://github.com/theagentplane/chronicle。

Abstract: Large language model responses are non-deterministic, so failures in LLM agents are hard to reproduce: a failure depends on inference that is not bitwise reproducible, on tools that read changing state, and on a multi-step trajectory that a re-run rarely repeats. Record-and-replay makes a run reproducible, but existing agent tooling records runs only to trace or score them, not to test a code change against them. We present Chronicle, which records an agent run at its non-deterministic boundaries as immutable envelopes and replays it from the record. Its central operation, cut-point replay, serves a chosen subset of boundaries from the record and executes the complementary subset live with new code, turning a recorded incident into a regression test that runs in continuous integration. On a benchmark of 6 recorded failures with simulated model boundaries, recording adds 23 μs per crossing (0.008% of an assumed 300 ms model call), full replay issues zero model calls and is bit-stable across 20 repetitions, and cut-point tests fail on faulty code and pass on guarded and benign changes for all 6 incidents. In a mutation study of the guarded tools, cut-point tests catch every mutant that lets the recorded unsafe action through, while a baseline that stubs every boundary, using the same assertion, catches none. Chronicle and the benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/theagentplane/chronicle.

</details>


### [164] [UniPolicy: Unified Objective-Specific Policies for Generative Search Advertising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20630)
*Kun Yao,Yuhang Zhou,Yichi Zhang,Zeliang Tong,Shengri Xue,Haitao Wang,Siyu Lu,Qianlong Xie,Xingxing Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出UniPolicy,一种面向目标的搜索广告多策略对齐框架,通过分层参数解耦与多目标偏好构造,在统一检索预算下平衡相关性、点击倾向与商业价值,离线与在线实验均优于单目标RL及朴素奖励融合基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 搜索广告需同时兼顾相关性、点击倾向与商业价值等异构目标,以平衡用户体验与商业收益。现有系统多将预训练生成模型对齐到单一业务奖励(如eCPM),或采用朴素奖励融合做初步多目标对齐,易因梯度竞争导致全局次优,亟需更合理的多目标策略对齐方案。

Method: UniPolicy在共享主干内分层解耦参数:结合目标专属前缀token、稀疏MoE-LoRA路由与目标专属残差FFN,为不同业务目标提供差异化参数与策略表达空间;利用多阶段行为反馈构造成对偏好,补充曝光未点击样本中的相对偏好信息,并强化点击候选在生成分布中的相对优势;推理时支持并行、业务可定制的多策略束搜索,在固定检索预算下灵活分配各目标候选配额。

Result: 大规模离线实验表明UniPolicy在保持检索质量的同时实现多指标均衡提升,优于单目标强化学习与朴素奖励融合基线;在真实搜索广告系统7天在线A/B测试中,CTR提升0.71%,RPS提升1.58%,广告收入提升1.32%,且服务延迟保持稳定。

Conclusion: UniPolicy通过目标感知的多策略对齐与分层参数解耦,有效缓解多目标梯度竞争,在固定检索预算下实现用户体验与商业价值的协同优化,并在真实系统中验证了收益与效率的兼容性。

Abstract: Search advertising connects user intent with commercial content and plays a critical role in platform monetization. Recent systems typically align pretrained generative models with a single business reward, such as eCPM, or use naive reward fusion for preliminary multi-objective alignment. However, an ideal search advertising system must jointly account for heterogeneous objectives, including relevance, click propensity, and commercial value, to balance user experience and business value while mitigating globally suboptimal performance caused by gradient competition. We propose UniPolicy, an objective-aware multi-policy alignment framework. UniPolicy combines objective-specific prefix tokens, sparse MoE-LoRA routing, and objective-specific residual FFNs to hierarchically decouple parameters within a shared backbone, providing differentiated parameter and policy-expression spaces for different business objectives. It further constructs pairwise preferences from multi-stage behavioral feedback, supplementing the relative preference information in exposed-but-unclicked samples and strengthening the relative advantage of clicked candidates in the generation distribution. At inference, UniPolicy supports parallel, business-customizable multi-policy beam search, flexibly allocating candidate quotas across objectives under a fixed retrieval budget. Large-scale offline experiments show that UniPolicy delivers balanced improvements across multiple metrics while preserving retrieval quality, outperforming single-objective reinforcement learning and naive reward-fusion baselines. In a 7-day online A/B test on a real search advertising system, UniPolicy improves CTR by 0.71%, RPS by 1.58%, and advertising revenue by 1.32%, while maintaining stable serving latency.

</details>


### [165] [HerHealthEval: Evaluating Multilingual and Register-Sensitive Understanding of Women's Health Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20684)
*Hassan Saeed Hassan Albattra,Mazen Mohammed Bahgat,Rahatara Ferdousi,Hana Essam Sayed Ahmed Amrya,Mariam Mousa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出 HerHealthEval，一个针对女性健康多语言沟通理解的可控评测框架，覆盖英语、法语和现代标准阿拉伯语，并揭示聚合指标如何掩盖安全相关的失败，强调语域变异、不确定性处理与适配标签不变性的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大语言模型在医疗沟通中的应用日益增多，但多数评测只关注回答质量，默认用户诉求已被正确理解，忽视多语言、语域差异和歧义表述下理解失败可能带来的安全隐患。

Method: 构建 HerHealthEval 框架：对每个临床案例提供英、法、现代标准阿拉伯语三种语言的匹配版本，并设六种沟通形式——规范、临床、外行、间接/模糊、情绪关切、故意信息不足；前五种保留相同临床信息，最后一种故意省略关键细节以测试模型是否主动澄清。在多语言指令模型及 QLoRA 适配变体上评测诉求分类、风险校准、澄清行为、解析合规性与跨形式一致性。

Result: 结果表明聚合准确率和一致性会掩盖安全相关失败。在多语言风险监督语言不对称下，某多语言适配模型在法语和阿拉伯语上的漏诊率（under-triage）达 0.994；改用源数据派生、语言不变的风险标签进行受控再适配后，漏诊率分别降至 0.572 和 0.558。

Conclusion: 稳健的多语言医疗评测必须显式测试语域变异、不确定性处理，以及适配标签的来源与不变性；单纯依赖聚合指标不足以保障医疗沟通场景下的安全性。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in healthcare communication, yet most evaluations emphasize response quality while assuming that the user's concern has been interpreted correctly. We introduce HerHealthEval, a controlled evaluation framework for multilingual understanding of women's-health communication. For each clinical case, HerHealthEval provides matched versions in English, French, and Modern Standard Arabic using six communicative forms: canonical, clinical, layperson, indirect or hedged, emotionally concerned, and deliberately under-specified. The first five express the same underlying concern and retain the same clinical information, whereas the under-specified form intentionally omits relevant details to test whether the model recognizes that clarification is needed. We evaluate a multilingual instruction model and QLoRA-adapted variants on concern classification, risk calibration, clarification behavior, parse compliance, and cross-form consistency. Results reveal that aggregate accuracy and consistency can conceal safety-relevant failures. A multilingual adaptation model reaches 0.994 under-triage in French and Arabic under language-asymmetric risk supervision. A controlled re-adaptation using source-derived, language-invariant risk labels reduces under-triage to 0.572 and 0.558, respectively. These findings show that robust multilingual healthcare evaluation requires explicit testing of register variation, uncertainty handling, and the provenance and invariance of adaptation labels.

</details>


### [166] [Summarization Bias: The Directional Collapse of Objective Projection into Told-Mode Labels in Large Language Models --- A Conceptual Framework and Registered Test Protocol](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20712)
*Levent Bulut*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出并操作化了"摘要偏差"这一构念，指大语言模型倾向于将叙事意义表达为抽象摘要标签，而非可重建的推断结构；文章界定该构念、将其置于LLM-as-judge偏差框架中、以一项独立信度研究的再解读作为方向性证据，并预注册了双机制检验及放弃标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益充当评判者与奖励模型，若其存在朝"讲述模式"（told mode）的方向性偏好，就可能形成选择压力，使文本退化为扁平直白的陈述。作者希望借此识别并检验这一潜在系统性偏差。

Method: 理论建构与预注册相结合：在Bulut Doctrine的told-shown轴上界定"摘要偏差"构念（shown模式为高负荷条件，需通过Objective Projection从物理线索与间接表达重建意义）；提出生成型与评价型两种机制；对一项已完成的独立信度研究进行再解读以获取方向性证据；预注册双机制检验及明确的判定规则。

Result: 本文未声称该偏差已被验证。结果仅限于：完成构念定义、与LLM-as-judge偏差的对照定位，以及将独立信度研究的再解读呈现为与假设一致的方向性证据；正式检验结果为预注册待出。

Conclusion: "摘要偏差"被界定为双向机制的方向性倾向，其中评价型机制后果更严重（可能使评判标准偏向直白表达、压低含蓄表达）。研究以可证伪的方式推进，并设定了在该构念不成立时予以放弃的判定规则。

Abstract: This paper introduces and operationalizes summarization bias: a proposed systematic tendency of large language models (LLMs) to represent narrative meaning as an abstract summary label rather than as the reconstructable inferential structure that produces it. Within the Bulut Doctrine, narrative effect is theorized along a told-shown axis: in told mode, emotional and informational content is declared explicitly and requires little reader reconstruction; in shown mode, that content is suppressed at the surface and must be reconstructed from physical cues and indirection (Objective Projection). Shown mode is the higher-load condition the doctrine is designed to measure.
  The claim is that LLMs fail along this axis in a specific direction. Summarization bias is hypothesized to operate in two regimes: (i) a generative regime, in which a model asked to render an emotion through Objective Projection defaults to declaring it instead; and (ii) an evaluative regime, in which a model judging narrative quality rewards told-mode explicitness and under-detects shown-mode suppression. The evaluative regime is the more consequential, since LLMs increasingly serve as judges and reward models, and a directional bias toward told mode would impose a selection pressure degrading prose toward flat declaration.
  This report does not claim the bias is validated. It defines the construct, situates it against LLM-as-judge biases, rereads a completed independent reliability study as directional evidence consistent with it, and pre-registers a two-regime test with decision rules under which the construct would be abandoned.

</details>


### [167] [On-Demand Attention: Language Models Know When to Recall](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20734)
*Haibo Feng,Ruiqi Liang,Hanyang Peng,Shiqi Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 On-Demand Attention (ODA)，一种 local-first 解码方法：用轻量 recall head 依据预训练模型解码态预测全局注意力收益，按需选择性调用全局注意力，实现长上下文解码加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理与 agentic 任务对长上下文高效推理需求日益增长，但全注意力解码在每个 token 步都读取不断增长的历史 KV，无论其对下一步预测是否有益，造成大量冗余计算与访存。

Method: 核心发现：预训练模型的解码状态在全局读取之前已包含可预测该收益的信息。据此设计 ODA——以局部注意力为主，用轻量 recall head 在生成过程中根据预测收益变化选择性触发全局注意力。仅训练 recall head，冻结预训练权重，并保留完整历史 KV cache 以供后续召回。同时在 vLLM 中实现 GPU 端条件执行，将减少的全局读取转化为实际解码加速。在 Qwen、Gemma 及混合注意力骨干上验证。

Result: 选择性召回可恢复局部注意力下损失的大部分性能，同时显著减少全局读取；GPU 端条件执行在长上下文长度下将减少的全局读取转化为对全注意力的实际解码加速。

Conclusion: 预训练模型能够通过自身解码状态引导对其所保留信息的访问，为长上下文推理提供了一条“按需访问”的高效路径，兼顾性能与效率。

Abstract: Reasoning and agentic workloads increasingly demand efficient long-context inference. Yet full-attention decoding reads the growing history at every step, regardless of its benefit to the next prediction. We show that a pretrained model's decoding states already contain information predictive of this benefit, before the global read. Building on this finding, we introduce On-Demand Attention (ODA), a local-first decoding method that uses a lightweight recall head to selectively invoke global attention as its predicted benefit changes during generation. ODA trains only the recall head, leaving pretrained weights unchanged and the complete historical KV cache available for future recall. We further implement GPU-side conditional execution in vLLM, translating reduced global reads into practical decoding speedups over full attention at long context lengths. Experiments across Qwen and Gemma models, including hybrid-attention backbones, show that selective recall recovers most of the performance lost under local attention while substantially reducing global reads. These findings support long-context inference in which pretrained models guide their own access to the information they retain.

</details>


### [168] [dQwen3.5: Hybrid-Attention Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20751)
*Anton Xue,Litu Rout,Aditya Akella,Adam Klivans,Sujay Sanghavi,Sanjay Shakkottai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究能否将混合（注意力+RNN）架构的自回归模型高效地改造为扩散语言模型（DLM），并以 Qwen3.5 为骨干构建了 dQwen3.5 家族（0.8B/2B/4B/9B）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有将预训练自回归（AR）模型适配为扩散语言模型（DLM）的方法几乎都基于全注意力 Transformer。然而 AR 建模正转向注意力与 RNN 层交替的混合架构，而 RNN 在结构上具有因果性，难以双向化，这为适配带来了障碍。作者希望验证这类混合骨干是否仍能成为有效的 DLM。

Method: 基于 Qwen3.5，在 0.8B、2B、4B、9B 四个规模上进行适配，得到 dQwen3.5 家族，并设置全注意力对照组进行比较。

Result: 与全注意力对照相比，混合骨干达到相同训练损失所需 token 数约为其一半；在不同规模上，dQwen3.5 在任意顺序（any-order）解码行为上与全注意力 DLM 相似，并在并行解码下表现强劲。

Conclusion: 混合骨干可以作为扩散语言模型适配的高效起点，尽管 RNN 的因果结构存在适配障碍，改造后的模型仍具备与全注意力 DLM 相当的解码能力。

Abstract: Adapting a pretrained autoregressive (AR) model is a cost-efficient route to a diffusion language model (DLM). While nearly all such adaptations start from a full-attention transformer, AR modeling has shifted toward hybrid architectures that interleave attention and RNN layers. This creates an obstacle for adaptation: unlike attention, RNNs are structurally causal and nontrivial to bidirectionalize. Despite this mismatch, we investigate whether such backbones can become effective DLMs by adapting Qwen3.5 at 0.8B, 2B, 4B, and 9B scales, yielding the dQwen3.5 family. We find that hybrid backbones can be efficient starting points for adaptation: against a full-attention control, the hybrid reaches a given training loss in about half the tokens. Across scales, dQwen3.5 resembles full-attention DLMs in any-order decoding behavior and performs strongly under parallel decoding.

</details>


### [169] [Harm Laundering in GPT Models: Evidence That Gender Discrimination Is Transformed Rather Than Reduced Across Safety-Trained Generations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20779)
*Sarah Wyer,Sue Black,Noura Al Moubayed*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出"harm laundering(伤害洗白)"概念,证明大语言模型的安全评估依赖表层分类器会系统性遗漏伤害:显性歧视内容并非被移除,而是被转化为分类器无法捕捉的新形式。作者分析15个模型、45万条性别指向文本,发现毒性分数下降的同时表征性伤害上升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM安全评估主要依赖表层形式的毒性分类器,并据此报告跨模型代际的伤害分数持续下降。作者质疑这一方法论的完整性,认为分数下降可能掩盖了伤害的真实转化而非消除,因此需要检验"显性歧视内容是否被转换而非移除"。

Method: 在OpenAI GPT谱系(GPT-2至GPT-5)的15个模型上,生成45万条性别指向的补全文本,覆盖三种人口统计条件。采用主题聚类(Topic modeling)、情感分析、REGARD与Detoxify等三类独立分类器,量化毒性分数与表征性伤害,并检验其与模型发布时间的关系。提出"harm laundering"的三标准形式化定义及三阶段检测协议。

Result: GPT-2中女性指向输出盛行的性暴力聚类在GPT-4中消失;男性指向补全获得照护、情感表达、盟友身份等正向表征空间,而女性指向未获得。GPT-5最显著:Topic 5(1,997篇文档)将乳腺癌框定为男性权利议题,女性指向输出中无对等聚类,但三类分类器均判定其非毒性。情感分数在GPT-4发生反转(早期贬损女性,后期过度矫正)。女性指向主题多样性在GPT-4对齐边界处相对男性下降36%(W/M由GPT-2的0.91降至0.58)。REGARD表征伤害差异与发布时间显著相关(ρ=+0.55, p=.034),Detoxify则不相关(ρ=-0.23, p=.42)。

Conclusion: 毒性分数下降并不等同于伤害减少。表层毒性分类器会漏掉被转化后的表征性伤害,导致跨代模型的安全评估失真。作者将harm laundering形式化为三标准测试,并提供适用于任意生成模型的三阶段检测协议,强调在OpenAI GPT谱系内,毒性分数削减不是伤害削减的充分代理。

Abstract: Safety evaluations for large language models rely on surface-form classifiers that report declining harm scores across model generations. We provide evidence that this methodology is systematically incomplete: explicit discriminatory content is transformed rather than removed. We call this \emph{harm laundering}. Analysing 450,000 gender-directed completions across 15 models spanning GPT-2 through to GPT-5 (OpenAI GPT lineage; three demographic conditions), we show that sexual violence clusters prevalent in GPT-2 women-directed output disappear by GPT-4, while men-directed completions gain positive representational territory (caregiving, emotional range, ally identity) that women-directed completions do not. The pattern is most visible at GPT-5: Topic~5 (1,997~documents) frames breast cancer as a men's rights debate, while zero equivalent clusters appear in women-directed output. Three independent classifiers score this content as non-toxic. Sentiment scores invert at GPT-4: early models demean women; later models over-correct. Topic diversity in women-directed completions falls 36\% relative to men at the GPT-4 alignment boundary (W/M~$= 0.58$, from $0.91$ at GPT-2). REGARD representational harm disparity correlates with release date ($ρ= +0.55$, $p = .034$) while Detoxify does not ($ρ= -0.23$, $p = .42$): toxicity scores fall as representational harm grows. We formalise harm laundering as a three-criteria test and provide a three-stage detection protocol applicable to any generative model. Within the OpenAI GPT lineage, toxicity score reduction is not a sufficient proxy for harm reduction.

</details>


### [170] [RetireOPD: Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20784)
*Yan Yu,Zhengxi Lu,Yizhou Liu,Yichen Pan,Aozhe Wang,Qipeng Chen,Hua Yang,Wenqi Zhang,Weiming Lu,Qianglong Chen,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 RetireOPD，通过解耦的技能条件教师训练与自适应退休机制，在师生差距不再缩小且学生达到教师成功率目标比例时自主停止蒸馏，仅保留 RL 继续训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮智能体用 RL 训练时每条轨迹仅获单一标量奖励，监督稀疏；现有自在线策略蒸馏（OPD）依赖自教师提供 token 级密集监督，但存在两个问题：特权信息并不总能使教师可靠，且教师监督的收益具有阶段依赖性。

Method: RetireOPD 分两步：先用环境奖励优化一个解耦的、技能条件化的教师；再用 RL 与 OPD 联合训练无技能学生。不采用预设蒸馏日程，而是自适应退休：当师生差异不再缩小且学生成功率达到教师的目标比例时，学生自主丢弃教师，之后仅靠 RL 训练。

Result: 在 1.5B 至 7B 的 Qwen2.5 系列模型上，ALFWorld 成功率较 RL 基线提升 14.1%–18.8%，WebShop 准确率提升 11.8%–19.0%，且在所有设置下均超越其技能条件教师。

Conclusion: 教师监督的有效性取决于可靠性与训练阶段，动态决定蒸馏退出时机比固定日程更优；RetireOPD 可让无技能学生内化教师能力并反超教师，验证了自适应退休机制的有效性。

Abstract: Multi-turn agents trained with reinforcement learning (RL) receive a single scalar reward per trajectory, which motivates self on-policy distillation (OPD) to supply dense token-level supervision from a self-teacher with privileged task skills, letting a skill-free student internalize them. This recipe, however, is undermined by two findings in agentic tasks: privileged information alone does not always make a teacher reliable, and the benefit of teacher supervision is stage-dependent. We therefore propose RetireOPD (Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation), which first optimizes a decoupled, skill-conditioned teacher with environment rewards and then trains a skill-free student jointly with RL and OPD. Rather than following a predefined distillation schedule, RetireOPD adopts Adaptive Retirement: the student drops the teacher on its own once their discrepancy stops shrinking and it reaches a target fraction of the teacher's success rate, after which training proceeds with RL alone. Across Qwen2.5 models from 1.5B to 7B, RetireOPD improves ALFWorld success rate over RL baseline by 14.1% to 18.8% and WebShop accuracy by 11.8% to 19.0%, and surpasses its own skill-conditioned teacher in every setting.

</details>


### [171] [JEPA-Anything: Learning Predictive Models across Different Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20800)
*Taoyong Cui,Zhongyao Wang,Xinyue Xu,Weiyang Liu,Zhaochen Yu,Yuying Zhang,Qiang Gao,Mengyue Yang,Wanli Ouyang,Pheng Ann Heng,Yingcheng Wu,Zhenfei Yin,Ling Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出JEPA-Anything领域无关世界建模框架，基于正交预测因子分解（OPF），在七个异构领域验证预测、干预与泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预测模型多为领域专用，缺乏可跨系统通用的世界建模学习原则；作者希望验证是否存在一种通用的因子化预测原则，使智能体能够预判后果、指导干预并从交互中学习。

Method: 扩展联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），提出正交预测因子分解（OPF）：将隐空间目标分解为互补因子，通过专用路径分别学习，并在共享预测设计中重新组合，形成领域无关框架JEPA-Anything。

Result: 在视觉、生物学、临床轨迹、控制、分子动力学、物理场、天气七领域评估，涵盖表征学习、干预预测、分布外泛化与长时程动力学：10项匹配动力学任务指标全部提升；Interventional Pong单干预预测误差降低34.8%；四个分子系统的一步与100步误差均为最优；因子提名生物干预获细胞共培养、患者来源类器官、肿瘤碎片和小鼠实验支持；隐轨道模式恢复开普勒标度指数，拟合斜率-1.4991。

Conclusion: 正交预测因子分解可作为跨异构世界的通用预测原则，将世界建模与干预及实验支撑的科学发现相连接。

Abstract: World modeling enables intelligence to anticipate consequences, guide interventions, and learn from interaction. Yet predictive models remain domain-specific: can a common learning principle support world modeling across radically different systems? We introduce JEPA-Anything, a domain-agnostic framework based on orthogonal predictive factorization (OPF). Extending joint-embedding predictive architectures, OPF decomposes latent targets into complementary factors, learns them through dedicated pathways, and recombines them within a shared predictive design. We evaluate JEPA-Anything across seven domains: vision, biology, clinical trajectories, control, molecular dynamics, physical fields, and weather. Experiments span representation learning, intervention prediction, out-of-distribution generalization, and long-horizon dynamics, including 10 matched dynamics tasks, forecasting of over 1,000 clinical events, and 100-step molecular rollouts across four systems. Against matched JEPA baselines, JEPA-Anything improves reported metrics on all 10 dynamics tasks and reduces single-intervention prediction error on Interventional Pong by 34.8%. It achieves the lowest one-step and 100-step molecular errors among compared methods in all four systems. Beyond prediction, a factor-nominated biological intervention receives experimental support in cell co-cultures, patient-derived organoids, tumor fragments, and mice; latent orbital modes recover the Keplerian scaling exponent with a fitted slope of -1.4991. These results support a common factorized predictive principle across heterogeneous worlds, connecting world modeling with intervention and experimentally grounded scientific discovery. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/JEPA-Anything

</details>


### [172] [Unifying Models of Intergroup Hostility in Online Discourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20808)
*Patrick Gerard,Julia Mendelsohn,Kristina Lerman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文汇总6种群际敌意理论机制，在2024年美国大选期间TikTok、Truth Social与Twitter/X的286万条帖子中进行统一框架建模，揭示了机制的结构性锚点与时序规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对社会群体敌意修辞的研究依赖社会心理学、道德心理学与政治学的多种基础理论，但这些理论多平行发展、假设彼此不同甚至冲突，且极少在真实话语中相互检验，导致对敌意修辞机制的理解碎片化。作者希望厘清这些机制在现实网络话语中如何出现并相互关联。

Method: 采集2024年美国总统选举期间TikTok、Truth Social和Twitter/X上的2.86百万条帖子，将六种群际敌意基础理论机制——边界建构、威胁建构、替罪羊化、负面评价、非人化与行动导向——纳入同一实证框架进行建模，以恢复敌意修辞的整体组织结构。

Result: 结构上，边界建构与威胁建构构成该系统的锚点；时间上，各机制呈现规律性排序：边界建构、贬抑与行动导向倾向较早出现，非人化与威胁建构较晚，替罪羊化最晚。

Conclusion: 该研究将理论框架在话语中的实际表现进行映射，弥合了社会科学传统之间的长期分歧，并为计算社会科学超越单一标签检测、建模群际敌意修辞提供了更清晰的实证基础。

Abstract: Hostile rhetoric toward social groups can normalize exclusion and justify mistreatment, as well as contribute to rising polarization and political violence. Efforts to moderate hostile rhetoric in online speech draw on foundational theories in social and moral psychology, and political science. However, these theories were developed largely in parallel, often propose different and sometimes conflicting accounts of how hostility develops, and have rarely been tested against each other in real discourse. The result is a fragmented understanding of the rhetorical mechanisms of hostility, without a clear sense of how they appear, and relate to each other, in real-world discourse. Using 2.86 million posts from TikTok, Truth Social, and Twitter/X during the 2024 U.S. presidential election, we model the mechanisms of six foundational theories of intergroup hostility -- boundary construction, threat construction, scapegoating, negative evaluation, dehumanization, and action orientation -- within a common empirical framework to recover the broader organization of intergroup hostility rhetoric. Structurally, we find that boundary construction and threat construction anchor the system; temporally, we find that these mechanisms tend to follow a regular ordering: boundary construction, derogation, and action orientation tend to appear early; dehumanization and threat construction later; scapegoating latest. Mapping how these theoretical frameworks actually manifest in discourse bridges longstanding divisions across social science traditions and presents computational social science with a clearer empirical foundation for modeling intergroup hostility rhetoric beyond single-label detection.

</details>


### [173] [Embedding Models Measure in Peculiar Ways](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20821)
*Juri Opitz,Andrianos Michail*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文探究词/句子嵌入空间是否能够真实反映质量、距离、时间、体积等物理量的客观测量关系，发现嵌入仅能弱建模物理测量，并呈现异常模式，其表示主要受表层字符串相似性影响，且重新校准相似度也难以显著改善对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 嵌入空间被广泛用于定义语义相似性与距离，但其是否对应具有唯一客观语义等价与距离定义的物理量测量（如质量、距离、时间、体积）尚不清楚，作者希望验证嵌入表示是否忠实反映这类客观测量关系。

Method: 以具有唯一客观语义距离的物理量为基准，考察嵌入空间对质量、距离、时间、体积等测量的建模程度；分析嵌入表示与物理测量模式的一致性，并探究表层字符串相似性对嵌入表示的影响，同时尝试对相似度进行重新校准以检验是否能改善对齐。

Result: 嵌入空间仅弱建模物理测量，且呈现出相当特殊的测量模式；进一步分析表明嵌入表示强烈受表层字符串相似性影响，重新校准相似度并未显著提升与物理测量的对齐程度。

Conclusion: 嵌入空间无法可靠反映物理量的客观语义等价与距离，其表示更多由表层字符串相似性驱动，且简单重新校准相似度不足以纠正这一偏差，提示应谨慎将嵌入相似性等同于客观语义测量。

Abstract: Embedding spaces define notions of semantic similarity and distance. We study whether those embeddings reflect physical measurements of mass, distance, time and volume, which admit a unique, objective notion of semantic equivalence and distance. We find that physical measurement is only weakly modeled in the embedding space, and that instead quite peculiar measurement patterns can be observed. Further analysis indicates that embedding representations of physical measurements are strongly influenced by superficial string similarity, and recalibration of similarity does not substantially improve the alignment.

</details>

### [174] [From Models to Systems: A Comprehensive Survey of Efficient Multimodal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19445)
*Pan Wang,Siwei Song,Hui Ji,Siqi Cao,Heng Yu,Zhijian Liu,Huanrui Yang,Yingyan Celine Lin,Beidi Chen,Mohit Bansal,Xiaoming Liu,Pengfei Zhou,Ming-Hsuan Yang,Tianlong Chen,Jingtong Hu*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 该综述针对高效多模态学习（EML）研究碎片化的现状，首次提出“模型—算法—系统”三层级分类体系，整合300余篇工作，探讨跨层协同设计与“效率—效用—隐私”权衡，并以MLLM为例描绘从结构微调到全栈资源编排的演进路径，展望自调节智能等未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态模型快速扩展带来计算、内存与部署瓶颈，推动高效多模态学习成为重要前沿。然而现有研究对效率在学习栈中“何处、如何、以何种形式”体现缺乏统一认识，成果零散，亟需系统化梳理与整合框架。

Method: 采用结构化综述方法，构建首个“模型—算法—系统”三层级分类法：分别对应架构精简、执行优化与硬件感知编排；并对300余篇代表性工作进行归纳，进一步开展跨层协同（vertical synergy）的方法论综合，探讨其如何影响“效率—效用—隐私”权衡。

Result: 形成首个面向EML的结构化模型到系统分类体系；给出三层级间的协同机制分析；以多模态大语言模型（MLLM）为综合案例，梳理该领域从早期结构微调到现代全栈资源编排的演化轨迹；同时提供面向多领域的整体讨论与应用导向的优化蓝图。

Conclusion: 提出效率应向“自调节智能”范式转变，即效率成为模型基础设计中内在涌现的属性，而非事后附加约束；并总结开放挑战与未来方向。整体为构建高性能、可泛化且原生高效、可普适部署的多模态系统提供结构化框架，且综述持续更新于公开仓库。

Abstract: The rapid expansion of multimodal models has surfaced formidable bottlenecks in computation, memory, and deployment, catalyzing the rise of Efficient Multimodal Learning (EML) as a pivotal research frontier. Despite intensive progress, a cohesive understanding of what, how, and where efficiency is manifested across the learning stack remains fragmented. This survey systematizes the EML landscape by introducing the first structured, model-to-system taxonomy. We distill insights from over 300 seminal works into three hierarchical levels--model, algorithm, and system--addressing architectural parsimony, execution refinement, and hardware-aware orchestration, respectively. Moving beyond a purely categorical review, we offer a methodological synthesis of the vertical synergies between these layers, elucidating how cross-layer co-design contributes to the fundamental "Efficiency-Utility-Privacy" trade-off. Through an integrative case study of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), we trace the field's evolutionary trajectory from initial structural adjustments to modern full-stack resource orchestration. Furthermore, we provide a holistic discussion and application-specific optimization blueprints for diverse domains and posit a paradigm shift toward self-regulating intelligence, where efficiency is an intrinsic, emergent property of the model's fundamental design rather than a post-hoc constraint. Finally, we present open challenges and future directions that will define the trajectory of EML research. This survey establishes a structured framework for multimodal systems that are not only high-performing and generalizable but natively efficient and ready for ubiquitous deployment. A continuously updated version is available at https://github.com/pwang322/Efficient-Multimodal-Learning-Survey.

</details>


### [175] [Trigger Timing, Deadline Readiness, and Event-Aligned Accounting for Dynamic Ad Insertion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19899)
*Prashant Chaudhary,Kapil Khandelwal*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 动态广告插入的对比分析容易将触发、触及、就绪、播放、计费与测量等事件混为一谈。本文通过观测事件账本、候选不变的参考截止期限和广告段级贡献核算将这些事件分离，并在合成场景下检验不同政策比较的稳健性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态广告插入的对比研究常将触发、触及、就绪、播放、计费和测量等概念混淆，即便算术上正确，也可能导致归因和对比结论失真。作者希望明确区分这些事件，厘清何种表示与评分规则会影响广告插入政策的比较结果。

Method: 提出观测事件账本以分离各事件，采用在候选分配前固定的参考截止期限规则，检验的是"截止时是否存在合法过渡状态"而非"准备是否提前完成"；引入广告段级贡献核算；给出受限单调播放表示，界定媒体位置摘要何时足够，并用反例说明其在更广路径类上失效。通过离线合成研究，在9种短生命周期条件（信息性就绪对比）和9种长生命周期条件（解析对照）下，对45,000个共享脚本、两种触发政策（共享强加播放路径、时延抽样和假设价值/成本系数）进行检验。

Result: 在非单调混合场景中，播放头摘要对触及事件有显著误分类；但在该网格下，两种简化方法均未逆转贡献对比，因为共享设计下部分误差相互抵消。将"截止时合法性"替换为"截止前完成"会使9种信息性条件中的3种比较结果逆转，且均发生在3种时延设置之一。按实际观众到达而非参考截止期限评分就绪度，会改变暂停路径的就绪情况，但不改变贡献符号。这些结果源于事件定义应用于既有的误分类机制。

Conclusion: 记录缺失时保守界可保留不确定性；工件包含代码、随机种子、事件历史和校验程序。证据为合成数据，未使用商业遥测，也不对服务器端与服务引导式插入进行排名。

Abstract: Dynamic ad insertion comparisons can conflate trigger, reach, readiness, playback, billability and measurement even when the accounting is arithmetically correct. We separate these events with an observed-event ledger, a candidate-invariant reference deadline and pod-level contribution accounting. The deadline rule is fixed before candidate assignment and tests whether an admissible transition state remains valid, not whether preparation merely finished earlier. A restricted monotone-playback representation states when media-position summaries suffice; a counterexample shows why they fail over a wider path class. An offline synthetic study exercises the definitions over nine short-lifetime conditions informative for the readiness comparison and nine long-lifetime conditions serving as analytic controls. Across 45,000 shared scripts, two trigger policies share imposed playback paths, latency draws and hypothetical value and cost coefficients. Playhead summaries substantially misclassify reach events in the nonmonotone mixtures, yet neither shortcut reverses the contribution contrast in this grid, because some errors cancel under the shared design. Replacing validity at the deadline with completion by the deadline reverses the comparison in three of the nine informative conditions, all at one of the three latency settings. Scoring readiness at actual viewer arrival rather than at the reference deadline shifts pause-path readiness but changes no contribution sign. These outcomes are consequences of the event definitions applied to established misclassification mechanisms. Conservative bounds retain uncertainty when records are missing, and the artifact records code, seeds, event histories and checking procedures. The evidence is synthetic, uses no commercial telemetry, and ranks neither server-side nor server-guided insertion.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [176] [Characterizing Web Search by Conversational LLM Agents: From Search Decisions and Strategies to Results and Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19244)
*Mahsa Amani,Seungeon Lee,Abhisek Dash,Asmaa El Fraihi,Yunah Jang,Elisabeth Kirsten,Qinyuan Wu,Krishna P. Gummadi,Manish Gupta,Abhilasha Ravichander,Muhammad Bilal Zafar,Soumi Das*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首个跨平台研究对话式LLM智能体的Web搜索全生命周期，结合真实用户交互与API控制实验，揭示搜索决策、查询策略、域名偏好与结果归因中的显著差异与风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话式LLM智能体日益依赖Web搜索，但其"智能体化搜索"的端到端生命周期仍缺乏系统理解，尤其缺乏跨平台的实证比较，因此需要揭示各环节中的决策机制与潜在缺陷。

Method: 覆盖ChatGPT、Claude、Grok、DeepSeek四大平台，采用双轨设计：invivo（真实用户交互）与invitro（通过各平台API对同一模型进行受控实验）；考察四个环节——是否发起Web搜索的决策、查询构造策略、所获搜索结果中的域名偏好、以及将搜索结果转化为有据回答时的选择。

Result: Web搜索的触发决策在不同平台与模型间差异显著，且更频繁地调用搜索并不必然带来更好的回答质量；各智能体采用不同的复杂查询策略；平台自有搜索引擎倾向于返回其偏好域名的结果；回答总体以搜索结果为依据，但部分论断依赖未被引用的搜索结果，带来归因与可靠性隐患。

Conclusion: 研究为面向对话式检索优化的未来AI智能体与Web搜索工具设计提供了重要启示，指出需在搜索触发策略、平台搜索生态偏好及引用归因机制上加以改进。

Abstract: Conversational LLM agents increasingly rely on Web search, yet the end-to-end lifecycle of agentic search remains poorly understood. We present the first study of Web search across four major conversational platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and DeepSeek), combining real-world user interactions (invivo) with controlled experiments using the same platform's models by their APIs (invitro). We investigate the quality of agentic decisions to invoke Web search, their strategies to formulate queries, the potential domain preferences in the search results they receive, and the choices they make when transforming search results into grounded responses. We find that Web-search decisions vary substantially across platforms and models, while more frequent Web-search invocation does not necessarily yield better response quality. We further show that conversational agents employ different complex querying strategies and that platform specific search engines return search results from their preferred domains. Finally, although responses are largely grounded in search results, some claims rely on uncited search results, raising concerns about attribution and reliability. Our findings have important implications for the design of future AI agents and Web search tools optimized for conversational retrieval.

</details>


### [177] [FINSKILLOPS: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for SEC Filing QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19680)
*Yanzhang Ma,Zhenghan Tai,Hanwei Wu,Sizhe Guan,Jianliang Lei,Hailin He,Chaolong Jiang,Jijun Chi,Tung Sum Thomas Kwok,Bohuai Xiao,Jingrui Tian,Xinlu Wu,Xingao Zhan,Peng Lu,Muzhi Li,Yihong Wu,Liheng Ma,Sicheng Lyu,Tianshuo Yan,Junhao Zhu,Yaqian Xu,Lei Ding,Yufei Cui,Ziquan Liu,Boyu Han,Hengli Liu,Ling Zhou,Xinyu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将金融问答系统的部署后改进重构为"可控行为维护"：反复出现的失败被转化为有范围的技能补丁，每个补丁须通过验证与回归检查才能被采纳。FINSKILLOPS 在多智能体 SEC 文件问答中实现该机制，在六个基准上取得最高的判定加权正确率和参考一致性，并将增强基准正确率从 3.70 提升至 4.55。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有金融问答系统的改进多发生在部署之前（检索、提示或智能体协作），部署后可靠性行为固定不变。实际中新的 SEC 文件问题会持续暴露期间、实体、证据使用与计算等异质错误。已有自改进方法虽能把失败转为新行为，却难以控制纠正的作用范围，也无法避免破坏此前正确的答案。因此需要一种兼顾"纠错"与"防退化"的部署后改进范式。

Method: 提出 FINSKILLOPS 多智能体系统：从基于证据的、带类型的失败诊断中提取可复用技能；通过定向验证、受保护用例回归检查、阴性对照以及版本化替换或退役来治理技能。核心是控制技能范围（scope）、准入（admission）与生命周期（lifecycle）。

Result: 在六个金融问答基准上，单一冻结的技能注册表在受评系统中取得最高的判定加权正确率与参考一致性；技能演化使增强基准正确率由 3.70 提升至 4.55。在独立的 12 轮运行研究中，33 个候选技能仅 6 个被提升（采纳），监控非纠正率由 20.0% 降至 12.5%。

Conclusion: 可控的技能范围、准入与生命周期管理是实现可靠自改进的基础，为金融问答系统部署后的持续、无退化改进提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Financial QA systems are typically improved before deployment through better retrieval, prompting, or agent coordination, leaving their reliability behavior fixed thereafter. In practice, new SEC-filing questions repeatedly expose heterogeneous errors in period, entity, evidence use, and calculation. Existing self-improvement methods can turn failures into new behaviors, but offer limited control over where a correction should apply or which previously correct answers it may break. We therefore frame post-deployment improvement as controlled behavioral maintenance: recurring failures should become scoped skill patches, and each patch should earn deployment with- out introducing regressions. We instantiate this view in FINSKILLOPS, a multi-agent system for SEC filing QA. FINSKILLOPS derives reusable skills from evidence-grounded, typed failure diagnoses and governs them through targeted validation, protected-case regression checks, negative controls, and versioned replacement or retirement. Across six financial QA benchmarks, a single frozen skill registry achieves the highest verdict-weighted correctness and reference consistency among the evaluated systems. Evolved skills raise correctness from 3.70 to 4.55 on our enhanced benchmark. In a separate 12-round operational study, only six of 33 proposed skills are promoted, while the monitoring non-correct rate falls from 20.0% to 12.5%. These results establish controlled skill scope, admission, and lifecycle management as the foundation for reliable self-improvement.

</details>


### [178] [From Intent to Action: Benchmarking LLM Safety in Vehicle Voice Command Authorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19630)
*Diba Afroze,Xingli Zhang,Yazhou Tu,Xiali Hei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出面向车载语音助手中 LLM 指令授权的 202 场景基准与七类决策分类体系，评测两类本地开源模型与三类 API 模型，发现即使最优模型对齐率 89.1% 仍存在 False Execute，结构化决策不足以单独作为安全机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 正被集成进车载语音助手，将自然语言请求映射为车辆功能构成安全攸关的授权问题。系统需在"执行、拒绝、澄清、要求确认、转人工、触发紧急响应、不调用工具"之间做前置决策，而现有评测未在说话人角色、认证状态、车辆状态、工具可用性等维度上孤立考察该前置决策。

Method: 构建 202 个场景的基准，给出七类分类法下的参考决策；评测两个本地开源权重模型与三个 API 基座 LLM，采用决策对齐率（Decision Alignment）及安全专用错误指标；并对 Llama 3.2 3B 做受控消融，对比结构化授权策略与仅 schema、通用安全基线。
