The weaker Effect-Compatible Cognitive Admission recertifies an effect against a simultaneously held current dependency vector and current policy without claiming to serialize the original stochastic derivation. TCT combines immutable versioned executable definitions, registry-derived authority plans, sealed envelopes, guard-first commit transactions, post-seal envelope- and witness-bound grants, co-committed receipts, idempotent grant finalization, and receipt-driven epistemic reconciliation. Complete registered footprints and a single growing phase induce an acyclic lock-point order over local guards and incompatible external reservations. The corresponding results give serializability conditions and an observational-equivalence boundary for zero-error soundness and positive progress. A falsification suite tests the implementation obligations: the prototype prevented all injected anomalies and added 3.22 ms mean commit overhead.

</details>


### [247] [AI-Driven Real-Time Relay Optimisation in Smart Urban NR-V2X Networks via Learning-to-Optimise Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20271)
*Giambattista Amati,Federica Mangiatordi,Emiliano Pallotti,Simone Angelini*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于GNN的L2O框架，用于NR-V2X多跳中继选择，兼顾近优连通性与实时性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智慧城市与工业4.0应用依赖NR-V2X的可靠低时延通信，但RSU部署有限、城市传播条件复杂，CAV难以维持稳定连接，需要实时中继选择方案。

Method: 将车联网建模为图（节点为CAV与RSU，边表征无线链路特性）；用离线MILP求解最优中继决策作为监督标签；训练边感知的GINE模型实现实时多跳中继选择。

Result: 在真实城市数据集上达到近优连通性能，连通性增益最高11.3%，执行时间相比MILP最高加速100倍。

Conclusion: 该框架支持可扩展的实时网络控制，适用于智慧城市与工业4.0部署。

Abstract: Reliable and low-latency communication is a fundamental requirement for smart city services and Industry 4.0 applications enabled by NR-V2X networks. However, limited Road-Side Unit (RSU) deployment and complex urban propagation conditions often prevent Connected and Automated Vehicles (CAVs) from maintaining stable connectivity. This paper proposes an AI-driven Learning-to-Optimise (L2O) framework based on Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for real-time multi-hop relay selection in NR-V2X systems. The vehicular network is modelled as a graph, where nodes represent CAVs and RSUs, and edges encode radio-link characteristics. An offline Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) formulation provides optimal relay decisions used as supervision for training an edge-aware Graph Isomorphism Network with Edge Features (GINE). Extensive experiments on realistic urban datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves near-optimal connectivity performance, recovering up to 11.3% connectivity gain, while reducing execution time by orders of magnitude (up to 100 x speed-up) compared to MILP. The framework enables scalable and real-time network control, making it suitable for smart city and Industry 4.0 deployments.

</details>


### [248] [AgentPProf: Semantic Profiler for Long Horizon AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20301)
*Yusheng Zheng,Chaokun Chang,Yu Mao,Tianyuan Wu,Yuxi Huang,Tao Ma,Wenan Mao,Shuyi Cheng,Andi Quinn,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出语义操作栈模型与递归操作分割方法，并实现 AgentPProf 性能分析器，将 AI 智能体轨迹聚合为 pprof 兼容剖面，实现跨运行的资源归因与问题定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 智能体长期编排用户、工具与系统资源的活动，开发者需定位失败点、识别不安全效应的触发因素、找出最耗预算的任务并优化。现有智能体可观测工具侧重单次执行的调试与追踪，缺乏跨运行、长期的性能分析能力，难以规模化回答上述问题。

Method: 提出语义操作栈模型：用统一操作表示所有活动，以操作栈替代运行时调用栈，实现不同粒度的层次化归因。观察到智能体任务占据连续区间并分解为子任务，据此设计递归操作分割，在任务边界处递归切分轨迹。AgentPProf 将轨迹聚合为 pprof 兼容剖面，支持火焰图可视化与分析。

Result: 在 CodeTraceBench 上，AgentPProf 相对人工标注达到 0.764 的 B^3 F1；在三个问题定位基准上，剖面使 MAP 最高提升 56%，证明其能有效进行资源归因、定位问题并在实用分析成本下优化 token 开销。

Conclusion: 智能体可观测不仅需要调试，更需要性能分析。语义操作栈与递归操作分割使性能分析适配智能体轨迹，AgentPProf 以实用成本实现了资源归因、问题定位与 token 成本优化，工具已开源。

Abstract: AI agents increasingly orchestrate long-running activities with users, tools, and system resources for days and weeks. To improve agent quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers need to determine where failures happen, what triggers unsafe effects, and which tasks consume the most budget, then optimize those tasks. In systems software, profiling answers similar questions by aggregating resource consumption and attributing it to responsible code paths to identify hotspots. Yet existing agent observability tools focus on per-execution debugging and tracing rather than cross-run, long term profiling, making these questions difficult to answer at scale. Agent observability needs profiling, not only debugging, but profiling agents is challenging: the responsible entities are task intent like diagnose authentication, compare branches rather than code paths, and lack stable identifiers for aggregation. We propose a semantic operation stack model that adapts profiling to agent trajectories. Uniform operations represent all activities, and operation stacks replace the runtime call stack, enabling hierarchical attribution at different granularities. We observe that an agent's task occupies a contiguous span and decomposes into subtasks, so we introduce recursive operation segmentation, which recursively splits trajectories at task boundaries. AgentPProf is a profiler that aggregates agent trajectories into pprof-compatible profiles, enabling flame graph visualization and analysis. AgentPProf reaches 0.764 $B^3$ F1 against human annotations on CodeTraceBench. On three problem-localization benchmarks, the profile raises MAP by up to 56%, demonstrating that it effectively attributes resources, locates problems, and helps optimize token cost at practical profiling cost. AgentPProf is available at https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agentsight.

</details>


### [249] [Diagnose, Recover, Certify: Task Readiness under Hidden Dynamics Changes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20304)
*Nguyen Viet Tuan Kiet,Huynh Thi Thanh Binh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出"潜伏动力学漂移下的任务就绪性"决策问题，并给出基于干预的贝叶斯方法EG-MPT，在有限交互预算下统一进行故障定位与恢复控制，输出带校准性能下界的策略或拒答到安全回退。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署后的控制策略可能掩盖动力学变化：若策略很少激励某执行器，其失效不影响当前任务，却会危及尚未指定的未来任务。因此需要在任务身份揭示前，用有限的、任务无关的交互预算预先诊断变化并准备恢复能力。

Method: 提出Evidence-Gated Matched-Pulse Transport（EG-MPT），一种基于干预的贝叶斯流程。它通过共享的匹配响应表示将故障定位与执行器有效性估计耦合，在保持诊断可靠性的同时把局部证据转化为与恢复相关的不确定性，并将该不确定性传播至任务条件策略选择与就绪性认证，从而显式权衡期望性能、置信度与回退使用。评测协议覆盖多模拟器的休眠执行器基准，将诊断与能力恢复分离，以就绪覆盖率、选择性风险、交互成本及回报进行评分。

Result: 在多模拟器的休眠执行器基准上验证框架；评测协议分离诊断与能力恢复，按就绪覆盖率、选择性风险和交互成本并连同回报计分，并识别出传输证据具有决定性作用的故障区制。

Conclusion: 该工作将变化诊断与变化后控制恢复统一为任务就绪性问题，提供可在下游任务未知时给出校准性能下界或安全拒答的部署决策框架，并明确了证据传输起决定性作用的故障条件。

Abstract: A deployed control policy can conceal consequential dynamics changes: an actuator may lose effectiveness without affecting the current task when the policy rarely excites it, despite being critical for a future task that has not yet been specified. We introduce task readiness under dormant dynamics drift, a decision problem that unifies active change diagnosis and post-change control recovery under a limited, task-agnostic interaction budget. An agent must identify whether and where local dynamics have changed, use a small number of informative interactions to characterize the change before downstream task identity is revealed, and subsequently provide each candidate task with either a recovered policy and a calibrated lower bound on its achievable return or an abstention decision to a safe fallback. We propose Evidence-Gated Matched-Pulse Transport, an intervention-based Bayesian procedure that couples fault localization with estimation of actuator effectiveness through a shared matched-response representation, thereby preserving diagnostic reliability while converting localized evidence into recovery-relevant uncertainty. This uncertainty is propagated to task-conditioned policy selection and readiness certification, enabling deployment decisions that explicitly trade off expected performance, confidence, and fallback use. We evaluate the resulting framework on a diverse suite of dormant-actuator benchmarks spanning multiple simulators, under a protocol that separates diagnosis from capability recovery, scores deployment by readiness coverage, selective risk, and interaction cost as well as return, and identifies the fault regimes in which transported evidence is decisive.

</details>


### [250] [NeuSOGA3D: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Explainable 3D Geometric Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20323)
*Qingde Li,Qingqi Hong,Zihan Li,Jie Tian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出NeuSOGA3D混合框架，将点云投影到主轴正交平面，用符号样条隐式表示并通过保形CSG运算融合生成粗视觉外壳，再借助截面分解与部分保形样条体式重建恢复细节，输出控制多边形、样条隐式场、截面与体积放样等显式符号实体，在ModelNet40全部40类上实现结构合理且CAD兼容的重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三维无序点云重建仍是计算机视觉、几何建模与CAD中的难题。神经隐式方法精度高，但几何被编码在潜在表示中，可解释性差，难以在工程工作流中复用。

Method: NeuSOGA3D（Neuro-Symbolic Geometric Abstraction in 3D）将NeuSOGA习得的感知先验与显式符号几何推理结合：把点云投影到主轴正交平面，从观测构建符号隐式样条表示，并通过保形构造实体几何（CSG）运算融合，得到粗视觉外壳；随后利用截面分解与Partial Shape-Preserving Splines进行体式重建以恢复额外几何细节。整个过程逐步把观测转化为可解释的显式符号实体。

Result: 在ModelNet40基准全部40个类别上的实验表明，该框架能够从多样化的点云观测中恢复具有结构意义且CAD兼容的几何表示。

Conclusion: 与常规神经隐式方法不同，NeuSOGA3D将观测逐步转换为控制多边形、隐式样条场、截面和体积放样等显式符号实体，展示了将学习感知与符号几何推理结合以实现可解释几何智能的潜力。

Abstract: Three-dimensional reconstruction from unorganized point clouds remains a challenging problem in computer vision, geometric modeling, and computer-aided design. While neural implicit methods achieve impressive reconstruction accuracy, geometry is typically encoded in latent representations that limit interpretability and reuse within engineering workflows.
  We present NeuSOGA3D (Neuro-Symbolic Geometric Abstraction in 3D), a hybrid framework that combines learned perceptual priors inherited from NeuSOGA with explicit symbolic geometric reasoning. The method projects point clouds onto principal orthographic planes, constructs symbolic implicit spline representations from the resulting observations, and fuses them through shape-preserving constructive solid geometry operations to generate a coarse visual hull. Additional geometric detail is recovered through cross-sectional decomposition and volumetric reconstruction using Partial Shape-Preserving Splines.
  Unlike conventional neural implicit approaches, NeuSOGA3D progressively transforms observations into explicit symbolic entities, including control polygons, implicit spline fields, cross-sections, and volumetric lofts. Experiments on all forty categories of the ModelNet40 benchmark demonstrate the ability of the framework to recover structurally meaningful and CAD-compatible geometric representations from diverse point-cloud observations. The results highlight the potential of combining learned perception with symbolic geometric reasoning for explainable geometric intelligence.

</details>


### [251] [Structured Four-Stage Legal Translation: From Natural-Language Traffic Rules to PROLOG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20334)
*May Myo Zin,Wachara Fungwacharakorn,Ken Satoh,Katsumi Nitta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出结构化四阶段法律翻译框架S4L→Prolog，将交通法规直接翻译为可执行Prolog逻辑，在20条真实交通规则基准上以75%的准确率优于NL→Prolog（60%）和LE→Prolog（55%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交通法规面向人类理解撰写，依赖共享背景知识与灵活措辞，天然带有歧义性、语境依赖性和语义欠指定，这与Prolog等计算推理引擎所需的精确显式逻辑结构相冲突。现有翻译方法难以弥合这一鸿沟，因此需要一种能直接、可靠地将自然语言法规转化为可执行逻辑的框架。

Method: 研究评估了两种基线方法：自然语言到Prolog（NL→Prolog）和逻辑英语到Prolog（LE→Prolog），并提出新的推理引导翻译框架——结构化四阶段法律翻译（S4L→Prolog）。该框架在单一引导提示中依次完成语义角色抽取、场景补全、逻辑映射和Prolog规则生成，无需人工干预即可将原始交通规则直接翻译为可执行逻辑，并以20条真实交通规则构建基准，从语法有效性、语义正确性和逻辑完整性三方面进行评估。

Result: S4L→Prolog取得最高准确率，正确形式化75%的规则；NL→Prolog为60%，LE→Prolog为55%。定性分析表明，S4L在捕捉隐含因果关系、道义模态和例外结构方面比基线方法更可靠。

Conclusion: 结构化推理提示可显著提升自然语言到逻辑翻译的可靠性，适用于法律和安全关键型应用。

Abstract: Traffic regulations are written for human interpretation and therefore rely on shared background knowledge and flexible phrasing, which inherently introduce ambiguity, context dependence, and semantic underspecification. These linguistic characteristics conflict with the precision required by computational reasoning engines such as Prolog, which demand explicit logical structure. This study evaluates two baseline translation approaches, Natural Language to Prolog ($NL\rightarrow Prolog$) and Logical English to Prolog ($LE\rightarrow Prolog$), and introduces a new reasoning-guided translation framework called Structured Four-Stage Legal Translation ($S4L\rightarrow Prolog$). The proposed S4L framework performs semantic role extraction, scene completion, logical mapping, and Prolog rule generation within a single guided prompt, enabling direct translation of raw traffic rules into executable logic without human intervention. A benchmark consisting of twenty real-world traffic rules was used to evaluate each approach in terms of syntactic validity, semantic correctness, and logical completeness. $S4L\rightarrow Prolog$ achieves the highest accuracy, correctly formalizing 75 percent of the rules, while $NL\rightarrow Prolog$ reaches 60 percent and $LE\rightarrow Prolog$ reaches 55 percent. Qualitative analysis further shows that S4L captures implicit causal relations, deontic modality, and exception structure more reliably than the baselines. These results demonstrate that structured reasoning prompts can substantially improve the reliability of natural-language-to-logic translation for legal and safety-critical applications.

</details>


### [252] [A Qualitative Model for Reasoning about Path and Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20349)
*Abhishek Jaiswal,Zoe Falomir*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合定性模型，用于积木解谜游戏Camelot Jr.，通过引入质心稳定性数学逻辑来指导定性求解器，实现类人且可解释的玩家引导，以促进儿童空间推理能力训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间推理能力与STEM领域表现高度相关，而游戏是训练儿童空间技能的有效媒介。但要实现类人化辅导与玩家引导，游戏需要能从空间事件中做出常识推理的AI智能体。

Method: 采用定性推理（QR）模型作为框架，因其以符号表示进行推理，可将游戏状态直接转化为可解释的反馈。针对Camelot Jr.，构建一个混合定性模型：整合基于数学的质心稳定性逻辑，用以指导定性求解器，应对该领域所需的精确物理判断。

Result: 该模型能够处理Camelot Jr.中的关键挑战，包括平台稳定性判断、路径规划，以及确保所有给定积木都被使用。

Conclusion: 该工作有助于在Camelot Jr.中开展空间技能训练，并推动以人为中心、可解释的游戏智能体发展。

Abstract: Spatial reasoning abilities correlate strongly with performance in STEM fields. Games offer a compelling medium for training these critical skills in developing children who have a natural proclivity for play. However, to facilitate human-like tutoring and player guidance, these games require an AI agent capable of making commonsense inferences from spatial events. Qualitative reasoning (QR) models appear to be a suitable framework for these application domains. As these models reason in symbolic representations, they can seamlessly translate game states into interpretable feedback for human-like player guidance. This paper introduces a hybrid qualitative model designed for Camelot Jr., a block-puzzle game that requires constructing multi-level bridges to connect two avatars stationed on separate towers. The game poses a challenge for the player, who must make platforms stable, plan their path, and ensure they use all the provided blocks. To handle the precise physics required by the domain, we integrate a mathematical center-of-mass stability logic to guide our qualitative solver. Our work facilitates spatial skill training in Camelot Jr. and contributes to the development of human-centric, explainable game-playing agents.

</details>


### [253] [Generating Heterogeneous 3D Geological Microstructures from 2D Images via a Stable Diffusion-Adversarial Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20358)
*Ali Aouf,Eric Laloy,Bart Rogiers,Christophe De Vleeschouwer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种混合扩散模型方法，利用对抗损失替代标准去噪损失，在无3D真值条件下由2D图像稳定生成复杂非均质微观结构3D体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黏土与胶凝材料物理性质的表征与模拟通常需要3D成像，但3D成像成本高、可及性差，且对某些材料存在技术限制。基于GAN（如SliceGAN）的方法在同质各向同性/各向异性体系表现良好，却难以捕捉更复杂非均质微观结构的细节，因此需要替代性生成框架。

Method: 提出一种混合方法，借助去噪扩散模型的稳定性与生成质量。由于缺乏3D真值，用对抗损失替代标准去噪损失，从而使训练过程稳定。模型从更易获取的2D图像重建3D体积。

Result: 实验表明，该模型能生成复杂度各异的微观结构，切片伪影极小，且生成结果的相分数与结构描述符与真值高度一致。

Conclusion: 该混合扩散-对抗框架为在缺乏3D真值情况下，从2D图像生成复杂异质微观结构提供了稳定有效的途径，优于SliceGAN在细节刻画方面的表现。

Abstract: Characterizing the physical properties of clay and cementitious materials matters across many fields, from materials science to geological waste disposal. Property simulation typically calls for 3D imaging, which is expensive, not always accessible, and technically limited for certain materials. Recent progress in deep generative models offers a way around this, reconstructing 3D volumes from the more easily acquired 2D images.
  Among GAN-based methods for 3D microstructure generation, SliceGAN has shown strong results for homogeneous isotropic and anisotropic systems. It struggles, however, to capture the finer detail of more complex heterogeneous microstructures, which motivates alternative generative frameworks.
  We introduce a hybrid approach that draws on the stability and generation quality of denoising diffusion models. Since no 3D ground truth is available, we replace the standard denoising loss with an adversarial loss, which yields a stable training process in our experiments. We show that the resulting model generates microstructures of varying complexity with minimal slice artefacts and close agreement with ground-truth phase fractions and structural descriptors.

</details>


### [254] [The Organization of Inference: Information, Resource Constraints, and AI Production](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20449)
*Yukun Zhang,Kemu Xu,Yishen Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过受控工作流实验揭示：AI推理的经济价值不仅取决于算力规模，更取决于任务信息在工作流各阶段的分布结构；规划环节的信息可见性可显著改变成功率的规模弹性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理的经济价值取决于算力与任务信息在AI生产各阶段的分布方式，但两者如何交互影响产出效率尚缺乏因果证据。作者希望厘清"规模决定可用能力、而工作流与信息结构决定生产价值"这一组织性边界。

Method: 在外部可验证的软件工程任务上开展受控工作流实验，设置两组匹配资源面板：直接执行（direct execution）与信息受限规划（information-constrained planning），分别在12,000与24,000逻辑token上限下对比成功率；并开展严格只读的规划实验，操纵规划者是否可见任务issue（issue access vs. issue-hidden）；采用任务簇bootstrap估计区间，并记录token使用的约束率（binding rate）与各阶段用量分解。

Result: 直接执行在12,000与24,000 token上限下成功率均为59.6%；信息受限规划的成功率由36.2%升至51.2%，规划劣势缩小15.0个百分点（95%任务簇bootstrap区间4.2–25.8）。在12,000 token下，可见issue使规划成功率较隐藏issue提高约16个百分点；相比直接执行，知情规划在12,000 token时低约10个百分点，但在24,000 token时反超29.6个百分点。直接执行的实际用量远低于任一上限，而规划工作流的约束率从46.2%降至0.8%，下游执行贡献了总用量增量的89.9%。

Conclusion: 规模（scale）决定系统可用的算力容量，而工作流结构与信息结构决定这些容量的生产价值；信息约束会削弱规划优势，且该劣势随算力预算扩大而收窄甚至反转，说明算力与信息分布存在互补关系。

Abstract: The economic value of inference depends on how capacity and task information are distributed across stages of AI production. We study these organizational margins using controlled workflow experiments on externally verified software-engineering tasks. In two matched resource panels, direct execution records the same success rate of 59.6 percent at logical-token ceilings of 12,000 and 24,000, while success under information-constrained planning rises from 36.2 to 51.2 percent. The planning disadvantage narrows by 15.0 percentage points (95 percent task-cluster bootstrap interval: 4.2 to 25.8). A strict read-only planning campaign varies whether the planner sees the task issue. At 12,000 tokens, issue access raises success by about 16 percentage points over issue-hidden planning. Compared with direct execution, task-informed planning is about 10 points lower at 12,000 tokens; at 24,000 tokens, it shows a 29.6-point advantage. In the resource panels, direct execution uses substantially less than either ceiling, while the planning workflow's binding rate falls from 46.2 to 0.8 percent and downstream execution accounts for 89.9 percent of the increase in total use. Scale determines the capacity available to a system; workflow and information structure shape the productive value

</details>


### [255] [SkillAA: Attribution-Guided Skill-Graph Updating with Targeted Validation and Rollback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20455)
*Ziqiao Shang,Ling-Yue Ge,Lan-Zhe Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 SkillAA 框架，用统一的技能图表示技能适用性、执行与组合，通过失败归因定位可编辑位置并做图范围验证，在冻结语言模型上取得显著效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有外部技能方法虽无需参数更新即可提供领域流程，但多直接从失败轨迹中编辑技能，缺乏从观测失败到可编辑位置的结构化路由；同时现有技能图在技能检索、定向更新和范围化验证上未充分利用语义边界、对象地址与拓扑依赖。

Method: SkillAA（Skill Abductive Attribution）将技能的适用性、执行与组合统一表示为图结构，同一结构支持技能选择、归因引导修复与更新验证；通过对比成功与失败执行，将候选修复路由到特定图对象，仅更新选定的局部结构，并用 Local Gate 与 Big Gate 在提交前筛选候选变更。

Result: 在 gpt-5.6-sol 上，SkillAA 在 SearchQA、LiveMath、DocVQA 上分别达到 81.5%、66.7%、91.2%，并在所有主要设置中取得最高观测均值。

Conclusion: 结果支持归因引导的图编辑与图范围验证的有效性。

Abstract: External skills provide domain procedures without parameter updates, but existing methods often edit skills directly from failed rollouts without structured routing from an observed failure to an editable location; existing skill graphs also underuse semantic boundaries, object addresses, and topological dependencies for skill retrieval, targeted updating, and scoped validation. We introduce SkillAA (Skill Abductive Attribution), a structured skill-optimization framework for frozen language models. It represents skill applicability, execution, and composition in a unified graph, allowing the same structure to support skill selection, attribution-guided repair, and update validation. SkillAA contrasts successful and failed executions to route candidate repairs to specific graph objects, updates only the selected local structure, and uses Local and Big Gates to screen candidate changes before commitment. With gpt-5.6-sol, SkillAA reaches 81.5%, 66.7%, and 91.2% on SearchQA, LiveMath, and DocVQA, respectively, and attains the highest observed mean in every main setting. These results support the utility of attribution-guided graph editing and graph-scoped validation.

</details>


### [256] [How Do Agent Harnesses Create Value? Planning Information and Release Control in Stateful LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20474)
*Yukun Zhang,Kemu Xu,Yishen Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在τ²-bench的两个Retail实验和一个Airline试点中，智能体框架的规划指导内容可显著提升任务成功率，只读终端验证器能以极低成本拦截大部分错误接受，且规划与验证的相对价值取决于对错误接受的损失设定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体框架（harness）提供规划指导、组织执行并检查完成情况，但这些组件各自对成功率、错误接受与成本的影响尚不清楚，需要拆解并量化各组件贡献。

Method: 在τ²-bench上开展两个Retail实验与一个Airline试点。核心对照为“预写任务专属计划（Fixed）”与“词数匹配的打乱策略文本（Sham）”，以隔离指导内容本身的作用；共265个匹配单元，采用90%任务聚类自助法区间、oracle验证成功率；另评估只读终端验证器对oracle无效/正确回合的接受与保留情况，并比较规划与验证组件的成本。

Result: 265个匹配单元中，Fixed使oracle验证成功率提高7.17个百分点（90%任务聚类自助区间1.15–13.36），增益集中在高复杂度任务。只读终端验证器拒绝61%的Retail oracle无效回合，同时保留17%的正确回合，每回合额外成本不足1美分。低责任设定下规划增益占优；高责任设定下验证器避免的误通过占优，且独立验证器以远低于完整“规划+验证”栈的成本获得了几乎全部避免误通过的收益。

Conclusion: 规划指导的内容质量对成功率有实质且任务复杂度相关的提升；验证器则是高性价比的错误接受拦截手段。哪个组件更重要取决于对错误接受赋予的损失：低责任时规划主导，高责任时验证主导，且独立验证器可作为完整栈的低成本替代方案。

Abstract: Agent harnesses supply planning guidance, organize execution, and check completion. We study how these components affect success, erroneous acceptance, and cost in two Retail experiments and an Airline pilot in $τ^2$-bench. The primary comparison pairs prewritten task-specific plans (Fixed) with shuffled policy text matched in word count (Sham), isolating the contribution of guidance content. Across 265 matched cells, Fixed improves oracle-verified success by 7.17 percentage points (90\% task-clustered bootstrap interval, 1.15--13.36 points), with gains concentrated in higher-complexity tasks. A read-only terminal verifier rejects 61\% of Retail oracle-invalid episodes while withholding 17\% of correct ones, at less than one cent of additional cost per episode. Which component matters more depends on the loss assigned to erroneous acceptance: at low liability the planning gain dominates; at high liability the verifier's avoided false passes dominate---and a standalone verifier captures nearly all the false-pass benefit of the full planning-plus-verification stack at a fraction of its cost.

</details>


### [257] [SoL-Pi: Recursively Scaling Auto-Research Loops for Efficient Agent Harness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20519)
*Haozhe Liu,Tian Ye,Sensen Gao,Qihang Cao,Yitong Li,Mingchen Zhuge,Duomin Wang,Ruihua Zhang,Ping Luo,Jiawang Bian,Lei Zhu,Ligeng Zhu,Enze Xie,Song Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 SoL-Pi，一种在 harness（智能体外壳）层进行自动搜索与优化、以提升 token 效率的编码智能体方案，在保持性能可比的同时显著降低 token 消耗与 API 成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体正从受监督的代码补全转向无人值守、全天候的自主探索，其工作形态由孤立预测扩展为包含推理、工具调用与反馈的长轨迹。此时 token 效率成为支撑递归自我改进（RSI）规模化的关键瓶颈，因此需要在 harness 层进行系统性优化。

Method: 采用受 RSI 启发的思路，在 harness 层扩展 auto-research 循环，在数量更多、更多样的环境中进行 harness  rollout。在该规模下筛选出可复用、可跨开发环境迁移的改进，最终形成包含四个机制的 SoL-Pi，覆盖动作执行、上下文压缩、观测处理与委托式阅读（delegated reading）。

Result: 在 51 项任务的 EdgeBench 评测上，SoL-Pi 在 GPT-5.6 Sol 与 Opus 5 上取得与 Pi 相当的性能，同时将记录的 token 流量降低 44.7%–49.0%，API 成本降低约三分之一。相较原生 Codex 与 Claude Code harness，估计每小时节省 \$8.75–\$13.50；相较 Pi 节省 \$4.36–\$5.71。

Conclusion: 在 harness 层通过大规模 auto-research 循环发现的可复用机制，能够在不牺牲性能的前提下大幅提升 token 效率与成本效益，推动自动化 harness 发现向生产级成果迈进。

Abstract: As coding agents move from supervised code completion to unattended, around-the-clock exploration, their work expands from isolated predictions into long trajectories of reasoning, tool use, and feedback. Token efficiency therefore becomes important for scaling recursive self-improvement. We take an RSI-inspired approach at the harness layer, scaling auto-research loops across increasingly numerous and diverse environments for harness rollouts. At this scale, the process yields reusable improvements that transfer beyond their development setting, moving automated harness discovery toward production-level outcomes. Four mechanisms survive selection and form SoL-Pi, spanning action execution, context compaction, observation handling, and delegated reading. On the 51-task EdgeBench evaluation, SoL-Pi achieves performance comparable to Pi across GPT-5.6 Sol and Opus 5 while reducing recorded token traffic by 44.7-49.0% and API cost by about one third. In other words, estimated hourly savings are \$8.75-\$13.50 relative to native Codex and Claude Code harnesses, and \$4.36-\$5.71 relative to Pi.

</details>


### [258] [FreqCondNorm: Towards Cross-domain Predictive Maintenance through a Frequency-Conditioned Transformer Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20535)
*Zaynab Raounak,Camille LHermine,Zhiguo Zeng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 FreqCondNorm：一种带 FiLM 风格频率条件归一化层的 Transformer 架构，用于统一异构采样频率的预测性维护时序；在多数据集上自监督预训练后，故障诊断迁移性能显著提升，但 RUL 预测未见改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习预测性维护模型跨机器、跨工况迁移性差，尤其在标注数据稀缺、信号采样频率跨越五个数量级（1 Hz 至约 100 kHz）时问题突出。现有模型难以在单一框架内统一处理如此异构的时序数据。

Method: 提出 FreqCondNorm，基于 Transformer 架构，引入 FiLM 风格的频率条件归一化层（frequency-conditioned normalization），将异构时序统一到单一模型中。在五个公开预测性维护数据集（CWRU、MFPT、UOC18、PRONOSTIA、CMAPSS）上，采用掩码自编码（masked auto-encoding）与对比学习（contrastive learning），并结合平衡域采样（balanced domain sampling）进行预训练。

Result: 故障诊断任务上：CWRU 达到 99.2% 准确率（较 CNN 提升 6.4 个百分点）；MFPT 零样本准确率达 82.1%，表明跨采样频率迁移能力较强。但在剩余使用寿命（RUL）预测任务上未取得改进。

Conclusion: 频率条件归一化可有效统一跨采样频率的异构信号，显著提升故障诊断的迁移与零样本性能；但方法对 RUL 预测无效，提示预训练目标与 RUL 任务目标之间存在不匹配，需在未来工作中进一步研究。

Abstract: Deep learning predictive maintenance models suffer from poor transferability across machines and operating conditions, especially when labelled data are scarce and signals span five orders of magnitude in sampling frequency (1 Hz to ~100 kHz). We propose FreqCondNorm, a Transformer-based architecture that introduces a FiLM-style frequency-conditioned normalization layer to unify heterogeneous time-series within a single model. The architecture is pretrained on five public predictive maintenance datasets (CWRU, MFPT, UOC18, PRONOSTIA, CMAPSS) using masked auto-encoding and contrastive learning with balanced domain sampling. On fault diagnosis, the model achieves 99.2% accuracy on CWRU (+6.4 pp over CNN) and 82.1% zero-shot accuracy on MFPT, demonstrating strong transfer across sampling frequencies. However, the approach does not improve remaining useful life prediction, suggesting a mismatch between pretraining and RUL objectives that warrants future investigation.

</details>


### [259] [Refuse, Decompose, Refresh: A Claim-Safe Protocol for Closed-Loop AI Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20538)
*Peiying Zhu,Sidi Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"claim-safe"协议（Refuse/Decompose/Refresh三步），在闭环AI评测中把弃权、运行时准入、结构性假设分开报告，而非给出单一PASS/FAIL结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 完美可复现的AI评测仍可能支撑错误结论，闭环系统中策略决定被访问状态、可见组件与可测失败痕迹，风险尤为突出。

Method: 协议含三动作：Refuse（缺乏干净参考流或匹配的运行时比较时弃权）、Decompose（分别报告协议执行、操作级误纳与结构性假设）、Refresh（将分布漂移警报视为失效并重算参考图的请求而非故障证据）。在仅聚合模拟器中实例化：24个策略组件、3种需求情形、2类故障掩蔽族、独立的开发与留出种子；预注册留出集含1,440个案例与21,600行分区。

Result: 仅55/72个情形-组件单元通过参考准入，其中54/55保持运行时准入，弃权成为结果的一部分；稳定误纳为0/20已代表组件，单侧精确95%上界0.1391（冻结0.20规则下）。在准入单元内，受影响干净流量比名义故障单元占比更具预测力：540个单元-臂行嵌套于20个组件簇，单元减流量的负对数似然差为0.1264 nats/行，95%组件簇区间[0.0593, 0.1918]。漂移日志显示干净故障零流在三种情形下分别触发15/15、0/15、14/15警报，仅中间情形与冻结检测器参考相符，说明"零假设"必须相对于参考。

Conclusion: 结论不是给出通用阈值，而是提供一份可执行契约，将可观测支持、统计校准与有据主张相连接。

Abstract: An AI evaluation can be perfectly reproducible and still support the wrong claim. This risk is acute in closed-loop systems: policy determines visited states, observable components, and which failures leave a measurable trace. We propose a claim-safe protocol with three actions. Refuse: abstain when a clean reference stream or matched runtime comparison lacks support. Decompose: report protocol execution, operational false admission, and structural hypotheses separately rather than as one PASS/FAIL label. Refresh: treat distribution-shift alarms as requests to invalidate and recompute a reference map, not as fault evidence. We instantiate the protocol in an aggregate-only simulator with 24 policy components, three demand regimes, two fault-mask families, and independent development and heldout seeds. The preregistered heldout contains 1,440 cases and 21,600 partition rows. Only 55/72 regime-component units were reference-admitted and 54/55 remained runtime-admitted, making abstention part of the result. Stable false admission was 0/20 represented components, with a one-sided exact 95% upper bound of 0.1391 under a frozen 0.20 rule. Within admitted units, affected clean traffic outpredicted nominal fault-cell fraction: across 540 unit-arm rows nested in 20 component clusters, the cell-minus-traffic negative-log-likelihood difference was 0.1264 nats per row, with a 95% component-cluster interval of [0.0593, 0.1918]. A drift log shows why "null" must be reference-relative: clean fault-null streams triggered 15/15, 0/15, and 14/15 alarms across three regimes, while only the middle regime matched the frozen detector reference. Rather than a universal threshold, we contribute an executable contract linking observable support, statistical calibration, and justified claims.

</details>


### [260] [Limits of Confidence in Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20581)
*Russ Webb,Amitis Shidani,Alice Bizeul,Dan Busbridge*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文指出离散扩散采样器（remasking 与 uniform-state）每一步并行写入多个 token 的机制，仅在所写位置在已固定 token 条件下条件独立时才匹配训练分布，而一般领域 token 间存在依赖，故这类采样器存在固有缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散采样器为提升效率，每步从各位置分布采样并同时写入多个位置。但像素、音素、词等一般领域中 token 之间存在固有依赖。作者试图从理论上厘清：这种"逐位置分布之积"式的并行写入，究竟在何种条件下才能保证采样分布与训练分布一致，并揭示其根本局限。

Method: 作者采用理论分析与构造性论证相结合的方法：证明一个步骤匹配训练分布当且仅当所写位置在给定已固定 token 时条件独立；证明任何逐位置分布之积都无法匹配一个依赖组；并构造性说明逐位置分布不能决定一组是否依赖——两个联合分布可拥有完全相同的逐位置边缘分布，却在哪些取值组合会出现上不同。随后在 ScanAndAdd 这一联合分布具闭式表达的合成任务上进行实验验证。

Result: 理论上证实：所写位置必须条件独立才能匹配训练分布，逐位置分布之积无法匹配依赖组，且逐位置分布不足以判定依赖关系。实验上，在 ScanAndAdd 上验证置信度排序所写入的每一组两个及以上未定位置都是依赖的；测得的生成分布总变差达到采样噪声下限的 29 倍，而逐样本指标却为 1.0，表明逐样本指标会掩盖分布层面的严重偏差。

Conclusion: 并行写入多个位置的离散扩散采样器在存在 token 依赖的一般领域中无法复现训练分布，其每步所写位置实为依赖组；逐位置分布不足以刻画依赖，且逐样本指标（如 1.0）会完全掩盖分布层面的误差（29× 噪声下限）。这提示需要能建模联合依赖的采样机制，并对生成质量采用分布层面的度量。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion, including remasking and uniform-state samplers, generate a sequence by writing multiple token positions per step, drawing each from a per-position distribution and choosing which positions to write from those same distributions. For domains of general interest (pixels, phonemes, or words) there are inherent dependencies between tokens. We show that a step matches the training distribution only when the positions it writes are conditionally independent given the tokens already fixed, that no product of per-position distributions can match a dependent group, and that per-position distributions do not determine whether a group is dependent: two joint distributions can have identical per-position marginals while differing in which combinations of values occur. On ScanAndAdd, a synthetic task whose joint distribution is available in closed form, we verify that every group of two or more undetermined positions a confidence ranking writes is dependent, and measure the generated distribution to be $29\times$ the sampling-noise floor total variation while per-sample metrics are $1.0$.

</details>


### [261] [Ownership in AI-Assisted Everyday Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20658)
*Megan Wei,Melanie Subbiah,Audrey Lee,Annya Dahmani,Dave Edwards,Helen Edwards,Ellie Pavlick*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文通过探索性质性问卷调查发现，人对AI辅助作品的“所有权感”取决于协作过程：亲自主导、迭代与改写则保有所有权，仅审核AI建议则丧失所有权；愿景归属、理解不足与个人表达流失亦影响所有权，且AI使用披露意愿更多受社群规范和署名焦虑驱动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI融入日常任务，需考察机器参与创作时人的所有权感与贡献感如何变化，以推动支持人们作者身份感的AI发展。

Method: 探索性质性问卷调查，要求参与者描述两项自选、近期借助AI完成的任务：一项感觉属于自己的，一项不属于自己的，并进行对比分析。

Result: 所有权感取决于协作过程：仅批准AI建议会失去所有权，主导、迭代或重写则保留；当人拥有项目愿景而非执行时所有权仍可延伸，甚至对独立无法完成的任务报告高所有权；个人声音的丧失与对输出的不理解会削弱所有权；披露AI使用的意愿常与自豪感/所有权脱钩，而受社群规范与对署名被抹除的担忧影响。

Conclusion: 提出若干研究方向，以促进支持人们在自身生活中作者身份感的AI开发。

Abstract: When does work done with AI still feel like ours? As AI becomes woven into everyday tasks, we must examine what happens to our sense of ownership and contribution when a machine shares in producing what we make. We report an exploratory qualitative survey in which participants were asked to describe two recent, self-selected tasks completed with AI: one that felt like their own and one that did not. We find that felt ownership depends on the process of collaboration: people disown work when they merely approve AI's suggestions, but retain ownership when they lead, iterate, or rewrite. Ownership can also extend to settings where people own the vision for a project but not the execution; respondents reported high ownership on tasks they could not have completed without AI. Loss of personal voice and a lack of comprehension of the output both erode ownership. Finally, willingness to disclose AI use is often decoupled from actual pride or ownership, and instead shaped by community norms and fear of credit erasure. We propose several research directions as a result of these findings to promote AI development that supports people's sense of authorship over their own lives.

</details>


### [262] [Deep Noir: Autonomous Steering Discovery via Architectural Chronometry in Transformer Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20722)
*Frank E. Bobe,Gregory D. Vetaw,Darshan W. Bryner,Matthew G. Cook,Jose L. Salas-Vernis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Deep Noir 框架利用 Logit Lens 收敛与因果注意力头归因，自动发现最优激活引导参数，在多任务多架构上实现显著性能提升，并揭示引导幅度的提示注入攻击面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活引导（Activation Steering）能在推理阶段修改大模型行为，但其干预位置与强度需要人工设定，缺乏自动化手段，限制了其可扩展性与跨任务、跨架构的泛化能力。

Method: 提出 Deep Noir 框架：结合 Logit Lens 收敛分析与因果层面的注意力头归因，自主定位并确定最优引导参数（位置与强度），无需修改代码即可迁移至新任务。在三种规模（1B×3、2-3B×2、7-9B×4）上验证，并与 RepE（无头掩码）等方法对比。

Result: 1B 规模下垃圾邮件任务提升 16.7 个百分点（标准差 4.7，39 次运行）；7-9B 在四种架构上提升 21-42 个百分点。SST-2 情感任务提升 13.1 个百分点且零代码改动。情感任务中 RepE 无头掩码未能超过基线，而 Deep Noir 对所有模型均有提升（p<0.01）。同时发现引导会形成可预测的提示注入攻击面，其脆弱性随引导幅度单调增加。

Conclusion: 机制性归因可支撑干预点的自动化发现，且具备跨任务、跨架构的泛化能力；同时提示部署已引导分类器的智能体系统需警惕随幅度增长的注入攻击风险。

Abstract: Activation steering modifies LLM behavior at inference time, but identifying where and how strongly to steer remains manual. We introduce Deep Noir, a framework that uses Logit Lens convergence and causal head-level attribution to autonomously discover optimal steering parameters. Across three scales (1B x 3, 2-3B x 2, and 7-9B x 4), our engine achieves 16.7 percentage-point improvement on spam at 1B (standard deviation 4.7; 39 runs), with gains increasing to 21 to 42 percentage points at 7-9B across four architectures. On SST-2 sentiment, it achieves a 13.1 percentage-point improvement with zero code changes. Mechanistic grounding enables automated discovery of intervention points that generalize across tasks and architectures. On sentiment, RepE without head masking fails to improve over baseline, while Deep Noir improves all models (p less than 0.01). We further show that steering creates a predictable prompt-injection attack surface whose vulnerability increases monotonically with steering magnitude. This finding is relevant to agent systems deploying steered classifiers.

</details>


### [263] [Q&A on Any Spreadsheet Requires Interpreting Its Grid Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20732)
*Zofia Smoleń*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出基于单元格角色标注的电子表格分块框架，虽超越现有方法，但受限于离散分类的固有天花板；作者主张应转向降维技术，将2D非结构化表格直接展平为1D文本以突破瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的RAG系统处理电子表格时存在瓶颈：表格是二维非结构化数据，关系连续且单元格角色无限，而现有分类模型只能处理有限预定义类别，无法完美刻画其结构细微差别，因此需要重新思考表格到LLM的转换路径。

Method: 提出一个新框架，利用单元格角色标注（cell role annotation）将任意电子表格拆分为可解释的分块，并以此作为语义单元格标注手段。

Result: 该框架超越了当前最先进方法（state of the art），语义单元格标注提升了分块的可解释性，通过丰富上下文而非提升检索准确率来辅助答案生成；但该方法面临硬性上限，无法完美捕捉表格结构细节。

Conclusion: 解决电子表格到LLM的瓶颈需要超越离散单元格分类，转而发展降维技术，将2D非结构化电子表格直接展平为1D非结构化文本，使文本分块更易被下游RAG解释与生成。

Abstract: Semantic cell annotation improves chunking interpretability for spreadsheets in LLM-driven RAG systems, aiding answer generation through enriched context rather than improved retrieval accuracy. We propose a novel framework of splitting any spreadsheet into interpretable chunks using cell role annotation. Our framework beats the state of the art, yet it faces a hard ceiling. Spreadsheets are fundamentally two-dimensional unstructured data with continuous relationships and infinite potential cell roles. Because classification models are restricted to finite, pre-defined classes, they cannot perfectly capture this structural nuance, even with human-level annotation. We show that addressing the spreadsheet-to-LLM bottleneck requires moving beyond discrete cell classification. Instead, the field must develop dimensionality-reduction techniques to directly flatten 2D unstructured spreadsheets into 1D unstructured text. Text chunks would be easier for downstream RAG to interpret and generate from.

</details>


### [264] [RAFT: A Stateful Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Troubleshooting Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20754)
*Mingxuan Zhang,Xiaowen Wang,Anupma Sharan,Zhengyi Chen,Chenyu Diana Zhang,Shanshan Yang,Chittibabu Pacharu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RAFT 是一个有状态的检索增强生成框架，将历史支持案例抽象为时间线条目链并在条目级检索，使活跃案例的中间状态能匹配到历史案例对应状态并返回其后续轨迹；在合成 Windows Server 基准和真实 Apache Jira 重复标签数据上，各阶段 Case Hit 均优于 vanilla RAG 与 GraphRAG 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业客户支持中的排障代理依赖从相似历史案例中检索可执行指引，但现有 RAG 系统将支持案例当作静态文档处理，忽视了其多阶段、有状态的特征，导致难以在案例进展到某一中间状态时找到真正有用的对应知识。

Method: 提出 RAFT（Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Troubleshooting Agents）：把每个已关闭历史案例抽象为有向时间线条目链，在条目级进行检索，从而召回中间状态与当前活跃案例相匹配的案例，并返回以匹配状态为锚点的父案例轨迹；另设可选的案例级图，通过可配置的相似度表示连接案例。评估直接针对检索层，无需生产部署。

Result: 由于公开的多阶段排障数据极度稀缺，作者构建了基于 Microsoft Learn Windows Server 文档的合成基准，并搭配带人工重复标签的真实 Apache Jira 问题数据。RAFT 在案例进展的每个阶段都提升了 Case Hit，相对最强基线具有统计显著增益；Jira 结果提供方向性证据，表明该优势可迁移至真实案例历史。

Conclusion: RAFT 通过状态化、条目级的检索建模多阶段排障案例，显著优于 vanilla RAG 与 GraphRAG；作者公开基准、实现及 Apache Jira 评估集，为后续研究提供资源。

Abstract: Effective troubleshooting agents in enterprise customer support depend on retrieving actionable guidance from similar historical cases, yet existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems treat support cases as static documents and overlook their multi-stage, stateful nature. We introduce RAFT (Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Troubleshooting Agents), a stateful RAG framework that abstracts each closed historical case into a directed chain of timeline entries and retrieves at the entry level, surfacing cases whose intermediate states match the active case and returning the parent-case trajectory anchored at the matched state; an optional case-level graph links cases through a configurable similarity representation. We evaluate this retrieval layer directly, which, unlike evaluating a full agent system, requires no production deployment. Because public multi-stage troubleshooting data is extremely rare, we pair a synthetic benchmark built from Microsoft Learn Windows Server documentation with real Apache Jira issues carrying human-created duplicate labels. RAFT improves Case Hit over vanilla RAG and GraphRAG baselines at every stage of case progress, with statistically significant gains over the strongest baseline; the Jira results provide directional evidence that the advantage transfers to real case histories. We release our benchmark, implementation, and the Apache Jira evaluation set.

</details>


<div id='cs.SD'></div>

# cs.SD [[Back]](#toc)

### [265] [A State-Space Model of Figured-Bass Realization: Local Constraints, Coupled Voices, and Polynomial-Time Solvability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19397)
*Evan Unit Lim*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文对限定风格的四声部数字低音实现问题建立显式数学模型，将各类规则表达为谓词，区分硬约束与可选偏好代价，并以分层图路径刻画合法进行，证明其可行性与最小代价实现在多项式时间内可解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字低音实现本质上是在每个和弦内部及相邻和弦之间进行一系列受约束的选择，但缺乏明确的数学形式化描述，难以分析其计算复杂度与优化性质。

Method: 将音高拼写、音域、和弦音归属、重复、省略、排列间距、交叉、重叠、旋律进行、连续完全音程及部分解决要求等表达为谓词；区分硬约束与可选偏好代价；把四个带标签的音表示为四边形顶点，并在计算上表示为一个有序声部状态；合法进行对应分层图中的路径。

Result: 证明在声部数固定、音符域显式有限且局部规则固定时，可行性与最小代价实现均为多项式时间问题；当音域、音符字母表固定并采用相邻事件规则时，图操作数与事件数呈线性关系；并以二拍、四拍和八拍实例说明合法性、优化以及贪心选择失效的情形。

Conclusion: 结果为所给出的形式化模型提供计算复杂性结论，而非断言所有音乐判断都能由局部谓词完全刻画。

Abstract: Figured-bass realization can be described as a sequence of choices constrained both within each sonority and between successive sonorities. This paper gives an explicit mathematical model of a restricted, examination-style four-part realization problem. Pitch spelling, range, chord membership, doubling, omission, spacing, crossing, overlap, melodic motion, consecutive perfect intervals, and selected resolution requirements are expressed as predicates. We distinguish hard constraints from optional preference costs. Four labeled notes are represented visually as the vertices of a quadrilateral and computationally as one ordered voicing state. Legal progressions become paths through a layered graph. We prove that feasibility and minimum-cost realization are polynomial-time problems for a fixed number of voices with explicit finite note domains and fixed local rules. For fixed ranges, a fixed note alphabet, and adjacent-event rules, the number of graph operations is linear in the number of events. Worked two-, four-, and eight-beat examples illustrate legality, optimization, and the failure of a greedy choice. The result concerns the stated formal model; it is not a claim that every musical judgment is captured by local predicates.

</details>


### [266] [A Cross-Lingual Acoustic Disease-Alignment Framework for Respiratory Health Assessment from Spontaneous Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19398)
*Roksana Khanom,Raghib Asfak Tasnim,Bodrun Nahar Bithi,Shafia Shirin Supty,Saiful Islam Raju,Ashok Agrawala,Nirupam Roy*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出跨语言疾病对齐框架CL-DAF，从自发语音中筛选疾病效应跨语言一致的声学维度，实现英语与孟加拉语间COPD识别的有效迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自发语音可作为可扩展、非侵入的呼吸健康评估信号，但疾病相关声学变化与语言特异性音位变异相互混淆，导致可解释模型难以跨语言泛化。

Method: 构建272维通用声学表示；使用带符号秩双列效应量与语言不变性得分量化疾病对齐程度；基于201名英语与75名新采集孟加拉语说话者，筛选跨语言疾病效应方向一致的声学特征。

Result: 孟加拉语自发语音可区分COPD与对照（AUC 0.85）；但133个特征疾病方向跨语言反转，全表示迁移差（孟加拉语到英语AUC 0.49）；CL-DAF选出26个疾病对齐特征，使英语到孟加拉语、孟加拉语到英语AUC分别提升至0.825与0.722。

Conclusion: 该框架为强调病理而非语言依赖变异的 multilingual 临床语音模型奠定基础。

Abstract: Spontaneous speech offers a scalable, noninvasive signal for respiratory health assessment, yet interpretable models that generalize across languages remain challenging because disease-related acoustic changes are confounded by language-specific phonetic variation. We present CL-DAF, a Cross-Lingual Disease-Alignment Framework that identifies acoustic dimensions whose disease effects remain consistent across languages. Using 201 English and 75 newly collected Bangla speakers, we construct a common 272-dimensional acoustic representation and quantify disease alignment using signed rank-biserial effects and the Language Invariance Score. We first show that spontaneous Bangla speech separates COPD from controls (AUC 0.85); however, 133 features reverse their disease direction across languages and the full representation transfers poorly (AUC 0.49 from Bangla to English). CL-DAF isolates 26 disease-aligned features that raise AUCs to 0.825 and 0.722 from English to Bangla and Bangla to English, respectively. These findings provide a foundation for multilingual clinical speech models emphasizing pathology over language-dependent variation.

</details>


### [267] [CoRELoop: Parameter-Efficient Controlled Recurrent Refinement for Audio Deepfake Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19818)
*Kunyu Feng,Yuxiang Wang,Li Wang,Wan Lin,Zhizheng Wu*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出 CoReLoop，一种在已训练 SSL 音频深伪检测器上进行的循环精炼方法，无需新数据、不改原参数，仅训练轻量模块与低秩适配器，即可提升跨域泛化并支持按话语自适应选择精炼深度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音频深伪检测器泛化到未见攻击类型仍然困难，而收集覆盖所有潜在攻击的训练数据不现实，因此需要一种在不增加数据、不改变已有检测器原始参数的前提下提升泛化的方法。

Method: 作者探索在已训练的 SSL 检测器上进行循环精炼。诊断发现直接把编码器输出回收作为输入会导致检测性能下降。为此提出 CoReLoop：使循环输入适配冻结编码器、控制状态更新、并将精炼输出与冻结分类器对齐。仅在原始数据上训练轻量精炼模块与循环专用的低秩适配器（LoRA），在保留检测器首轮预测的同时实现额外精炼。可选地引入 halting head 为每条话语选择精炼深度。

Result: 在 14 个跨域测试集上，24 层模型经两轮精炼将 pooled EER 从 4.85% 降至 3.74%，可训练参数约 10M（总参数 598M）。使用 halting head 自适应选择深度时，达到 3.73% pooled EER，平均仅需 1.18 轮。

Conclusion: 通过适配输入、控制状态更新与对齐输出的循环精炼设计，可在冻结的 SSL 深伪检测器上以极少可训练参数有效提升跨域泛化；halting head 进一步实现低成本的自适应精炼深度选择。

Abstract: Generalizing to unseen attacks remains challenging for audio deepfake detectors, and collecting training data covering all potential attacks is impractical. We explore recurrent refinement in an already-trained SSL-based detector without additional data or changes to its original parameters. However, directly recycling encoder outputs as inputs degrades detection in our diagnostic. We propose CoReLoop, which makes this reuse effective by adapting recurrent inputs to the frozen encoder, controlling state updates, and aligning refined outputs with the frozen classifier. By training only lightweight refinement modules and loop-specific low-rank adapters on the original data, CoReLoop enables additional refinement while preserving the detector's original first-pass prediction. On 14 cross-domain test sets, the 24-layer model reduces pooled equal error rate (EER) from 4.85% to 3.74% with two passes, with approximately 10M trainable parameters out of 598M. To selectively apply this refinement, an optional halting head chooses the depth for each utterance, achieving 3.73% pooled EER with an average of 1.18 passes.

</details>


### [268] [Robust Workflow Generation via Adversarial Learning for Audio Deepfake Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20063)
*Xiang Li,Pin-Yu Chen,Wenqi Wei*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出ROGUE框架，通过双智能体对抗学习动态编排多检测工具，提升音频深伪检测在真实扰动下的鲁棒性与泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音合成与语音转换技术快速发展使音频深伪日益逼真，带来严重安全风险。现有检测方法在受控条件下表现良好，但在真实世界的扰动与损坏下泛化能力不足，亟需提升鲁棒性的检测方案。

Method: ROGUE将检测工作流生成建模为序贯决策问题，采用双智能体范式：扰动智能体生成音频扰动，策略智能体学习在扰动条件下选择并执行检测工具；通过对抗学习实现扰动感知的工具选择、自适应执行策略以及对分布偏移的鲁棒性，从而动态构建鲁棒检测工作流。

Result: 在多个数据集和真实世界损坏条件下的广泛实验表明，ROGUE在鲁棒性和泛化性上均持续优于强基线方法。

Conclusion: 结果凸显了对抗优化工作流生成在构建面向真实部署场景的可靠音频深伪检测系统方面的有效性。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of speech synthesis and voice conversion technologies has made audio deepfakes increasingly realistic, posing serious security risks in practical applications. While existing detection methods achieve strong performance under controlled conditions, they often fail to generalize under real-world perturbations and corruptions. In this paper, we propose ROGUE, a framework that dynamically constructs robust detection workflows by orchestrating multiple detection tools. ROGUE formulates workflow generation as a sequential decision-making problem and introduces a dual-agent paradigm, where a perturbation agent generates audio perturbations and a policy agent learns to select and execute detection tools under perturbed conditions. Through adversarial learning, ROGUE enables perturbation-aware tool selection, adaptive execution strategies, and improved robustness to distribution shifts. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and real-world corruptions demonstrate that ROGUE consistently outperforms strong baselines in both robustness and generalization. Our results highlight the effectiveness of adversarially optimized workflow generation for building reliable audio deepfake detection systems in real-world deployment settings.

</details>


### [269] [CircleMatch: Prototype Matching with Circular Temporal Statistics for Tiny Keyword Spotting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20070)
*Jiajun Sun,Zhe Gao*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出CircleMatch，一种极低参数量的关键词识别（KWS）匹配框架，其编码器分频带压缩并融合为帧特征，再与类原型匹配生成时间响应曲线，并用无参数循环聚合将时间编码为角度进行分类。其四个微型变体（约1k–7k参数）在Speech Commands v1/v2及多语种语料库子集上取得有竞争力的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在语音唤醒等场景中，KWS需在严格参数预算下保持高精度，且要适应不同词表规模，现有方法难以兼顾极小参数量与高准确率。

Method: 提出CircleMatch匹配框架：编码器独立压缩各频带并融合为帧级特征；将帧特征与可学习的类别原型匹配，产生时间响应曲线；采用无参数的循环聚合，把时间编码为角度，汇总响应分布与相对时序用于分类。设计Circle-D4/D8/D16/D32四个微型变体，12类设置下参数量约1k至7k。

Result: 在Speech Commands v1/v2以及Multilingual Spoken Words Corpus的英语、西班牙语Micro子集上，多随机种子实验显示其以极小模型达到有竞争力的识别精度。定性分析表明原型响应近似具有平移等变性，并能适应时间压缩。

Conclusion: CircleMatch以极少参数实现有竞争力的KWS性能，验证了原型匹配结合循环时序聚合的有效性；原型响应的近似平移等变性与时间压缩适应性为其优势来源。代码与模型权重已开源。

Abstract: Keyword spotting (KWS), the task of identifying predefined words in speech, is a core capability of voice-enabled devices. Achieving high KWS accuracy under tight parameter budgets across different vocabulary sizes remains challenging. We present CircleMatch, a matching framework enabling KWS with very few parameters. Its encoder independently compresses frequency bands and fuses them into frame features. These features are then matched against learned class-specific prototypes to produce temporal response curves. Parameter-free circular aggregation encodes time as angles and summarizes response distributions and relative timing for classification. We develop four tiny variants, Circle-D4, Circle-D8, Circle-D16, and Circle-D32, ranging from approximately 1k to 7k parameters in the 12-class setting. Experiments with multiple random seeds on Speech Commands v1/v2 and the English and Spanish Micro subsets of the Multilingual Spoken Words Corpus demonstrate competitive accuracy with tiny models. Our qualitative analysis further suggests approximate shift equivariance of prototype responses and adaptation to temporal compression. Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/ora942878/CircleMatch.

</details>


### [270] [Multi-Dimensional Prosody Judgment For Live Streaming Speech Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20124)
*Zifan Guan,Longyu Lu,Junan Zhang,Zhizheng Wu,Meiguang Jin,Junfeng Ma*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出LPJ与D-LPJ，从Gemini蒸馏出低成本成对评测器用于流式TTS细粒度韵律评估，并解决"判定耦合"问题，在人工标注测试集与Best-of-8选择任务中验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式直播TTS评测需捕捉情感、语调、能量等细粒度且高表现力的韵律，传统MOS预测器无法胜任；Gemini等专有LLM虽可评测但推理成本过高，难以支撑大规模推理与强化学习反馈。

Method: 先提出Live-ProsodyJudge(LPJ)，将Gemini蒸馏进Qwen3-Omni作为低成本成对评测器；针对多维评测中的"判定耦合"缺陷，进一步提出D-LPJ：移除总体判定目标以防盲目跟随、在SFT阶段掩码不确定的配对维度、并引入span-local GRPO，将归一化优势严格作用于对应理由片段。

Result: 在精心构建的人工标注测试集上，10样本均衡顺序的LPJ点准确率高于单次Gemini调用；D-LPJ能产生独立且解耦的维度判断。在Best-of-8 TTS候选选择锦标赛中，LPJ选出的语句在高置信度情况下有85.29%落入人类前三。

Conclusion: 蒸馏式成对评测器可在低成本下实现优于专有LLM的细粒度韵律评测，且通过解耦设计恢复多维评分的独立性，验证了其用于细粒度TTS偏好优化的有效性。

Abstract: Evaluating live streaming speech synthesis (TTS) requires assessing fine-grained, highly expressive prosody such as emotion, intonation, and energy which traditional MOS predictors fail to capture. While proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs) like Gemini can evaluate these aspects, they are too costly for massive inference and reinforcement learning feedback. To address this, we first introduce Live-ProsodyJudge (LPJ), a cost-effective pairwise evaluator distilled from Gemini into Qwen3-Omni. However, we identify a critical flaw in standard multi-dimensional evaluation: verdict coupling. The judge tends to lazily align all individual dimension scores with its overall preference, collapsing a rich multi-dimensional rubric into a single preference bit. To resolve this, we further propose Decoupled-Live-ProsodyJudge (D-LPJ). D-LPJ eliminates the overall verdict target to prevent blind following, masks uncertain pair-dimensions during Supervised Fine-Tuning(SFT), and introduces a novel span-local GRPO strategy that applies normalized advantages strictly to their corresponding rationale spans. Evaluated on highly curated human-annotated test sets, 10 sample balanced-order LPJ achieves higher point accuracy than a single Gemini call, while D-LPJ successfully produces independent,decoupled dimension judgments. Furthermore, in a Best-of-8 TTS candidate selection tournament, the LPJ-selected utterance falls within the human top-3 in 85.29% of high-confidence cases, demonstrating its efficacy for fine-grained TTS preference optimization.

</details>


### [271] [Music Hallucination in Audio-Language Models: A Hierarchical Formulation and Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20195)
*Yu Liu,Jiahui Liu,Zhilin Liu,Cong Cao,Fangfang Yuan,Yuling Yang,Pin Xu,Yanbing Liu*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文首次针对音频-语言模型的音乐幻觉开展分层、多范式的实证研究，将其形式化为五个层级的感知接地失败，并提出MuseDiag诊断框架与两种免训练缓解方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音频-语言模型日益生成自信但缺乏音频依据的音乐描述（幻觉），而现有研究缺乏面向音乐领域、分层且多范式的系统性诊断手段，导致幻觉的成因与缓解效果难以被准确刻画。

Method: 将音乐幻觉形式化为跨五个层级（声音事件、时间属性、音调属性、风格、情感）的层级式感知接地失败；提出多范式诊断框架MuseDiag，采用基于矛盾的验证方式；评测九个模型（四个开源、五个闭源）；提出两种免训练缓解方法——面向音乐的音频依赖性感知解码（ADD-M）与分类体系引导的感知锚定（TPA）。

Result: （1）人声误感知在九个模型中普遍存在，音调感知是架构差异的主要轴，Audio-Flamingo-3稳定领先，其下模型排序大幅变化，揭示范式特异的脆弱性画像；（2）肯定性偏差、生成模式效应与层级特异的感知局限均与观测模式经验相关，多分析汇聚证据但不作严格因果归因；（3）ADD-M与TPA可在探测任务中降低幻觉，但增益随模型而异，且往往无法迁移到自由生成。

Conclusion: 音乐幻觉是多层级、范式依赖的现象；缓解方法必须在多范式下评估，仅靠探测任务的改进不足以代表自由生成场景的有效性，为后续诊断与缓解研究提供了分层框架与评测规范。

Abstract: Audio-language models increasingly generate confident music descriptions that are unsupported by the input audio. We present, to our knowledge, the first music-specific, layer-wise, multi-paradigm empirical study of hallucination in audio-language models and formulate it as a hierarchical perceptual grounding failure across five layers: sound events, temporal properties, tonal attributes, style, and emotion. We introduce MuseDiag, a multi-paradigm diagnostic framework with contradiction-based verification, and evaluate nine models (four open-source and five closed-source). We find that (1) vocal misperception is a universal weakness across all nine models, tonal perception is a major axis of architectural differentiation, and Audio-Flamingo-3 remains the stable leader while substantial reordering below it reveals paradigm-specific vulnerability profiles; (2) affirmative bias, generation-mode effects, and layer-specific perceptual limitations are each empirically associated with the observed patterns, with convergent evidence from multiple analyses rather than strict causal attribution; and (3) our two training-free mitigation methods, Audio-Dependency-Aware Decoding for Music (ADD-M) and Taxonomy-Guided Perceptual Anchoring (TPA), can reduce hallucination in probing, but their gains vary by model and often do not carry over to free-form generation, showing that music hallucination mitigation must be evaluated across paradigms.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [272] [Algebraic Retrieval: Composable Search for Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19482)
*Damian Delmas*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 代数检索允许AI智能体在查询时组合搜索策略，将相关性、资格约束与排序偏好表达为统一数学查询；论文在PEM基础上评估执行一致性，验证多实现的等价性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统检索接口固定，智能体难以在查询时自由组合相关性标准、资格约束与排序偏好。作者希望提供可组合的数学查询表面，使智能体可检查中间结果并修改检索程序，从而支持更灵活的检索策略编排。

Method: 基于Programmatic Embedding Modulation（PEM），在检索过程中暴露向量与分数的算术操作；将对比评分、候选池重排序、加权排序等表达为可组合查询，并提供可执行的SQL与PyTerrier对应实现。评估聚焦于执行一致性，而非智能体行为或检索质量。

Result: 在公开的Vaswani数据集（11,429篇文档）上，各程序的实现所选文档集合完全一致，分数差异低于1e-6；仅有一对同分文档在不同评分路径下排序不同。

Conclusion: 代数检索的可组合查询表面能够跨实现保持高度执行一致性，说明该抽象在多种执行后端上具有稳定性；同分对的排序差异提示需关注评分路径间的平局处理规则。

Abstract: Algebraic Retrieval lets AI agents compose search strategies at query time. Relevance criteria, eligibility constraints, and ranking preferences can be expressed together in a mathematical query. The query surface exposes available operations, so an agent can combine them for the question at hand and revise a program after inspecting results. We evaluate execution parity, not agent behavior or retrieval quality. Building on Programmatic Embedding Modulation (PEM), which exposes vector and score arithmetic during retrieval, we demonstrate contrastive scoring, candidate-pool reranking, and weighted ranking as composable queries, alongside executable SQL and PyTerrier counterparts. On the public 11,429-document Vaswani fixture, each program's implementations select the same document set with score differences below 1e-6; one tied pair orders differently across scoring paths.

</details>


### [273] [Beyond Similarity through Zero-Token Geometric Graphs for Multi-Hop RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19622)
*Zeliang Li,Xiaofen Xing,Kailing Guo,Xiangmin Xu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: G$^3$RAG 提出一种无需 LLM 调用的几何增益图 RAG 框架，用 $\cosθ\cdot\sinθ$ 边权、密度拓扑惩罚与单步受控扩散实现高效多跳证据检索，在多个基准上取得最优平均 F1 与命中率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多跳 RAG 需要证据既与查询相关又具备足够新颖性以跨越语义鸿沟。稠密检索易集中于语义相似文档；基于图的替代方案往往依赖昂贵的 LLM 实体抽取，并可能沿噪声连接传播。

Method: 提出 Geometric Gain Graph RAG（G$^3$RAG），离线构图不调用 LLM。为每条边赋予几何增益分数 $\cosθ\cdot\sinθ$，同时刻画文档表示间的方向一致性与正交性；引入密度感知拓扑惩罚抑制高度连接的枢纽节点；再从过滤后的查询种子出发，以单步受控扩散扩展至互补证据。

Result: 在 MusiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA、HotpotQA 上用 Nv-embed-v2 和 Qwen3-8B-embed 评估。G$^3$RAG 在两种嵌入设置下均取得所评估图基线中最优的平均 F1 与答案文档命中率，平均性能提升最高 4.26 个 F1 点，MusiQue 上提升 5.76 点，并消除了基于实体的图方法在构图阶段的 token 成本。

Conclusion: 几何结构可在不依赖 LLM 构图的情况下支持高效的多跳证据发现。

Abstract: Multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires evidence that remains relevant to a query while introducing enough novelty to bridge semantic gaps. Dense retrieval tends to concentrate on semantically similar documents, whereas graph-based alternatives often depend on costly Large Language Model (LLM) entity extraction and may propagate through noisy connections. We introduce Geometric Gain Graph RAG (G$^3$RAG), a document-only framework whose offline graph construction uses no LLM calls or generated tokens. G$^3$RAG assigns each edge a geometric gain score, $\cosθ\cdot \sinθ$, that jointly captures directional consistency and orthogonality between document representations. A density-aware topological penalty suppresses highly connected hubs, while single-step controlled diffusion expands from filtered query seeds toward complementary evidence. We evaluate G$^3$RAG on MusiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and HotpotQA using Nv-embed-v2 and Qwen3-8B-embed. G$^3$RAG obtains the best average F1 and answer-document hit rate among the evaluated graph-based baselines in both embedding settings, with gains of up to 4.26 F1 points in average performance and 5.76 points on MusiQue. It also removes the graph-construction token cost incurred by entity-based graph methods. These results show that geometric structure can support efficient multi-hop evidence discovery without LLM-based graph construction. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/G3RAG-99D9/

</details>


### [274] [Self-Evolving Search Index](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19656)
*Sangam Lee,Wonjae Lee,Sunghwan Kim,Deogyong Kim,Jaehoon Kim,Daye Nam,SeongKu Kang,Dongha Lee*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出SELF-INDEX框架，使检索索引无需人工干预即可自我演化，自主诊断检索缺陷、修订索引键并验证，同时通过查询模拟器主动探索需求，在多种语料与检索器上稳定提升检索性能并惠及下游智能体应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体需处理多样信息需求，检索质量高度依赖索引键对文档知识的表征能力。但有效索引表征随检索环境变化，固定优化策略难以一致奏效，而现有索引演化仍高度依赖人工：诊断检索失败、改进优化策略、重新处理索引。

Method: SELF-INDEX框架包含两个核心组件：Optimizer自主诊断检索短板，选择性修订应负责的索引键，并在更新索引前对每次修订进行验证；Query Simulator在被动响应观察到的检索需求之外，主动探索额外需求，使索引能够超越当前可用查询进行演化。

Result: 在多种语料和检索器上，SELF-INDEX持续提升检索性能，优于现有索引优化方法；其收益还延伸至下游应用，提升搜索智能体的有效性与效率，并帮助智能体记忆系统检索到有用的历史交互。

Conclusion: 索引可通过自演化机制在无人工干预下适配检索环境，主动需求探索进一步拓展其优化边界，该框架兼具检索性能提升与下游智能体应用价值。

Abstract: Information retrieval is increasingly important as LLM agents tackle complex tasks involving diverse information needs. Because retrieval relies on an index that represents each document through index keys, retrieval quality depends heavily on how effectively these keys expose the knowledge contained in each document. However, effective index representations vary across retrieval environments, making it difficult for any fixed optimization strategy to perform consistently. Yet evolving an index to its retrieval environment remains largely human-driven, requiring humans to diagnose retrieval failures, refine the optimization strategy, and reprocess the index accordingly. We propose SELF-INDEX, a framework that enables an index to self-evolve without human intervention. Its Optimizer autonomously diagnoses retrieval shortfalls, selectively revises the responsible index keys, and validates each revision before updating the index. Beyond reacting to observed retrieval demands, SELF-INDEX proactively explores additional demands through a Query Simulator, allowing the index to evolve beyond the queries already available for optimization. Across diverse corpora and retrievers, SELF-INDEX consistently improves retrieval performance while outperforming existing index optimization methods. We further show that these benefits extend to downstream applications, improving the effectiveness and efficiency of search agents and helping agent memory systems retrieve useful past interactions.

</details>


### [275] [Dense Feature Representation over Sequence Modeling: A Solution to the KDD Cup 2026 UniRec Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19787)
*Yi Zhang,Weiliang Ji*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文报告 KDD Cup 2026 腾讯 UniRec 挑战赛（3,482 万条记录工业 CVR 预测）第 10 名方案：在官方 PCVRHyFormer 基线上经 15 步单变量改进链，测试 AUC 由 0.813237 提升至 0.827816，最终提交达 0.828535。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文动机是回答"在该规模工业 CVR 预测中，究竟哪些机制真正提升 held-out AUC"。通过单变量链与留一消融，区分开真正有效的因素与看似有效但增益落在种子波动带内的因素，并揭示验证集评估中潜在的泛化风险。

Method: 以官方 PCVRHyFormer 为基线，采用 15 步单变量改进链逐步迭代；从完整模型做 leave-one-out 消融，量化各组件的 AUC 贡献，并以 ±0.0004 的种子波动带判定显著性；同时检验 row-group 划分与时间序重划分下的评估一致性。

Result: 去掉稠密特征表示栈损失 0.0095 AUC，去掉正交化优化器损失 0.0028；而各序列建模组件（合并单流主干、极性通道、辅助头、逐 token FFN）损失均不超过 0.0005，处于或接近 ±0.0004 种子带内。另发现 row-group 训练/验证划分共享同一时间窗，导致验证 AUC 比排行榜高约 0.014；反记忆与高基数 ID 改动甚至出现符号反转，该分歧源于 dump-to-dump 分布漂移，且在时间序重划分后依然存在。

Conclusion: 在该规模下，驱动 CVR AUC 提升的是稠密表示与优化策略，而非更精细的序列建模；评估结论必须来自 held-out 排行榜而非共享时间窗的验证集。

Abstract: We describe our 10th-place solution to the KDD Cup 2026 Tencent UniRec Challenge, industrial click-to-conversion (CVR) prediction over 34.82M records, and we ask which mechanisms actually move held-out AUC. Starting from the official PCVRHyFormer baseline, a 15-step single-variable chain raises test AUC from 0.813237 to 0.827816, and our final submission reaches 0.828535. A leave-one-out ablation from the full model attributes the gain: removing the dense-feature representation stack costs 0.0095 AUC and removing the orthogonalized optimizer costs 0.0028, while no sequence-modeling component (merged single-stream backbone, polarity channel, auxiliary head, per-token FFN) costs more than 0.0005, within or adjacent to a $\pm$0.0004 seed band. We also report a generalization hazard: the row-group train/validation split shares one time window, so validation AUC overstates the leaderboard by about 0.014; anti-memorization and high-cardinality-ID changes even invert sign against it, a divergence that traces to dump-to-dump distribution shift and survives a time-ordered re-split. Dense representation and optimization, not finer sequence modeling, drive CVR AUC at this scale, and verdicts must come from the held-out leaderboard.

</details>


### [276] [Reproducing Transparent and Scrutable Recommendations: Exploring Open-Weight Models via Natural-Language User Profiles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19831)
*Noah Mamié,Laurin van den Bergh*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 对基于生成式自然语言用户画像的推荐系统进行可复现性研究，确认其透明性与竞争性性能，并通过消融、多种子与机制可解释性实验揭示画像扰动仅均匀影响评分而不改变排序，归因于评分回归目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原论文提出用生成的自然语言用户画像增强推荐系统，使用户能直接交互和干预（纠正偏好误判、缓解冷启动），但该方法的可复现性、统计可靠性及内在机制尚未被系统检验，因此本文开展复现与扩展研究。

Method: 复现原研究的核心流程（从Amazon Movies &amp; TV、TripAdvisor的原始评论文本合成用户画像，跨电影与住宿领域）；扩展实验包括：系统性上下文消融、五个不同随机种子的多种子稳定性检验、以及基于nnsight框架的机制可解释性分析，在反事实画像扰动下探测模型内部表征。

Result: 成功复现原研究核心结论，验证UPR在其测试集重排序协议下具有竞争性性能并使推荐更透明。反事实画像扰动确实改变预测，但预测评分的偏移跨类型均匀分布，未检测到类型选择性效应；即使在直接激活引导下排序也保持不变。这一问题可追溯至评分回归目标而非画像界面，排序目标模型在该任务上表现明显更优。

Conclusion: 基于自然语言用户画像的推荐在透明度与性能上可复现，但其画像界面对排序无实质影响，瓶颈在于评分回归目标；采用排序目标的模型更适合此类任务。

Abstract: In this reproducibility study, we investigate the transparency and scrutability of recommender systems enhanced by incorporating generated natural-language user profiles that represent user preferences. The original paper explores the synthesis of user profiles from raw user-generated review text across domains such as movies and accommodations (Amazon Movies & TV, TripAdvisor). Crucially, these natural-language user profiles enable direct user interaction and intervention, allowing users to customize recommendations by correcting misattributed preferences or addressing cold-start settings. We successfully reproduce the core findings of the original study. Additionally, we extend the evaluation by conducting systematic context ablation experiments, multi-seed stability across five distinct random seeds to establish statistical reliability, and a mechanistic interpretability analysis using the nnsight framework to probe internal model representations under counterfactual profile perturbations. Our findings verify the original paper's claim that User Profile Recommendation (UPR) achieves competitive performance under its test-set reranking protocol and makes recommendations more transparent. Perturbing the natural-language profiles does change predictions, but it shifts predicted ratings uniformly across genres with no detectable genre-selective effect, leaving rankings unchanged even under direct activation steering. We trace this back to the rating-regression objective rather than the profile interface, with ranking-objective models clearly exceeding in this task.

</details>


### [277] [The Missing Complement: State-Conditioned Minimal Sufficient Evidence for Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20050)
*Zhexi Feng,Ruiyi Zhang,Yongbo Yang,Pengtao Xie*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出"状态条件化最小充分证据恢复"任务，并设计MSS-Complement集合构建式检索方法，在SERBench与AMA-Bench上取得优于重排序基线的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检索按单段相关性打分，但充分性属于集合层面：排序器可能用同一必要事实的多个变体填满预算，却仍无法支撑决策。智能体在中途已读过大量高排名内容，真正缺的是"决策仍需但尚未获得的证据组合"。

Method: 形式化任务为：给定捕获的智能体状态，恢复一个紧凑的证据组合以补足其下一步决策所缺的支撑。构建SERBench基准（45个仓库、500个留出状态），记录智能体已读内容，仅当覆盖当前决策所需全部事实时才计分。MSS-Complement将获取视为集合构建而非排序，通过三次语义调用分别提出联合充分集、搜索缺失项，并在6,144 token预算内返回4–8个完整源单元；配置仅在校准数据上确定。

Result: 五条证据时恢复完整集合的比例为73.0%，八条时80.6%，对比Qwen3 embedding加重排序的61.4%与72.4%。仅按相似度排序的匹配对照为66.6%，说明增益来自集合级策略而非算力。在无金标池的冻结仓库源码上领先5.0个点。AMA-Bench上以缩小76.2%的答案提示作答，准确率高于该基准自带记忆智能体2.08个点。从完整集合中移除一个必需组，在两种执行器下分别损失12.3和11.1个点的修复定位精度。

Conclusion: 面向智能体的检索应重新表述为"恢复决策所缺之物"，而非"对问题相似度重新排序"。

Abstract: A coding agent halfway through an issue has already read much of what a retriever ranks highest. Relevance is scored per passage, but sufficiency belongs to the set: a ranker can fill its budget with variants of one required fact and leave the decision unsupported. We formulate state-conditioned minimal sufficient evidence recovery: given a captured agent state, recover a compact evidence combination that supplies the support its next decision still lacks. SERBench measures this on 500 held-out states from 45 repositories, recording what the agent has seen and crediting only sets that cover every fact the current decision was annotated to require. MSS-Complement treats acquisition as set construction, not ranking. Three semantic calls propose a jointly sufficient set, search for what it lacks, and return 4-8 intact source units within 6,144 tokens. One configuration, fixed on calibration data, recovers a complete set for 73.0% of those states at five items and 80.6% at eight, against 61.4% and 72.4% for Qwen3 embedding with reranking. A matched control ranking by similarity alone reaches 66.6%, placing the gain in the set-level policy, not the computation. From frozen repository source with no gold-derived pool, the lead is 5.0 points. On AMA-Bench it answers from a 76.2% smaller answer prompt, with accuracy 2.08 points above that benchmark's own memory agent. Removing one required group from an otherwise complete set costs 12.3 and 11.1 points of repair-localization precision under two executors. Retrieval for agents is better posed as recovering what a decision lacks than re-ranking what an issue resembles.

</details>


### [278] [Think Thrice Before Reranking: Multi-perspective Evidence and Reasoning Integration for Text Reranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20131)
*Lijun Liu,Zhengzong Chen,Wenyan Li,Yuanyuan Zhao,Fei Huang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出MERIT-Rank框架，通过多视角推理轨迹建模与渐进式策略优化提升文本重排序鲁棒性与效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM推理的重排序方法依赖单一推理轨迹，易受推理错误影响，且难以建模文档相关性的多面性信号。

Method: 构建多轨迹推理空间（MTRS），从多视角评估查询-文档相关性；设计联合重排序器整合多条推理路径形成统一排序决策；提出渐进式排序策略优化（PRPO），通过分阶段优化目标稳定推理轨迹并持续提升排序质量。

Result: 在推理密集型与传统检索基准上均持续优于竞争基线；4B模型在BRIGHT上显著超越多数7B甚至32B重排序器。

Conclusion: 多视角推理集成与渐进式策略优化能有效缓解单一推理轨迹的局限，提升重排序的鲁棒性与性能，且小模型可达到甚至超越大模型效果。

Abstract: Reasoning-based reranking with Large Language Models (LLMs) has shown promising improvements in text ranking. However, current methods predominantly rely on a single reasoning trajectory, resulting in rankings that are susceptible to reasoning errors and inherently constrained in modeling the multifaceted signals underlying document relevance. To resolve this dilemma, we propose MERIT-Rank(Multi-perspective Evidence and Reasoning Integration for Text Reranking), a framework that models complementary reasoning trajectories to improve reranking robustness. MERIT-Rank formulates a Multi-Trajectory Reasoning Space (MTRS) that evaluates query-document relevance from multiple perspectives and introduces a joint reranker that consolidates these reasoning paths into a unified ranking decision. We further develop Progressive Rank Policy Optimization (PRPO), a progressive training framework that stabilizes reasoning trajectories while continually improving ranking quality through staged optimization objectives. Experiments on both reasoning-intensive and traditional retrieval benchmarks show that MERIT-Rank consistently achieves superior performance over competitive baselines. The 4B model notably outperforms most 7B and even 32B rerankers on BRIGHT.

</details>


### [279] [FacetCRS: Multi-Faceted Preference Learning for Pricking Filter Bubbles in Conversational Recommender System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20175)
*Yongsen Zheng,Ziliang Chen,Jinghui Qin,Liang Lin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出FacetCRS范式，通过多面向偏好学习在对话推荐系统中刺破过滤气泡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过滤气泡是推荐系统固有问题，使用户仅接触狭窄信息、强化既有偏好。现有研究多关注静态或准静态推荐场景，但真实在线推荐中用户与系统的反馈回路会使过滤气泡随时间不断加剧，因此需要新的解决思路。

Method: 提出FacetCRS范式，借助自然语言对话实现及时的用户-物品交互。将用户偏好自动建模为多面向，包括实体面向、词面向、上下文面向和评论面向，以捕捉多样且动态的用户偏好；构建端到端CRS框架，自适应学习各层级偏好面向的表示及多种外部知识。

Result: 在两个公开基准数据集上的大量实验表明，所提方法在缓解过滤气泡和提升CRS推荐质量方面达到当前最优性能。

Conclusion: 通过对话式交互与多面向偏好建模，FacetCRS能够有效刺破对话推荐系统中的过滤气泡，同时提升推荐效果。

Abstract: The filter bubble is a notorious issue in Recommender Systems (RSs), which describes the phenomenon whereby users are exposed to a limited and narrow range of information or content that reinforces their existing dominant preferences and beliefs. This results in a lack of exposure to diverse and varied content. Many existing works have predominantly examined filter bubbles in static or relatively-static recommendation settings. However, filter bubbles will be continuously intensified over time due to the feedback loop between the user and the system in the real-world online recommendation. To address these issues, we propose a novel paradigm, Multi-Facet Preference Learning for Pricking Filter Bubbles in Conversational Recommender System (FacetCRS), which aims to burst filter bubbles in the conversational recommender system (CRS) through timely user-item interactions via natural language conversations. By considering diverse user preferences and intentions, FacetCRS automatically model user preference into multi-facets, including entity-, word-, context-, and review-facet, to capture diverse and dynamic user preferences to prick filter bubbles in the CRS. It is an end-to-end CRS framework to adaptively learn representations of various levels of preference facet and diverse types of external knowledge. Extensive experiments on two publicly available benchmark datasets demonstrate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance in mitigating filter bubbles and enhancing recommendation quality in CRS.

</details>


### [280] [Reasoning Quality Matters: Combating Reasoning Collapse in LLM-based Embedding Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20563)
*Zihan Gong,Xiaohan Ye,Jiangchao Yao,Jinsong Lan,Xiaoyong Zhu,Xu Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出CoFree，一个两阶段框架，将LLM推理逐步融入查询与文档的嵌入优化中，在保持推理质量的同时提升检索效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM嵌入方法要么将嵌入学习视为被动特征提取，要么仅通过指令跟随利用推理能力；而针对嵌入目标进行专门化会抑制有用的推理生成或产生与检索无关的文本，作者将这两种退化形式称为"推理崩溃"(reasoning collapse)。

Method: CoFree采用两阶段框架：第一阶段使用参考引导的监督微调，恢复基础嵌入模型的推理能力并保持其表征强度；第二阶段引入双重奖励（面向嵌入的奖励与面向推理的奖励），在强化学习中保证针对嵌入目标的相关性推理。这种端点耦合优化将嵌入学习从静态对齐转变为高质量的推理引导搜索过程。

Result: 大量实验验证了CoFree的有效性，CoFree-4B在MTEB和BRIGHT的22个数据集上相较Qwen3-Embedding-4B平均绝对提升2.8个nDCG@10点；真实检索系统的在线实验也显示出一致的收益。

Conclusion: CoFree通过两阶段渐进式整合推理与嵌入优化，有效缓解推理崩溃问题，在离线与在线检索任务上均取得显著提升。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown strong potential for producing context-rich text embeddings for retrieval. Most existing methods either treat embedding learning as passive feature extraction or exploit LLM reasoning through instruction following for better embedding optimization. However, specialization toward embedding objectives can suppress useful reasoning generation or produce retrieval-irrelevant text. We refer to these two forms of degradation as reasoning collapse. To address this issue, we propose CoFree (Collapse-Free Reasoning Embedding), a two-stage framework that progressively integrates LLM reasoning into query and document embedding optimization while preserving reasoning quality. At the first stage, CoFree applies reference-guided supervised fine-tuning to restore the reasoning ability and retain representational strength of the foundation embedding model. At the second stage, we introduce dual rewards, an embedding-oriented reward and a reasoning-oriented reward, to guarantee fine-grained reasoning of the relevance toward the embedding goal in reinforcement learning. This endpoint-coupled optimization transforms embedding learning from static alignment into a high-quality reasoning-guided search process for retrieval. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of CoFree, with CoFree-4B achieving an average absolute improvement of 2.8 nDCG@10 points over Qwen3-Embedding-4B across 22 datasets from MTEB and BRIGHT. Online experiments in a real-world retrieval system further show consistent gains. Code, RTED, and model checkpoints will be made publicly available.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [281] [SAGG: Sample-Adaptive Gradient Gating for Robust Multimodal Learning under Heterogeneous Corruption](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20302)
*Wentao Zhang,Yifan Zhu,Yutong Zhang,Wentao Mo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文揭示批级模态梯度平衡在样本异构损坏下存在不可消除偏差，提出样本级全有或全无门控的SAGG方法，实现无损坏误差底线的标准收敛率并提升鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态梯度平衡方法对每种模态使用共享标量调节编码器梯度，隐含假设整个训练批次内损坏是均匀的。但实际上损坏是样本异构的：同一小批次中不同样本可能损坏不同模态。作者希望解决这种批次级、样本无关的线性估计器在异构损坏下引入的固有权重偏差问题。

Method: 作者首先证明，在异构损坏模型下，任何带有共享调节参数的批次级、样本无关线性估计器都会相对干净数据梯度产生不可消除的偏差，并证明样本级全有或全无门控是某类自然无分布估计器中唯一无偏策略。基于此提出 Sample-Adaptive Gradient Gating (SAGG)：通过在线特征范数质量测试对每个样本做二元保留或丢弃决策，并加入截断机制控制方差。理论分析给出基于SAGG的SGD以标准O(1/sqrt(T))速率收敛到干净损失的稳定点，且无依赖损坏的误差底线；同时为独立编码器架构推导了认证鲁棒半径，将各模态Lipschitz常数与分类间隔联系起来。

Result: 在Kinetics-Sounds和UCF-101上，针对高斯噪声注入、部分模态缺失和自然贡献不平衡三种设置，SAGG一致优于十种现有方法，且在高损坏区间增益最大，因为该区间批次级偏差最严重。

Conclusion: 样本异构损坏使传统批级模态梯度平衡产生固有偏差，样本级全有或全无门控可实现无偏。SAGG通过在线样本级门控与截断机制，在理论和实验上均有效：收敛无损坏误差底线，并在多种损坏场景下超越现有方法，尤其在高损坏区间优势显著。

Abstract: Multimodal gradient balancing methods modulate encoder gradients with a shared scalar per modality, implicitly assuming that corruption is uniform across the training batch. In practice, corruption is sample-heterogeneous: within a single mini-batch, different samples may have different modalities corrupted. We prove that under this heterogeneous corruption model, any batch-level sample-agnostic linear estimator with a shared modulation parameter incurs an irreducible bias with respect to the clean-data gradient, and that sample-level all-or-nothing gating is the unique unbiased strategy within a natural distribution-free estimator class. Motivated by this result, we propose Sample-Adaptive Gradient Gating (SAGG), which makes a binary retain-or-discard decision per sample via an online feature-norm quality test and incorporates a truncation mechanism for variance control. We prove that SAGG-based SGD converges at the standard O(1/sqrt(T)) rate to stationary points of the clean loss without a corruption-dependent error floor, and derive a certified robustness radius for the independent-encoder architecture that connects per-modality Lipschitz constants to the classification margin. Experiments on Kinetics-Sounds and UCF-101 under Gaussian noise injection, partial modality missing, and natural contribution imbalance show that SAGG consistently outperforms ten existing methods, with the largest gains in high-corruption regimes where batch-level bias is most severe.

</details>


### [282] [Learn Your Own Thoughts: Abstract Token Curriculum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19717)
*Khashayar Gatmiry,Avrajit Ghosh,Parsa Mirtaheri,Jason D. Lee,Nika Haghtalab,Emmanuel Abbe,Peter Bartlett*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出抽象令牌课程（ATC），一种无需显式监督或手工设计草稿的课程学习框架，通过在连续表示空间中逐步增加问题复杂度，诱导模型自发形成内部抽象“思维”，并在理论上与实验上验证其优于既有连续思维方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 思维链（CoT）能显著提升大语言模型的推理能力，但其依赖对思维令牌的显式监督，需要大量任务特定数据，且草稿设计往往依赖人工。作者希望摆脱这种监督依赖，让模型在连续表示空间中自行发展有效的中间抽象思维。

Method: 提出抽象令牌课程（ATC）框架：按一系列分布逐步提升问题难度，形成课程学习路径，从而在无直接监督、无手工草稿设计的情况下，训练模型在连续表示空间内生成内部抽象“思维”。同时从理论上分析单层 softmax 注意力在奇偶校验函数上使用 ATC 时的注意力行为。

Result: 理论上证明，在单层 softmax 注意力学习奇偶校验函数时，ATC 使注意力自然聚焦于上下文中提供“最易路径”以预测下一令牌的 CoT 令牌；实验上在图可达性与算术学习任务中展示了 ATC 的有效性，并体现其相对既有连续思维训练方法的优势。

Conclusion: ATC 提供了一种无需显式监督即可诱导连续抽象思维的有效途径，兼具理论解释与实验支持，为连续思维训练提供了新范式。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable reasoning capabilities by utilizing chain-of-thought (CoT) as a scratchpad for intermediate stages of thinking. However, CoT techniques require explicit supervision on thinking tokens, which requires rich, task-specific data. In this work, we propose Abstract Token Curriculum (ATC), a novel curriculum learning framework that elicits effective continuous intermediate representations without direct supervision or manual scratchpad design. ATC gradually increases problem complexity through a sequence of distributions, training the model to develop internal abstract ``thoughts'' in the continuous representation space. This paper provides both theoretical and experimental evidence for the benefits of ATC and its advantages over previous methods for training continuous thoughts.
