Theoretically, we show that for learning parity functions with single-layer softmax attention using ATC, attention naturally focuses on the CoT tokens in the context that provide the ``easiest path'' to predicting the next token. Experimentally, we show ATC's effectiveness on graph reachability and arithmetic learning tasks.

</details>


### [283] [Uni-LaDiR: Latent Diffusion Unifies Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19878)
*Haoqiang Kang,Yizhe Zhang,Nikki Lijing Kuang,Yian Ma,Lianhui Qin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Uni-LaDiR 提出统一潜空间扩散推理器，将多模态思维令牌映射到共享潜空间并预测下一思维块，在视觉推理与机器人操纵任务上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态推理方法将各模态的思维令牌简单拼接成单一序列，迫使模型在跨模态推理时自行弥合表征差异，缺乏统一的表征空间。

Method: 提出 Uni-LaDiR 框架：用统一编码器将不同模态的教师推理步骤映射为共享思维令牌，并训练其保留后续推理与最终答案/动作所需的信息；由于同一上下文可对应多个有效下一步，采用扩散模型从输入及前序思维块预测下一思维块；编码器与扩散推理器共享模型权重联合训练，使思维令牌既任务有用又可从上下文预测；推理时无需教师观测即可生成令牌。

Result: 在 11 个 VLM 基准与 2 个 VLA 套件上，相对最强基线，视觉推理任务平均相对提升 7.3%，机器人操纵任务平均相对提升 6.1%。

Conclusion: 将多模态思维统一到共享潜空间并借助扩散建模下一思维块，可有效提升跨模态推理与动作生成性能，验证了共享表征与联合训练的有效性。

Abstract: Multimodal reasoning requires models to draw on information from multiple modalities throughout the reasoning process. Yet existing methods often concatenate modality-specific thought tokens in a single sequence, leaving the model to bridge representational differences as it reasons across modalities. We introduce Uni-LaDiR (Unified Latent Diffusion Reasoner), a framework that brings these thoughts into a shared latent space for reasoning. A unified encoder maps teacher reasoning steps from different modalities into shared thought tokens, trained to preserve the information needed for later reasoning steps and the final answer or action. Because the same context can support multiple valid next steps, we use diffusion to predict the next block of thought tokens from the input and preceding blocks. Jointly training the encoder and diffusion reasoner with shared model weights encourages thought tokens to be both useful for the task and predictable from the available context. At inference, the model generates these tokens without teacher observations. Across eleven vision-language model (VLM) benchmarks and two vision-language-action (VLA) suites, Uni-LaDiR achieves relative gains over the strongest evaluated baselines of 7.3% on visual reasoning tasks and 6.1% on robot manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [284] [MATCH: Model-Aware Tool Learning with Curriculum Scheduling and Hierarchically Gated Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20082)
*Shihao Liu,Hao Yin,Lijun Liu,Zhengzong Chen,Yuanyuan Zhao,Fei Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MATCH闭环框架，结合模型感知课程学习与分层门控奖励，优化LLM工具调用，在API-Bank和BFCL V3上超越主流基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习优化工具调用存在两问题：固定阈值课程与策略能力边界错位；加性奖励在工具预测错误时泄漏参数级信用。

Method: MATCH框架含两部分：MACL基于奖励推导样本难度并与策略共同演化，每轮选取能力边界附近样本及top-k更难样本池；HTGR将工具名、参数键、参数值作为门控链评分，仅当前置条件满足才授予信用。同一HTGR奖励驱动GRPO更新与MACL难度刷新，形成闭环。

Result: 在API-Bank和BFCL V3上总体准确率分别达72.19%和62.87%，优于主要监督与RL基线；在来自两个模型族的四个骨干上均获一致提升。

Conclusion: MATCH通过课程调度与分层门控奖励的闭环设计，有效解决课程错位与信用泄漏问题，提升工具学习效果并具跨骨干泛化性。

Abstract: Tool learning enables large language models (LLMs) to use external tools for tasks beyond parametric knowledge. Reinforcement learning can optimize tool-call behavior from feedback, but current methods still face two problems: fixed-threshold curricula can become misaligned with the policy's evolving capability boundary, and additive rewards can leak argument-level credit when the predicted tool is wrong. To address these problems, we propose MATCH, a closed-loop framework for model-aware tool learning with curriculum scheduling and hierarchically gated rewards. Model-Aware Curriculum Learning (MACL) maintains reward-derived sample difficulty that co-evolves with the policy, and each epoch selects samples near the current capability boundary together with a top-k pool of harder cases. Hierarchical Tool-call Gated Reward (HTGR) scores tool name, argument key, and argument value as a gated chain, granting credit at each level only when prerequisites hold. The same HTGR rewards drive both GRPO updates and MACL's difficulty refresh, closing the loop between policy optimization and sample scheduling. On API-Bank and BFCL V3, MATCH reaches 72.19% and 62.87% overall accuracy, outperforming the main supervised and RL-based baselines. Backbone experiments further show consistent improvements across four backbones from two model families.

</details>


### [285] [Don't Mask the Environment: Observation Supervision Changes How Agents Explore Under RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20715)
*Juzheng Zhang,Disha Makhija,Manoj Ghuhan Arivazhagan,Vinayshekhar Bannihatti Kumar,Rashmi Gangadharaiah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出ActObs，在SFT阶段不仅监督智能体动作token，还监督轨迹中已有的观察token，从而让策略学习建模动作后果。该方法不增加数据、参数、序列长度或前向次数，在GRPO后的表现优于仅监督动作的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准SFT只对智能体生成的动作token计算损失，把环境观察仅当作上下文而非预测目标。作者质疑这一惯例是否为后续强化学习提供了最佳初始化，并希望在不增加额外成本的前提下改进策略的初始化质量。

Method: 提出ActObs，对每条轨迹中已存在的观察token也施加监督，使策略学会预测动作后果。由于观察token本就在轨迹中，该方法不增加数据、参数、序列token或前向传播次数，随后用于GRPO等后续强化学习。

Result: 两种方法在SFT后表现相近，但在GRPO后出现分化。Qwen3-4B上，ActObs的GRPO在Terminal-Bench 2.0各采样预算下pass@k均更高；Qwen3-8B上以部分pass@1可靠性换取更高pass@k（pass@16提升3.4个百分点）并解决更多不同任务。在跨域代码编辑aider-polyglot上（SFT与RL均未见任务），4B模型pass@1提升4.2个百分点。

Conclusion: ActObs在RL中保留更多熵且需更少策略移动，使最终策略更接近SFT初始化。分析表明差异源于SFT：动作与观察梯度迅速趋于正交，而仅动作训练留下较大观察梯度残差并削弱环境预测能力；联合监督可避免这种单侧特化，保持后果预测能力并为下游探索做好准备。

Abstract: Agent trajectories record what an agent does and what happens next. Yet standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) applies loss only to agent-authored action tokens, using environment observations as context but not as prediction targets. We ask whether this convention provides the best initialization for subsequent reinforcement learning. We introduce ActObs, which also supervises the observation tokens already present in each trajectory. Although deployed agents never generate observations, learning to predict them encourages the policy to model action consequences without adding data, parameters, sequence tokens, or forward passes. The methods perform similarly after SFT but diverge after GRPO. On Qwen3-4B, GRPO from ActObs achieves higher pass@k at every evaluated sampling budget than its action-only counterpart on Terminal-Bench 2.0. On Qwen3-8B, it trades some pass@1 reliability for higher pass@k (+3.4 pp at pass@16) and solves more distinct tasks. The advantage extends to cross-domain code editing on aider-polyglot (+4.2 pp at pass@1 at 4B), whose tasks are unseen during SFT and RL. ActObs retains more entropy during RL while requiring less policy movement, leaving the final policy closer to its SFT initialization. Our analysis traces this difference to SFT: action and observation gradients rapidly become orthogonal, while action-only training leaves a large residual observation gradient and degrades environment prediction below the base model. Joint supervision prevents this one-sided specialization, preserving consequence prediction and preparing the policy for downstream exploration.

</details>


### [286] [Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) Improves Classification Accuracy of Bacterial Raman Spectral Data Enabling Portable Diagnostics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19453)
*Kaitlin Zareno,Jarett Dewbury,Siamak K. Sorooshyari,Hossein Mobahi,Loza F. Tadesse*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出使用锐度感知最小化（SAM）优化器来提升拉曼光谱病原菌分类模型在有限、多样临床数据集上的泛化能力，相比传统Adam优化器，平均准确率提升2.7%，单次划分最高提升10.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 抗生素耐药性预计到2050年每年导致1000万人死亡，资源有限地区受影响最严重。拉曼光谱是一种有前景的快速便携式病原菌诊断手段，可在数小时内完成耐药性检测。然而现有拉曼光谱分析算法存在两大局限：(1) 在有限数据集上难以跨多样患者群体泛化；(2) 由于拉曼光谱数据质量低，需依赖特征提取等非平凡预处理步骤，导致模型复杂度增加。

Method: 采用锐度感知最小化（Sharpness-Aware Minimization, SAM）方法，在临床细菌分离株分类任务中增强模型在多种超参数配置下的泛化能力。

Result: 在光谱分类任务中，SAM相比传统优化器Adam，在单次数据划分上准确率最高提升10.5%，在所有划分上平均准确率提升2.7%。

Conclusion: 结果表明SAM具备推动AI驱动的拉曼光谱工具临床应用的潜力。

Abstract: Antimicrobial resistance is expected to claim 10 million lives per year by 2050, and resource-limited regions are most affected. Raman spectroscopy is a novel pathogen diagnostic approach promising rapid and portable antibiotic resistance testing within a few hours, compared to days when using gold standard methods. However, current algorithms for Raman spectra analysis 1) are unable to generalize well on limited datasets across diverse patient populations and 2) require increased complexity due to the necessity of non-trivial pre-processing steps, such as feature extraction, which are essential to mitigate the low-quality nature of Raman spectral data. In this work, we address these limitations using Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) to enhance model generalization across a diverse array of hyperparameters in clinical bacterial isolate classification tasks. We demonstrate that SAM achieves accuracy improvements of up to 10.5% on a single split, and an increase in average accuracy of 2.7% across all splits in spectral classification tasks over the traditional optimizer, Adam. These results display the capability of SAM to advance the clinical application of AI-powered Raman spectroscopy tools.

</details>


### [287] [Compressed Active Subspaces for Scalable Bayesian Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19539)
*Thomas Flynn,Sanket Jantre,Byung-Jun Yoon,Kibaek Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出压缩活跃子空间（CAS）方法，通过结构化等距嵌入将模型参数映射到压缩空间，再在低维参数化中构建活跃子空间，从而大幅降低内存需求并支持大模型贝叶斯推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准活跃子空间方法需要存储大量全维模型梯度，随着模型规模增大，内存开销变得不可承受，限制了其在高维大模型中的贝叶斯推断应用。

Method: CAS 首先利用结构化等距嵌入（structured isometric embedding）将模型参数映射到一个压缩空间，然后在压缩后的参数化中构建活跃子空间，从而避免存储全维梯度。

Result: 在规模递增的神经网络上验证了 CAS 的可扩展性，同时保持了预测性能和稳健的不确定性估计。

Conclusion: CAS 显著降低了活跃子空间构建的内存需求，使标准活跃子空间方法难以处理的大模型贝叶斯推断成为可行。

Abstract: Active subspace methods provide a framework for quantifying predictive uncertainty in high-dimensional models by identifying and performing inference along parameter directions that have the greatest influence on the model output. However, the construction of active subspaces requires storing many full-dimensional model gradients, which becomes prohibitive as model size increases. We address this limitation by proposing Compressed Active Subspaces (CAS), a scalable approach that first maps the model parameters to a compressed space using a structured isometric embedding and then constructs the active subspace within this reduced parameterization. Our approach substantially reduces the memory required for active subspace construction and enables Bayesian inference for large models where standard active subspace methods become impractical. We demonstrate the scalability of CAS on neural networks of increasing size while maintaining predictive performance and robust uncertainty estimates.

</details>


### [288] [When Does Retrieval Help Time-Series Forecasting?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20193)
*Mert Onur Cakiroglu,Elham Buxton,Mehmet Dalkilic,Hasan Kurban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文表明，检索式预测插件的收益并非来自其机制，而是取决于运行点——回看窗口长度 S 与主导季节周期 L 的关系；作者提出分层评估协议揭示该“收益机制图”，并给出两个可解释统计量用于部署前筛选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有评估一致报告检索插件带来增益，并将其归因于各自机制，但这些评估从未变化窗口长度 S 与主导周期 L 的关系这一维度。作者希望检验：收益究竟属于机制，还是属于被标准协议忽略的运行点（S 与 L 的关系）。

Method: 按 S 与 L 的关系对评估进行分层；设置简单对照（重复最后观测到的周期）与六种标准骨干模型、最强插件对比；在七个基准上测试；进行合成数据扫描（变化预测跨度、周期、窗口）；使用无相位可恢复的配对对照；加入零样本预训练基础模型对照；用两个可解释统计量（趋势检验、陈旧率）在留一数据集评估下预测逐单元收益符号。

Result: 在 S=12 时，简单对照在七个基准中的四个上以 MSE 的 8%–44% 整体优于六个标准骨干，在 ETTm1 上超过最强插件，在 ECL 上持平；在训练集频谱缺乏集中共享周期的三个数据集上最多差 25%。合成扫描显示收益边界随周期变化（相关 +0.71），而非随跨度（−0.23）。无相位对照几乎消除效应，符合“相位饥饿”。零样本基础模型在周期基准上落后训练骨干 22%–50%。精确查找与图扩散效果相当。两统计量预测符号准确率 0.76，高于多数规则的 0.69，22 特征堆叠仅 0.57。

Conclusion: 论文不提出新插件，贡献在于收益机制图、揭示该机制的评估协议，以及部署前可用的两个筛选统计量；核心结论是检索收益来自“查阅记录”这一操作点，而非其上叠加的机制。

Abstract: Retrieval plug-ins supply a deep forecaster with information its lookback window cannot carry. Published evaluations report consistent gains, and each credits its own mechanism. We show that the benefit belongs instead to the operating point: the relation between window length $S$ and dominant seasonal period $L$, an axis the standard protocol never varies. Stratifying the evaluation by that relation exposes the regime. At $S{=}12$, a simple control that repeats the last observed period beats the six standard backbones, in aggregate, on four of seven benchmarks by $8\%$ to $44\%$ of MSE. It beats the strongest plug-in we run on ETTm1 and matches it on ECL. It is worse by up to $25\%$ on the three datasets whose training-split spectra lack a concentrated, shared period. A controlled synthetic sweep of horizon, period, and window shows the benefit boundary tracks the period (correlation $+0.71$), not the horizon ($-0.23$). A paired control with no phase to recover nearly erases the effect, consistent with phase starvation. Zero-shot pretraining does not escape it: a foundation model trails trained backbones by $22\%$ to $50\%$ on the periodic benchmarks. Within our instrument, exact lookup matches graph diffusion: the payoff is consulting the record, not the machinery on top. Two interpretable statistics, a trend test and a staleness rate, predict the sign of the per-cell benefit at $0.76$ accuracy under leave-one-dataset-out evaluation, a suggestive margin over the $0.69$ majority rule, where a 22-feature stack manages $0.57$. We propose no new plug-in. The contribution is the regime map, the protocol that reveals it, and two statistics that screen it before deployment. Code: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/retrieval-regime.

</details>


### [289] [The Bias of Nonlinear Two-Time-scale Stochastic Approximation under Constant Step-Sizes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20409)
*Djamel Rassem Lamouri,Dorian Baudry,Nicolas Gast*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究常步长下非线性双时间尺度随机逼近（TTSA，步长 α≫β）的有限时间误差界，证明均方误差与偏差上界为 O(α+β²/α²)，并在 β≤α^{3/2} 时证明其紧性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TTSA 是分析强化学习、优化与随机控制中耦合迭代算法的基本工具，但非线性双时间尺度方案的有限时间保证（尤其常步长情形）难以获得；已有结果多限于线性 TTSA，非线性动力学带来的额外有限时间效应尚不清晰。

Method: 在标准稳定性、正则性与马尔可夫噪声假设下，对步长 α≫β 的非线性 TTSA 进行有限时间分析，分别刻画初值条件、快时间尺度跟踪误差、马尔可夫相依性以及时间尺度耦合的贡献，并据此推导两个迭代量围绕其极限平衡点的均方误差与偏差上界。

Result: 得到均方误差与偏差上界 O(α+β²/α²)，并证明当 β≤α^{3/2} 时该界是紧的；分析明确了 β²/α² 项的来源，并揭示非线性 TTSA 与线性 TTSA 存在质的差异——非线性动力学引入了线性情形中不存在的额外有限时间效应。

Conclusion: 该工作为常步长非线性 TTSA 提供了紧的有限时间误差刻画，澄清了各误差来源，并表明非线性情形不能简单沿用线性 TTSA 的结论。

Abstract: Two-timescale stochastic approximation (TTSA) is a fundamental tool for analyzing coupled iterative algorithms in reinforcement learning, optimization, and stochastic control. However, finite-time guarantees for nonlinear two-timescale schemes remain difficult to obtain, especially under constant step-sizes. In this paper, we study nonlinear TTSA with step-sizes $α\ggβ$. Under standard stability, regularity, and Markovian noise assumptions, we upper bound the mean-squared error and the bias of both iterates around their limiting equilibria. Our bounds scale as $O(α+β^2/α^2)$, which we prove to be tight when $β\leα^{3/2}$. The analysis separates the contributions of initial conditions, fast-timescale tracking error, Markovian dependence, and timescale coupling, thereby clarifying the origin of the $β^2/α^2$ term. Our results reveal qualitative differences from the linear TTSA setting previously studied, showing that nonlinear dynamics introduce additional finite-time effects that are absent in the linear case.

</details>


### [290] [Parallelism, critical windows, and separations among diffusion language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20539)
*Sitan Chen,Liye Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次在细粒度层面理论比较了三种主流扩散大语言模型（masked、uniform、Gaussian diffusion）的并行采样能力，证明uniform与Gaussian diffusion能以正比于分布"对偶全相关"的forward pass数完成采样，并在随机经验测度族上给出uniform/Gaussian需Θ̃(√d)次、而masked diffusion需Ω̃(d)次forward pass的可证明分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）的核心卖点是并行生成效率远高于自回归模型，但针对masked、uniform、Gaussian三类主流扩散范式之间并行能力差异的严谨理论理解仍然匮乏，缺乏对它们并行性优劣的原则性比较。

Method: 作者对三种主流扩散范式（masked、uniform、Gaussian diffusion）的并行采样能力进行细粒度理论分析：一方面证明uniform与Gaussian diffusion的采样forward pass数可由分布的对偶全相关（一种内在复杂度度量）来约束；另一方面构造一类随机经验测度，分别给出uniform/Gaussian diffusion所需forward pass数的上、下界，以及masked diffusion在特定近似score oracle下的下界，从而建立分离结果；并进一步分析导致该分离的机制——masked diffusion采样中关键窗口（critical windows）的渐近宽度。

Result: 1）uniform与Gaussian diffusion可在正比于分布对偶全相关的forward pass数内完成采样，该量可远小于上下文长度，此前仅知masked diffusion能达到这一性质；2）对某类随机经验测度，uniform或Gaussian diffusion所需forward pass数为Θ̃(√d)（上下界匹配），而存在近似score oracle使masked diffusion需要Ω̃(d)次forward pass，从而首次在三类dLLM范式间建立了可证明的并行性分离。

Conclusion: 该分离结果与"masked diffusion因必须确定token值而更难并行"的流行直觉相反：真正原因在于masked diffusion采样的关键窗口在渐近意义下比uniform与Gaussian diffusion采样更窄。这一工作为dLLM范式间的并行性比较提供了首个严格理论框架。

Abstract: A popular selling point of diffusion large language models (dLLMs) is their capacity for parallelism: the ability to generate sequences of text far more efficiently than autoregressive models, which require one forward pass per token. Yet among the many competing paradigms for dLLMs, from masked to uniform to Gaussian diffusion, principled understanding of how these different proposals compare in parallelism remains limited. In this work, we initiate a fine-grained comparison of the capacity for parallelism among these three leading approaches and prove the following:
  - Uniform and Gaussian diffusion can sample in a number of forward passes which scales with the dual total correlation of the underlying distribution, a measure of intrinsic complexity which can be much smaller than the context length. Previously, it was only known how to achieve this using masked diffusion.
  - For a certain family of random empirical measures, we show that $\widetildeΘ(\sqrt{d})$ forward passes are necessary and sufficient to sample using uniform or Gaussian diffusion, yet there exist approximate score oracles for which $\widetildeΩ(d)$ forward passes are needed for masked diffusion. This establishes the first provable separation in parallelism between the three prevailing dLLM paradigms.
  Contrary to popular intuition that masked diffusions are harder to parallelize because they must commit to token values, the latter separation instead comes from the fact that the critical windows in masked diffusion sampling are asymptotically narrower than those in uniform and Gaussian diffusion sampling.

</details>


### [291] [Epidemiological Causal Graph Identification: Challenges, Identifiability and Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20676)
*Sambit Mishra,Yingying Wang,Christine K. Johnson,Urbashi Mitra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究混合类型数据的因果发现问题，证明有序变量与指数族变量之间的边方向在分布上可识别，并提出基于评分的穷举搜索与掩码连续优化（DAGMA）方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果可识别性研究多聚焦于连续变量与加性噪声模型，忽视了包含有序量表、计数与连续测量的混合数据集，导致此类场景下的因果方向判断缺乏理论支撑。

Method: 将节点建模为有序分布（有序logit模型）或单参数指数族分布，在DAG框架下证明有序节点与指数族节点间边方向的分布可识别性；计算上采用基于评分的穷举搜索，并对较大图引入基于DAGMA的掩码连续优化框架。

Result: 理论证明在一般参数取值下，有序变量与指数族变量之间的边方向可识别，将以往的Ordinal-Poisson结论推广至更广泛的指数族；数值实验验证了理论，能够恢复在经典结构方程模型下不可识别的马尔可夫等价类内的边方向。

Conclusion: 该工作将混合类型数据的因果可识别性从特定分布推广到指数族，并提供可扩展的计算方案，为混合数据因果发现提供了理论与实践工具。

Abstract: Causal discovery from observational data is fundamental to statistics and machine learning, yet determining causal direction without interventions necessitates structural assumptions. Existing identifiability research primarily focuses on continuous variables under additive noise models, often neglecting mixed datasets containing ordinal scales, counts, and continuous measurements. This paper investigates causal discovery in Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) where nodes follow either an ordinal distribution (via an ordered logit model) or a regular one-parameter exponential family distribution. We prove that the edge direction between an ordinal and an exponential family node is distributionally identifiable for generic parameter values. Our findings generalize previous Ordinal-Poisson results to the broader exponential family. Computationally, we introduce a score-based exhaustive search and a masked continuous optimization framework using DAGMA for larger graphs. Numerical results validate the theory, recovering edge orientations within a Markov equivalence class that are unidentifiable under classical structural equation models.

</details>


### [292] [Layer-wise Curriculum Learning for Efficient LLM Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19213)
*Donggeon Lee,Dooyeon Na,Seungmin Oh,Jongbin Ryu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出逐层课程学习（layer-wise curriculum learning）用于高效LLM压缩，通过将模型划分为多层段、缓解累积误差、并配合多线程特征缓存，实现了SOTA压缩性能与显著的效率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM压缩中知识从教师模型向学生模型迁移时存在计算开销大、层间特征错位以及累积误差导致收敛慢/不稳定等问题，亟需兼顾性能与计算效率的压缩方案。

Method: 1) 将整个模型划分为由若干层组成的多个段，实现逐层课程学习，从易到难逐步迁移知识；2) 基于对累积误差现象的理论分析，用课程学习加速收敛并稳定迁移过程；3) 提出多线程特征缓存方法，解决跨层特征错位问题并最大化GPU利用率。

Result: 在多个数据集上取得SOTA性能；在BERT和GPT-2上GPU显存占用与训练时间均降低50%以上；在相同训练时间下，于LLaMA系列与Qwen模型上优于其他剪枝方法，且显存占用更低。

Conclusion: 逐层课程学习结合特征缓存可同时实现先进的压缩性能与高计算效率（低显存、短训练时长），在多种模型规模与架构上具有良好通用性。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce layer-wise curriculum learning for efficient LLM compression. The proposed method facilitates the knowledge transfer from the teacher model to the student model, utilizing a curriculum learning approach that begins with easier optimization tasks and progressively tackles harder ones. In order to adopt the layer-wise learning in LLM compression, we partition the whole model into multiple segments consisting of layers, thereby enabling more computationally efficient knowledge transfer for LLMs. Based on our theoretical analysis of cumulative error phenomenon, layer-wise curriculum learning accelerates convergence while stabilizing the knowledge transfer process. In addition, we present a feature caching method with a multi-threading strategy to efficiently address feature misalignment across layers, maximizing GPU utilization. Consequently, our method exhibits advanced model compression performance, as well as high computational efficiency in terms of minimized memory usage and short training hours. Experiments on multiple datasets show that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing GPU memory usage and training hours by more than 50\% on BERT and GPT-2. Moreover, it outperforms the other pruning methods on LLaMA-family and Qwen models under the same training hours, with a lower GPU memory footprint.

</details>


### [293] [Randomized SVD Approximations for Spectral Co-Clustering of Word-Document Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19243)
*Fateme Mazdarani,Carlos Toxtli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出两种面向二部文本数据归一化谱共聚类的随机近似方法（随机投影SVD与部分SVD结合逐元素随机采样），在真实与合成数据集上降低运行时间，但其效果依赖矩阵稀疏性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谱共聚类能发现词-文档矩阵中的潜在结构，但依赖SVD，在高维数据上标准方法代价高昂。

Method: 针对文档簇与词簇数量可能不同的归一化谱共聚类，提出两种随机近似：一是通过随机投影的随机SVD；二是将部分SVD与逐元素随机采样结合。

Result: 在真实与合成数据集上，两种方法相较完整SVD基线均降低运行时间，但表现取决于矩阵稀疏性：随机投影方法在测试设置中更稳定可靠；基于采样的方法在较稠密矩阵上最有用，对已稀疏的文本数据收益有限。

Conclusion: 谱共聚类的随机近似应根据数据底层结构进行选择。

Abstract: Spectral co-clustering is a useful tool for discovering latent structure in word-document matrices, but its reliance on singular value decomposition (SVD) can make standard formulations expensive on high-dimensional data. This paper presents two randomized approximations for normalized spectral co-clustering of bipartite text data when the numbers of document and word clusters may differ. The first method uses randomized SVD through random projection, while the second combines partial SVD with element-wise random sampling. Across real-world and synthetic datasets, both methods reduce runtime relative to the full-SVD baseline, but their behavior depends on matrix sparsity. The random projection method is the more reliable approximation across the tested settings, whereas the sampling-based method is most useful on denser matrices and provides limited benefit on already sparse text data. These results show that randomized approximations for spectral co-clustering should be selected according to the underlying structure of the data.

</details>


### [294] [How to Guide Your Language Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19356)
*Rohit Dilip,Tianrong Chen,Yuyang Wang,David Van Valen,Joshua Susskind,Miguel Angel Bautista*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"探针引导"（probe guidance），利用冻结扩散模型的内部状态构造引导信号以引导流匹配模型，无需额外前向传播，在扩散语言模型上达到无条件生成的新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有autoguidance需要推理时额外的前向传播，且难以保证弱模型与强模型具有相似的动力学。作者希望在消除额外计算开销的同时，提供一种可靠路径来确保强弱模型动力学相似。

Method: probe guidance：使用已有扩散模型中冻结的内部状态（frozen internal states）来构造引导信号，原理上与autoguidance类似，但无需推理时的额外前向传播。将该方法应用于连续扩散语言模型，并借助探针研究传统autoguidance设置（强模型为弱checkpoint）。

Result: 在连续扩散语言模型上，probe guidance在无条件生成任务上刷新SOTA；应用于1.7B扩散语言模型时，在多项选择题问答基准上取得一致提升。研究发现，在autoguidance中作为强模型替代的弱checkpoint必须来自训练的低熵区域。

Conclusion: probe guidance为改进扩散语言模型提供了实用手段，同时揭示了autoguidance背后此前理解不足的实际机制——弱模型需处于低熵训练区域。

Abstract: We introduce a new method to guide flow matching models. Our approach, which we call probe guidance, uses the frozen internal states of an existing diffusion model to construct a guidance signal. This works using a similar principle as autoguidance, but eliminates the need for an additional forward pass at inference time and provides a reliable path to ensure that the weak and strong model share similar dynamics. We apply and benchmark this method on continuous diffusion language models, where probe guidance sets a new state-of-the-art performance on unconditional generation. When applied to a 1.7B diffusion language model, probe guidance consistently improves on multiple choice question answering benchmarks. Using our probes, we study the traditional autoguidance setting where the strong model is a weak checkpoint, and find that the weak model must come from a low-entropy region of training. These findings both provide a practical way to improve diffusion language models and shed light on the actual mechanism behind autoguidance, which is currently poorly understood.

</details>


### [295] [Past, Future, All at Once: Mitigating Stability-Plasticity Dilemma via Post-hoc JANUS Rectification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19985)
*Zhilong Zheng,Letian Tao,Yang Guan,Yujie Yang,Wei Xiong,Kehua Sheng,Bo Zhang,Jingliang Duan,Keqiang Li,Shengbo Eben Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出JANUS框架，通过将参数更新投影到Jacobian零空间实现参数空间正交性，以事后、与微调方法无关的方式缓解灾难性遗忘，兼顾历史知识保留与下游任务适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型在新任务上微调时不可避免地产生灾难性遗忘。现有基于参数高效微调（PEFT）的方法采用过于严格的子空间正交（Subspace Orthogonality）条件，限制了历史知识的保留效果。

Method: 提出纯事后（post-hoc）、与微调方法无关的权重矫正框架JANUS。将参数更新投影到Jacobian零空间，满足一阶意义上保持历史性能的充要条件——参数空间正交性（Parameter Space Orthogonality）。针对Jacobian近似的局部有效性问题，提出多步自适应矫正机制，利用JANUS偏移动态验证有效信赖域并调整步长。并结合ghost projection、ghost orientation comparison和序列级SVD压缩技术提升时空效率。

Result: 实验表明JANUS可与多种微调方法无缝集成，在保留下游任务适应能力的同时恢复历史知识，显著缓解稳定性-可塑性困境。

Conclusion: JANUS通过参数空间正交性与多步自适应矫正机制，在事后、与微调方法无关的前提下有效缓解灾难性遗忘，并以高效时空实现提升实用性。

Abstract: Fine-tuning foundation models on new tasks inevitably suffer from catastrophic forgetting. While existing works attempt to mitigate this on the basis of parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods, they adopted an overly restrictive Subspace Orthogonality condition. In this paper, we introduce a purely post-hoc and tuning-agnostic weight rectification framework that achieves Parameter Space Orthogonality, which is the necessary and sufficient condition for preserving historical performance to the first order. By projecting parameter updates into the JAcobian NUll Space (JANUS), our method significantly recovers compromised historical knowledge without interfering with the underlying fine-tuning process. To overcome the local validity of the Jacobian approximation, we further propose a Multi-step Adaptive Rectification mechanism that utilizes the JANUS shift to dynamically verify the valid trust region and adjust step sizes. Coupled with our proposed ghost projection, ghost orientation comparison, and sequence-level singular value decomposition compression techniques, JANUS also achieves great temporal and spatial efficiency. Experiments demonstrate that JANUS seamlessly integrates with various fine-tuning methods, significantly mitigating the stability-plasticity dilemma by recovering historical knowledge while preserving downstream task adaptation.

</details>


### [296] [EPIG-Tree: Compute-Optimal Branching for Gradient-Efficient Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20004)
*Nikita Khomich,Leopold Hermansson,Ido Hakimi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文将树状 rollout 构建视为策略梯度估计中的算力分配问题，提出 EPIG-Tree 分支分配方法，按"单位算力对策略梯度不确定性的削减"放置分支，并在连续控制、LLM 梯度校准、数学与 Wordle 任务上验证其优于 GRPO 与熵分支。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于奖励的强化学习（如 GRPO）将整条随机轨迹压缩为单一标量奖励，虽简洁可扩展，但探索与奖励分配效率低下：轨迹中大量因果决策、恢复尝试与环境随机事件共享同一轨迹级优势。作者因此追问：树状 rollout 的分支应放在何处，才能最有效地改善策略梯度估计。

Method: 将分支放置建模为算力分配问题，核心主张是分支应放在"单位算力最能降低策略梯度不确定性"之处。通过对局部策略梯度随机变量做全方差分解，导出两条分配律：新分支降低决策不确定性，重复后缀 rollout 降低延续不确定性。据此提出 EPIG-Tree 分数，仅利用已计算 rollout 估计占用与得分加权的价值不确定性，并给出后缀律 n_e ∝ w_e·‖∇_θ log π(a_e|h_e)‖·σ_e/√c_e。

Result: 在克隆状态控制中，EPIG 降低梯度 MSE，在 13 个环境扫描中的全部 9 个稠密连续控制环境中胜出，并近乎完美地恢复参考梯度方向；在冻结 LLM 上，其梯度校准优于熵分支。在线单轮数学任务中，树局部信用优于扁平 GRPO，但分支放置的重要性次于 token 级信用分配。在线多轮 Wordle 中，EPIG 取得最高最终胜率 0.850，超过早期饱和于 0.790 的扁平 GRPO 以及熵分支。

Conclusion: 按不确定性削减效率分配树分支可改善策略梯度估计，该优势能迁移到有状态、大动作空间场景；在部分任务中，token 级信用分配比分支放置更为关键。

Abstract: Reward-based reinforcement learning for language models, exemplified by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), collapses an entire stochastic trajectory into a single scalar reward. This is clean and scalable, but it explores and allocates reward inefficiently: a trajectory may contain many causal decisions, recovery attempts, and environment-randomness events, yet every token or action inherits one trajectory-level advantage. We study tree-based rollout construction as a compute-allocation problem for policy-gradient estimation. Our central claim is that branches should be placed not where the policy is merely uncertain, but where an additional branch most reduces uncertainty about the policy gradient per unit of compute. From a law-of-total-variance decomposition of the local policy-gradient random variable, we derive two allocation laws: new branches reduce decision uncertainty, while repeated suffix rollouts reduce continuation uncertainty. The resulting EPIG-Tree score allocates branches using the already computed rollouts. It estimates occupancy- and score-weighted value uncertainty, along with a suffix law $n_e \propto w_e \|\nabla_θ\log π(a_e|h_e)\| σ_e / \sqrt{c_e}$. Empirically, EPIG reduces gradient MSE in cloned-state control, winning in all nine dense continuous-control environments of a 13-environment sweep and recovering the reference gradient direction near-perfectly, and it improves frozen-LLM gradient calibration relative to entropy branching. In online single-turn math, tree-local credit beats flat GRPO, while branch placement is secondary to token-level credit assignment. In online multi-turn Wordle, EPIG attains the highest final win rate (0.850), overtaking flat GRPO, which saturates early at 0.790, and entropy branching as training proceeds, confirming that the gradient-estimation advantage transfers to a stateful, large-action setting.

</details>


### [297] [Dynamic Generalized Gromov-Wasserstein Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20008)
*Junda Ying,Zhiwei Zeng,Peijie Zhou,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出TP-DATE框架，将Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输动态化，通过路径作用量统一定义二次型OT并证明静态-动态等价，利用travelling-pair流匹配实现无模拟的连续轨迹重建，在空间转录组数据上更好地保持空间结构并改进3D动态重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GW-OT通过引入结构感知的传输代价扩展了经典最优传输，适用于需在匹配表达模式的同时保持组织结构的空间转录组学。然而现有方法多为静态形式，缺乏用于重建连续轨迹的通用动态框架。

Method: 提出TP-DATE理论计算框架，以无模拟方式动态推广GW-OT；通过路径作用量形式化一大类静态与动态二次型OT（QOT）并证明静态-动态等价性；进一步提出travelling-pair流匹配，允许相互作用的条件路径并将其交互边缘化为单一向量场。

Result: 在合成与真实空间转录组数据上，TP-DATE更好地保持了空间结构，并改善了连续3D动态重建效果。

Conclusion: TP-DATE为结构感知最优传输提供了通用的动态建模范式，通过路径作用量与travelling-pair流匹配实现了无模拟的连续轨迹估计，在空间转录组动态重建任务上优于静态方法。

Abstract: Gromov--Wasserstein optimal transport (GW-OT) extends classical optimal transport by introducing structure-aware transport cost. This is particularly relevant for spatial transcriptomics, where dynamical reconstruction should preserve tissue structure in addition to matching expression patterns. While static formulations have been widely used for such structure-aware alignment, a general dynamic formulation for reconstructing continuous trajectories is still missing. We introduce Travelling Pair Dynamical Alignment and Trajectory Estimation (TP-DATE), a theoretical and computational framework to generalize GW-OT dynamically in a simulation-free manner. We formulate a broad class of static and dynamic Quadratic-form OT (QOT) through path actions and prove the static dynamic equivalence. We further develop travelling-pair flow matching, which allows interacting conditional paths and marginalizes their interactions into a single vector field. On synthetic and real spatial transcriptomics data, TP-DATE better preserves spatial structure and improves continuous 3D dynamics reconstruction.

</details>


### [298] [Correct Now, Insufficient Later: Auditing Update Sufficiency in Context Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20045)
*Guangzhe Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"配对历史审计"方法，用于揭示记忆系统在"当前答案正确但丢弃后续更新所需区分"时的失败模式，并通过合成机制、多种记忆条件与记录级审计进行可复现的失败分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 记忆系统可能在当前查询上回答正确，却丢弃了后续更新所要求的区分信息，导致未来更新后答案错误。作者希望用配对历史审计来系统性地刻画并定位这类失败，而非仅报告总体精度。

Method: 采用配对历史审计：两条历史当前答案相同、共享同一未来更新，但要求不同的后续答案。在六个合成机制、12种记忆条件、两次重复、两个模型后端上评估24个历史对；使用确定性前沿选择器、结构化写入器，并进行四结果联合对比的有限样本识别区间分析、记录级审计（区分保留状态充分性、响应交付、答案模式合规）、墓碑移除与标识符重命名测试，以及标签等变修复。

Result: 前沿选择器严格揭示准确率为 DeepSeek 96/96、GLM 82/96；结构化写入器为62次成功、1个未定结果与56/96。四结果联合对比的有限样本识别区间为[0.521,0.542]和[0.292,0.313]。记录级审计发现26与25个格式良好但语义错误的结构化揭示记忆，GLM 14个前沿揭示失败均为"正确值放入错误包装"。墓碑移除在目标机制下产生16/16精确重放失败；标识符重命名后原始前沿后向引用充分性从8/8降至94/320。标签等变修复仅保留2/8原始后向引用答案。所有证据为付费试运行、回顾性诊断与离线测试，无独立留出或自然任务验证。

Conclusion: 结果支持一种范围受限的评估方法论与可复现的失败分析，而非声称修复算法具有普遍优越性。消除命名捷径并不能解决未知未来相关性问题。

Abstract: A memory can answer a current query correctly while discarding distinctions required by a later update. We investigate this failure with a paired-history audit: two histories have the same current answer, receive a shared future update, and require different subsequent answers. A pilot evaluates 24 history pairs across six synthetic mechanisms, 12 memory conditions, two repeats, and two model backends. A deterministic frontier selector obtains strict reveal accuracy of 96/96 on DeepSeek and 82/96 on GLM; a structured writer obtains 62 successes with one unresolved outcome and 56/96. The configured four-outcome joint contrast has finite-sample identification intervals of [0.521, 0.542] and [0.292, 0.313], not confidence intervals. A record-level audit distinguishes retained-state adequacy, response delivery, and answer-schema compliance without changing those original scores. It finds 26 and 25 well-formed but semantically wrong structured reveal memories, while all 14 GLM frontier reveal failures contain correct values in the wrong wrapper. Tombstone removal produces 16/16 exact replay failures in the targeted mechanism. Identifier renaming then exposes a separate flaw: original frontier late-reference adequacy falls from 8/8 to 94/320 transformed instances. We provide and test a label-equivariant repair, but it preserves only 2/8 original late-reference answers: eliminating a naming shortcut does not solve unknown future relevance. These results support a scoped evaluation methodology and reproducible failure analysis, not general superiority of the repaired algorithm. Paid pilot evidence, retrospective diagnostics, and new offline tests are reported separately; no independent held-out or natural-task validation is claimed.

</details>


### [299] [Local Sparsity Enables Unsupervised LLM Safety Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20129)
*Xin Chen,Gil Kur,Alexander Shevchenko,Andreas Krause*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于局部掩码稀疏自编码器（SAE）的异常检测框架，仅依赖安全数据建模即可在LLM部署阶段识别新型攻击与危害类别，并在仅用1-2%神经元计算时接近最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM部署阶段安全方法多为监督式，依赖不安全训练数据，难以应对不断出现的新攻击与危害类别；转向异常检测思路又面临LLM激活处于高维空间、统计可行性存疑的问题。

Method: 在线性表示假设（LRH）下，利用经稀疏自编码器恢复的概念空间中相邻点共享较小公共活跃支撑这一局部稀疏性，提出局部掩码的SAE异常检测框架，并给出理论证明。

Result: 在多种架构与数据集（含能力测试集和安全专用数据集）上验证有效；当允许使用1%分布外数据进行校准时，局部稀疏方法达到接近最优性能，且仅需1-2%的SAE神经元参与计算。

Conclusion: 局部稀疏的SAE异常检测在统计上可行，能够仅用安全数据捕获有意义的部署期安全信息，为应对新型攻击与危害类别提供了高效、低计算开销的方案。

Abstract: Deployment-time safety methods for large language models (LLMs) are predominantly supervised and assume access to unsafe training data. Nevertheless, new attacks and harm categories regularly arise, not captured by models trained in such a supervised fashion. An alternative approach is to view this problem through the lens of anomaly detection, namely, to rely solely on modeling safe data and flagging out-of-distribution inputs. However, LLM activations lie in a high-dimensional space, raising concerns about whether anomaly detection is statistically feasible. We show that, under the linear representation hypothesis (LRH), there may indeed be hope. In the LRH concept space, which is typically recovered via a sparse autoencoder (SAE), nearby points share a small common active support. Using this local sparsity insight, we propose a framework for locally masked SAE-based anomaly detection, supported by theoretical justifications. We validate it on various architectures and datasets, including both capability-testing datasets and safety-specific datasets. Finally, when we allow algorithms to use 1% out-of-distribution data for calibration, locally sparse methods achieve near-optimal performance, demonstrating their ability to capture meaningful safety information while using only 1-2% of SAE neurons for computation.

</details>


### [300] [QUALS: Corpus Equilibrium for Universal Forecasting via Pattern Quantization and Learnability Synchronization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20156)
*Yujie Li,Zezhi Shao,Chengqing Yu,Yisong Fu,Weijie Zhu,Yifan Du,Jilin Hu,Bin Yang,Yongjun Xu,Fei Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出QUALS，一个大规模时间序列语料均衡框架，通过模式量化与可学习性同步两大机制优化数据采样，显著提升数据效率，使现有模型仅用少量训练数据即可获得更优的零样本预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型的现有研究多聚焦架构创新，忽视数据多样性，常采用简单采样策略，难以有效处理复杂数据分布，导致训练数据利用低效、性能次优。

Method: QUALS包含两个核心机制：(1) 模式量化框架，通过向量量化和均匀分箱从混合语料中系统解码异构模式；(2) 可学习性同步框架，校准异构模式的采样权重，弥合简单与复杂模体之间的优化差距。

Result: 大量基准实验表明，在QUALS上预训练即使在训练预算大幅缩减的情况下，仍能持续取得更优的零样本预测性能。

Conclusion: QUALS通过语料均衡提升数据效率，为时间序列基础模型的高效预训练提供了有效方案，证明数据层面优化与架构创新同等重要。

Abstract: Ubiquitous time series data across diverse domains enables critical applications in areas such as transportation systems and power grids. Recently, training foundation models on massive datasets to achieve accurate zero-shot forecasting has emerged as a major research focus. However, current studies predominantly prioritize architectural innovations while insufficiently addressing data diversity, often relying on simple data sampling strategies that fail to manage complex data distributions effectively, leading to inefficient use of training data and suboptimal performance. To address this, we propose QUALS, a large-scale time series corpus equilibrium framework. QUALS significantly enhances data efficiency, i.e., enabling existing models to achieve superior performance using only a small fraction of the original training data. Specifically, QUALS operates through two core mechanisms. First, a pattern quantization framework systematically decodes heterogeneous patterns from mixed corpora via vector quantization and uniform binning. Second, a learnability synchronization framework calibrates sampling weights for heterogeneous patterns, bridging the optimization gap between simple and complex motifs to maximize overall training efficiency. Extensive benchmarks demonstrate that pre-training on QUALS consistently achieves superior zero-shot performance, even under substantially reduced training budgets.

</details>


### [301] [SoftTri: Smooth Triangular Membership Functions for Adaptive Fuzzy Inference Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20194)
*Babak Sarani,Rahman Ardakanian,Ali Mousavi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SoftTri，一种基于Swish型激活的平滑软铰链机制构造的可微三角隶属函数，具有C∞光滑性并保持经典三角MF的几何结构与局部性，集成至Takagi-Sugeno模糊神经网络后在多个逼近基准与Airfoil自噪声回归任务上提升了优化稳定性与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典三角隶属函数因可解释性强、参数化复杂度低、局部性好而被广泛使用，但其在节点处不可微，限制了自适应神经模糊架构中基于梯度的优化，常需次梯度近似或启发式平滑。因此需要一种既保持三角MF几何结构与局部特性、又可全程微分的方法。

Method: 提出SoftTri：利用受Swish型激活启发的平滑软铰链机制构造可微三角隶属函数。该公式在任意有限锐度参数β>0下，对输入变量及隶属参数(a,b,c)均具有C∞光滑性。推导了闭式解析梯度，以支持高效、完全可微的反向传播学习。将SoftTri集成到采用网格划分规则的Takagi-Sugeno模糊神经网络中。

Result: 在多个一维、二维非线性逼近基准以及基于Airfoil Self-Noise数据集的真实回归任务上进行评估。实验结果表明，与经典三角隶属函数相比，SoftTri一致地改善了优化稳定性与逼近精度；在相同规则结构与训练设置下，其性能与高斯隶属函数相当或更优。

Conclusion: SoftTri在现代神经模糊学习系统中为可解释性与可微优化之间提供了一种有效的折中方案。

Abstract: Triangular membership functions (MFs) are widely used in fuzzy systems because of their interpretability, low parameterization complexity, and strong locality properties. However, their inherent nondifferentiability at knot points limits the effectiveness of gradient-based optimization in adaptive neuro-fuzzy architectures, often necessitating subgradient approximations or heuristic smoothing techniques. In this paper, we propose \emph{SoftTri}, a differentiable triangular membership function constructed using a smooth soft-hinge mechanism inspired by Swish-type activations. The proposed formulation preserves the geometric structure and localized behavior of classical triangular MFs while providing $C^\infty$ smoothness with respect to both the input variable and the membership parameters $(a,b,c)$ for any finite sharpness parameter $β>0$. Closed-form analytical gradients are derived to enable efficient and fully differentiable backpropagation-based learning. SoftTri is integrated into a Takagi--Sugeno fuzzy neural network with grid-partitioned rules and evaluated on multiple one-dimensional and two-dimensional nonlinear approximation benchmarks as well as a real-world regression task using the Airfoil Self-Noise dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that SoftTri consistently improves optimization stability and approximation accuracy compared with classical triangular membership functions, while achieving performance comparable to or better than Gaussian MFs under identical rule structures and training settings. The proposed approach provides an effective compromise between interpretability and differentiable optimization in modern neuro-fuzzy learning systems.

</details>


### [302] [Scene-Conditioned Relation Routing for urban cellular activity forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20209)
*Qingzhong Li,Jingye Lin,Hui Ma,Yajun Zhang,Xinjun Pei,Ming Yan,Fei Xing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出场景条件空间关系路由框架SCRR-Net，用城市上下文联合控制空间依赖选择与跨任务知识迁移，在米兰和特伦托数据集上优于对比方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市蜂窝活动预测需联合建模SMS、移动网络流量与通话活动等异质时空信号。现有方法将时间建模、空间关系学习与多信号预测相互分离，依赖固定图结构或静态多任务学习，难以适应不断变化的城市场景。

Method: SCRR-Net由四部分组成：上下文编码器、空间图专家路由模块、时间Transformer编码器、任务知识路由模块。城市上下文信息共同驱动空间依赖选择与跨任务知识迁移，实现场景条件的路由机制。

Result: 在Milano与Trento数据集上，SCRR-Net在SMS、网络流量与通话活动预测任务上持续优于竞争方法，并呈现可解释的路由行为。

Conclusion: 以场景为条件的统一路由框架能够更自适应地建模异质时空信号，兼顾预测性能与路由可解释性。

Abstract: Urban cellular activity forecasting requires jointly modeling heterogeneous spatiotemporal signals, including SMS usage, mobile network traffic, and call activity. Existing methods often separate temporal modeling, spatial relation learning, and multi-signal prediction, relying on fixed graph structures or static multi-task learning schemes, which limits their adaptability to changing urban scenes. We propose SCRR-Net, a scene-conditioned spatial relation routing framework in which urban contextual information jointly controls spatial dependency selection and cross-task knowledge transfer. SCRR-Net includes a context encoder, a spatial graph expert routing module, a temporal Transformer encoder, and a task knowledge routing module. Experiments on the Milano and Trento datasets demonstrate that SCRR-Net consistently outperforms competing methods on SMS, network traffic, and call activity forecasting, while providing interpretable routing behaviors.

</details>


### [303] [Is It Still Worth Training a Classical Model in the Era of LLMs? A Crossover Benchmark on Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20218)
*Kaihua Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文量化了“提示冻结大模型”与“收集数据训练经典模型”的取舍：提出带标签数据交叉点 N*，发现仅需约 6%（中位数）训练集大小的标注数据，训练模型即可超越冻结小 GPT 模型，且在小样本场景训练更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流表格工具已支持零训练地用大模型对表格行打标签，但许多业务预测问题标注昂贵，实践者需知道：应提示冻结 LLM，还是收集数据训练模型，以及需要多少数据。现有研究缺乏对这一取舍的定量刻画。

Method: 提出“带标签数据交叉点 N*”，即训练模型学习曲线超越冻结 LLM 平坦误差所需的训练集规模。汇总 126 份独立学生评测：18 个表格数据集、小 GPT 模型、8 种提示配置，配以 6 类经典模型族的幂律学习曲线；并做控制性探针实验，考察独立实施者复现的一致性及 LLM 对特征名语义的依赖。

Result: 训练胜出很快：即使让 LLM 使用最优提示配置（oracle），训练模型在 86% 情况下用现有数据量即可胜出，40% 情况下用最小评估子集即胜出，交叉点中位数约为训练集的 6%。少样本示例不遵循训练式幂律；跨实施者复现的变异系数为 0.148。探针表明 LLM 依赖可识别的特征名语义，故交叉点可能是保守估计（不主张记忆）。

Conclusion: 对典型业务表格任务，证据明确：收集几百个标注并训练梯度提升模型，优于提示冻结小 LLM。该结论为标注数据量与建模范式的选择提供了可操作的量化依据。

Abstract: Large language models can label a tabular row from a plain-English description with no training - a capability now shipping in mainstream spreadsheet tools such as Microsoft Copilot in Excel and Anthropic's Claude for Excel - raising a practical question for the many business prediction problems where labels are expensive: should you prompt a frozen LLM, or collect data and train a model - and if so, how much data? We quantify the answer with the labeled-data crossover N*, the training-set size at which a trained classical model's learning curve overtakes a frozen LLM's training-free (and therefore flat) error. Aggregating 126 independent student evaluations of small GPT models under eight prompting configurations across 18 tabular datasets, paired with authoritative power-law learning curves for six classical model families, we find that training wins fast: even given an oracle choice of its best prompt configuration, a trained classical model beats the small frozen LLM using no more labeled data than is already on hand in 86% of cases, and wins by the smallest labeled subset we evaluate in 40%, with the observed crossover at a median of ~6% of the training set. In-context few-shot examples do not behave like training - error versus shot count does not follow a power law - and the same protocol re-run by independent implementers varies with a coefficient of variation of 0.148. A controlled probe indicates the LLM depends on recognizable feature-name semantics, which plausibly makes our crossover a conservative estimate (we do not claim memorization). For a typical business table, the evidence is clear: collect a few hundred labels and train a gradient-boosted model.

</details>


### [304] [Labeled Incidence Structures for Native Transformer Modeling of Text, Knowledge Graphs, and Hypergraphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20278)
*Mahesh Godavarti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出标签化关联结构（LIS），用统一的 $(x_d, s, e)$ 三元组表示文本、知识图谱和超图中的端点，使标准 Transformer 无需展平即可原生处理多种数据类型，并通过算子分解对注意力施加角色与关系感知的归纳偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本、知识图谱和超图的元素在关系实例中扮演不同角色，现有方法将数据展平为 token 序列后丢失了这种结构信息；同时持久知识库中基于存储位置的标识符会导致模型对存储顺序敏感，而自由学习的标识符在库规模增大时难以控制。

Method: 提出 LIS，将每个端点编码为内容 $x_d$、角色/槽 $s$ 与关系实例 $e$ 的三元组；通过槽算子与实例算子组合为结构地址 $A(s,e)=R_s R_e$，刻画其给出唯一且路径无关地址的条件；以相对传输 $P_{j\to i}=A_i^{-1}A_j$ 作为端点比较算子，为注意力引入角色与关系感知的归纳偏置；并分析持久知识库中关系实例算子的计算方式。

Result: 证明“位置项加关系项”的加性编码无法捕捉 $s$ 与 $e$ 的联合依赖，并在受控示例族中给出反例；同时表明由内容计算关系实例算子可避免存储顺序问题，在固定架构与 Lipschitz 假设下得到与 $M$ 无关的容量界。

Conclusion: LIS 为异构结构化数据提供了统一的非展平表示，结构差异由算子而非架构承担；相对传输算子给出了无需人为序列顺序的注意力归纳偏置；由内容计算关系实例算子可规避存储顺序敏感性并给出与库规模无关的容量保证。

Abstract: Text, knowledge graphs, and hypergraphs all have elements that play distinct roles within relation instances, structure that is lost when data is flattened into token sequences. We introduce labeled incidence structures (LIS), a uniform representation that encodes each endpoint as $(x_d, s, e)$: content $x_d$, a role or slot $s$, and the relation instance $e$ in which that role appears. Because every data type maps to the same $(x_d, s, e)$ representation without flattening, a single standard transformer can process them all natively, structural differences are carried entirely by the operators, not the architecture.
  LIS assigns a structural address to each endpoint by composing a slot operator and an instance operator, $A(s,e) = R_s R_e$. We characterize when this factorization gives every token a unique, path-independent address. When it does, the natural operator comparing endpoint $j$ to endpoint $i$ is the relative transport $P_{j\to i} = A_i^{-1} A_j$, which gives attention a role- and relation-aware inductive bias without imposing an arbitrary sequence order.
  Additive encodings of the form "position term plus relation term" can miss information that depends jointly on $s$ and $e$. We prove this in a controlled example family: when the journey operator is approximated by the sum of a position-only term and a relation-only term, the approximation cannot capture how position and relation combine, only their separate effects.
  We also analyze persistent knowledge repositories. Identifiers tied to storage locations make models sensitive to storage order, while freely learned identifiers can become harder to control as the repository size $M$ grows relative to the sample size $n$. Computing relation-instance operators from content avoids this storage-order issue and yields a capacity bound independent of $M$, under fixed architectural and Lipschitz assumptions.

</details>


### [305] [SCGFM-ART: Amortized Relational Transport for Structure-Centric Graph Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20419)
*Xiaodong He,Xincheng Wang,Zhao Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SCGFM-ART，一种以结构为中心的图基础模型框架，通过摊销关系传输（ART）将任意图对齐到共享的"关系图谱"上，从而在严重异质的图域间学习可迁移表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图基础模型（GFM）旨在跨高度异质的图域学习可迁移表示，但拓扑、图规模与特征语义上的严重域偏移阻碍了统一、域无关表示空间的构建。

Method: 提出SCGFM-ART：以有限"关系地标（基）"定义通用坐标系统（关系图谱）；ART直接端到端预测可复用的图到基的传输方案，绕过昂贵的Gromov-Wasserstein运行时优化。图被分解为统一表示：全局用相对图谱的关系响应坐标，局部用节点到角色的结构对应，将异构节点属性投影到规范角色空间。作者将图与图谱基严格建模为有限测度关系空间。

Result: 在14个跨域图级与节点级分类任务中取得最优迁移性能，平均排名分别为2.29和1.14；拓扑扰动分析显示节点-角色传输能保留超越全局坐标的细粒度结构；在真实基准上，摊销公式使冻结目标域推理加速44.2至85.1倍。

Conclusion: SCGFM-ART通过关系图谱与摊销关系传输，在单一对齐接口中解决了结构与语义异质性，并给出坐标保真界、预测传输稳定性及摊销覆盖界等理论保证，实现了高效且强迁移的图基础模型。

Abstract: Graph foundation models (GFMs) aim to learn transferable representations across severely heterogeneous graph domains. However, severe domain shifts in topology, graph scale, and feature semantics impede the construction of a unified, domain-agnostic representation space. To address this, we propose SCGFM-ART, a structure-centric GFM framework that aligns arbitrary graphs onto a shared relational atlas via Amortized Relational Transport (ART). The relational atlas serves as a universal coordinate system defined by a finite set of relational landmarks (bases), while ART directly predicts reusable, end-to-end graph-to-base transport plans, bypassing costly runtime Gromov-Wasserstein optimizations. Under this formulation, SCGFM-ART decomposes a graph into a unified representation: globally via its relational response coordinates relative to the atlas, and locally via its node-to-role structural correspondences. These correspondences project disparate node attributes into a canonical role space, resolving structural and semantic heterogeneity within a singular alignment interface. Rigorously modeling graphs and atlas bases as finite measured relational spaces, we establish coordinate fidelity bounds, prove stability under predicted transport plans, and derive an amortized coverage bound that guarantees our learning objective tightly surrogates ideal relational coverage. Benchmarked across 14 cross-domain graph- and node-level classification tasks, SCGFM-ART achieves state-of-the-art transferability, securing superior average ranks of 2.29 and 1.14, respectively. Topological perturbation analyses demonstrate that node-role transport retains fine-grained structural nuances beyond global coordinates. On real-world benchmarks, the amortized formulation yields 44.2 to 85.1 times faster frozen target-domain inference by avoiding iterative alignment at test time.

</details>


### [306] [Deep Learning-Based Classification of Cognitive and Resting States Using Electroencephalography Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20467)
*K. A. Januka S. Fernando,Harshit Srivastava*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种CNN堆叠GRU的深度学习框架，结合时频分析，从EEG信号中区分静息与认知状态，在静息-数学、静息-记忆、静息-音乐三类任务分类中分别达到83.177%、76.107%、83.432%的准确率，优于对比方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从EEG信号中分类认知与静息状态对理解与不同心理状态相关的大脑活动波动至关重要。EEG可无创记录静息和任务导向认知条件下的大脑功能，而深度学习能从复杂EEG数据中自动提取重要模式，因此需要一种有效的框架来区分这两类状态。

Method: 提出一种深度学习框架：将卷积神经网络（CNN）与门控循环单元（GRU）堆叠用于EEG信号特征提取；开展时频分析以探索信号显著特征；将提取的特征输入传统深度学习与机器学习分类器进行评估，包括所建议的2D-Net架构。

Result: 所提方法与特征提取策略优于所评估的对比方法，分类准确率为：静息-数学任务83.177%，静息-记忆任务76.107%，静息-音乐任务83.432%。

Conclusion: 结果证明了将信号处理与深度学习方法相结合、利用EEG信号区分静息与认知状态的有效性。

Abstract: The categorization of cognitive and resting states derived from electroencephalography (EEG) signals is crucial for comprehending fluctuations in brain activity linked to various mental states. EEG provides a non-intrusive approach for documenting brain function in both resting and task-oriented cognitive conditions, whilst deep learning techniques enable the automatic extraction of significant patterns from intricate EEG data. This study presents a deep learning framework to distinguish between resting and cognitive states through EEG records. The proposed framework integrates a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) stacked with a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) for the extraction of features from EEG signals. Time-frequency analysis is conducted to explore the salient aspects of signals, and the derived features are then assessed utilizing conventional deep learning and machine learning classifiers, including the suggested 2D-Net architecture. The proposed approach and feature extraction strategy outperform the evaluated comparative methods, achieving accuracies of 83.177% for resting-versus-mathematical task classification, 76.107% for resting-versus-memory task classification, and 83.432% for resting-versus-music task classification. The findings illustrate the efficacy of integrating signal processing with deep learning methodologies to discriminate resting from cognitive states utilizing EEG signals.

</details>


### [307] [Mitigating Retaliatory Algorithmic Collusion in Repeated Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20548)
*Karthik Sivachandran,Rohan Paleja*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将Q学习中的算法合谋现象与经典"简单惩罚码"（SPC）理论建立联系，提出CURB奖励塑形框架，通过惩罚条件策略依赖信号，保证消除由惩罚威胁维持的合谋均衡，在Bertrand与Cournot重复博弈中显著降低合谋。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习智能体在重复博弈中最大化自身收益时，无需通信或共享设计即可收敛到类似明示合谋的超竞争结果。现有缓解方法多局限于特定经济场景（如双边平台、拍卖），缺乏面向一般重复博弈的通用干预设计。

Method: 首先形式化连接先前Q学习合谋的经验观察与经典SPC理论，证明任何非平凡SPC都会在智能体策略中引入可量化的条件依赖，可通过智能体在合作历史与背叛历史下动作分布间的全变差（TV）距离检测。基于此提出CURB（Collusion Unwinding via Reward shaping and Belief injection），在Q学习过程中对TV距离信号施加惩罚，并证明该机制可将动态系统的任何SPC不动点转化为平凡不动点，从而排除由惩罚威胁维持的合谋均衡。

Result: 在Bertrand和Cournot竞争重复博弈中，CURB显著降低了Q学习智能体的合谋程度；在Bertrand竞争中进一步证明CURB可推广至深度Q网络（DQN）智能体，表明该机制不限于表格型Q学习。

Conclusion: CURB提供了一种通用、理论上可保证的合谋消解框架，将算法合谋的检测与干预统一到SPC理论视角下，并具备向深度强化学习扩展的潜力。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning agents trained to maximize their own reward in repeated interactions can converge to supra-competitive outcomes resembling explicit collusion, without communication or shared design. Existing mitigation approaches are largely tied to specific economic settings, like two-sided platforms and auctions, leaving open how to design interventions for general repeated games. We address this gap by formalizing the connection between empirical observations from prior work on Q-learning collusion and classical theory of Simple Penal Codes (SPCs). We show any non-trivial SPC induces a quantifiable conditional dependence in agents' policies, detectable via the total variation distance between an agent's action distributions across cooperation and defection histories. Building on this connection, we propose CURB (Collusion Unwinding via Reward shaping and Belief injection), a reward-shaping framework that penalizes this Total Variation (TV) distance signal during Q-learning and is guaranteed to convert any SPC fixed point of the dynamics into a trivial one, thus precluding collusive equilibria sustained by punishment threats. Empirically, CURB substantially reduces collusion by Q-learning agents in both Bertrand and Cournot Competition Repeated Games. We further demonstrate that CURB extends to deep Q-network agents in Bertrand competition, suggesting the mechanism generalizes beyond tabular Q-learning.

</details>


### [308] [Generative Query Suggestion via Intent Coverage and Query-Level Credit Assignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19209)
*Xinpeng Liu,Lu Ma,Jiayi Qiao,Mengyu Zhou,Linglong Li,Xiaofeng Bian,Haonan Chen,Xiaoxi Jiang,Guanjun Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种意图驱动的生成式查询建议框架，通过双阶段优化同时提升单条查询质量与整个建议列表的意图覆盖度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式查询建议的核心挑战在于：既要保证列表中每条查询各自有用，又要让整个列表覆盖不同意图，即需兼顾个体质量与整体多样性。

Method: 提出双阶段优化框架。第一阶段为意图感知多样性建模：构建意图对齐的监督微调（SFT）数据，并采用意图感知多样性奖励来优化意图覆盖；第二阶段为查询级信用分配：将单条质量信号路由至对应的查询token，同时在整个列表层面共享多样性信号。

Result: 在大规模生产数据集上开展在线A/B测试与离线评估，结果显示点击率、查询质量和意图覆盖度均有提升。

Conclusion: 该框架通过分离并分别优化单条查询质量与列表级意图多样性，有效提升了生成式查询建议的用户参与度与实际效果。

Abstract: Generative query suggestion aims to enhance user engagement by anticipating user intents and recommending relevant follow-up queries. A central challenge is to generate slates whose individual queries are useful while the slate covers distinct intents. We propose an Intent-Driven Query Suggestion Framework with dual-stage optimization. First, intent-aware diversity modeling constructs intent-aligned supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data and uses an Intent-Aware Diversity Reward to optimize intent coverage. Second, query-level credit assignment routes individual quality signals to the corresponding query tokens while sharing a slate-level diversity signal across the slate. Experiments on a large-scale production dataset, including online A/B testing and offline evaluation, show improvements in click-through rate, query quality, and intent coverage.

</details>


### [309] [Block Parallelism For Efficient Distributed Long-Context Diffusion Language Model Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19242)
*Tarun Suresh,Pranshu Chaturvedi,Hangoo Kang,Parth Shroff,Ishan S. Khare,Hermann Kumbong,Azalia Mirhoseini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出块并行（BP）及上下文分片块并行（CSBP），通过将每个损坏块计算分配到独立rank并分片共享干净序列，在不损失训练语义的前提下显著加速长上下文BDLM训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 块扩散语言模型（BDLM）在块间具自回归依赖、块内并行去噪，但长上下文训练受限于分布式注意力通信与激活内存。传统上下文并行（CP）按位置分片"干净+损坏"合并序列，需通信共享的干净K/V、块特定的损坏K/V及其梯度，开销大。

Method: 观察到BDLM目标函数可沿目标块分离，提出块并行（BP）：将每个损坏块的计算分配给单一rank。为扩展至长上下文，进一步提出上下文分片块并行（CSBP），在浅层rank间分片共享干净序列，使损坏K/V及梯度保持本地化，避免复制干净前缀，并保持BDLM训练语义不变。

Result: 16块H200、256K上下文下，CSBP相较最优基线在监督微调上吞吐提升1.18–1.45倍，自回归模型转BDLM提升1.27–1.33倍，峰值HBM持平或更低；512K下全模型加速1.61倍。8块H100上，DFlash2投机解码器训练在512K加速2.48倍、1M加速7.59倍。12小时DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B SFT对比中，CSBP在每个训练检查点的SWE-bench Verified和Terminal-Bench Lite通过率均更高。

Conclusion: CSBP作为一种新的分布式并行维度，有效解决BDLM长上下文训练的通信与内存瓶颈，在吞吐、显存和下游任务表现上均优于现有基线，具备良好可扩展性。

Abstract: Block diffusion language models (BDLMs) combine autoregressive dependencies across blocks with parallel denoising within blocks, but long-context training is constrained by distributed attention communication and activation memory. Conventional context parallelism (CP) shards the combined clean-plus-corrupted sequence by position, communicating shared clean K/V together with block-specific corrupted K/V and their gradients. We observe that the BDLM objective separates over target blocks. We introduce block parallelism (BP), a new distributed parallelism dimension that assigns each corrupted-block computation to one rank. To scale BP to long contexts, we introduce context-sharded block parallelism (CSBP), which also shards the shared clean sequence across those ranks. CSBP keeps corrupted K/V and gradients local, avoids replicated clean prefixes, and preserves BDLM training semantics. On 16 H200 GPUs at 256K context, CSBP improves throughput over the best baseline by 1.18-1.45x for supervised fine-tuning and 1.27-1.33x for conversion of autoregressive models to BDLMs, while matching or reducing peak HBM. Full-model speedup reaches 1.61x at 512K. On eight H100 GPUs, CSBP accelerates DFlash2 speculative-decoder training by 2.48x at 512K and 7.59x at 1M. In matched 12-hour DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B SFT runs, CSBP achieves higher pass rates at every trained checkpoint on SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench Lite. Code: https://github.com/ScalingIntelligence/Turbo-dLLM

</details>


### [310] [Radio-Frequency Convolutional Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19279)
*Zhihui Gao,Shi-Yuan Ma,Yiran Chen,Dirk Englund,Tingjun Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出射频卷积神经网络（RF-CNN），通过复用无线通信设备中已有的频率混频器，在频域以单次被动混频完成多通道卷积，实现边缘端深度CNN推理，能效低至0.72 fJ/MAC，较数字处理器降低两个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备（手机、可穿戴、无人机）运行AI模型具有低延迟、可扩展与数据隐私优势，但计算能力不足；而为其增加边缘加速器又受限于尺寸、重量、功耗与成本（SWaP-C）。作者希望利用设备已具备的无线射频硬件来承担推理计算，从而避免额外硬件开销。

Method: 提出RF-CNN：将多通道卷积映射到不同频率分量（频调），利用无线电台中现成的频率混频器对信号在时间域相乘、天然等价于频域卷积的特性，由被动混频器单次完成CNN推理；权重通过空中传输获得，模拟硬件与通信共享。

Result: 实验验证RF-CNN可运行最多26.4M参数、9层的深度CNN，任务涵盖无线信号分类、图像分类及可控图像生成，性能接近全精度。由于权重的空中获取与硬件共享，边缘设备仅需消耗数据准备与读出能量，能效达0.72 fJ/MAC，比附加数字处理器低约两个数量级。

Conclusion: 结果表明可借助已部署的无线基础设施，为已连接的数十亿设备提供高效、前沿的AI推理能力。

Abstract: Running artificial intelligence (AI) models directly on edge devices such as smartphones, wearables, and drones offers low latency, pervasive scalability, and data privacy, but these devices rarely carry the computing capability that modern neural networks demand. Edge accelerators have been developed in response, yet each adds computing hardware to devices already constrained in size, weight, power, and cost (SWaP-C). An alternative lies in what these devices already carry: the frequency mixer in every wireless radio multiplies signals in time, natively performing convolution in the frequency domain. Here we introduce radio-frequency convolutional neural networks (RF-CNNs), which repurpose existing communication hardware for CNN inference. Multi-channel convolutions are mapped onto frequency tones for a passive mixer to execute in a single pass. We experimentally demonstrate that RF-CNN runs deep CNNs up to 26.4 million parameters and nine layers from classification of wireless signals and images to controllable image generation, close to full-precision performance. Because the weights arrive over the air and the analog hardware is shared with communication, the edge device spends energy only on data preparation and readout-down to 0.72 femtojoules per multiply-accumulate, two orders of magnitude less than it would cost on an added digital processor. These results suggest that deployed wireless infrastructure can bring efficient, state-of-the-art AI inference to the billions of devices it already connects.

</details>


### [311] [Learning-Induced Dynamical Transition in Recurrent Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19288)
*Varun Vaidya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种非平衡动力学平均场理论(DMFT),描述循环神经网络在学习过程中从混沌动力学向稳定任务行为的转变。理论揭示:缓慢的反馈驱动学习过程产生逐渐增强的有效反馈强度,当该强度跨越由DMFT解的分岔所定义的关键值时,网络经历从混沌到稳定的转变;由此可识别临界反馈强度及依赖学习率的临界时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环神经网络的学习会根本性地重塑其底层动力学,将初始的混沌活动转变为稳定的任务相关行为。然而,对这一学习过程中动力学转变的理论刻画尚不充分,缺乏能够定量预测训练期间网络输出随学习时间演化的解析框架。

Method: 构建非平衡动力学平均场理论(DMFT)来描述学习过程中的动力学转变。推导学习全过程的双时关联函数,引入由学习产生的有效反馈强度作为序参量,并将其增长与DMFT解的分岔(临界点)相联系,进而得到临界反馈强度与依赖学习率的临界时间。

Result: 理论表明,学习驱动的有效反馈强度增长使网络穿越DMFT解的分岔点,实现从混沌到稳定动力学的转变;该转变得以发生是因为增长的已学反馈结构逐步形变有效动力学景观。从初始未训练状态出发,理论预测了训练中网络输出的时间演化,并与数值模拟定量吻合。

Conclusion: 学习可被视为一种非平衡过程,通过缓慢反馈驱动的有效反馈强度增长,推动循环网络穿越分岔点完成混沌-稳定的动力学转变。所提出的非平衡DMFT为刻画学习诱导的动力学重塑提供了可解析、可定量验证的理论框架,并成功预测训练动态。

Abstract: Learning in recurrent neural networks can fundamentally reshape their underlying dynamics, transforming initially chaotic activity into stable task-dependent behavior. We develop a non-equilibrium dynamical mean-field theory(DMFT) to describe this transition during learning. We show that a slow feedback-driven learning process generates an evolving effective feedback strength that drives the network through a transition from chaotic to stable dynamics defined by a bifurcation of the DMFT solution. By deriving the two-time correlation function throughout learning, we identify a critical feedback strength and a corresponding learning rate dependent critical time separating these regimes. The transition arises from the progressive deformation of an effective dynamical landscape by the growing learned feedback structure. Starting from the untrained state, the theory predicts the time evolution of the network output during training and shows quantitative agreement with numerical simulations.

</details>


### [312] [Personalized Federated Hierarchical Gaussian Processes for Privacy-Preserving Modeling of Heterogeneous Distributed Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19337)
*Xianjian Xie,Hao Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出个性化联邦分层高斯过程(pFedHGP)，通过将各客户端隐函数分解为共享全局成分、客户端偏差与局部残差三部分，在保护数据隐私的前提下实现概率回归与分类，并在故障监测和空气质量建模中获得优异表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦场景下客户端数据异构，单一全局模型难以刻画个体特性，而完全本地化建模又无法利用跨客户端共享信息。需要一种既能共享知识又能保留个性化的概率建模方法，同时兼顾隐私保护与不确定性量化。

Method: 将每个客户端的隐函数分解为三个层次：(1)共享全局成分，(2)共享全局核结构的客户端特定偏差，(3)灵活的局部残差。采用稀疏诱导变量近似与联邦变分推断，原始数据保留在本地，服务器仅同步共享成分的低维统计量。输出完整预测分布。并从瞬时线性混合模型(ILMM)视角将层次结构与多输出高斯过程关联，以刻画相关传感器。

Result: 在压机吨位监测应用中，仅使用13.77%的标注循环即达到完美的故障分类；在联邦空气质量建模中成功恢复地理分区，且无需集中化站点级时间序列数据。ILMM视角建立了层次结构与多输出高斯过程之间的理论联系。

Conclusion: pFedHGP在异构联邦环境下实现了隐私保护的概率回归与分类，通过分层分解平衡共享与个性化，并以稀疏近似与联邦变分推断保证可扩展性，适用于故障监测、环境建模等相关传感器场景。

Abstract: We present Personalized Federated Hierarchical Gaussian Processes (pFedHGP) for probabilistic regression and classification when data are distributed across heterogeneous clients. Each client's latent function decomposes into (i) a shared global component, (ii) a client-specific deviation that shares the global kernel structure, and (iii) a flexible local residual. Sparse inducing-variable approximations and federated variational inference keep raw data local while the server synchronizes only low-dimensional statistics for the shared component. Full predictive distributions support uncertainty-aware decisions. In application studies, pFedHGP attains perfect fault classification in press tonnage monitoring using 13.77% of labeled cycles and recovers geographic zones in federated air-quality modeling without centralizing station-level time series. An Instantaneous Linear Mixing Model viewpoint links the hierarchy to multi-output Gaussian processes for correlated sensors.

</details>


### [313] [Smart Insole Human Activity Recognition for Continuous Monitoring in Elderly Care](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19359)
*Edwin Rios,Antony Garcia,Fengpei Yuan,Xinming Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种无线智能鞋垫平台与机器学习流程，利用足底压力和IMU信号识别坐、站、行走和不稳定行走四种活动状态，并通过受试者独立交叉验证验证了其泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 老年人跌倒常伴随移动能力、平衡和姿势转换的变化，因此需要一种能在训练中未见过的人群上推断活动状态的监测手段，为老年人照护中的活动监测和跌倒预防提供基础。

Method: 每只鞋垫集成16个主动压力传感点和六维IMU（三轴加速度与角速度），数据以80~Hz从15名健康成人采集并切分为重叠窗口。先用分层10折交叉验证筛选窗口长度与候选模型族，再以受试者独立的5折分层分组交叉验证（同一受试者的所有窗口保留在同一折）作为主要性能评估。

Result: 在该协议下，基于直方图的梯度提升（HGB）对左、右脚分别取得0.954和0.959的macro-F1，双侧传感时为0.980；同受试者独立折下评估的紧凑1D-CNN未显著优于HGB（p=0.0625）。

Conclusion: 低剖面鞋垫传感可仅凭压力与IMU测量推断训练中未见过受试者的活动状态，为老年人照护中的活动监测与跌倒预防奠定了基础。

Abstract: Falls in older adults are often preceded by changes in mobility, balance, and postural transitions. This paper presents a wireless smart insole platform and machine-learning workflow for recognizing sitting, standing, walking, and unstable walking from plantar-pressure and inertial signals. Each insole integrates 16 active pressure-sensing locations and a six-dimensional IMU stream consisting of tri-axial acceleration and angular velocity. Data were collected from 15 healthy adults at 80~Hz and segmented into overlapping windows. Window length and candidate model families were first screened with stratified 10-fold cross-validation; the primary performance estimate was then obtained with participant-independent 5-fold Stratified Group cross-validation, ensuring that all windows from a participant remained in a single fold. Under this protocol, Histogram-Based Gradient Boosting (HGB) achieved macro-F1 scores of 0.954 and 0.959 for the left and right feet, respectively, and 0.980 with bilateral sensing. A compact 1D-CNN evaluated with the same participant-independent folds did not significantly outperform HGB ($p=0.0625$). The results show that low-profile footwear sensing can infer activity state from pressure and IMU measurements for participants unseen during training, establishing a basis for activity monitoring and fall prevention in elderly care.

</details>


### [314] [Stiefel Attention: When the Geometry of Transformer Projection Matrices Dominates Optimizer Choice---and When It Does Not](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19363)
*Rubén Darío Guerrero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将注意力中的查询/键投影约束在Stiefel流形上并用定制Riemannian Adam优化，可显著提升grokking与CIFAR-10下游表现，且增益来源为"步长尺度自由"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力中的$\WQ,\WK$通常由欧氏优化器训练且对几何无约束；作者希望用流形约束（Stiefel）刻画注意力几何，并厘清所谓几何约束/规范消去等常见动机是否真正有效。

Method: 把$\WQ,\WK$约束到Stiefel流形$\mathrm{St}(d,r)$，使用Riemannian Adam：每帧仅一个标量二阶矩、信任域截断步长、极分解(retraction)。给出四个命题（嵌入度量下最速下降、与梯度尺度无关、良条件、精确$\mathrm{O}(d)$等变）与第五个机制命题（权重衰减在$\mathrm{St}(d,r)$上Riemannian梯度恒为零，因$W=WI_r$位于法空间）。在模算术grokking与CIFAR-10 patches上做配对实验、消融与步长尺度诊断。

Result: grokking单次运行在第20\,000轮达97.0%验证精度（基线61.1%，作为机制证据而非效应量）；CIFAR-10 patches上相对12个配对起点提升+8.98pp（$t=60.6$，12/12），且随数据量增大差距扩大。步长诊断：固定步长Riemannian更新对梯度为一阶，每步位移仅为同形状AdamW矩阵的$1/24$--$1/40$，帧几乎不离开初始化，直接冻结仅损失0.28pp。消融显示全部增益来自步长尺度自由，投影器与等变性无可测贡献。反向结果：规范消去不能作为方法动机，因为沿损失不变方向没有梯度。

Conclusion: Stiefel约束的Riemannian Adam为注意力几何学习提供了稳定且可复现的优化范式；其收益由步长尺度自由驱动，几何项（投影/等变性）并非增益来源，规范消去式动机在理论上不成立。

Abstract: The query and key projections $\WQ,\WK$ in attention are almost always trained by Euclidean optimizers with no constraint on their geometry. We constrain them to the Stiefel manifold and optimize them there with a Riemannian Adam that carries one scalar second moment per frame, caps its step by a trust region, and retracts polarly. Four propositions prove this update is steepest descent in the embedded metric, independent of gradient scale, well conditioned, and exactly $\mathrm{O}(d)$-equivariant, each certified numerically in \texttt{float64}. A fifth supplies the mechanism: weight decay has \emph{identically zero} Riemannian gradient on $\St(d,r)$, since $W = W I_r$ lies in the normal space, so the learned attention geometry survives the collapse cycles that decay drives through the rest of the model. On modular arithmetic grokking, a single run holds $97.0\%$ validation accuracy at epoch 20\,000 against the baseline's $61.1\%$---an unstable endpoint we report as evidence for the mechanism rather than as an effect size. On CIFAR-10 patches the same rule gains $\mathbf{+8.98}$\,pp over 12 paired starts ($t{=}60.6$, $12/12$), and the gap widens with data rather than eroding. The step rule earns this: a fixed-step Riemannian update is degree one in the gradient, so it moves $24$--$40\times$ less per step than an identically shaped AdamW matrix---its frames barely leave their initialization, and freezing them outright costs only $0.28$\,pp. An ablation credits the whole gain to making the step scale free, and nothing measurable to the projector or to equivariance. A negative result sharpens the account: gauge removal cannot motivate the method, because a direction along which the loss is invariant carries no gradient at all.

</details>


### [315] [Machine-Learning Assessment of the Predictive Value of Inflammatory Biomarkers for Cognitive Impairment in an Older Hispanic Adult Cohort](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19374)
*Antony Garcia,Gabrielle Britton,Alcibiades Villarreal,Diana Oviedo,Giselle Rangel,Xinming Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在PARI-HD队列（n=165）中，作者构建了防泄漏的阈值似然朴素贝叶斯分类器，发现I-309（CCL1）是可解释的认知障碍预测候选特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型临床表格数据集需要可解释的机器学习方法，深度学习往往不实用，集成模型难以审查；同时需警惕统计显著性并不等于预测效用这一关键陷阱。

Method: 基于PARI-HD队列（n=165），采用防泄漏的阈值似然Bernoulli/Categorical朴素贝叶斯（BNB/CNB）分类器：在每个训练折内，将连续预测变量经监督式卡方导出的状态离散化，收入以分类似然形式进入模型；所有依赖数据的步骤均在重复分层10折交叉验证（30次重复）内完成，并通过DeLong检验及随机分区评估稳健性，对18个候选标记物做Benjamini-Hochberg校正。

Result: 人口学基线ROC-AUC为0.630±0.017。I-309（CCL1）是主要增量特征，AUC提升0.110，配对的DeLong检验在100%的重复中p<0.05；预设主分析中固定分区DeLong p=0.0018，200次随机分区的中位p值为0.0011。在18个候选标记物中，I-309在冻结分区上BH校正后q=0.032，并在85%的随机分区中满足q<0.05，其他标记物均未显示可靠的增量预测价值。

Conclusion: 由于所拟合模型是可审查的阈值与类条件概率表，结果支持I-309/CCL1作为表格化预测认知障碍的可解释候选特征，但仍有待外部验证。

Abstract: Small clinical tabular datasets require interpretable machine learning because deep learning is often impractical and ensemble models can be difficult to inspect. A key pitfall is that statistical significance does not necessarily imply predictive utility. Using data from the Panama Aging Research Initiative--Health Disparities (PARI-HD) cohort (n=165), we implemented a leakage-safe threshold-likelihood Bernoulli/Categorical Naive Bayes (BNB/CNB) classifier. Within every training fold, each continuous predictor was reduced to a supervised chi-square-derived state, while income entered the model through a categorical likelihood. All data-dependent steps were performed within repeated stratified 10-fold cross-validation with 30 repeats. The demographic baseline achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.630 +/- 0.017. I-309 (CCL1) was the dominant incremental feature, increasing AUC by 0.110, with paired DeLong tests yielding p<0.05 in 100% of repeats. In the pre-specified primary analysis, I-309 produced a fixed-partition DeLong p=0.0018, with robustness assessed across 200 random partitions, where the median p-value was 0.0011. Within the exploratory family of 18 candidate markers, I-309 achieved a Benjamini-Hochberg-adjusted q=0.032 on the frozen partition and satisfied q<0.05 in 85% of random partitions, whereas no other marker demonstrated reliable incremental predictive value. Because the fitted model is an inspectable table of thresholds and class-conditional probabilities, these results identify I-309/CCL1 as an interpretable candidate feature for tabular prediction of cognitive impairment, pending external validation.

</details>


### [316] [FCx: An algorithm for finding Feasible Counterfactual Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19383)
*Kleopatra Markou,Vana Kalogeraki,Dimitrios Gunopulos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Feasible Counterfactual Explanations (FCx)，基于改进的变分自编码器与多因子损失函数，首次高效生成同时满足真实性、低代价与可行性的反事实解释，并支持硬性及软性可行性约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有反事实解释方法虽能生成真实且低代价的修改建议，但往往无法保证可行性：它们可能建议非建设性修改，或与后续变化不兼容（例如通过改变种族来获得工作机会）。因此需要一种显式强制可行性约束的反事实解释方法。

Method: 提出FCx方法，基于改进的变分自编码器（VAE），采用多因子损失函数进行优化。可行性约束分为两类：由领域知识用户指定的硬性可行约束，以及通过因果推断从数据集中自动推断的软性可行约束。代价衡量基于数值变化的绝对值（proximity）和改变特征的数量（sparsity），真实性通过LOF密度估计衡量，确保反事实样本位于高密度区域。

Result: 在四个公开数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在多项指标上达到最先进性能，同时保证可行性。

Conclusion: FCx是首个高效生成同时兼顾真实性、低代价和可行性的反事实解释的方法，通过硬性与软性可行性约束的融合，弥补了现有方法在可行性方面的不足。

Abstract: Counterfactual (CF) explanations identify changes that alter an input's classification. While existing methods produce realistic and low-cost CFs, they often fail to ensure feasibility, by suggesting non-constructive modifications or incompatible with future changes (e.g., changing an individual's race to secure a job offer). We introduce a refinement of CF explanations that explicitly enforces feasibility. Our approach is the first to efficiently generate CFs that are realistic, low-cost and feasible. We accommodate both hard feasible constraints, specified by domain knowledge users, and soft feasible constraints, inferred automatically via causal inference from the dataset. Our method, Feasible Counterfactual Explanations (FCx), is based on a modified Variational Autoencoder (VAE) optimized with a multi-factor loss function. We measure the cost of a change based on the absolute change in values (proximity) as well as the number of features changed (sparsity) while realism is measured based on the LOF for density estimation, guaranteeing that CFs reside in densely populated regions. Extensive experiments on four public datasets show that our approach matches state-of-the-art performance across multiple metrics while guaranteeing feasibility.

</details>


### [317] [Improving Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning via Selective Reward Stimulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19414)
*Jing Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RSIQL方法，从奖励传播视角分析离线目标条件RL中的价值分离难题，通过为中间进度状态添加奖励信号来缓解稀疏延迟奖励问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习在稀疏奖励和长时域依赖下具有挑战性：目标完成信息在时间上远离早期决策，且离线价值估计引入额外误差。作者从奖励传播角度分析，指出在延迟目标设定中，目标导向的价值分离可能相对于局部估计误差变得很小，从而导致学习困难。

Method: 提出Reward Stimulation Implicit Q-Learning (RSIQL)，一种简单的非层次化方法。它在离线轨迹中为产生进展的中间状态引入额外奖励信号。RSIQL使用辅助的目标条件价值函数来识别估计能向目标推进的中间状态，并施加奖励刺激以提供延迟更少的训练监督。与层次化方法不同，RSIQL不学习单独的高层子目标策略。

Result: 在D4RL目标到达基准和OGBench上实验，RSIQL平均优于目标条件IQL，并达到与层次化离线目标条件方法相当的性能，同时保持简单的扁平策略结构。

Conclusion: RSIQL通过奖励刺激机制有效缓解了离线目标条件RL中价值分离不足的问题，在保持非层次化简单结构的同时实现了与层次化方法竞争的性能。

Abstract: Goal-conditioned reinforcement learning aims to learn policies that reach specified goals, but remains challenging in offline settings with sparse rewards and long-horizon dependencies. In such settings, goal-completion information can be temporally distant from the early decisions that enable success, while offline value estimation introduces additional error. We study this issue from a reward-propagation perspective and show, in a stylized delayed-goal setting, how goal-directed value separation can become small relative to local estimation error. Motivated by this analysis, we propose Reward Stimulation Implicit Q-Learning (RSIQL), a simple non-hierarchical method that introduces additional reward signals at progress-making intermediate states in offline trajectories. RSIQL uses an auxiliary goal-conditioned value function to identify intermediate states estimated to make progress toward the goal and applies reward stimulation to provide less-delayed training supervision. Unlike hierarchical methods, RSIQL does not learn a separate high-level subgoal policy. Experiments on D4RL goal-reaching benchmarks and OGBench show that RSIQL improves over goal-conditioned IQL on average and achieves performance competitive with hierarchical offline goal-conditioned methods, while retaining a simple flat policy structure.

</details>


### [318] [Bayesian Optimization with Rich Auxiliary Information via LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19437)
*Tejus Gupta,Efe Mert Karagözlü,Rohit Sonker,Barnabás Póczos,Jeff Schnieder*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出利用大语言模型（LLM）将丰富辅助信息引入贝叶斯优化（BO），开发了三种方法，在超参数优化基准及真实核聚变优化任务上均优于标准BO和现有LLM优化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实优化问题中往往包含远比单纯函数评估更丰富的信息（如超参数优化中的训练曲线、科学实验中的专家笔记与图像、关于最优解位置的先验知识），而传统贝叶斯优化仅利用函数评估值，未能充分利用这些辅助信息。

Method: 作者首先验证LLM能够有效利用此类丰富辅助信息来指导优化，随后据此提出三种将辅助信息通过LLM融入贝叶斯优化的方法。

Result: 在超参数优化基准测试和真实核聚变优化任务上，所提方法一致性地优于标准贝叶斯优化以及现有的基于LLM的优化方法。

Conclusion: LLM能够有效利用丰富辅助信息来改进贝叶斯优化，验证了其在带辅助信息的黑盒优化中的有效性。

Abstract: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is widely used for optimizing expensive black-box functions, yet many real-world optimization problems contain substantially richer information than function evaluations alone. Examples include training curves in hyperparameter optimization, expert notes and images in scientific experimentation, and prior knowledge about where optima may lie. We show that large language models (LLMs) can effectively leverage such rich auxiliary information to guide optimization.
