*Xiao Han,Zhen Zhang,Xin Zhao,Jiechun Lei,Moxuan Zheng,Youting Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文比较了5种共购边过滤方法（Apriori、Apriori+lift后过滤、top-K、NC、DF）在两个杂货数据集上的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Apriori算法的支持度阈值存在权衡：高阈值只保留高频关联，低阈值则产生大量规则，难以兼顾稀有高提升度关联。

Method: 在Instacart（320万购物篮）和Dunnhumby（20.8万购物篮）数据集上，对比Apriori、Apriori+lift后过滤、基于lift的top-K排序，以及两种网络方法（噪声校正NC、差异过滤DF）五种共购边过滤方法。

Result: top-K保证最大平均lift，NC通过单一显著性参数α达到相近lift水平；两者恢复的稀有高lift关联显著多于Apriori（80-100%对22-28%）。NC与top-K所选边差异明显（18-29%不重叠）：NC保留统计验证的边，top-K保留高lift但统计显著性低的稀有边。滚动原点留出评估显示top-K边在各切分点复现率更高，但NC边在留出网络中保持统计显著的可能性约高12个百分点。

Conclusion: 网络过滤方法（NC和top-K）在恢复稀有高lift关联方面优于传统Apriori，两者各有侧重：NC强调统计显著性，top-K强调高lift稀有性。

Abstract: The support threshold of the Apriori algorithm involves a trade-off in conducting market basket analysis: the associations that occur frequently are noted with high threshold; however, the low ones lead to generating the large amount of rules. The paper compares five methods for co-purchase edge filtration on two grocery datasets: i.e., Instacart (3.2 million baskets) and Dunnhumby (208 thousand baskets), including Apriori, Apriori + lift post-filtering, top-$K$ ranking based on lift, and two methods based on networks, noise-corrected (NC) and disparity filter (DF). The top-$K$ method ensures the maximum average lift, while the NC achieves similar lift level by means of a single value of the significance parameter ($α$). These two methods recover substantially more rare high-lift associations than Apriori (80-100% against 22-28%). NC and top-$K$ select meaningfully different edges (18-29% non-overlapping): NC retains statistically validated pairs, while top-$K$ retains rare pairs with high lift but low statistical significance. A rolling-origin holdout evaluation shows that top-$K$ edges recur at higher rates at every split, but NC edges are ~12 pp more likely to remain statistically significant in the held-out network.

</details>


### [354] [Robust Federated Q-Learning with Almost No Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20174)
*Sreejeet Maity,Aritra Mitra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Robust Fed-Q 联邦 Q 学习算法，在部分智能体为对抗性时仍能精确收敛至最优价值函数，并获得受益于协作的近乎最优有限时间速率，且通信轮数为对数级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多个智能体共享同一 MDP、通过中央服务器交换信息的联邦强化学习场景中，部分智能体可能是对抗性的并可任意行动。核心问题是：在此类环境下，协作能带来多大程度的样本复杂度加速。

Method: 提出 Robust Fed-Q 算法，融合基于模型与无模型 RL 的思想，并引入稳健统计中的均值中位数（median-of-means）技术以抵御少量对抗性智能体的污染。

Result: 理论证明：在存在污染的情况下，Robust Fed-Q 以高概率 (i) 在样本量趋于无穷时精确收敛到最优价值函数；(ii) 获得受益于多智能体协作的近乎最优有限时间收敛速率。此外，实现上述保证仅需对数级通信轮数。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，即使存在少量对抗性智能体，联邦强化学习仍可实现协作式样本复杂度加速，同时对通信瓶颈具有良好的效率。

Abstract: We consider a federated reinforcement learning setting involving $M$ agents, all of whom interact with a common Markov Decision Process (MDP). The agents exchange information via a central server to learn the optimal value function. Our goal is to understand to what extent one can hope for collaborative sample-complexity speedups in such a setting, when a small fraction of the agents are adversarial and can act arbitrarily. To that end, we propose Robust Fed-Q}, a federated Q-learning algorithm that blends ideas from both model-based and model-free RL, along with the median-of-means device from robust statistics. We prove that despite corruption, with high-probability, Robust Fed-Q (i) guarantees exact convergence to the optimal value function in the limit of infinite samples, and (ii) enjoys near-optimal finite-time rates that benefit from collaboration. In addition, our approach requires just $\tilde{O}(1)$ rounds of communication to achieve each of the above guarantees, a feature of independent interest in FL where communication is the major bottleneck.

</details>


### [355] [Evaluating Financial Sentiment in the Age of AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20198)
*Arslan Bisharat,Oudom Hean*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文比较十二种金融情感模型（词典法、金融专用Transformer、开源大模型），从语言学效度与经济效度两方面评估，发现通用大模型零样本分类效果可比金融专用模型，但更高分类准确率并不意味着更强的经济关联性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融情感度量在实证金融中应用广泛，但通用大语言模型（LLM）是否优于现有金融专用方法尚不明确，因此需要系统评估不同情感模型的有效性。

Method: 评估十二种情感模型，涵盖词典法、金融专用Transformer和开源LLM；采用两条标准：语言学效度（分类性能）与经济效度（与盈利惊喜、次日股票收益的关联），并区分盈利大幅超预期/低于预期与温和惊喜的公告。

Result: 通用LLM无需任务特定微调即可达到与金融专用Transformer相当的分类性能；但分类准确率更高并未带来更强的经济关系。若干模型的情感度量与盈利惊喜显著相关，但没有模型与次日股票收益显著相关。模型在盈利大幅超预期或大幅低于预期的公告上表现最强，在温和盈利惊喜的公告上明显较弱。

Conclusion: 金融情感捕捉的是公司经济绩效的信息，但解释短期市场反应的能力有限；分类准确率不能作为经济效度的替代指标。

Abstract: Financial sentiment measures are widely used in empirical finance, but it remains unclear whether general-purpose large language models (LLMs) improve on existing finance-specific methods. This paper evaluates twelve sentiment models, including dictionary-based methods, finance-specific transformers, and open-source LLMs, using two criteria: linguistic validity and economic validity. We find that general-purpose LLMs achieve classification performance comparable to finance-specific transformer models without task-specific fine-tuning. However, higher classification accuracy does not translate into stronger economic relationships. Several models produce sentiment measures that are significantly associated with earnings surprises, but none is significantly associated with next-day stock returns. Model performance is strongest for announcements with large earnings beats or misses and substantially weaker for announcements with more moderate earnings surprises. These findings suggest that financial sentiment captures information about firms' economic performance but has limited ability to explain short-run market reactions

</details>


### [356] [Towards a Unified Modality-Agnostic Multimodal Framework for Cognitive Workload Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20199)
*Stefanos Gkikas,Christian Arzate Cruz,Calvin Joseph,Giorgos Giannakakis,Raul Fernandez Rojas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出一种模态无关的分层Transformer架构，在单一模型中处理异质生物信号，并通过试点研究系统评估5种模态的全部31种组合在认知负荷测量中的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 认知负荷是自适应人机系统设计的核心，生物信号测量已有大量研究，但多种异质生物信号模态的融合效果研究仍十分有限。

Method: 构建统一、模态无关的分层Transformer架构，在单一模型内处理异质生物信号；对ECG、EDA、RESP、SpO2、EEG五种模态的全部31种组合，在三种认知任务（IQ抽象推理、MATH算术、GAME游戏）上采用留一被试交叉验证。

Result: (i) EEG为最强单模态，在IQ、GAME及合并的ALL设定中排名最高；(ii) 增加模态并不持续提升性能；(iii) 五模态全组合在IQ上取得最高Average 73.02%，四设定平均后为68.08%；(iv) 相比晚期融合方案模型尺寸减少约50%，且推理时间更低。

Conclusion: 异质生物信号的多模态融合并不必然带来增益，所提分层Transformer在保持或提升性能的同时显著降低模型规模与推理耗时，为多模态认知负荷测量提供了统一框架与实证参考。

Abstract: Cognitive workload reflects the mental effort required during task performance and is central to the design of adaptive human-machine systems. The use of biosignals to measure cognitive workload has been extensively researched and documented; however, studies examining the effects of combining heterogeneous biosignal modalities for this purpose remain limited. To provide insight into this area, we developed a unified, modality-agnostic, hierarchical Transformer-based architecture to process heterogeneous biosignal modalities within a single model. We use this framework in a pilot study evaluating all $31$ possible combinations of five modalities: Electrocardiogram (ECG), Electrodermal Activity (EDA), Respiration (RESP), Peripheral Oxygen Saturation (SpO$_2$), and Electroencephalogram (EEG), under leave-one-subject-out validation across three cognitively distinct tasks: abstract reasoning (IQ), arithmetic problem solving (MATH), and a game task (GAME). In this pilot setting, the results suggest that: (i) EEG is the strongest single modality, ranking highest in IQ, GAME, and the pooled ALL setting, where samples from all three tasks are combined; (ii) adding more modalities does not consistently improve performance; (iii) the full five-modality combination achieves the highest \textit{Average} score of $73.02%$ on IQ and $68.08%$ when the \textit{Average} scores are averaged over the four evaluation settings: IQ, MATH, GAME, and ALL; and (iv) the proposed method reduces model size by approximately $50%$ compared with late-fusion alternatives while maintaining a lower inference time.

</details>


### [357] [Subdomain-aware representation compression for pretrained image embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20213)
*Poowanut Niamluang,Jittat Fakcharoenphol*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探索将降维技术用于子域表示压缩，在图像域中采用PCA与LDA，发现其不仅提升空间与计算效率，还提升了精度，并具备迁移学习能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 降维通常被统一应用于整个数据集以提升空间效率，但针对子域表示压缩的降维方法尚缺乏系统研究，而边缘设备机器学习对空间与计算复杂度有迫切需求。

Method: 在图像域中应用主成分分析（PCA）与线性判别分析（LDA）等标准降维技术，对子域表示进行压缩，并与直接使用完整嵌入（full-embedding）的流程进行对比；同时开展迁移学习实验。

Result: 实验不仅验证了在空间与计算复杂度上的预期改进，还显示相比直接完整嵌入方法在精度上有所提升；推测原因在于降维有效提取了子域特征。迁移学习实验表明压缩表示具备迁移能力。

Conclusion: 降维可有效用于子域表示压缩，在提升效率的同时改善精度并支持迁移学习，为边缘设备ML应用提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Dimensionality reduction is a well-known technique for improving space efficiency, typically applied uniformly across an entire dataset. This paper investigates the possibilities of using dimensionality reduction techniques for subdomain representation compression. We explore standard techniques such as Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Linear discriminant analysis (LDA) in image domains. The results not only demonstrate the expected improvements in space and computation complexity crucial for edge-device ML applications but also show improvements in accuracy over direct full-embedding procedure. One possible explanation is that dimensionality reduction effectively extracts subdomain features. We also performed experiments to demonstrate transfer learning capabilities using the compressed representations.

</details>


### [358] [Explaining spatial information flow in short-term traffic forecasting models using a gated graph attention network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20217)
*Yue Li,Shujuan Chen,Ying Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过在GAT层中引入可学习门控，量化邻居信息占比，从而实现渐进式消融，验证GAT层是否真正捕捉空间依赖。应用于ST-MetaNet并在英格兰498个环形检测器一年数据上训练。结果显示门控随交通量和出行周期变化，轻度正则化略有增益，编码器与解码器GAT层高度冗余，单独移除任一层精度不降，同时移除则显著下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GAT层常被描述为捕捉邻近位置的影响，但其注意力权重无法与任何实测物理量对比，因而缺乏验证。这留下两个悬而未决的问题：模型应如何解释，以及其哪些组件是必要的。

Method: 在GAT层中加入门控，在每个传感器和每个时间步学习传感器更新状态中来自邻居而非自身的比例；对门控做正则化以逐步撤回邻居信息，形成分级消融。将门控GAT应用于ST-MetaNet（编码器与解码器各在两个循环层之间放置一个GAT层），并在英格兰战略路网498个环形检测器的一个日历年数据上训练。

Result: 门控将更大比例的邻居信息分配给承载更重交通的传感器，并遵循每日和每周出行周期，与相邻位置在繁忙时耦合更强的现象一致。轻度正则化略微提升精度，更高强度下精度下降，因为惩罚撤回了模型所需信息。编码器门先于解码器门关闭，但直接消融对该顺序提出了限定：单独移除任一GAT层精度至少与保留两层相当，而同时移除两层精度显著下降。

Conclusion: 门控GAT带来适度的精度提升，提供了空间信息在何处、何时流动的解释，并给出了架构需要哪些层的证据：两层GAT在很大程度上相互冗余，而非任一不可或缺。

Abstract: Short-term traffic forecasting supports real-time monitoring and control of road networks, and graph attention networks (GAT) are the standard means of representing spatial dependence in these models. GAT layers are widely described as capturing the influence of neighbouring locations, but this is seldom verified, because the attention weights offered in support cannot be compared against any measured quantity. That leaves two questions open, how the model should be explained and which of its components are necessary. We address this by adding a gate to the GAT layer which learns, at every sensor and every time step, what share of a sensor's updated state is drawn from its neighbours rather than from itself. Regularising the gate withdraws neighbour information progressively and thereby provides a graded form of ablation. We apply the gated GAT to ST-MetaNet, whose encoder and decoder each place one GAT layer between two recurrent layers, and train it on one calendar year of records from 498 loop detectors on the strategic road network of England. The gate assigns a larger share of neighbour information to sensors carrying heavier traffic and follows the daily and weekly cycle of travel, consistent with adjacent locations being more strongly coupled when busy. Mild regularisation improves accuracy slightly, and accuracy declines at higher strengths as the penalty withdraws information the model needs. The encoder gate closes before the decoder gate, but direct ablation qualifies that ordering. Removing either GAT layer alone leaves accuracy at least as good as keeping both, whereas removing both degrades it substantially, so the two layers are largely redundant rather than either being indispensable. The gated GAT therefore yields a modest accuracy gain, an explanation of where and when spatial information flows, and evidence on which layers the architecture requires.

</details>


### [359] [Accuracy Is Not Enough: A Cross-Architecture Audit of Demographic Bias in Deep Knowledge Tracing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20249)
*Dang Quang Minh,Nguyen Dung Son,Nguyen Huu Loi,Truong Viet Vu,Nguyen Thai Anh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次对四种深度知识追踪架构（DKT、DKVMN、SAKT、AKT）在三种训练机制下进行跨架构人口统计学公平性审计，发现偏见真实存在但依赖情境、最准确架构偏见最大、且标准缓解方法不可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公平性证据几乎全部来自贝叶斯知识追踪（BKT），而驱动现代自适应系统的深度知识追踪模型缺乏可比的跨架构审计，因此需要填补这一空白。

Method: 在Eedi（15.9M交互）与OULAD（预处理后167k）两个含人口统计元数据的公开数据集上，训练四种架构（DKT、DKVMN、SAKT、AKT），采用三种训练机制（标准、重加权、对抗去偏），并使用ABROCA、学生级自助法置信区间及置换检验（以应对近期对公平性指标不稳定的批评）进行评估。

Result: (i) 偏见真实存在但依赖情境：所有架构在Eedi上均显示显著社会经济ABROCA（0.018–0.023，p<0.005），经济弱势学生各组AUC更低；性别偏见在OULAD上四种架构中有三种经多重校正后显著，但在Eedi上可忽略。(ii) 最准确架构偏见最大：AKT通过项目级Rasch嵌入获得约4个AUC点增益，其社会经济ABROCA最大，配对自助法下超过其他架构（p≤0.002）；仅消融Rasch嵌入会同时消除精度增益与超额偏见。(iii) 标准缓解不可靠：在保持精度的所有配置中，重加权与对抗去偏使ABROCA基本不变，尽管对抗器在满反强度下被钉在随机水平，弱强度阳性对照排除了探针失效。

Conclusion: 深度知识追踪存在显著且架构间不一致的人口统计学偏见；偏见最大者恰是最准确模型，且源于Rasch嵌入；当前主流标准缓解手段在保持精度时无法实质降低偏见，亟需更有效的公平性干预。

Abstract: Deep knowledge tracing (DKT) models implicitly decide which students an adaptive system believes have mastered a skill, yet almost all evidence on their demographic fairness comes from Bayesian knowledge tracing; the deep models that power modern systems have received no comparable cross-architecture audit. We close this gap: four architectures (DKT, DKVMN, SAKT, AKT) trained under three regimes (standard, reweighting, adversarial) on two public datasets with demographic metadata, Eedi (15.9M interactions) and OULAD (167k after preprocessing), evaluated with ABROCA, student-level bootstrap confidence intervals, and permutation tests addressing recent critiques of fairness-metric instability. Three findings emerge. (i) Bias is real but context-dependent: every architecture shows a significant socioeconomic ABROCA on Eedi (0.018-0.023, $p<0.005$), with per-group AUC lower for economically disadvantaged students, while gender bias is significant on OULAD for three of four architectures after multiplicity correction yet negligible on Eedi. (ii) The most accurate architecture is the most biased: AKT gains about 4 AUC points from item-level Rasch embeddings and shows the largest socioeconomic ABROCA, exceeding every other architecture under a paired bootstrap ($p\leq0.002$); ablating only the Rasch embeddings removes the accuracy gain and the excess bias together. (iii) Standard mitigation is unreliable: reweighting and adversarial debiasing leave ABROCA essentially unchanged in every configuration that preserves accuracy, even though the adversary is pinned at chance at full reversal strength and a weak-strength positive control rules out a dead probe.

</details>


### [360] [How Far Can Sub-3B Open Language Models Go in Zero-Shot Essay Scoring on an 8 GB Consumer GPU?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20250)
*Nguyen Dung Son,Dang Quang Minh,Nguyen Huu Loi,Truong Viet Vu,Nguyen Thai Anh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究在8GB消费级GPU上本地部署四个小于3B的开源指令微调模型（Qwen2.5 0.5B/1.5B/3B、SmolLM2 1.7B），在ASAP-AES全部八个提示上开展零样本作文评分，通过bootstrap置信区间与Holm校正配对检验，发现评分表分解提示优于整体提示、多特质专门化的min-max归一化能修复评分校准崩溃、且符号误差随作文长度增加而下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零样本作文评分多依赖专有API大模型，但在公立学校等最需要自动评分的场景中，受严格隐私规则限制，将学生作文发送至第三方API不可接受。因此作者追问：当模型必须是完全本地运行于FP16的3B以下开源模型时，还有多少能力可以保留。

Method: 在单张8GB消费级GPU上，对来自两个家族的四个指令微调模型（Qwen2.5 0.5B/1.5B/3B、SmolLM2 1.7B）在全部八个ASAP-AES提示上进行受控研究，采用bootstrap置信区间、Holm校正配对检验，并针对关键设计选择设置贴近部署现实的变体。

Result: 三项发现：(i) 在batch min-max聚合下，评分表分解提示对所有模型均优于整体提示（Qwen2.5-3B在一个提示上显著下降），mean聚合下两个无关家族在1.5-1.7B规模上差异在0.01内。(ii) 将特质分数映射到提示范围对评分者校准脆弱：某模型将特质压缩至0-10分中的2-4窄低带，朴素mean聚合崩溃，而Multi-Trait Specialization的min-max归一化修复之（宏QWK从0.204升至0.388），其统计量冻结在30篇留出作文上时波动在0.03内。(iii) 12种配置中有11种符号误差随作文长度下降，与大模型评判者报告的冗长偏差相反；归一化评分表分解对校准良好的模型基本抹平该斜率。

Conclusion: 最佳本地配置（0.388）仍远低于人类评分者间上限（0.769）和仅长度基线（0.523），因此作者将3B以下本地模型严格定位为形成性、有人类监督的反馈用途。

Abstract: Zero-shot essay scoring with large language models is usually demonstrated with proprietary API models, yet the settings where automated scoring is most needed, such as public schools grading thousands of essays under strict privacy rules, are often those where sending student writing to a third-party API is unacceptable. We ask how much capability survives when the model must be a sub-3B open model running fully locally in FP16, with a controlled study of four instruction-tuned models from two families (Qwen2.5 at 0.5B/1.5B/3B, SmolLM2 at 1.7B) on all eight ASAP-AES prompts on a single 8 GB consumer GPU, with bootstrap confidence intervals, Holm-corrected paired tests, and deployment-realistic variants of the key design choices. Three findings emerge. (i) Rubric-decomposed prompting beats holistic prompting for every model under batch min-max aggregation (though Qwen2.5-3B drops significantly on one prompt), and under mean aggregation two unrelated families land within 0.01 at the 1.5-1.7B scale. (ii) Mapping trait scores into the prompt range is fragile to grader calibration: one model compresses traits into a narrow low band (2-4 on 0-10) and naive mean aggregation collapses, while the min-max normalization of Multi-Trait Specialization repairs it (macro QWK 0.204 to 0.388) and stays within 0.03 when its statistics are frozen on 30 held-out essays. (iii) Signed error falls with essay length in eleven of twelve configurations, opposite to the verbosity bias reported for large LLM judges; normalized rubric decomposition largely flattens this slope for well-calibrated models. We anchor results honestly: the best local configuration (0.388) remains far below both the human inter-rater ceiling (0.769) and a length-only baseline (0.523), so we position sub-3B local models strictly for formative, human-supervised feedback.

</details>


### [361] [Improving Online Reinforcement Learning via Bidirectional Behavior Prior Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20268)
*Gong Gao,Xiao Lai,Jiaji Shen,Ning Jia,Xianhui Liu,Weidong Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出双向行为先验蒸馏算法B2PD，利用动作价值先验引导CVAE生成高价值行为支持集，并将专家行为先验蒸馏进智能体，从而提升在线强化学习的样本效率与策略优化稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线强化学习存在样本效率低、学习动态不稳定等问题，根源在于贪心策略更新加剧了评论家估计的系统性误差。现有行为先验方法依赖离线预训练学习行为模型并以策略先验约束在线更新，但离线数据集质量有限，难以提供高价值策略来有效指导更新；专家轨迹的缺失严重损害在线策略学习，导致样本效率低和性能次优。

Method: 作者偏离传统行为先验思路，提出双向行为先验蒸馏（B2PD）算法。B2PD利用动作价值先验引导条件变分自编码器（CVAE）生成高价值行为支持集，再将所得的专家行为先验蒸馏进智能体，同时建立双向知识流机制。

Result: 在基于状态和基于像素的任务上进行的实证评估表明，B2PD显著提升了样本效率，同时保持了策略优化的稳定性。

Conclusion: 更广泛地看，该工作表明在在线学习过程中强制引入高质量行为支持，可有效缓解评论家引发的误差放大，使结构化行为先验以有原则且样本高效的方式指导策略更新。

Abstract: Online reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms frequently exhibit poor sample efficiency and unstable learning dynamics, stemming from systematic critic estimation errors that are exacerbated by greedy policy updates. Existing behavior-prior reinforcement learning methods attempt to alleviate this issue by relying on offline pre-training to learn behavior models from fixed datasets and using policy priors to constrain online policy updates. However, the limited quality of offline datasets often hinders the ability to provide high-value policies that can effectively guide policy updates. The absence of expert trajectories significantly impairs online policy learning, leading to low sample efficiency and suboptimal performance. To address these challenges, we depart from conventional behavior prior approaches and propose a Bidirectional Behavior Prior Distillation (B2PD) algorithm. B2PD leverages action-value priors to guide a conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) in generating a high-value behavior support set. The resulting expert behavior priors are further distilled into the agent, effectively reducing inefficient exploration and enabling stable policy optimization, while establishing a bidirectional knowledge flow mechanism. Empirical evaluations on both state- and pixel-based tasks verify that B2PD substantially improves sample efficiency while maintaining stable policy optimization. More broadly, this work shows that enforcing high-quality behavioral support during online learning effectively mitigates critic-induced error amplification, enabling structured behavior priors to guide policy updates in a principled and sample-efficient manner.

</details>


### [362] [Placement Is Free, Composition Is Not: The Latin Square as a Provably-Balanced Construction for Heterogeneous Sequence-Mixer Stacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20269)
*Taebong Kim,Youngsik Hong,Minsik Kim,Sunyoung Choi,Jaewon Jang,Minseo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 Aether-7B-5Attn（6.59B 参数 MoE，激活约 2.98B），在 49 层中以 7×7 拉丁方排列七种序列混合机制，并通过参数匹配代理实验证明：性能主要取决于异质机制的深度分布，而非具体排列顺序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自 GPT 以来，多数 Transformer 在各层重复相同注意力机制，这一设计多为惯例而非经实验验证的结论。当多种序列混合器共存于同一堆栈时，改进可能来自机制选择、放置位置或二者交互，导致因果归因困难。作者希望剥离"放置"混杂，明确性能提升的真正来源。

Method: 1) 构建 Aether-7B-5Attn：6.59B 参数 MoE 模型（约 2.98B 激活），49 层包含七种序列混合机制，按 7×7 拉丁方排列，保证每种机制在每行每列各出现一次，实现深度上的均衡暴露。2) 构建参数匹配代理：四种机制、16 层、4×4 拉丁方，参数量 700.9M，每臂训练 8 个随机种子。3) 对比实验：重排为均衡周期循环、将机制聚为连续深度带、替换为同质堆栈。4) 在 2.16 倍规模（1.514B 参数）上验证。5) 额外报告各机制成本画像、英韩双语评测及全部 49 层的因果安全审计。

Result: 代理实验中，将分布式异质堆栈重排为均衡周期循环仅使验证损失变化 0.16%，说明精确放置影响极小；将机制聚为连续深度带产生 0.59% 惩罚；替换为同质堆栈产生 1.68% 惩罚。在 2.16 倍规模（1.514B 参数）下，同质堆栈惩罚增至 2.63%，移除 SSM 族机制导致 3.20% 性能退化。

Conclusion: 性能主要依赖于分布在不同深度上的异质机制组合，而非任何特定排列顺序。该结论在大规模下得到确认，且异质性的收益随规模增大而增强。作者公开模型权重、训练配方、训练代码、日志与架构源码。这一工作将"逐层同质注意力"从惯例转化为可检验的设计选择，为异构序列混合架构提供实证依据。

Abstract: Since GPT, most Transformers have repeated the same attention mechanism at every layer. Yet this design is largely a convention rather than a tested conclusion. When multiple sequence mixers are combined in one stack, improvements may arise from mechanism choice, placement, or both, making causal attribution difficult. We introduce Aether-7B-5Attn, a 6.59B-parameter mixture-of-experts model ($\approx$2.98B active) whose 49 layers contain seven sequence-mixing mechanisms arranged as a $7\times7$ Latin square. Because each mechanism appears exactly once in every row and column, the design guarantees balanced exposure across depth while eliminating placement confounds. To evaluate this principle, we build a parameter-matched proxy with four mechanisms arranged as a $4\times4$ Latin square over sixteen layers, matched to 700.9M parameters and trained with eight seeds per arm. The results reveal a clear dissociation. Rearranging a distributed heterogeneous stack into a balanced periodic cycle changes validation loss by only 0.16\%, indicating that exact placement has little effect. In contrast, clustering the same mechanisms into contiguous depth bands incurs a 0.59\% penalty, while replacing the heterogeneous stack with a homogeneous one incurs a 1.68\% penalty. These results indicate that performance depends primarily on heterogeneous composition distributed across depth rather than on any particular permutation. We confirm this finding at 2.16$\times$ larger scale (1.514B parameters), where the homogeneous-stack penalty increases to 2.63\% and removing the SSM-family mechanism produces a 3.20\% degradation. We further report per-mechanism cost profiles, English and Korean evaluations, and a causal-safety audit of all 49 layers. We release model weights, training recipes, training code, logs, and architecture source code.

</details>


### [363] [Personalising a Cross-User Surface Electromyography Encoder Under a Small Calibration Budget](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20296)
*Jethro Odeyemi,W. J. Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文比较消耗相同校准重复数据的四种个性化方法，发现全量微调最准，但无梯度的原型方法能在无需优化器和用户权重副本的情况下恢复52%–78%的收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有肌电接口研究将校准视为一种数量，但未回答收集到校准重复数据后设备应如何使用它们；本文把跨用户编码器的个性化视为带成本的设计决策，探究如何在有限校准预算下最优使用标注重复数据。

Method: 以单一跨用户编码器为基础，对每个留出受试者在各预算下测试四种方法：原型自适应（无梯度）、线性探针、缩放微调和全量微调；预算上限为DB1五次、DB2与DB5四次的重复，覆盖77名受试者及其子集。

Result: 全量微调在每个预算下精度最高，且在受试者子集中无例外；无梯度的原型规则无需优化器和每用户权重副本，即可恢复全量微调52%–78%的收益；"好表征只需新分类器"的直觉不成立；各方法与临床拟合的每用户分类器的相对表现取决于具体数据库。

Conclusion: 个性化应在设备穿戴时即可完成，原型自适应因低成本无梯度而具工程价值；全量微调虽最准但成本较高，方法选择需结合具体数据库与部署约束。

Abstract: A myoelectric interface needs calibration from the user before it will function. Earlier work has treated calibration as a quantity, but has not asked the question of what a device should do with the calibration repetitions once they have been collected. This paper views personalizing the cross-user encoder as a design decision with a cost. Four alternative approaches to using exactly the same labeled repetitions were tested from a single cross-user encoder per held-out subject. Prototypical adaptation, linear probes, scaled fine-tuning and full fine-tuning were tested at every budget up to the maximum each database allows, five repetitions on DB1 and four on DB2 and DB5. Comparing four ways to spend a small calibration budget across 77 subjects, full fine-tuning is the most accurate at every budget, consistently enough that there is no exception among subsets of subjects. The result which impacts how one might make an engineering decision however is that a gradient free prototypical rule recovers 52 to 78 per cent of its benefit with no optimiser and no per-user copy of the weights, which makes personalisation something a worn device can do at donning time. The widespread intuition that a good representation only needs a fresh classifier is incorrect here. How well each method may perform relative to a per-user classifier that would be fitted by a clinic will depend on the specific database.

</details>


### [364] [Intact-to-Amputee Transfer in Surface-EMG Gesture Decoding: Training Source and Calibration Budget](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20297)
*Jethro Odeyemi,W. J. Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究考察了跨用户肌电（EMG）编码器在经桡骨截肢者上的迁移能力，发现零样本跨群体迁移完全失败，但在少量（3次）标注重复后，编码器显著优于临床按用户单独训练的基线（0.779 vs 0.589 macro-F1）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有识别器通常仅对单一用户有效，跨用户迁移性差，需终端用户重新标注校准；同时文献中截肢者样本稀缺（1077项研究中仅约六分之一涉及截肢者），证据基础薄弱，因此有必要系统验证跨用户编码器在截肢群体上的迁移边界。

Method: 采用与健全肢体训练数据匹配的实验协议，将一种与电极阵列布局无关（montage-agnostic）的跨用户编码器迁移至11名经桡骨截肢者；比较零样本迁移、不同标注重复次数（1次、3次）下的性能，对比按用户单独训练的临床基线分类器，并考察不同源池（40名健全者 vs 10名其他截肢者 vs 二者组合）对迁移效果的影响，同时对预注册预测进行检验。

Result: 零样本跨群体迁移完全失败；获得新用户标注数据后编码器开始有效解码，并在3次重复时以0.190 macro-F1优势超过按用户拟合的临床分类器，且对队列中每个被试均成立（0.779 vs 0.589 macro-F1）。用40名健全者训练比用10名其他截肢者训练能带来更好的新截肢者迁移，二者结合优于任一单独来源。预注册预测仅在有若干次重复且源池加入更多截肢者后成立；在单次重复及与健全肢体比较匹配的每种预算下均不成立。

Conclusion: 跨用户编码器在截肢群体中无法实现零样本迁移，必须依赖少量新用户标注数据；其优势需在具备若干次标注重复后才显现，且可通过扩充源池（健全者+截肢者）进一步提升迁移。研究界定了"基线强度"解释的适用边界，并凸显截肢者数据在文献中的稀缺性。

Abstract: A recogniser trained on one person rarely transfers to the next, and useful performance usually demands a fresh round of labelled calibration from the end user. A systematic review of 1077 studies quantifies where the evidence is thin: amputees appear in about one in six. Here a montage-agnostic cross-user encoder is carried to eleven transradial amputees on a protocol matched to its intact-limb training data. Zero-shot cross-population transfer fails outright: the encoder requires labeled data from the new user before it begins decoding, and it then exceeds the per-user classifier a clinic would fit by 0.190 macro F1 at three repetitions and for every subject in the cohort. Given three labelled repetitions it reaches 0.779 macro-F1 against 0.589 for the per-user pipeline. Training on forty intact subjects produces better transfers to a new amputee than training on ten other amputees, and combining the two produces better transfers than either individually. The prediction pre-registered for this study, which extends the encoder's baseline-strength account with the premise that amputee EMG is less separable, holds true only after a few repetitions become available and after enriching the source pool with additional amputees. At a single repetition, and at every budget under a source matched to the intact-limb comparison, it fails. Thus, it locates the boundary of the proposed account.

</details>


### [365] [A Learning Algorithm for Threshold Boolean Networks with Prescribed Fixed Points](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20298)
*Gonzalo A. Ruz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种可微分损失驱动的学习算法，用于推断具有指定不动点的阈值布尔网络（TBN），在拟南芥FOS-GRN模型上实现精确重构且无伪吸引子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从观测或期望的动态约束（指定不动点）出发推断布尔网络结构是基因调控网络建模的核心问题；标准方法（如感知机、逻辑回归）虽能拟合不动点，却会引入大量伪吸引子，破坏网络动态的真实性。

Method: 设计自定义可微分损失函数，联合施加四项约束：不动点保持、伪吸引子惩罚、输出二值化激励以及L1正则化促进稀疏性；在拟南芥FOS-GRN模型上以30次独立运行进行验证，并额外分析稀疏系数λ对性能与结构性质的影响。

Result: 30次运行中5次实现完美重构（10个目标不动点全部恢复且无伪吸引子），平均恢复8.53±0.90个正确不动点且无伪吸引子；对比之下，感知机与逻辑回归虽最多恢复10个不动点，却引入8至31个伪吸引子；性能与网络结构性质在λ ≤ 0.01范围内保持稳健。

Conclusion: 该算法在指定动态约束下能有效且稳定地捕捉有意义的网络动态，显著优于传统方法，且对正则化强度具备实用范围内的鲁棒性。

Abstract: We present a learning algorithm for inferring threshold Boolean networks (TBNs) with a prescribed set of fixed points. The proposed method employs a custom differentiable loss function that jointly enforces fixed point preservation, penalizes spurious attractors, encourages binary outputs, and promotes sparsity through L1 regularization. Applied to the FOS-GRN model of Arabidopsis thaliana, the approach achieved perfect reconstruction (i.e., all 10 desired fixed points and no spurious ones) in 5 out of 30 independent runs, recovering on average 8.53 $\pm$ 0.90 correct fixed points with no spurious attractors. In contrast, standard methods such as the Perceptron and Logistic Regression recovered up to 10 fixed points but introduced between 8 and 31 spurious ones. An additional analysis varying the sparsity coefficient ($λ$) confirmed that the method's performance and the structural properties of the inferred networks remain robust within a practical range (up to 0.01) of regularization strengths. Overall, the results demonstrate the effectiveness and stability of the proposed algorithm in capturing meaningful network dynamics under prescribed dynamical constraints.

</details>


### [366] [Improving Generalization and Robustness in Offline Reinforcement Learning via Boundary-Aware Data Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20300)
*Gong Gao,Weidong Zhao,Xianhui Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对离线强化学习中因数据增强忽略了状态间距离导致的泛化性与鲁棒性不足问题，从理论上分析随机回合插值的误差界，并提出边界感知数据增强方法BADA，利用邻近状态构建插值边界以生成更符合原始分布的合成数据，在多基准上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离线强化学习算法易过拟合训练数据集，部署到真实环境时分布内泛化能力和鲁棒性较差。已有方法多借用计算机视觉中的正则化技术，但低层物理信号对分布偏移高度敏感，这些方法仍存在明显局限，难以在复杂环境中保持稳定性能。因此需要一种更契合离线RL数据特性的增强手段。

Method: 理论上分析使用随机回合插值训练的行为策略与动作价值函数的误差界，发现误差与状态间距离正相关。基于该洞见提出BADA（边界感知数据增强）：利用邻近状态构建插值边界，在边界约束下生成合成数据，从而更忠实地保留原始数据分布。并在玩具环境中进行定性研究验证。

Result: 玩具环境中的定性研究表明，BADA生成的混合样本在保持理想策略平滑性的同时，能够准确重建多模态价值分布；在有限离线数据集上的大量实验表明，BADA在多个基准上取得了当前最优（SOTA）性能。

Conclusion: BADA通过边界感知的插值数据增强，缓解了离线RL中的过拟合与分布偏移问题，提升了分布内泛化性与鲁棒性，并在多基准上验证了其有效性与优越性。

Abstract: Current offline reinforcement learning (ORL) algorithms tend to overfit the training dataset and exhibit poor in-distribution generalization and robustness performance when deployed to real environments, thus compromising their effectiveness. Existing methods typically enhance in-distribution generalization and robustness by leveraging regularization techniques widely used in computer vision. However, due to the high sensitivity of low-level physical signals to distributional shifts, these methods still suffer from notable limitations in in-distribution generalization and robustness, making it difficult to achieve stable performance in complex environments. To address this issue, we theoretically analyze the error bounds of the behavior policy and action-value function trained with random episode interpolation, revealing that the error scales positively correlated with the distance between states. Based on this insight, we propose a method called $\bf{B}$oundary-$\bf{A}$ware $\bf{D}$ata $\bf{A}$ugmentation (BADA), which leverages neighboring states to construct interpolation boundaries, enabling the generation of synthetic data that more faithfully preserves the original data distribution. We first conduct qualitative studies in a toy environment, showing that BADA generates mixed samples that preserve desirable policy smoothness while accurately reconstructing multimodal value distributions. Extensive experiments on limited offline datasets further demonstrate that BADA attains state-of-the-art performance across diverse benchmarks.

</details>


### [367] [Hypernetwork-Parameterized Spatially Adaptive Neural Operators for PDE Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20309)
*Jiaquan Zhang,Chaoning Zhang,Shuxu Chen,Meng Ye,Xiaofeng Zhang,Qiang He,Weifeng Huang,Guoqing Wang,Yang Yang,Caiyan Qin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出空间自适应神经算子SANO，用连续空间变化的算子参数场替代空间共享参数化，在1D-3D PDE及多孔域椭圆问题上优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间异质PDE具有位置依赖动力学。现有神经算子（多尺度、注意力、区域分解）更新规则仍空间共享；超网络方法虽能跨实例自适应，但每个实例仅生成一个全局参数化，导致算子在边界和高梯度区域欠拟合，且误差在自回归推演中累积。

Method: 用傅里叶编码坐标与坐标条件超网络，在采样点生成空间算子条件编码，取代空间共享参数化，形成位置依赖算子参数的连续场。提出超神经单元（HNE）机制，在局部子区域内插值这些编码，耦合相邻算子同时允许其更新规则随空间变化；并用单位分解权重组装重叠的局部预测。

Result: 在一维、二维、三维PDE及两个多孔域椭圆基准上，SANO一致优于竞争的神经算子、超网络类及物理信息类基线。

Conclusion: 通过空间连续、位置依赖的算子参数化与局部耦合的HNE机制，可有效缓解共享算子对边界与高梯度区域的欠拟合并抑制自回归误差累积，实现更优的空间异质PDE建模。

Abstract: Spatially heterogeneous partial differential equations (PDEs) exhibit location-dependent dynamics arising from variations in geometry and physical coefficients. Existing neural operators improve localized modeling through multiscale features, attention mechanisms, or domain decomposition, yet their update rules often remain spatially shared. Hypernetwork-based methods adapt parameters across PDE instances but typically generate only one global parameterization per instance. Consequently, shared operators may underfit boundaries and high-gradient regions, with these localized errors accumulating during autoregressive rollout. We propose a spatially adaptive neural operator (SANO), which replaces this spatially shared parameterization with a spatially continuous field of location-dependent operator parameters. SANO uses Fourier-encoded coordinates and a coordinate-conditioned hypernetwork to generate spatial operator-conditioning codes at sampling points. A Hyper-Neural Element (HNE) mechanism interpolates these codes within local subregions, coupling neighboring operators while allowing their update rules to vary across space, and partition-of-unity weights assemble the overlapping local predictions. Experiments on one-, two-, and three-dimensional PDEs and two perforated-domain elliptic benchmarks show that SANO consistently outperforms competitive neural-operator, hypernetwork-based, and physics-informed baselines.

</details>


### [368] [ZeroHAT: Behavior-Conditioned Zero-Shot Human Activity Trace Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20310)
*Rongchao Xu,Dahai Yu,Lin Jiang,Guang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ZeroHAT，一种行为条件化的零样本框架，通过迁移源区域真实人类活动轨迹（HATs）中的行为模式，并结合目标区域公开上下文信息，为目标区域生成合成HATs，在十城市基准上显著优于最强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模人类活动轨迹（HATs）对移动性预测和城市模拟等应用至关重要，但采集成本高且涉及隐私问题。合成HAT生成虽受关注，但现有方法多依赖同一区域的真实数据生成该区域合成数据，对于缺乏真实HATs的区域不可行。

Method: ZeroHAT包含三个关键新颖组件：(i) 多维一致性感知意图提取器；(ii) 跨区域行为克隆模块；(iii) 行为条件化活动实现模块。框架以行为为条件，从源区域真实HATs学习行为模式，并借助目标区域公开上下文信息进行适配，实现零样本生成。

Result: 在十城市基准上，ZeroHAT达到最强基线归一化下游效用的4.5-6.4倍，并在各目标区域将平均保真度提升15.6%-40.8%。

Conclusion: ZeroHAT为缺乏真实HATs的目标区域提供了可行的零样本合成数据生成方案，通过跨区域行为迁移与上下文适配，显著提升下游效用和保真度。

Abstract: Human activity traces record individuals' timestamped visits to points of interest and are essential for applications such as mobility prediction and urban simulation. However, accessing large-scale HATs is challenging due to high collection costs and privacy concerns. Synthetic HAT generation offers a promising way to make such data available and has attracted growing interest from both industry and academia. Although many efforts have been devoted to this topic, most of them rely on real data from a region to generate synthetic data for the same region, which is infeasible for the many regions where real HATs are unavailable. To fill this gap, we propose ZeroHAT, a behavior-conditioned framework that generates synthetic HATs for a target region in a zero-shot manner by transferring behavioral patterns learned from real HATs in source regions and adapting them with publicly available contextual information about the target region. ZeroHAT has three key novel components: (i) a multidimensional consistency-aware intent extractor; (ii) a cross-region behavioral cloning module; and (iii) a behavior-conditioned activity realization module. We evaluate ZeroHAT on a ten-city benchmark, where extensive experiments show that ZeroHAT achieves 4.5-6.4x the normalized downstream utility of the strongest baseline and improves average fidelity by 15.6%-40.8% across target regions.

</details>


### [369] [EviRec: Continual Evidence Learning for Dual Cold-Start POI Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20313)
*Rongchao Xu,Lin Jiang,Guang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出持续双冷启动POI推荐任务，并设计EviRec框架，通过候选POI级别的证据可靠性估计与门控路由，在冷启动场景显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有POI推荐方法大多假设用户群体与POI目录固定不变；但基于美国10个城市的大规模数据分析发现，POI流失、用户更替、类别漂移及静态POI记忆衰减现象显著，因而需要研究持续双冷启动场景下的POI推荐。

Method: EviRec是一个持续证据学习框架，针对每个候选POI分别估计历史证据的可信度。它从三个互补视角对可见候选项打分：基于用户近期移动画像的匹配视角、捕捉重复移动规律的状态转移记忆视角、反映候选成熟度的生命周期视角。针对转移分数接近零可能源于不相关或观测不足的歧义，EviRec利用候选的观测状态对证据进行限定，并通过可靠性门控在转移记忆与生命周期证据之间自适应路由。

Result: 在覆盖全年、五个城市、超过30,000用户与684,200条轨迹的POI签到数据集上，EviRec持续优于最先进基线，且增益主要集中在冷启动查询上；在Dual-New情形下，NDCG@10相对最强基线提升20.4%。深入分析表明，增益主要来自候选特定的可靠性门控，同时基本保留了已学到的移动规律。

Conclusion: EviRec有效应对持续双冷启动POI推荐，验证了候选级证据可靠性建模与门控路由的关键作用，并能在提升冷启动性能的同时保持已有移动模式知识。

Abstract: Point-of-Interest (POI) recommendation is a core task in location-based services, yet most existing methods assume a fixed user population and POI catalog. Through a large-scale data-driven analysis of 10 U.S. cities, we identify substantial POI churn, user turnover, category drift, and decay in static POI memory, motivating the study of continual dual cold-start POI recommendation. To address this setting, we propose EviRec, a continual evidence-learning framework that estimates how much historical evidence should be trusted separately for each candidate POI. EviRec scores each visible candidate from three complementary views: a matching view based on the user's recent mobility profile, a transition-memory view that captures repeated mobility routines, and a lifecycle view that reflects candidate maturity. Because a near-zero transition score may indicate either irrelevance or insufficient observation, EviRec qualifies the evidence using each candidate's observation state and applies a reliability gate to adaptively route between transition-memory and lifecycle evidence. We evaluate EviRec on a full-year, five-city POI check-in dataset containing more than 30,000 users and 684,200 trajectories. Experimental results show that EviRec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, with the largest gains concentrated on cold-start queries. In particular, EviRec improves NDCG@10 by 20.4\% on Dual-New cases over the strongest baseline. In-depth analyses further confirm that these gains arise primarily from candidate-specific reliability gating while largely preserving previously learned mobility routines.

</details>


### [370] [Sharp Reconstruction Bounds for Autoencoders Using the Same Forward Map](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20333)
*Patricia Medina,Hy P. G. Lam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在观测坐标置零前后应用同一前向映射的自编码器重构问题。对于相等的奇数输入与隐层维度 d≥3，在雅可比奇异值属于 [m,M] 的保向微分同胚中，证明最小一致重构导数误差为 max{1-M(M-m)/2,0}，且仿射映射在任意指定深度达到该紧界。平移径向旋转能以任意接近1的奇异值精确重构任意指定球，由此提出有限数据界的附加条件。在798,452点地面LiDAR森林扫描数据上验证：输入尺度0.05时，理论界均值0.155，约为四个空间区域、两个深度、三个随机种子下归一化训练误差均值0.185的84%；该尺度下增加一个隐层坐标可将平均重构误差降至6×10^{-6}以下。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究自编码器在特定对称结构（置零前后同映射）下的重构误差下界，揭示维度压缩与重构精度之间的内在权衡，并为有限数据情形下的理论界提供条件。

Method: 在保向微分同胚且雅可比奇异值约束于 [m,M] 的映射类中，推导最小一致重构导数误差的紧界；构造平移径向旋转映射作为反例；并在真实LiDAR森林点云数据上进行实验验证理论预测。

Result: 理论上证明最小误差为 max{1-M(M-m)/2,0}，仿射映射可达此界；构造的平移径向旋转能精确重构且奇异值趋近1。实验上，输入尺度0.05时理论界均值0.155，为实际归一化训练误差0.185的约84%；增加一个隐层坐标使平均重构误差降至6×10^{-6}以下。

Conclusion: 自编码器存在锐利的重构误差下界，仿射映射最优；但特定映射可规避该界，说明需要额外约束才能得到有限数据下的有效界。实验支持理论预测的紧致性。

Abstract: We study reconstruction in autoencoders that apply the same forward map before and after setting the observed coordinates to zero. For equal odd input and hidden dimensions $d\geq 3$, among orientation-preserving diffeomorphisms whose Jacobian singular values lie in $[m,M]$, we show that the least uniform reconstruction-derivative error is $\max\{1-M(M-m)/2,0\}$, with affine maps attaining this sharp bound at every prescribed depth. A translated radial rotation can nevertheless reconstruct any prescribed ball exactly with singular values arbitrarily close to one, motivating additional conditions for a finite-data bound. We test this prediction on a 798,452-point terrestrial LiDAR forest scan. At input scale $0.05$, the mean theoretical bound is $0.155$, about $84\%$ of the mean normalized training error $0.185$ across four spatial regions, two depths, and three seeds. At this scale, adding one hidden coordinate reduces the mean reconstruction error below $6\times10^{-6}$.

</details>


### [371] [COMPASS: Ordered Clustered Routing at 100K Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20352)
*Ido Greenberg,Hugo Linsenmaier,Piotr Sielski,Shie Mannor,Alex Fender,Gal Chechik,Eli Meirom*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 COMPASS 算法求解有序聚类旅行商问题（OCTSP），结合搜索与学习加速的路由，通过并行子求解器编排，可在聚类规模指数时间（而非实例规模）内达到精确解，并支持通用距离矩阵，已扩展至 100K 合成节点与 28.5K 真实电商节点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模路由常需按指定顺序访问节点簇，形成 OCTSP。独立优化每个簇虽自然，却忽略了非局部依赖，因此需要一种能利用聚类结构、兼顾质量与可扩展性的求解方法。

Method: 提出 COMPASS 算法：将搜索与学习加速的路由相结合，编排并行子求解器；无质量上限，解随算力增加而持续改进；利用聚类结构，时间复杂度为聚类规模的指数级而非实例规模的指数级；支持通用距离矩阵，不限于坐标输入。

Result: 实验中 COMPASS 持续优于对比方法；可扩展至 100K 合成节点及 28.5K 真实电商节点；后者为已知最大的非对称距离路由解，比现有 ATSP 基准规模大 9 倍。

Conclusion: COMPASS 有效解决了 OCTSP 中的非局部依赖问题，兼具精确性与可扩展性，并突破了现有大规模非对称路由的规模限制。

Abstract: Large-scale routing often requires visiting clusters of nodes in a prescribed order, giving rise to the Ordered Clustered Traveling Salesman Problem (OCTSP). Optimizing each cluster independently seems natural, but misses non-local dependencies. We introduce the COMPASS algorithm for OCTSP, which combines search with learning-accelerated routing by orchestrating parallel sub-solvers. COMPASS has no quality ceiling and its solutions keep improving with compute. It exploits the clustered structure, and can reach exact solutions in time exponential in cluster size rather than instance size. Empirically, COMPASS consistently outperforms alternative methods. Unlike common large-scale routing solvers, COMPASS consumes general distance matrices and is not limited to coordinate inputs. We demonstrate scaling to 100K synthetic nodes and to 28.5K real e-commerce nodes. To our knowledge, the latter is the largest reported routing solution over asymmetric distances, 9x beyond established ATSP benchmarks.

</details>


### [372] [Minimax-Optimal Online Contract Design with Unrestricted Bounded Contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20353)
*Rui Ai,David Simchi-Levi,Han Zhong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 重复合同设计中，当委托人仅观测结果而无动作信息时，对任意固定结果数 m≥2，T 轮最小最大遗憾为 T^{m/(m+1)} 量级（对数因子内）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究委托人在仅能观测结果、无法观测代理动作情形下的重复合同设计问题；由于代理人最优反应可能使期望利润关于支付向量不连续，经典方法难以直接适用，因此需要刻画该学习问题的最优遗憾率。

Method: 允许任意有界的结果依存支付向量。上界通过有效维度归约，将基准归一化（即便固定断平规则不满足平移不变性），再利用显示偏好得到支付差坐标下的单调响应映射，并以该映射的 Lipschitz 参数化构造仅依赖观测结果类别的学习策略。下界构造则刻画激励损失如何沿结果维度累积。

Result: 对每个固定的结果数 m≥2，T 轮最小最大遗憾为 T^{m/(m+1)}（至多对数因子）。该上界允许任意动作空间与代理人异质性，且无需平滑性或单调剩余假设；下界表明每增加一个可签约结果都会带来精确且不可避免的最坏情形学习代价增长。

Conclusion: 该工作完整刻画了结果数依赖的重复合同学习遗憾率，并在宽松假设下给出了紧的上下界匹配结果。

Abstract: We study repeated contract design when a principal observes outcomes but not the actions that generate them. The principal may use any bounded outcome-contingent payment vector, and the agent's best response can make expected profit discontinuous in those payments. For every fixed number $m\ge2$ of outcomes, the minimax regret over $T$ rounds is of order $T^{m/(m+1)}$, up to logarithmic factors. The upper bound allows arbitrary action spaces and agent heterogeneity, without smoothness or monotone-surplus assumptions. Its key is an effective-dimension reduction that the benchmark can be normalized even when fixed tie-breaking is not shift invariant, after which revealed preference yields a monotone response map in payment-difference coordinates. A learning policy built on a Lipschitz parametrization of this map attains the rate using only observed outcome categories. The lower-bound construction accounts for how incentive losses accumulate across outcome dimensions. It shows that each additional contractible outcome creates a precise and unavoidable increase in the worst-case cost of learning.

</details>


### [373] [Learning Principal-Agent Contracts for Equitable Smallholder Carbon Farming under Moral Hazard and Adverse Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20404)
*Rishi Bharadwaj,Yadati Narahari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究将农业碳汇项目中的小农排斥问题建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），用强化学习求解聚合商的动态利润最大化合同，发现利润最大化的聚合商会放大而非缓解对小农的排斥。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 农业土壤是尚未开发的巨大碳汇，碳农业（carbon farming）是开发该潜力的重要途径。南亚和撒哈拉以南非洲以小农为主，小农理应成为规模化气候减缓的关键，但现实中的碳项目大多未能覆盖他们，这一"小农被排斥"的落差亟待解释。作者从合同设计视角研究该缺口。

Method: 将问题刻画为聚合商向异质小农群体提供单一"池化合同"（pooled contract）的动态缔约问题。农户具有私人采纳成本（逆向选择/隐藏信息）并付出不可观测的努力（道德风险），农艺产出跨多个生产季演化。作者将该演化缔约问题形式化为POMDP（部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程），并用强化学习学习动态的利润最大化合同，随后在不同条件下分析聚合商表现，并进行反事实模拟。

Result: 利润最大化的聚合商不仅继承了对小农的排斥，还将其放大：大农场实现的可达采纳率为87.7%，而小农户仅为8.2%。单位面积（每公顷）的监测、报告与核查（MRV）成本随农场规模上升而下降，聚合商的池化合同进一步强化了这一梯度而非抵消它。反事实分析显示，若令MRV成本纯粹与面积成比例，则该采纳率差距消失。

Conclusion: 农业碳项目的规模化瓶颈并非外生给定，而是内生于合同结构与MRV成本设计的规模依赖。研究结果表明，通过调整合同与政策设计（尤其是使MRV成本与面积成正比）可以打开小农获取碳收益的通道，同时让农业土壤为大规模气候减缓作出贡献；其结论与仿真可为相关合同和政策设计提供指导。

Abstract: Agricultural soils are a major untapped carbon sink. Carbon farming is emerging as a promising practice for tapping this potential. Smallholder farmers, who dominate agriculture across South Asia and sub-Saharan Africa, are key to scaling climate mitigation via carbon farming. It is ironic that real-world carbon programs largely fail to reach them. We study this important gap through the lens of contract design. An aggregator offers a single pooled contract to a heterogeneous population of smallholder farmers who have private adoption costs (adverse selection) and exert unobserved effort (moral hazard), with agronomic outcomes evolving over multiple seasons. We formulate this evolving contracting problem as a POMDP and use reinforcement learning to learn a dynamic profit-maximising contract. We analyse the performance of the aggregator under various conditions. We find that a profit-maximising aggregator does not merely inherit the exclusion of smallholders, it amplifies it. On large farms the aggregator realises 87.7% of achievable adoption, against only 8.2% on smallholdings. Per-hectare Measurement, Reporting and Verification (MRV) costs fall as farm size rises, and the aggregator's pooling contract compounds this gradient rather than offsetting it. A counterfactual that makes MRV costs purely area-proportional eliminates this disparity. Our results and simulation can guide contract and policy design that opens carbon income to smallholders while enabling agricultural soils to contribute to climate mitigation at scale.

</details>


### [374] [Seismic Site Response Prediction from Sparse Observations Using Finite-Element-Pretrained Latent Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20451)
*Yi Zhu,Su Chen,Xiaojun Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FLARE-T框架，通过学习并校准连接基底输入与多深度输出的低维潜动力学，改善数值场地反应预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数值场地反应预测常与观测不符，但因传感器覆盖有限、记录事件数量少，修正偏差十分困难。

Method: 先从密集有限元模拟中学习低维响应流形与输入驱动动力学；再训练稀疏编码器将模拟传感器响应映射到该坐标；用有限记录在潜空间内校准动力学。以短响应窗初始化预测，由完整基底运动驱动响应。

Result: 在分层土离心机试验与Lotung现场竖向台阵上评估。测试集显示多深度加速度时程和5%阻尼伪加速度反应谱均优于原始有限元模型；在所有评估传感器、不同强度运动及Lotung两个水平分量上误差均降低；两种不同本构参数的Lotung源模型取得相近精度。

Conclusion: FLARE-T提供了一种数据高效的方法，将密集数值响应信息与有限现场记录结合，可降低对精确先验标定的依赖并改进未来场地反应预测。

Abstract: Numerical site-response predictions often deviate from observations, yet correcting these discrepancies is difficult because records are limited in both sensor coverage and number of events. This study proposes the Transfer-Enabled Forced Latent Autoencoder for Response Equations (FLARE-T) to improve these predictions by learning and calibrating low-dimensional latent dynamics that connect the base acceleration input to acceleration outputs at multiple depths. FLARE-T learns a low-dimensional response manifold and input-driven dynamics from dense finite-element simulations. It then trains a sparse encoder to map simulated sensor responses into the learned coordinates and uses limited records to calibrate the dynamics within them. A short response window initializes each prediction, while the complete base motion drives the response. The framework was evaluated using a layered-soil centrifuge test and the Lotung field vertical array. Test-set results show that FLARE-T improved multi-depth acceleration histories and 5%-damped pseudoacceleration response spectra relative to the original finite-element models, reducing errors at every evaluated sensor for motions of different intensities and, at Lotung, for both horizontal components. Two Lotung source models with different constitutive parameters achieved comparable test-set accuracy, indicating reduced dependence on precise prior calibration. FLARE-T therefore provides a data-efficient means of combining dense numerical response information with limited field records to improve future site-response predictions.

</details>


### [375] [Training Neural Networks to Approach the Optimum Bayes Estimator in Dense Multi-Emitter Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20465)
*Yi Sun,Mona Sharifi,Muzna Yumman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该工作利用合成图像帧训练神经网络，逼近稠密发光体定位的贝叶斯最优估计器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稠密发光体定位中，传统估计方法难以达到理论最优性能，而贝叶斯最优估计器（如最大似然估计）在稠密条件下计算复杂、难以实用。

Method: 在合成帧数据上训练神经网络，使其直接学习并逼近稠密发光体定位问题的贝叶斯估计器。

Result: 训练后的神经网络能够逼近该问题的贝叶斯最优估计器，验证了数据驱动方法在此任务上的有效性。

Conclusion: 该结果支持后续研究，即通过训练神经网络实现高通量、大视场的超时空分辨率SMLM。

Abstract: We train neural networks on synthesized frames to approach the optimum Bayes estimator for dense emitter localization. The result justifies the future work on training neural networks to achieve high-throughput large-FOV super spatiotemporal resolution SMLM.

</details>


### [376] [Distributionally Robust Federated Learning with Multi-Source Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20501)
*Yingzhu Liu,Zhongkui Li,Pengcheng You,Ashish Cherukuri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对联邦学习中跨客户端混合权重不确定与客户端内部分布模糊的双重问题，构建局部模糊集的容许混合之并集作为全局模糊集，给出可分离重构与高概率泛化保证，并提出带收敛性证明的联邦算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习从各客户端私有数据训练共享模型，但实际中各客户端数据生成分布可能不同，且真实混合比例往往未知，导致底层群体分布难以准确刻画。已有方法通过优化最坏情况混合来应对跨客户端混合不确定性，但假设客户端级分布估计准确；而基于有限样本的估计往往不可靠。因此需要同时处理跨客户端混合不确定性与客户端内部分布模糊。

Method: 构造全局模糊集为局部模糊集容许混合的并集，允许客户端特定的模糊半径，并获得按客户端可分离的重构形式。基于该结构建立高概率的样本外性能保证；进一步针对惩罚型重构开发联邦算法，并在更弱的正则条件下证明其收敛性。

Result: 得到高概率样本外性能保证；在所提惩罚型重构上设计联邦算法并证明其在较弱正则条件下收敛；仿真实验验证了算法有效性。

Conclusion: 通过将跨客户端混合不确定性与客户端内分布模糊统一纳入全局模糊集，可在有限样本下提供可靠的鲁棒性保证，且所提联邦算法具备理论收敛性与实证有效性。

Abstract: Federated learning trains a shared model from private client data. In practice, data-generating distributions may differ, and the true mixture across clients is often unknown, making the underlying group distribution difficult to specify. Existing approaches address cross-client mixture uncertainty by optimizing against the worst-case mixture, yet assume accurate client-wise distribution estimates. However, these estimates can be unreliable when based on finite samples. To handle both cross-client mixture uncertainty and within-client distributional ambiguity, we construct a global ambiguity set as the union of admissible mixtures of local ambiguity sets. The construction allows client-specific ambiguity radii and admits a client-wise separable reformulation. Leveraging this structure, we establish a high-probability out-of-sample performance guarantee. We further develop a federated algorithm for a penalty-based reformulation and prove its convergence under milder regularity conditions. Simulations validate the algorithm's effectiveness.

</details>


### [377] [Radio Frequency Detection and Classification of Microplastics in Water](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20507)
*Jaden Tolbert,Md Saiful Islam,Pingshan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种机器学习辅助的射频介电光谱流式细胞术（DiSC）平台，实现对水环境中微/纳塑料颗粒的无标记检测与分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微/纳塑料（MPs/NPs）污染日益严重且具潜在健康风险，亟需快速、无标记的检测方法；当颗粒尺寸降至低微米范围时，传统光学与光谱方法因通量受限或样品制备复杂而难以适用。

Method: 在去离子水中悬浮8种标称直径10 μm的MP颗粒，于0.2–9 GHz范围内4个频率下测量其相对于载液的射频散射参数（S参数）变化，并以此训练监督式机器学习模型进行材料分类，包括混合样品及盐水环境下的MP识别。

Result: 对去离子水中的8类MP，宏观平均F1分数、精确率与召回率均超过0.71；在含3.3%与6.6%海盐的盐水载液中，PET的分类性能基本保持。

Conclusion: 结果证明ML辅助RF DiSC用于水环境中快速单颗粒MP分类的可行性。未来工作将通过改进RF校准、扩大光谱覆盖、增大训练数据集，并利用环境老化及生物污染的微塑料进行验证来提升分类性能。

Abstract: Micro- and nano-plastic particles (MPs/NPs) are ubiquitous environmental contaminants whose increasing abundance and potential health impacts have created an urgent need for rapid, label-free detection methods. As particle size decreases to the low-micrometer range, conventional optical and spectroscopic techniques become increasingly challenging because of limited throughput and/or complex sample preparation. In this work, we present a machine learning (ML)-assisted radio-frequency (RF) dielectric spectroscopic cytometry (DiSC) platform for the label-free detection and classification of MPs. Eight types of $ 10 $ μm nominal-diameter MP particles suspended in deionized (DI) water were characterized at four frequencies spanning $ 0.2\text{-}9\text{ GHz} $. The measured alterations in RF scattering parameters (S-parameters), referenced to the carrier medium, were used to train supervised ML models for material classification, including the identification of MPs in mixed samples and saline-water environments. For eight MP classes suspended in DI water, the proposed method achieved macro-average F1-score, precision, and recall values exceeding $ 0.71 $. Furthermore, PET classification performance was largely maintained in saline carrier media containing $3.3\% $ and $ 6.6\% $ sea salt. These results demonstrate the feasibility of ML-assisted RF DiSC for rapid, single-particle MP classification in aqueous environments. Future work will focus on improving classification performance through enhanced RF calibration, increased spectral coverage, larger training datasets, and validation using environmentally aged and biologically contaminated microplastics.

</details>


### [378] [When EOS Tokens Disagree: Understanding Length Inflation in On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20511)
*Yuxiao Yang,Tianrun Yu,Shangzhe Li,Kaixiang Zhao,Xuchao Zhang,Chetan Bansal,Huaxiu Yao,Taylor W. Killian,Weitong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究聚焦在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中的长度膨胀问题，识别出基础学生模型与后训练教师模型之间的"终止符不匹配"是学生回复过长的重要原因，并提出将功能等价的EOS符视为共享语义终止动作来缓解该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在在线策略蒸馏中，学生模型的回复容易变得过长，甚至耗尽生成预算，而此前对该现象来源缺乏明确解释。作者希望找出导致长度膨胀的关键机制，并理解终止行为在训练过程中的演变规律。

Method: 作者在Qwen3、Llama和Gemma三种模型家族上开展实验，分析基础学生与后训练教师在EOS符停止概率分布上的差异，即便二者声明的停止集合相同，也可能将停止概率放在不同的EOS符上。作者比较了仅对齐解码停止集合与将功能等价EOS符视为共享语义终止动作两种策略的效果，并进一步在OPD不同K2-Horizon训练阶段进行分阶段分析，追踪终止偏好的变化。

Result: 仅对齐解码停止集合不足以解决问题；将功能等价EOS符视为共享语义终止动作能显著缓解三个模型家族中由不匹配引发的长度膨胀。分阶段分析显示，终止偏好在训练过程中会发生明显偏移，且在OPD训练后期还出现了在对齐终止行为后依然存在的独立长度膨胀现象。

Conclusion: 终止符不匹配是OPD长度动态的重要但非唯一来源。作者发布了包含所提终止处理修正的代码实现。

Abstract: We study length inflation in on-policy distillation (OPD), where student responses can become excessively long and even exhaust the generation budget. We identify \emph{termination-token mismatch} between base students and post-trained teachers as an important source of this behavior. Across Qwen3, Llama, and Gemma, the two models can place their stopping probability on different EOS tokens, even when their declared stopping sets are identical. This mismatch can suppress the student's preferred termination action without reliably transferring the teacher-preferred alternative. We show that aligning the decoding stopping set alone is insufficient, while treating functionally equivalent EOS tokens as a shared semantic stopping action substantially mitigates mismatch-induced length inflation across all three model families. To further understand how termination behavior evolves over training, we study OPD across different K2-Horizon training stages. This stage-wise analysis shows that termination preferences can shift substantially during training, while also revealing a distinct length inflation late in the OPD run that persists beyond termination alignment. Together, these results identify termination mismatch as an important, but not exhaustive, source of OPD length dynamics. We release an implementation incorporating the proposed termination-handling corrections.

</details>


### [379] [CrystalMO-TuRBO: Multi-Objective Trust-Region Bayesian Optimization for High-precision Joint Crystal Structure Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20592)
*Joseph Agada,Yishu Wang,Arpan Biswas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CrystalMO-TuRBO两阶段多目标信赖域贝叶斯优化方法，实现X射线与中子衍射数据的联合晶体结构精修。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统最小二乘与似然优化依赖局部搜索，难以应对非凸、含噪、参数强相关的精修问题；X射线与中子数据灵敏度互补但相互竞争，标量化目标需人工赋权且易陷入次优解。

Method: 将X射线与中子衍射偏差建模为独立目标，转化为归一化最大化问题；采用两阶段策略：第一阶段用并行信赖域贝叶斯优化在多种标量化下进行全局探索，第二阶段在收缩区域内局部精修。

Result: 在单晶Ho2Ti2O7实验X射线与中子衍射数据上，相比经典精修方法与贝叶斯优化基线，收敛性、鲁棒性与参数精度均有提升。

Conclusion: 多目标信赖域贝叶斯优化能有效分离全局搜索与精细优化，适配精修任务的高精度需求，为多模态衍射联合结构精修提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Crystal structure refinement is a fundamental inverse problem in materials characterization, where structural parameters are optimized to reproduce experimental diffraction data. Conventional approaches, such as least-squares and likelihood-based optimization, rely on local search and often struggle with non-convex, noisy, and highly correlated parameter landscapes, particularly when integrating multiple diffraction modalities. Joint refinement of X-ray and neutron data is especially challenging due to their complementary but competing sensitivities, which are typically combined through scalarized objectives requiring manual weighting and leading to suboptimal solutions. We propose CrystalMO-TuRBO, a multi-objective trust region Bayesian optimization architecture for joint crystal structure refinement. The method models X-ray and neutron discrepancies as separate objectives and transforms the problem into a normalized maximization setting. A two-phase optimization strategy is introduced: Phase 1 performs global exploration using parallel trust-region Bayesian optimization across multiple scalarizations to identify promising regions of the parameter space, while Phase 2 conducts localized refinement within a shrinking region to achieve high-precision solutions. This design explicitly separates global search from fine-grained optimization, addressing the unique accuracy requirements of refinement tasks. We evaluate the proposed method on experimentally collected X-ray and neutron diffraction data from single-crystal Ho2Ti2O7. Results demonstrate improved convergence, robustness, and parameter precision compared to classical refinement methods and Bayesian optimization baselines on refinement of a single-crystal pyrochlore material system.

</details>


### [380] [Recursive Quantum Long Short-Term Memory for Stable Short-Horizon Temperature Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20594)
*Mu-En Lee,Yen-Ku Liu,Samuel Yen-Chi Chen,Yun-Cheng Tsai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文比较了递归QLSTM与标准QLSTM在日气温预测任务上的表现，发现递归结构收敛更快、误差更低、泛化更好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子长短期记忆（QLSTM）模型虽将变分量子电路引入循环序列学习，但其优化行为对随机初始化和时间上下文高度敏感，稳定性与泛化性有待改进。

Method: 在多伦多每日气象观测数据上，采用相同训练设置，将递归QLSTM与标准QLSTM进行一步超前的最低/最高气温预测对比；输入窗口设为8、16、32天，并在20个随机种子上评估收敛性、预测精度与泛化能力。

Result: 递归模型始终更早达到接近最优的测试损失，降低了MAE与RMSE，且泛化差距更小。

Conclusion: 递归量子特征变换可提升紧凑型混合量子-经典时序模型的稳定性与样本外性能。

Abstract: Quantum long short-term memory (QLSTM) models extend recurrent sequence learning with variational quantum circuits, but their optimization behavior can vary substantially across random initializations and temporal contexts. This paper evaluates a recursive QLSTM architecture against a standard QLSTM for one-step-ahead prediction of daily minimum and maximum temperature. Using daily weather observations from Toronto and identical training settings, we compare convergence, predictive accuracy, and generalization across input windows of 8, 16, and 32 days over 20 random seeds. The recursive model consistently reaches a near-optimal test loss earlier, reduces mean absolute error and root mean squared error, and exhibits a smaller generalization gap. These results indicate that recursive quantum feature transformations can improve stability and out-of-sample performance for compact hybrid quantum--classical temporal models.

</details>


### [381] [COIN-GP: Cooperative Online Learning in Networked Distributed Systems with Partial Measurements via Gaussian Process Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20598)
*Zewen Yang,Xiaobing Dai,Zhenxiao Yin,Hang Zhao,Zhijun Li,C. C. Chan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对分布式传感器网络中仅存在部分状态观测的场景，提出基于观测器的动态协同学习框架，结合在线分布式高斯过程回归，联合估计系统状态与部分未知动态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在分布式传感器网络中，系统状态通常只能被部分观测，且动态模型部分未知，现有分布式GP方法在测量不完整、GP模型不完善时估计精度不足，因此需要新的联合估计框架。

Method: 提出基于观测器的动态协同学习框架，融合在线分布式高斯过程（GP）回归；设计新的数据采集策略并给出可行数据获取的理论条件；利用GP的确定性误差界推导涵盖状态估计与模型估计的误差上界。

Result: 在部分观测与GP模型不完善的条件下仍能实现准确估计；数据采集策略具备理论可行性保证；给出了状态估计与模型估计的联合误差上界；仿真表明优于现有基于分布式GP的方法。

Conclusion: 该框架有效解决了分布式网络中部分观测下的状态与未知动态联合估计问题，并通过理论误差界与仿真验证了其优越性。

Abstract: In this paper, we tackle the problem of jointly estimating the system states and partially unknown dynamics within distributed sensor-equipped networks, particularly in scenarios where only partial state observations are available. To address this issue, we propose an observer-based dynamic cooperative learning framework incorporating online distributed Gaussian Process (GP) regression, which enables accurate estimation despite incomplete in measurements and deficient GP models. In addition, a novel data collection strategy is introduced, with theoretical conditions ensuring feasible data acquisition. Moreover, we also derive an error upper bound encompassing state estimation and model estimation, leveraging the deterministic error bounds of GPs. Empirical simulations demonstrate the superiority of our approach compared to existing distributed GP-based methods.

</details>


### [382] [Multi-center Medical Data Mining with FL-Net - A One-stop Shop for Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20650)
*Simon Süwer,Julian Klemm,Elisa Acitelli,Mathieu Almeida,Lucia Altucci,Zsolt Bagyura,Michelangela Barbieri,Zsolt-Zoltán Bedő,Rosaria Benedetti,Béla Bihari,Csongor Csalóka,Lucia Dicunta,Stanislav Ehrlich,Bjoern M. Eskofier,Sándor-József Fejér,Georg Fröwis,Walter Hötzendorfer,Alexandra Kautzky-Willer,Jens Johann Georg Lohmann,Marianna Maranghi,Lorenzo Marconi,Rudolf Mayer,Wouter Leonard Megchelenbrink,Monika Moga,Adham Mottalib,Sanjeev Mehta,Madeleine Müller,Thomas Nyström,Balázs-Attila Orbán,Paul O'Toole,Giuseppe Paolisso,Paolo Parini,Matteo Pedrelli,Enrico Petrillo,Philipp Poindl,Niklas Probul,Anastasia Pustozerova,Tanja Šarčević,Lukas Weilguny,Jan Baumbach,Andreas Maier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FL-Net——一个满足临床联邦研究五项需求的联邦学习框架，集成模块化数据协调、数据发现、披露控制、版本化FL-Net-Tools与容器化联邦工作流执行，并在MIMIC与US-130上完成端到端验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习虽支持无需共享患者级数据的协作训练，但多数研究仍停留在仿真阶段。作者从文献中提炼出五项需求，分析14个现有FL框架，发现无一能完全满足，因而需要构建一个面向临床研究、可实际部署的联邦框架。

Method: 提出FL-Net框架，将模块化数据协调、数据发现、披露控制、安全构建的版本化FL-Net-Tools以及容器化联邦工作流执行集成到一个持久化网络中，并支持跨研究复用已协调的数据与工作流。通过数据协调、跨MIMIC与US-130的跨研究患者发现，以及最多50个并发客户端下的可复现且可审计的联邦工作流进行端到端评估。

Result: FL-Net在所有五项需求上均得到满足；端到端评估表明其支持数据协调、跨MIMIC与US-130的跨研究患者发现，以及最多50个并发客户端的可复现、可审计联邦工作流。该框架正在dAIbetes和Microb-AI-ome两个欧盟项目中开发，将覆盖9个国家10家医院逾80万名患者，涵盖纵向与单时点数据。

Conclusion: FL-Net为可互操作、可复现且隐私保护的多中心临床研究提供了实用基础。

Abstract: Federated learning enables collaborative training without sharing patient-level data, but most studies remain simulations. Based on five requirements derived from the literature, we analyzed 14 FL frameworks and found that none fully satisfied these requirements. We present FL-Net, a novel federated clinical research framework to fulfill all requirements. It integrates modular data harmonization, data discovery, disclosure control, securely built versioned FL-Net-Tools and containerized federated workflow execution into a persistent network. It enables the re-use of harmonized data and workflows across studies. FL-Net's end-to-end capabilities were evaluated through harmonization, cross-study patient discovery across MIMIC and US-130, and reproducible, audited federated workflows with up to 50 concurrent clients. FL-Net is being developed within the dAIbetes and Microb-AI-ome EU projects and will cover over 800,000 patients across 10 hospitals in 9 countries covering longitudinal and single point in time data, FL-Net provides a practical foundation for interoperable, reproducible, and privacy-preserving multicenter clinical research.

</details>


### [383] [RISC-V and machine learning: a survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20677)
*Shriman Keshri,Apparna Singh,Chinmaya Kumar Palo,Shreya Adya,Subhankar Mishra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文综述RISC-V指令集架构在机器学习应用中的现状，涵盖能力、挑战与未来方向，并提出统一分类法、性能权衡比较、软件工具链成熟度评估及四类研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源处理器架构与机器学习的交叉推动了对可定制、高效且易获取硬件的需求，因此需要系统评估RISC-V在该领域的适配性与发展潜力。

Method: 基于近期研究，综述学术界与工业界实现、软件框架及实际应用；分析从指令集扩展、核心实现到编译器优化与部署策略的完整生态，并构建统一分类法进行性能与设计权衡比较。

Result: 发现RISC-V在能效、专用指令开发与框架集成方面取得进展，但存在标准化不足、验证复杂度高与生态碎片化等挑战。

Conclusion: 提出四个研究方向：专用神经处理扩展、自适应与模块化处理器架构、安全框架、能效多域架构，为RISC-V成为下一代机器学习系统基础平台提供路线图。

Abstract: The intersection of open-source processor architectures and machine learning is driving the demand for customizable, efficient, and accessible hardware. This survey examines the state of the RISC-V ISA in machine learning applications, analyzing current capabilities, challenges, and future directions based on recent research. The analysis covers academic and commercial implementations, software frameworks, and real-world applications. The RISC-V machine learning ecosystem is evaluated, from instruction set extensions and core implementations to compiler optimizations and deployment strategies. Key contributions include a unified taxonomy of RISC-V ML implementations, a comparative analysis of performance and design trade-offs, an evaluation of software toolchain maturity, and the identification of emerging trends in instruction set extensions and specialized accelerators. Findings reveal progress in energy efficiency, specialized instruction development, and framework integration, while highlighting challenges in standardization, verification complexity, and ecosystem fragmentation. The analysis proposes four research directions to address current limitations: specialized neural processing extensions, adaptive and modular processor architectures, security frameworks, and energy-efficient multi-domain architectures. These directions provide a roadmap for advancing RISC-V as a foundational platform for next-generation machine learning systems.

</details>


### [384] [Video DeltaNet: A Video-Native Hybrid Attention for Livestream Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20744)
*Haocheng Xi,Yiming Xie,Hexu Zhao,Yiwen Zhang,Michael Liu,Thomas Creavin,Kurt Keutzer,Xiuyu Li,Zhaoyang Lv,Chenfeng Xu,Haiwen Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Video DeltaNet (VDN)，将局部 Softmax 注意力与双向线性记忆相结合的混合注意力机制用于视频扩散模型，并在 MiniMax H3 上实例化为 VDN-H3，实现 14.5 倍推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散模型在去噪过程中需反复处理长时空 token 序列，注意力成为主要计算瓶颈。线性注意力虽在大型语言模型中被广泛采用，但直接迁移到视频模型会丢失高质量生成所需的细粒度交互。

Method: VDN 将局部 Softmax 注意力与双向线性记忆相结合以建模长程视频上下文。线性分支提出 Video Delta Attention (VDA)，通过联合纳入空间 token 实现逐帧更新记忆；两个分支采用独立的输出投影与可学习门控进行校准，并通过分阶段教师对齐策略将新路径渐进式引入预训练模型。在 MiniMax H3 上实例化时，混合注意力用于视频到视频交互，涉及文本或音频的交互仍保留 Softmax。

Result: 结合八步蒸馏与优化的 SGLang 推理栈，VDN-H3 在八块 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上于 6.70 秒内完成 14.3 秒、768p 视频的 DiT 去噪，相比相同 GPU 数量下的 50 步稠密 H3 基线加速 14.5 倍。

Conclusion: VDN 通过混合注意力设计与渐进式对齐训练，在保持生成质量所需细粒度交互的同时显著提升视频扩散模型的推理效率，验证了线性注意力在视频生成中的可行性与加速潜力。

Abstract: Video diffusion models repeatedly process long spatiotemporal token sequences during denoising, making attention a major computational bottleneck. Linear attention offers an appealing alternative and has been widely adopted in recent large language models, but directly applying it to video models often fails to preserve the fine-grained interactions required for high-quality generation. We present Video DeltaNet (VDN), which combines local Softmax attention with bidirectional linear memory for long-range video context. Its linear branch introduces Video Delta Attention (VDA), which updates memory once per frame by jointly incorporating its spatial tokens. Separate output projections and learnable gates calibrate the two branches, while a staged teacher-alignment recipe progressively introduces the new pathway into pretrained models. We instantiate VDN on MiniMax H3, applying the hybrid to video-to-video interactions while retaining Softmax for interactions involving text or audio. With eight-step distillation and an optimized SGLang serving stack, VDN-H3 completes DiT denoising for a 14.3-second, 768p video in 6.70 seconds on eight NVIDIA B200 GPUs, corresponding to a 14.5x speedup over the 50-step dense H3 baseline on the same GPU count.

</details>


### [385] [Calibrated RF-Fingerprinting Under Interference With Heterogeneous Transmission Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20765)
*Tariq Abdul-Quddoos,Xiangfang Li,Lijun Qian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将RF指纹识别扩展到多信号同频干扰场景，建模为多标签分类，用1D CNN结合校准方法给出假阴性上界保证，在POWDER 5G测试床真实数据上验证，准确率73%–97%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RF指纹研究几乎只考虑单一发射机独立发射的场景，忽略了同频干扰下多信号在时频上重叠的真实情形，限制了其实际适用性。作者希望提升RF指纹识别在真实高竞争无线环境中的可用性。

Method: 将共存多发射机的RF指纹识别形式化为多标签分类问题，采用1D卷积神经网络(CNN)进行建模；并对模型进行校准，从标签概率导出置信阈值，从而对平均假阴性数量给出上界保证，确保不遗漏真实的频谱政策违规。使用POWDER 5G测试床的真实数据验证，设备发射802.11a(Wi-Fi)、4G LTE和5G NR波形。

Result: 校准后准确率依信道条件从73%到97%不等；针对不同平均假阴性上界进行校准可获得约(1−校准假阴性)的micro召回率，且校准对分布外干扰具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该方法在真实高竞争无线环境中展现出潜力，能够在同频干扰下有效识别多发射机并控制漏检风险，证明了将校准与多标签CNN结合的RF指纹方案在现实场景中的可行性。

Abstract: Radio Frequency(RF)-Fingerprinting is a spectrum monitoring technique that identifies specific transmitters based on hardware impairments imprinted within the emitted signal. Although widely researched, studies almost exclusively consider scenarios where only one transmitter is emitting at a time, limiting real world applicability. In this work, we further the study of RF-Fingerprinting by considering co-channel interference, with multiple emitted signals interfering with each other, overlapping in time and frequency. Specifically, we formulate this problem as a multi-label classification problem and employ a 1D convolutional neural network (CNN). Furthermore, the models are calibrated such that the confidence thresholds for the label probabilities are derived, with guarantees on the upper bound on the average number of False Negatives, providing a degree of confidence in not missing a true spectrum policy violation. The proposed method is validated using real world data from the POWDER 5G testbed on devices transmitting 802.11a(Wi-Fi), 4G LTE, and 5G NR waveforms. The results show accuracy as high as 97% and as low as 73% after calibration depending on channel conditions. Also calibrating for various average false negatives upper bounds achieves micro recall scores of approximately (1 - calibrated false negatives) with the calibration robust to out-of-distribution interference, demonstrating the potential of the proposed method in a realistic high contention wireless environment

</details>


### [386] [PosteriorBench: From Point Estimates to Posterior Matching in Evaluating Generative Inverse Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20794)
*Jiachen Yao,Zi-Siang Hsu,Xi Deng,Aditi Gupta,Xin Ju,Sally M Benson,Gege Wen,Anima Anandkumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 PosteriorBench，一个用于评估生成式逆问题求解器分布精度（而非单点重构）的基准，涵盖四类物理逆问题，并配套五项后验评估指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式逆问题评估主要关注能否产生单一合理重构，这对病态问题不足：多个解可能与同一稀疏或含噪观测一致。方法可在逐点精度上表现良好，却因模式崩塌、过度自信不确定性或对不相容解求平均而未能刻画真实后验。

Method: 构建 PosteriorBench，覆盖 Darcy 流反演、Poisson 源恢复、碳捕集与封存、光传输材料推断四个物理逆问题；用拒绝采样、马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛等计算代价高但成熟的方法构造高保真参考后验；配套五项后验评估指标：后验均值误差、后验标准差误差、最大均值差异、切片 Wasserstein 距离、径向平均功率谱误差。

Result: 基准覆盖稀疏感知、低分辨率观测、非线性前向模型、不同噪声水平与多峰先验，并提供统一的分布匹配与不确定性量化流程。实验显示当前求解器存在显著分布匹配差距；神经算子提升分辨率鲁棒性；引导权重与生成噪声是后验方差校准的关键。

Conclusion: PosteriorBench 将评估重点从单点重构转向后验分布精度，为生成式逆问题求解器提供统一、可比的分布级评测，揭示现有方法的分布匹配缺陷并指明方差校准的关键因素。

Abstract: Generative models are increasingly used to solve scientific inverse problems, but existing evaluations still focus primarily on whether a method can produce a single plausible reconstruction. This is insufficient for ill-posed problems, where multiple solutions may be consistent with the same sparse or noisy observations. In these settings, a method can achieve strong pointwise accuracy while still failing to capture the true posterior through mode collapse, overconfident uncertainty, or averaging incompatible solutions. We introduce PosteriorBench, a benchmark for evaluating the distributional accuracy of generative inverse solvers. PosteriorBench evaluates four physics-based inverse problems: Darcy flow inversion, Poisson source recovery, carbon capture and storage, and light transport material inference. For each task, we construct high-fidelity reference posteriors using computationally heavy but established procedures such as rejection sampling and Markov chain Monte Carlo, enabling direct assessment of whether solvers recover the full set of solutions rather than the single best sample. We pair these references with a five-metric posterior evaluation suite: posterior-mean error, posterior-standard-deviation error, maximum mean discrepancy, sliced Wasserstein distance, and radially averaged power-spectrum error. These metrics assess pointwise accuracy, marginal uncertainty, distributional alignment, and global frequency fidelity. The benchmark spans sparse sensing, low-resolution observations, nonlinear forward models, varying noise levels, and multimodal priors, with a unified pipeline for distribution matching and uncertainty quantification. Our experiments reveal substantial distribution-matching gaps across current solvers, while showing that neural operators improve resolution robustness, and guidance weights and generation noise are key to posterior-variance calibration.

</details>


### [387] [Score Centering Stabilizes Off-policy Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20807)
*Martin Marek,Max Ryabinin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"score centering"加性校正项，通过抵消训练引擎与推理引擎间的漂移，稳定存在训练-推理不匹配(TIM)的强化学习训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的强化学习对训练与推理引擎之间的微小差异（TIM）极其敏感，导致训练不稳定。然而完全消除TIM不切实际，因为会严重损害rollout效率，因此需要一种在不牺牲效率的前提下稳定RL的方法。

Method: 作者分析发现TIM下RL的不稳定性主要源于drift——一种随每个训练步累积的训练与推理引擎间的持续性偏差。基于此推导出加性的"score centering"校正项，通过抵消drift来稳定RL，且该校正项可与重要性采样(importance sampling)组合使用。

Result: 在0.6B至30B参数模型上的训练中，score centering单独使用即可匹配或超越量化下基于重要性采样的方法，且不匹配越严重差距越大；在staleness实验中，其与重要性采样的组合也优于纯重要性采样基线。

Conclusion: TIM下RL不稳定的主因是累积性drift，通过加性score centering校正可有效抵消drift，实现稳定且高效的RL训练，并能与重要性采样方法互补组合。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) of large language models is notoriously sensitive to small differences between training and inference engines, often referred to as the training-inference mismatch (TIM). However, completely eliminating TIM is impractical, as it would come at a major cost to rollout efficiency. In this paper, we show that the instability of RL under TIM is primarily caused by drift: a persistent bias between training and inference engines that accumulates with every training step. We derive an additive "score centering" correction term that stabilizes RL under TIM by canceling drift. When training models from 0.6B to 30B parameters, score centering alone matches or outperforms methods based on importance sampling under quantization, with the gap growing as the mismatch becomes more severe. Because the correction is additive, score centering also composes with importance sampling -- their composition outperforms pure importance-sampling baselines in our staleness experiments.

</details>


<div id='cs.NE'></div>

# cs.NE [[Back]](#toc)

### [388] [Position Paper: Neurotransmitters as a Missing Dimension in Artificial Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20083)
*Yupei Li,Manuel Milling,Berrak Sisman,Björn Schuller*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 这是一篇立场性（positional）论文，主张将神经调质（神经递质）机制显式建模为人工神经网络的"第三条学习轴"，与神经活动和突触可塑性并列，以提升自适应性与持续学习能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有人工神经网络依赖统一、局部、基于梯度的参数更新，缺乏生物系统所具有的自适应灵活性与长期稳定性。当前改进多集中于架构扩展或正则化、参数隔离等数学微调手段，却忽视了神经递质信号与神经可塑性等内部学习机制。作者受哺乳动物大脑优越适应性与可塑性启发，认为神经调质应被视为与神经活动、突触可塑性互补的学习维度。

Method: 作为立场性论文，本文不提出具体算法或实验方案，而是通过论证与观点陈述的方式，主张在人工神经网络设计中引入神经调质原理，并呼吁将神经调质作为第三条学习轴纳入建模框架。

Result: 本文为观点性论述，未报告实验或量化结果；其核心"结果"是指出神经调质建模是一个有前景但尚未被充分探索的研究方向，并论证其对自适应与持续学习系统的潜在价值。

Conclusion: 作者主张神经调质原理应被显式纳入人工神经网络设计，作为区别于神经活动与突触可塑性的第三条学习轴，并呼吁研究界给予更多关注，以推动自适应与持续学习系统的发展。

Abstract: Artificial neural networks (ANNs), as core components of modern deep learning (DL) systems, lack the adaptive flexibility and long-term stability exhibited by biological systems. This limitation largely stems from the fact that conventional ANNs rely on uniform, local, and gradient-based parameter updates, while neglecting internal learning principles that are biological mechanisms such as neurotransmitters signalling or neuroplasticity. Consequently, many existing approaches focus on architectural expansion or mathematical fine-tuning techniques such as regularisation or parameter isolation. Inspired by the superior adaptability and plasticity of mammalian brains, we posit that neuromodulation with neurotransmitters constitutes a third axis of learning, complementary to neural activity and synaptic plasticity, and should be explicitly modelled in artificial neural networks. In this positional paper, we argue that incorporating neuromodulatory principles into ANN design represents a promising and underexplored research direction, and we advocate for greater attention to this perspective in the development of adaptive and continual learning systems.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [389] [4D Radar Perception Algorithms for Autonomous Driving: A Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19216)
*Xumin Wu,Jun Zhou,Jilin Mei,Chen Min,Yu Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 这是一篇面向4D毫米波雷达感知的综述，按感知任务演进组织文献，涵盖信号处理、目标检测、语义分割、运动估计、占据预测与动态场景重建，并比较单雷达学习、多模态融合与跨模态监督/知识蒸馏三条技术路线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 4D毫米波雷达感知算法研究近年快速发展，任务与算法不断扩展，但领域缺乏从任务演进角度系统梳理的综述，难以厘清不同研究方向的经验支撑与共性挑战。

Method: 综述性研究：先介绍雷达基础原理、数据表示与质量增强方法；再按目标级感知、运动与定位、局部与稠密空间感知、动态场景理解四类任务组织文献；横向比较单雷达学习、多模态融合、跨模态监督与知识蒸馏；重点分析高度维、多普勒测量与雷达物理先验在各任务中的利用方式；并汇总现有数据集的任务覆盖、输入数据、标注与评测协议。

Result: 系统梳理了4D雷达感知的任务体系与算法谱系，明确了三条技术路线的适用性与关联，总结了高度、多普勒与物理先验的跨任务利用方式，并给出数据集体检式对比，厘清了各研究方向的经验支撑。

Conclusion: 综述以任务导向视角刻画了4D雷达感知从稀疏目标感知向动态空间理解的转变，讨论了面向自动驾驶的共性挑战与未来方向。

Abstract: Research on 4D millimeter-wave radar perception algorithms has flourished in recent years, extending from signal processing and object detection to semantic segmentation, motion estimation, occupancy prediction, and dynamic scene reconstruction.
