This review organizes the field according to the evolution of perception tasks and algorithms. It first introduces radar fundamentals, data representations, and quality-enhancement methods, and then reviews object-level perception, motion and localization, local and dense spatial perception, and dynamic scene understanding. Across these directions, we compare radar-only learning, multimodal fusion, and cross-modal supervision and knowledge distillation. Particular attention is paid to how elevation, Doppler measurements, and radar physical priors are exploited across tasks. We further summarize the task coverage, input data, annotations, and evaluation protocols of existing datasets, clarifying the empirical support for different research directions. Finally, we discuss the common challenges and future directions of 4D radar perception for autonomous driving. This review provides a task-oriented perspective on the transition from sparse object perception to dynamic spatial understanding.

</details>


### [390] [VABench: Measuring Embodied Spatial Intelligence through Visual Demonstrations, Active Perception, and Metric Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19554)
*Zhongbo Zhang,Jiayi Jin,Yifan Wang,Zaibin Zhang,Haiwen Diao,Lijun Wang,Huchuan Lu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出VA-Bench基准，用"观察-推理-行动-修正"闭环评估通用多模态大模型的空间智能，揭示其在主动视角选择、几何泛化和长程任务上的显著短板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间智能评测多停留在描述物体位置，无法刻画模型在不完整观测下主动获取缺失证据、在统一空间坐标系中解读并据此行动的能力；需要能覆盖完整具身闭环的基准。

Method: VA-Bench要求通用MLLM仅从RGB演示学习程序性上下文，主动选择相机视角、输出度量制笛卡尔指令，并依据执行反馈修正；不提供真实物体位姿、oracle轨迹或学习到的动作头，由固定的模型无关控制器执行模型指定的目标。基准含14个基础任务族（11单臂+3双臂）、7个留出几何/布局变体及长程五物体组合赛道；在每任务20个物理验证种子上，以3次独立运行评估12种主模型条件，报告最终成功率、9项轨迹级行为诊断与子任务进度。

Result: 最优模型在标注运行中目标定位100.0%、空间关系78.9%，但三次运行宏平均任务成功率仅53.93±3.17%；主动相机控制显著优于被动多视角观察（匹配对比中27.86%→57.50%）；留出几何迁移可致成功率下降超30个百分点；无模型能完成严格长程回合，尽管子任务进度显著。

Conclusion: VA-Bench检验通用MLLM能否将视觉演示与主动获取的证据转化为成功的具身行动，结果显示其在主动感知、几何泛化与长程闭环执行方面仍存在明显能力缺口。

Abstract: Spatial intelligence requires more than describing object locations. Under incomplete observation, models must identify and acquire missing evidence, interpret it in a common spatial frame, and act on it. We introduce VA-Bench to evaluate the complete observe-reason-act-revise loop. General-purpose MLLMs learn procedural context from RGB-only demonstrations, actively select camera viewpoints, issue metric Cartesian commands, and revise them from execution feedback. Models receive no privileged object poses, oracle trajectories, or learned action heads. A fixed model-agnostic controller executes only model-specified targets. VA-Bench contains 14 base task families (11 single-arm and three dual-arm), seven held-out geometry/layout variants, and a long-horizon five-object composition track. We evaluate 12 primary model conditions in three independent runs over the same 20 physically verified seeds per base task, reporting terminal success, nine trajectory-level behavioral diagnostics, and subtask progress. First, the best-performing model scores 100.0% on target localization and 78.9% on spatial relations in the annotated run. Its three-run macro-average task success is only 53.93+/-3.17%. Second, active camera control significantly improves task success over passive multi-view observation. In one matched comparison, success rises from 27.86% to 57.50%. Third, held-out geometric transfer can reduce task success by over 30 percentage points. No model completes a strict long-horizon episode, despite substantial partial progress. VA-Bench thus tests whether general-purpose MLLMs can turn visual demonstrations and actively acquired evidence into successful embodied action.

</details>


### [391] [Feeling Terrain Before Crossing: World Models for Off-Road Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19863)
*E-In Son,Dong-Wook Kim,Ji-Hoon Hwang,Kangsun Lee,Jisung Bae,Jung-Taak Kim,Seung-Woo Seo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Feel-WM，首个以本体感觉为条件的越野导航世界模型，同时预测机器人将"看到"的视觉场景与将"感受"到的物理未来（未来本体状态与失败风险），并在规划中以可分离分数权衡失败风险与目标相似度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 越野导航依赖机器人—地形交互，预测不仅要覆盖相机所见，还必须覆盖机器人所感（打滑、倾斜、颠簸等）。然而现有以场景为中心的世界模型无法预测这些动力学，仅靠视觉预测不足以作为规划代理。

Method: 以本体感觉作为输入条件的越野导航世界模型：预测未来本体状态与失败风险，二者均从机器人自身经验中以无人工标签方式学习；规划器将物理未来与场景一并展开（rollout），并以可分离评分同时考虑失败风险与目标相似度。在真实越野数据与仿真中，对轮式与足式平台进行开环规划与闭环崎岖地形导航评测。

Result: 在开环规划与闭环崎岖地形导航上，Feel-WM 优于纯视觉导航世界模型，覆盖轮式与足式平台；部署于山地小径的 Husky 上可机载规划、预判前方崎岖地形并绕行，完成端到端策略失败的路段。

Conclusion: 将本体感觉纳入世界模型条件、显式预测物理未来与失败风险，可显著提升越野导航的前瞻规划能力与实机鲁棒性。

Abstract: Navigation world models plan by foresight, predicting the future that each candidate action sequence produces and selecting the best, rather than mapping observations to actions directly. Unlike urban settings where a predicted scene is a sufficient proxy, off-road navigation hinges on the robot--terrain interaction, so the prediction must cover not only what the camera will see but what the robot will feel. However, existing scene-focused models do not predict how much the robot will slip, tilt or shake along a planned trajectory. Proprioception captures these dynamics directly and, when used as input, improves the prediction of the physical future. We present Feel-WM, the first off-road navigation world model that conditions on proprioception and predicts what the robot will feel alongside what the camera will see. The physical future takes the form of a future proprioceptive state and a failure risk, both learned from the robot's own experience without human labels. The planner rolls out the physical future alongside the scene and weighs the predicted failure risk against goal similarity in a separable score. Experiments on real off-road data and in simulation demonstrate that Feel-WM outperforms visual-only navigation world models in open-loop planning and closed-loop rough-terrain navigation across wheeled and legged platforms. Deployed on a Husky on mountain trails, Feel-WM plans onboard, predicts rough ground ahead and steers around it, completing courses that an end-to-end policy fails.

</details>


### [392] [LapaTrack-3D: 6 DoF pre-operative shape tracking for laparoscopic surgery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19954)
*Jingwei Song,Javid Hussain Jakir,Ray Zhang,Wenwei Zhang,Hao Zhou,Xiaomeng Xian,Maani Ghaffari*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 LapaTrack-3D：一种面向单目腹腔镜手术的实时 6 自由度跟踪算法，基于改进的 ORB-SLAM2 融合术前三维形状先验，实现术中视频与术前数据（如 CT）的对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腹腔镜手术缺乏触觉反馈且脏器透明（遮挡/形变导致可视性差），难以准确定位目标器官内部解剖结构；需将术中视频与术前影像对齐以提供空间定位依据。

Method: 采用并改造 ORB-SLAM2 框架，实现基于先验的三维跟踪，含四项主要改动：(1) 用初始三维形状快速初始化单目模式；(2) 伪分割策略分离目标器官与背景以利于跟踪；(3) 将三维形状作为几何先验融入位姿图优化；(4) 采用并改进多尺度彩色保持 Retinex（MSRCP）算法进行挑战性光照下的图像增强。

Result: 离体与在体实验表明，LapaTrack-3D 具备稳健的三维跟踪能力，可有效应对光照不佳、快速运动、视野外、部分可见以及"器官—背景"相对运动等典型挑战；对 1280×720 像素视频达到 13 Hz 的处理速率。

Conclusion: LapaTrack-3D 通过先验形状引导的单目 SLAM 改造方案，在复杂腹腔镜场景下实现实时、鲁棒的 6 DoF 跟踪，为术中—术前数据对齐提供可行方案。

Abstract: This work proposes a real-time 6 Degree-of-Freedom (6 DoF) tracking algorithm for monocular laparoscopic surgery. It provides alignment between intra-operative video and pre-operative data (e.g., CT). The 6 DoF tracking offers a solution for accurately locating the internal anatomy of the target organ despite the lack of tactile feedback and transparency. The ORB-SLAM2 framework is adopted and modified for prior-based 3D tracking with four major modifications. First, the primitive 3D shape is used for fast initialization of the ORB-SLAM2 monocular mode. Second, a pseudo-segmentation strategy is employed to separate the target organ from the background for tracking. Third, the 3D shape is incorporated as a geometric prior in its pose graph optimization. Fourth, the Multi-Scale Retinex with Chromaticity Preservation (MSRCP) algorithm is leveraged and modified for image enhancement in challenging illumination scenarios. In-vivo and ex-vivo experiments validate that LapaTrack-3D provides robust 3D tracking and effectively handles typical challenges such as poor illumination, fast motion, out-of-field-of-view scenarios, partial visibility, and ``organ-background'' relative motion. LapaTrack-3D achieves a processing rate of 13 Hz for 1280*720 pixel video.

</details>


### [393] [VLN on the Fly: An Onboard Vision-Language Navigation Stack for Aerial Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20191)
*Marco S. Tayar,Felipe Tommaselli,Gianluca Capezutto,Pedro Antonio Rabelo Saraiva,Pedro H. V. de Freitas,Lucas Kido,Guilherme Sonego,Ricardo V. Godoy,Marcelo Becker*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出机载VLN系统"VLN on the Fly"，将视觉语言导航的地面化、规划与控制保持为独立可检查的模块，在四旋翼上实现全机载运行，15次飞行中13次成功，平均目标误差5.72 cm，GPU利用率39.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在飞行机器人上全机载运行视觉语言导航（VLN）十分困难：定位（grounding）、规划与控制需共享有限算力，且单级错误在飞行中难以隔离。端到端空中策略将各阶段融合为单一网络，牺牲了模块化堆栈所具备的可观测性与安全检查能力。

Method: 提出"VLN on the Fly"机载堆栈，保持地面化、规划与控制为分离且可检查的阶段：用量化VLM将指令定位到粗略图像单元，通过深度信息提升为3D目标点，快速B样条规划器返回可行轨迹，再由预训练强化学习策略跟踪轨迹并输出电机指令，可跨多款四旋翼迁移。

Result: 在受控室内空间针对三个日常参照物的15次机载飞行中，13/15次抵达目标，平均目标误差5.72 cm，平均GPU利用率39.3%；在额外6次杂乱环境试验中，堆栈在机载感知门控下跟踪无碰撞轨迹。

Conclusion: 模块化、可检查的机载VLN堆栈可在有限算力下实现可靠飞行导航，兼顾可观测性、安全性与跨机型适用性，并在真实杂乱环境中保持无碰撞运行。

Abstract: Running vision-language navigation fully onboard an aerial robot is hard, since grounding, planning, and control must share limited compute and a single-stage error is difficult to isolate in flight. End-to-end aerial policies fuse these stages into one network, giving up the observability and safety checks a modular stack keeps available. We propose VLN on the Fly, an onboard stack that keeps grounding, planning, and control as separate, inspectable stages. A quantized VLM grounds an instruction to a coarse image cell, depth lifts it to a 3D goal, a fast B-spline planner returns a feasible trajectory, and a pretrained reinforcement learning policy tracks it to motor commands across quadrotors. Across 15 onboard flights over three everyday referents in a controlled indoor volume, the stack reaches the target in 13 of 15 trials with 5.72 cm mean goal error and 39.3% average GPU utilization. In 6 additional cluttered-environment trials, the stack tracks collision-free trajectories under onboard perception gating.

</details>


### [394] [LLM-Guided Transformation of Non-Critical Driving Scenes into Safety-Critical Scenarios Using Augmented Reality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20318)
*Noura Fady,Farah Khaled,Catherine M. Elias*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出结合计算机视觉、LLM与AR的自动化流水线，将安全驾驶场景转化为安全关键场景，用于ADS测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试自动驾驶系统需要真实的安全关键场景，但从真实驾驶中采集此类数据成本高且存在安全风险。

Method: 该流水线检测并跟踪道路使用者，提取距离、速度、运动方向和TTC等安全特征并评估场景关键性；对安全场景由LLM生成逼真的致碰撞物体与行为，再通过AR集成到原场景中。

Result: 在nuScenes数据集上评估，安全分类准确率达97.52%，并成功生成行人横穿、后方超车车辆、急停事件等逼真场景。

Conclusion: 该方法有效且灵活，可为自动驾驶系统的测试与验证自动生成安全关键场景。

Abstract: Testing Autonomous Driving Systems (ADS) requires realistic safety-critical scenarios, but collecting such data from real-world driving is costly and unsafe. This paper presents an automated pipeline that transforms safe driving scenes into safety-critical scenarios by combining computer vision, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Augmented Reality (AR). The system detects and tracks road users, extracts safety features including distance, velocity, motion direction, and Time-to-Collision (TTC), and assesses scene criticality. Safe scenes are modified by an LLM, which generates realistic collision-inducing objects and behaviors that are integrated into the original scene using AR. The proposed pipeline was evaluated on the nuScenes dataset, achieving 97.52% safety classification accuracy and successfully generating realistic scenarios such as pedestrian crossings, rear overtaking vehicles, and sudden-stop events. The results demonstrate an effective and flexible approach for automated generation of safety-critical scenarios to support the testing and validation of autonomous driving systems.

</details>


### [395] [Navi-Agent: Unlocalized Monocular Navigation Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20388)
*Wenyuan Xie,Mengyang Hong,Yongzhong Wang,Yanbiao Ji,Yijin Zhou,Shaokai Wu,Shalayiding Sirejiding,Huayi Zhou,Yi-Chao Chen,Ma Ling,Yue Ding,Hongtao Lu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Navi-Agent：一种无坐标的零样本VLN-CE智能体，通过视觉与运动历史构建导航拓扑来实现空间状态建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零样本VLN-CE系统依赖几何定位或坐标表示维持空间状态；近期几何约束导航虽去除了深度和全局一致坐标，但难以持续进行地点确认、进度验证与恢复。

Method: 从视觉观测与已执行运动历史构建无坐标空间状态，组织为导航拓扑（节点=视觉地点，边=运动转移）；基于观测进行近似自定位、任务进度验证与视觉重访恢复；闭环导航：指令分解为子目标、执行局部视觉导航、通过空间状态验证已访问地点。

Result: 在零样本VLN-CE基准和真实机器人平台上，Navi-Agent在几何约束方法中达到SOTA，并与依赖几何定位的方法具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 以无坐标导航拓扑为核心的零样本智能体可有效支撑长程指令执行，兼顾性能与对几何定位的独立性。

Abstract: Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an embodied agent to execute long-horizon instructions in unknown environments. Existing zero-shot VLN-CE systems typically maintain spatial states through geometric localization or coordinate-based representations. Recent geometry-constrained navigation removes depth and globally consistent coordinates, but maintaining persistent spatial awareness for place confirmation, progress verification, and recovery remains challenging. We present Navi-Agent, a zero-shot VLN-CE agent that constructs a coordinate-free spatial state from visual observations and executed motion histories. Navi-Agent organizes this state as a navigation topology, where nodes represent visual places and edges represent motion transitions. This representation enables observation-based approximate self-localization, task progress verification, and visual revisitation-based recovery. Navi-Agent performs closed-loop navigation by decomposing instructions into sub-goals, executing local visual navigation, and verifying visited places through the constructed spatial state. Experiments on zero-shot VLN-CE benchmark and real-world robot platforms show that Navi-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance among geometry-constrained methods while remaining competitive with approaches relying on geometric localization.

</details>


### [396] [OmniMimic: Dynamics-completed Motion Augmentation for Multi-style Omnidirectional Quadruped Locomotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20566)
*Sheng Wu,Guoqiang Zhao,Zhe Yang,Fei Teng,Zhikun Zhou,Yanlin Yang,Zheng Fang,Hong Zheng,Yaonan Wang,Kailun Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OmniMimic将方向覆盖有限的动物演示扩展为单一多步态策略，实现四足机器人全向速度控制，显著优于APEX基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动物演示能赋予四足机器人自然步态风格，但手工设计奖励难以指定；而动物演示方向覆盖窄，导致后退、侧向和转向指令缺乏风格一致的监督信号。

Method: 分三步：(1)结合时间反转、约束动力学补全与矢状面镜像反射，构造超出观测方向的机器人特化运动学与物理监督；(2)将指令从演示速度分布逐步扩展至目标各轴速度边界；(3)采用共享actor加软门控、步态特化的残差专家，兼顾可复用运动技能与步态特定修正。

Result: 在仿真中针对四种步态，相较匹配的APEX基线，前后向参考速度下的平均足部位置RMSE降低12.9%，均匀笛卡尔指令网格上的速度跟踪RMSE降低63.1%。

Conclusion: 通过监督数据扩增与渐进式指令扩展结合专家混合架构，可有效突破动物演示的方向局限，获得统一的、风格一致的多步态全向运动策略。

Abstract: Animal demonstrations provide quadruped robots with natural and distinctive gait styles that are difficult to specify through hand-crafted rewards. However, their narrow directional coverage leaves little style-consistent supervision for backward, lateral, and turning commands. We present OmniMimic, a training framework that turns directionally limited animal demonstrations into a single multi-gait policy over target per-axis velocity ranges. OmniMimic first combines temporal reversal, constrained dynamics completion, and sagittal reflection to construct robot-specific kinematic and physical supervision beyond the observed directions. It then expands commands progressively from the demonstrated velocity distribution toward the target per-axis bounds, and uses a shared actor with soft-gated, gait-specialized residual experts to balance reusable locomotion skills with gait-specific corrections. Across four gaits in simulation, OmniMimic reduces mean foot-position RMSE at forward and backward reference velocities by 12.9% and velocity-tracking RMSE on a uniform Cartesian command grid by 63.1%, compared with the matched APEX baseline. The project page is at https://OmniMimic.github.io.

</details>


### [397] [CoRef-GS: Cooperative Referring Gaussian Splatting for Multi-Agent Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20586)
*Zhikun Zhou,Kunyu Peng,Runyi Yang,Junhao Cai,Di Wen,Ruiping Liu,Danda Pani Paudel,Yi Zhou,Luc Van Gool,Kailun Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出CoRef-GS协作式指代高斯溅射框架，在融合地图上实现视角条件下的指代目标与关系定位，并发布CoQuad-Ref双四足机器人基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身机器人指代场景理解需要从指定视角对物体与关系语言查询进行定位。单智能体的局部语义高斯地图可支持该定位，但协作场景中，独立重建的地图对齐融合后仍需保持该能力：指代目标或上下文地标可能来自其他智能体的观测，而空间关系仍须从查询机器人视角解释。该问题要求几何可对齐、实例级语义可比、视角条件关系推理，而现有语言感知高斯方法仅面向单地图查询，高斯配准方法又只优化几何/光度对齐、不保持语言定位语义兼容性。

Method: 提出CoRef-GS协作式指代高斯溅射框架：构建局部开放词汇、实例感知的高斯地图；通过跨智能体对齐模块，基于几何与语义一致性对齐部分重叠地图；利用视角条件掩码关系图进行查询定位。同时构建CoQuad-Ref双四足机器人基准，覆盖真实与仿真室内场景。

Result: 仿真场景中，CoRef-GS将旋转误差从粗初始化后的2.58°降至细化后的0.15°；真实场景中指代mIoU由ReferSplat的52.6%提升至68.8%。基准与源码将公开。

Conclusion: CoRef-GS首次形式化并解决了融合地图上的协作指代高斯定位问题，兼顾几何对齐与语义可比性，并通过跨视角关系推理显著提升指代精度，为多机器人协作场景理解提供基准与方法支撑。

Abstract: Referring scene understanding for embodied robots requires grounding object- and relation-centric language queries from a designated viewpoint. While a local semantic Gaussian map can support such grounding within one agent's observations, cooperative settings require this ability to remain effective after independently reconstructed maps are aligned and fused. In this setting, the referred target or its contextual landmark may come from another agent's observations, while spatial relations must still be interpreted from the querying robot's viewpoint. We formulate this problem as cooperative referring Gaussian grounding over fused maps, which requires geometric alignability, instance-level semantic comparability, and view-conditioned relation reasoning. Existing language-aware Gaussian methods mainly focus on single-map querying, whereas Gaussian registration methods optimize geometric or photometric alignment without preserving language-grounding-oriented semantic compatibility. We propose CoRef-GS, a cooperative referring Gaussian splatting framework. CoRef-GS constructs local open-vocabulary instance-aware Gaussian maps, then aligns partially overlapping maps with a cross-agent alignment module by geometric and semantic consistency, and grounds queries using a view-conditioned mask relation graph. We further introduce CoQuad-Ref, a dual-quadruped benchmark spanning both real-world and simulated indoor scenes. Experiments show that, on simulated scenes, CoRef-GS reduces the rotation error from 2.58° after coarse initialization to 0.15° after refinement, and improves real-world referring mIoU over ReferSplat from 52.6% to 68.8%. The established benchmark and source code will be publicly released at https://github.com/ruojiruoli17/CoRef-GS.git.

</details>


### [398] [INSPECT: Learning Robot View Selection from Assistant Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20615)
*Di Wen,Kailun Yang,Wenhao Guo,Yitian Shi,Junwei Zheng,Yufan Chen,Ruiping Liu,Jiale Wei,Rania Rayyes,Kunyu Peng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: INSPECT是一种从智能眼镜助手记录中学习机器人视角偏好的方法，用于装配检查中的部件存在性与安装正确性验证，在齿轮箱与角磨机数据上提升了视角效用与验证率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在装配检查中需判断部件是否存在及安装是否正确；第一视角辅助中的头部运动与工件操作提供了检查证据，口头状态确认可将观察与流程结果关联起来，但如何利用这些记录让机器人自主选择有效视角仍是问题。

Method: 提出INSPECT框架：通过PI-TwinSwap（配对身份干预）校准物体证据；采用声明索引监督分离证据需求与相机可复现的观察变化；物体中心校准将相对视角偏好适配到机器人位姿；子句级筛选检查预测证据。机器人仅凭当前观测与已知位姿选择视角，无需候选图像，也无需目标域视角标签。

Result: 在物理齿轮箱装配图像上，INSPECT在非预言机策略中取得最高视角效用，将人工评定的完全可验证率从34.8%提升至41.7%；在IMPACT的商业角磨机录像上，迁移的相对视角选择器在冻结感知头下将正确决策率从50.6%提升至54.3%。

Conclusion: INSPECT证明了从辅助视频记录中学习相对视角偏好并迁移至机器人装配检查的可行性，可在无目标域视角标签条件下提升检查的可验证性与决策正确率。

Abstract: Robots inspecting an assembly must determine which parts are present and whether they are correctly installed. During egocentric assembly assistance, head motion and workpiece handling reveal evidence for these checks, while spoken state confirmations link observations to procedural outcomes. We introduce INSPECT, which learns robot view preferences from records of a smart-glasses assistant that answers part queries and provides next-step guidance. Presence-Invariant TwinSwap (PI-TwinSwap) calibrates object evidence through paired identity interventions. Claim-indexed supervision separates evidence requirements from camera-reproducible observation changes. Object-centered calibration adapts relative view preferences to robot poses, while clause-level screening checks predicted evidence. The robot selects views using only its current observation and known poses, without candidate images. Evaluation uses annotated assistant-video replay to simulate state feedback, without target-domain view labels for policy training. On images of physical gearbox assemblies, INSPECT achieves the highest view utility among the compared non-oracle policies and raises human-rated full verifiability from 34.8% to 41.7% compared with keeping the current view. On commercial angle-grinder recordings in IMPACT, the transferred relative-view selector increases the correct decision rate from 50.6% to 54.3% with a frozen perception head. The source code is available at https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/INSPECT.

</details>


### [399] [DexTouch-WM: Learning Action-Conditioned Tactile World Models from Human Touch for Dexterous Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20649)
*Yan Qin,Yue Chen,Wenwei Lin,Shujia Liu,Chuqiao Lyu,Kailun Su,Chenze Yu,Ping Luo,Wenbo Ding,Tianxing Chen,Renjing Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DexTouch-WM 是一种动作条件世界模型，通过对齐人类与机器人触觉观测和动作空间，利用可扩展的人类触觉数据联合预测未来 RGB 观测与双手触觉动态，提升灵巧操作预测与策略学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 富接触灵巧操作预测模型依赖密集触觉交互数据，但真实机器人数据难以规模化，且与特定本体传感器绑定。作者希望利用可扩展的人类触觉数据作为补充数据来源。

Method: 在人类与灵巧机器人手上部署共享传感布局的柔性压阻阵列，并将人类动作重定向到机器人动作空间，使人类交互可监督同一动力学模型。DexTouch-WM 通过解剖感知触觉 token 和对齐的动作条件，将预训练视频专家与轻量触觉专家耦合，进行动作条件世界建模。

Result: 在人到机器人扩展实验中，固定 5 小时真实机器人监督，将人类交互从 0 小时增至 100 小时，尽管人机任务集不重叠，机器域视觉、几何和接触预测的留出性能均显著提升；世界模型还可作为策略评估代理环境和合成轨迹生成器用于真实机器人策略学习。

Conclusion: 可扩展的人类交互为学习灵巧机器人世界模型提供了互补的数据维度，缓解真实机器人触觉数据稀缺问题。

Abstract: Learning predictive models of contact-rich dexterous manipulation requires dense tactile interaction, but such data are costly to scale on real robots and remain tied to embodiment-specific sensors. We introduce DexTouch-WM, an action-conditioned world model that learns from scalable human touch to jointly predict future RGB observations and bilateral tactile dynamics. Our insight is that human and robot manipulation share transferable contact dynamics when their tactile observations and action spaces are made compatible. We deploy flexible piezoresistive arrays with a shared sensing layout on both human and dexterous robot hands, and retarget human motion into the robot action space so that human interaction can supervise the same dynamics model used for real-robot prediction. DexTouch-WM couples a pretrained video expert with a lightweight tactile expert using anatomy-aware tactile tokens and aligned action conditioning. In human-to-robot scaling experiments, we keep five hours of real-robot supervision fixed while increasing human interaction from 0 to 100 hours, and observe substantial improvements in held-out robot-domain visual, geometric, and contact prediction despite disjoint human and robot task sets. Beyond prediction, we evaluate the world models as surrogate environments for policy evaluation and as generators of synthetic trajectories for real-robot policy learning, showing that scalable human interaction provides a complementary data axis for learning dexterous robot world models.

</details>


### [400] [Learning Foresight without Explicit Trajectories for 3D Diffusion Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20669)
*Zhongbo Zhang,Zaibin Zhang,Yifan Wang,Changbo Yan,Lijun Wang,Huchuan Lu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出"运动趋势引导"方法：从短时观测历史中学习交互演化的紧凑隐表示，用稀疏未来夹爪状态监督，在推理时仅保留该隐表示作为面向未来的条件，以极小的参数开销显著提升3D扩散策略性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D扩散策略虽能基于当前观测生成几何上可行的动作，但成功操作不仅需要知道当前可行的运动，还需预见交互的发展方向。现有策略大多让这种预见性从动作学习中隐式涌现，缺乏显式的未来导向信息。

Method: 提出Movement Trend Guidance：从短时观测历史学习交互演化的紧凑隐表示；训练阶段用稀疏的未来夹爪状态对该表示进行监督；推理时仅保留该隐表示作为面向未来的条件，与当前观测共同输入。该隐表示提供动作生成的全局条件，同时在UNet瓶颈处增设门控FiLM分支。方法仅比DP3增加3.52%参数，并保留原有的稠密动作与滚动时域（receding-horizon）框架。

Result: 在RoboTwin2.0、LIBERO-40和DexArt上一致优于DP3：50任务RoboTwin2.0混合训练达62.8% vs. 56.1%；LIBERO-40达71.93% vs. 37.08%；五个真实机器人任务达72.0% vs. 49.0%。

Conclusion: 扩散策略能在不需要明确告知具体运动目标的情况下，仅通过了解交互的演进方向就获得显著收益，表明面向未来的隐表示是提升操作策略的有效条件信号。

Abstract: 3D diffusion policies are strong at generating geometrically grounded actions from current observations, but successful manipulation requires not only knowing what motion is feasible now, but also anticipating where the interaction is heading. Existing policies largely leave such foresight to emerge implicitly from action learning. We introduce Movement Trend Guidance, a simple but effective way to provide this foresight without introducing an explicit plan. From a short observation history, the policy learns a compact latent representation of interaction evolution. During training, sparse future gripper states supervise this representation; at inference, only the latent is retained as future-oriented conditioning alongside the current observation. The latent provides global conditioning for action generation, while an additional gated FiLM branch is used only at the UNet bottleneck. Despite adding only 3.52% more parameters to DP3, our method preserves the original dense-action and receding-horizon formulation and consistently improves upon DP3 across RoboTwin2.0, LIBERO-40, and DexArt. It reaches 62.8% vs. 56.1% in 50-task RoboTwin2.0 mixed training, 71.93% vs. 37.08% on LIBERO-40, and 72.0% vs. 49.0% on five real-robot tasks. These results show that a diffusion policy can benefit substantially from knowing where an interaction is heading, without being told exactly where to move.

</details>


### [401] [Towards Scaling Marine Perception with Synthetic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20680)
*Haoyu Ma,Onur Bagoren,Anja Sheppard,Elias Fandi,Ashrith Edukulla,Tanner Aslan,Natasha Sieh,Jingyu Song,Katherine A. Skinner*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文扩展了基于IsaacSim的水下感知仿真器OceanSim，加入合成数据生成（SDG）流水线，可自动生成大规模、带标注、照片级真实的水下数据集，并在真实海胆检测任务上评估了合成场景变化对sim-to-real性能的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下环境下的可扩展机器学习受限于缺乏标注的真实训练数据，而真实数据采集成本高、耗时费力。合成数据有望弥补这一差距，但需要能够生成高质量、可配置且自动标注的水下数据。

Method: 在OceanSim（基于IsaacSim的水下感知仿真器）基础上扩展一套合成数据生成（SDG）流水线，支持用户生成大规模、自动标注、照片级真实的数据集，并可配置场景外观、结构与传感器设置。在真实海胆检测任务上进行评估，研究不同合成场景变化形式对sim-to-real性能的影响。

Result: 通过真实海胆检测实验，分析了不同合成场景变化对sim-to-real迁移性能的影响，并总结了流水线的有效性与主要局限。

Conclusion: 该SDG流水线可支持水下感知的合成数据生成与sim-to-real训练；作者讨论了当前流水线的主要局限，并指出提升水下渲染保真度、场景多样性以及sim-to-real泛化评估的未来方向。代码已开源。

Abstract: Scalable machine learning in challenging underwater environments is strongly limited by the lack of labeled real-world training data. This data is often expensive and laborious to gather, making large-scale real-world data challenging to gather and curate. However, simulated data can help close the gap, enabling many learning-based tasks for underwater perception. In this work, we extend OceanSim, an IsaacSim-based underwater perception simulator, with a Synthetic Data Generation (SDG) pipeline for training models to be used in underwater scenarios. The proposed pipeline enables users to generate large, automatically labeled, photorealistic datasets with configurable scene appearance, structure, and sensor settings. We evaluate the pipeline on a real-world sea urchin detection task and study how different forms of synthetic scene variation affect sim-to-real performance. Based on these experiments, we discuss findings on our results, main limitations of the current pipeline and identify future directions for improving underwater rendering fidelity, scene diversity, and the evaluation of sim-to-real generalization. The open-source code can be found at https://github.com/umfieldrobotics/OceanSim.

</details>


### [402] [OPTED: On-Policy Fine-Tuning for End-to-End Driving using a Render-Free Teacher](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20756)
*Damiano Da Col,Maximilian Igl,Peter Karkus,Kashyap Chitta,Boris Ivanovic,Marco Pavone,Konrad Schindler,Christos Sakaridis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 OPTED 框架：用特权教师（矢量输入 + RL）蒸馏监督预训练学生模型，实现端到端驾驶策略的闭环后训练，显著提升驾驶得分并大幅降低仿真交互需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅靠扩大预训练数据收益递减，后训练在物理AI（如自动驾驶）中日益重要。端到端驾驶策略通常以行为克隆在开环下预训练，但闭环部署时的复合误差会使车辆偏离训练分布，带来安全风险。闭环后训练可缓解该问题，但基于传感器策略的闭环后训练需要昂贵的仿真。因此需要一种绕过直接RL、降低仿真成本的闭环后训练方法。

Method: 将强化学习与端到端策略的后训练解耦：首先在矢量化输入（高精地图和边界框）上训练一个特权教师模型（使用RL）；然后该教师在闭环后训练阶段对预训练的学生模型提供监督（蒸馏/模仿）。在AlpaSim中，使用真实驾驶日志的神经重建（3DGS）对两个相机模型TransFuser和VaVAM进行微调。

Result: 在AlpaSim中微调后，TransFuser和VaVAM的驾驶得分分别提升1.6倍和9.5倍。在控制实验中，OPTED以约比直接RL后训练少三个数量级的仿真交互次数达到相当的闭环性能，同时更接近人类先验。

Conclusion: OPTED通过特权教师监督的方式解耦RL与端到端策略后训练，有效缓解分布偏移与复合误差，显著提升闭环驾驶性能，并极大降低仿真交互成本，同时保持对人类示范的贴近度。

Abstract: As scaling pre-training data alone yields diminishing returns, post-training is becoming increasingly important across physical AI domains such as autonomous driving. End-to-end driving policies are pre-trained in open loop with behavior cloning on human demonstrations. However, compounding errors during closed-loop deployment can take the vehicle outside the training data distribution, increasing the risk of safety-critical incidents. Closed-loop post-training can mitigate this risk but requires costly simulation for sensor-based policies. We propose OPTED (on-policy fine-tuning for end-to-end driving) which decouples reinforcement learning from the post-training of the end-to-end policy: a privileged teacher is trained using RL on vectorized inputs (HD-map and bounding boxes). This teacher then provides supervision to the pre-trained student during closed-loop post-training. We apply OPTED to two camera-based models, TransFuser and VaVAM, and fine-tune them in AlpaSim, using neural reconstructions (3DGS) of real driving logs. Driving scores increase by factors of 1.6$\times$ and 9.5$\times$, respectively. In controlled experiments OPTED matches closed-loop performance with approximately three orders of magnitude fewer simulator interactions than direct RL post-training, while staying closer to the human prior. Project page: https://01dami23.github.io/opted/

</details>


### [403] [Coding Agents with an Obstacle-Aware Harness for Safe Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20822)
*Bingxin Xu,Yuzhang Shang,Zhen Dong,Emilio Ferrara*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出编码智能体在带安全约束的机器人操作任务中普遍发生碰撞，根源在于规划阶段，并通过SafeHarness（障碍感知路径规划与障碍感知接触执行）使模型优先考虑安全约束，达到71.9%任务成功率与87.5%避碰率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体已能在无机器人专用训练的情况下操作机器人，但其安全性未被审视。任务同时给定操作目标与不可触碰的障碍物时，智能体把完成任务当作唯一目标而忽视安全，因此需要定位失败原因并加以弥补。

Method: 将操作分解为路径阶段与富接触时刻。路径阶段，模型缺乏"可通行路径"概念且无法在路径不可行时重新规划；接触阶段，模型未意识到接触执行同样受该约束限制。为此提出SafeHarness：障碍感知路径规划将物体表示为边界框并在其上以路点序列绘制候选路径，智能体预先规划、验证、必要时重规划后再执行；障碍感知接触执行则选择接触位置，使接触本身避开障碍。

Result: SafeHarness达到71.9%任务成功率与87.5%避碰率，分别超越此前SOTA 6.5%与27.0%，为同一智能体不带harness时的2.3倍与1.5倍。

Conclusion: 编码智能体在安全约束下失败并非感知或指令缺陷，而是规划中安全约束未成为优先项；通过从路径与接触两个阶段注入障碍感知的harness，可有效提升安全与任务表现。

Abstract: Coding agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation: a language model writes the robot controller as a program, and agents built in this way now operate robots without robot-specific training.Whether this paradigm is also safe, however, has not been asked. We evaluate coding agent under a safety constraint, where each task pairs a manipulation goal with an obstacle the robot must not touch. The agent pursues the goal but collides with the obstacle in most cases, treating task completion as its sole objective while neglecting safety. The agent reasons about the obstacle in its traces, and the prompt already forbids touching it, so neither perception nor instruction is at fault; the fault lies in the planning, where the stated constraint never becomes a priority. By decomposing manipulation into a route phase and a contact-rich moment, we locate the source of the failure. Along the route, the model cannot prioritize the safety constraint, having no notion of a clearing route and none of replanning once a chosen route becomes infeasible. At the contact, it is unaware that contact execution is bounded by the same constraint. To close this gap, we present SafeHarness, which equips the model with two obstacle-aware harnesses that enable it to prioritize the safety constraint. Obstacle-aware route planning grounds the objects as bounding boxes and draws candidate routes over them as sequences of waypoints. The agent then plans a route in advance, verifies it, replans when necessary, and only then executes it. Obstacle-aware contact execution instead selects the contact position so that the contact itself avoids the obstacle. SafeHarness attains 71.9% task success and 87.5% collision avoidance, surpassing the previous SOTA by 6.5% and 27.0%, respectively. These results are $2.3\times$ and $1.5\times$ those of the same agent without harnesses.

</details>


### [404] [AthenaZero: A low-inertia, bimanual robot for dynamic manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19194)
*Andrew S. Morgan,Gregory Xie,Capprin Bass,Rachel Thomasson,Chunpeng Wang,Erfan Shahriari,Harrison Busa,Oluwaseun Araromi,Joseph Aronov,Michael Burgess,Velin D. Dimitrov,Matthew A. Estrada,Faris Hamdi,Samuel Kendig,Taeyoon Lee,Jose Oscar Mur-Miranda,Emma Sommers,Paul Titchener,Margaret Wang,Achu Wilson,Mark Yeatman,Osman Dogan Yirmibesoglu,Alfred A. Rizzi,Annan Mozeika,Nicolas Rojas,Lael Odhner*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: AthenaZero是一种双臂机器人，通过准直驱驱动与传动远程化降低惯量，实现接近人类的等效末端质量，适用于棒球式投球、接球和击球等动态操作任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统机械臂惯量大、力矩透明度低，难以胜任棒球式的动态操作任务；这些任务存在毫秒级交互、要求高加速度，因此需要一种在不牺牲控制能力的前提下最小化惯量的设计。

Method: 采用准直驱驱动（quasi-direct drive actuation）和传动远程化（transmission remotization）技术，设计双臂操作器AthenaZero；并阐述其设计方法及任务实现。

Result: 等效末端质量与人类相当，约为常规机械臂的十分之一；投球速度超过30 m/s，在7.3 m距离内接球和击球速度超过14 m/s；完成机器人-机器人、人-机器人的击球练习与接球游戏。

Conclusion: AthenaZero凭借低惯量与固有高力矩透明度，在高加速度动态任务中展现出有效性和适应性。

Abstract: AthenaZero is a bimanual manipulator designed to minimize inertia without compromising control authority. By utilizing quasi-direct drive actuation and transmission remotization techniques, the system achieves an effective endpoint mass comparable to that of a human---about an order of magnitude less than conventional robot manipulators. This characteristic, combined with its inherent torque transparency, makes AthenaZero exceptionally well-suited for dynamic manipulation. We describe the methodology} that led to this design and demonstrate the robot's capabilities on three baseball-inspired tasks: throwing, catching, and batting, which showcase complex interactions on human-comparable timescales where milliseconds matter. AthenaZero was capable of throwing at speeds in excess of 30 m/s, with catching and batting at speeds in excess of 14 m/s over a short 7.3 m distance. Batting practice and a game of catch were subsequently performed in robot-to-robot and human-to-robot variations, showcasing the efficacy and adaptability of our system in tasks that require high acceleration.

</details>


### [405] [DITTO: Dexterous Interface for Transparent TeleOperation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19196)
*Joaquin Palacios,Katelyn Lee,Cheng Zhang,Zhanpeng He,Matei Ciocarlie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DITTO 通过解剖学协同设计7自由度机械手与运动学等效的电动外骨骼，以1:1驱动器映射统一了野外手持数据采集与关节级力反馈双边遥操作，消除现有方法的一致性与力透明性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高自由度手部操作数据采集困难：界面需同时捕捉丰富手部运动并呈现精确操作所需的接触交互。现有方法存在权衡——遥操作保证部署一致性但缺乏力反馈；手持（野外）系统提供自然力透明性但在部署时存在视觉具身差距。

Method: 提出 DITTO（Dexterous Interface for Transparent TeleOperation），通过解剖学启发的协同设计，构建7自由度灵巧机械手与运动学等效的电动外骨骼，二者间采用1:1驱动器映射。

Result: DITTO 外骨骼覆盖操作者自然的食指-拇指工作空间；并在接触密集型任务上通过学习策略展示其灵巧操作能力。

Conclusion: DITTO 将手持野外数据采集与关节级力反馈双边遥操作统一于单一平台，化解了部署一致性与力透明性之间的固有矛盾。

Abstract: Collecting data for manipulation with high-DOF hands is challenging, as interfaces must capture rich hand motion while rendering the contact interactions essential for precise manipulation. Existing data collection approaches face a trade-off: teleoperation ensures deployment consistency but lacks force feedback, while handheld (in-the-wild) systems provide natural force transparency but introduce a visual embodiment gap at deployment. We present DITTO, a Dexterous Interface for Transparent TeleOperation, which resolves this through the anatomically informed co-design of a dexterous 7-DOF robotic hand and a kinematically equivalent motorized exoskeleton. A 1-to-1 actuator mapping between the exoskeleton and robotic hand enables handheld (in-the-wild) data collection and bilateral teleoperation with joint-level force feedback unified in a single platform. We demonstrate that the DITTO exoskeleton spans the operator's natural index-to-thumb workspace, and showcase DITTO's dexterous capabilities via learned policies on contact-rich tasks.

</details>


### [406] [ULOHA: An Underwater Bimanual Robot System for Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19200)
*Masato Kobayashi,Takeru Tsunoori*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ULOHA是一个水下双臂机器人模仿学习平台，将定制主从硬件与LeRobot软件扩展结合，实现遥操作、多视角感知、示教采集、策略训练与自主部署，并系统评测了ACT、Diffusion Policy与SmolVLA在水下双臂任务中的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有水下视觉运动策略学习主要针对单机械臂，而双臂模仿学习多在空中开展，缺乏面向水下双臂操作的学习与评测平台；水下环境的气泡扰动、浮力驱动运动等耦合感知与物理效应会对空中学习与执行方法构成新挑战，亟需统一平台加以研究。

Method: 构建ULOHA水下双臂学习平台：定制主从式硬件 + LeRobot软件扩展，集成遥操作、多视角传感、示教采集、策略训练和自主部署。开展真机实验，覆盖臂间传递、共享物体操作、浮力驱动拦截等协同行为；评测ACT、Diffusion Policy和VLA模型SmolVLA，考察气泡干扰、浮力物体运动、动作执行时域（action-execution horizon）和实时分块（chunking）等要素；另设单臂研究，检验空气与水中之间的策略迁移。

Result: 真机实验展示了多种水下双臂协同行为；在测试条件下，跨空气与水的双介质示教可支持两种介质中的执行，即空气—水策略迁移可行；同时揭示了在空气中开发的操控学习与执行策略在水下受气泡、浮力等因素影响的表现差异。

Conclusion: ULOHA为研究水下双臂机器人学习在感知与物理耦合效应下的表现提供了统一实验平台，并为跨介质策略迁移与水下模仿学习方法的评估奠定基础。

Abstract: Underwater visuomotor policy learning has focused primarily on single manipulators, while bimanual imitation learning has been studied largely in air. We present ULOHA, an underwater bimanual robot learning platform that combines custom-designed leader--follower hardware with software extensions to LeRobot, integrating teleoperation, multi-view sensing, demonstration collection, policy training, and autonomous deployment. Real-robot experiments demonstrate a range of coordinated underwater bimanual behaviors, including inter-arm transfer, shared-object manipulation, and buoyancy-driven interception. We evaluate ACT, Diffusion Policy, and the vision--language--action model SmolVLA on the platform. We investigate how learning methods and execution strategies developed for manipulation in air perform underwater, examining bubble disturbances, buoyancy-driven object motion, action-execution horizons, and real-time chunking. A separate single-arm study examines policy transfer between air and water and shows that demonstrations spanning both media support execution in both under the tested conditions. ULOHA provides a unified experimental platform for studying underwater bimanual robot learning under the coupled perceptual and physical effects of underwater environments. Additional material: https://mertcookimg.github.io/uloha/

</details>


### [407] [REACT: A Fully Spiking State-Space Model for Real-Time Event-Driven Temporal Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19204)
*Geoffroy Keime,Nicolas Cuperlier,Benoit R. Cottereau*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: REACT 是一种全脉冲状态空间模型，直接逐事件处理原始事件流，无需时间累积，实现低延迟的连续时间感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态环境中的机器人视觉需随感知流持续演化。事件相机具备微秒级时间分辨率与异步感知能力，但多数学习方法将事件累积为帧或时间箱，引入积分延迟，限制快速反应。

Method: 提出 REACT 全脉冲状态空间模型，逐条处理原始事件而不做时间累积。采用复数值脉冲神经元 C-SiLIF，其连续时间动态由物理事件间隔驱动，内部状态以单个事件的时间分辨率演化。在无目标边界框或定位输入的条件下，于手势识别与全视场事件流 TTC 估计任务上评估。

Result: 在 EvTTC 上，REACT 取得 9.59% 相对 TTC 误差与 4.6 ms 端到端推理延迟，距最佳学习方法仅 0.15 个百分点且无需目标先验。该延迟对应约 4 cm 车辆位移，而最快竞争学习方法为 1 m。REACT 还支持随时 TTC 预测、零样本跨驾驶序列迁移，以及 INT8 量化，将每 32,768 事件的估计能耗由 18.5 mJ 降至 2.8 mJ。

Conclusion: 事件驱动的脉冲状态空间动态可为反应式机器人系统提供低延迟、持续更新的时间感知。

Abstract: Robotic systems operating in dynamic environments require visual perception that evolves continuously with the incoming sensory stream. Event cameras provide microsecond temporal resolution and asynchronous sensing, but most learning-based methods accumulate events into frames or temporal bins, introducing an integration delay that can limit fast reaction. Here we propose REACT, a fully spiking state-space model for event-driven temporal perception that processes raw events one by one, without temporal accumulation. REACT uses a complex-valued spiking neuron, C-SiLIF, whose continuous-time dynamics are driven by the physical inter-event interval, allowing its internal state to evolve at the temporal resolution of individual events. We evaluate REACT on gesture recognition and time-to-collision (TTC) estimation from full-field event streams, without a target bounding box or localization input. On EvTTC, REACT achieves a 9.59% relative TTC error with 4.6 ms end-to-end inference latency, within 0.15 percentage points of the best learned method while requiring no target prior. At the dataset's mean approach speed, this latency corresponds to only 4 cm of vehicle motion, compared with 1 m for the fastest competing learned method. REACT further supports anytime TTC prediction, zero-shot transfer to a different driving sequence, and INT8 quantization, reducing the estimated energy consumption from 18.5 to 2.8 mJ per 32,768 events. These results show that event-driven spiking state-space dynamics can provide low-latency, continuously updated temporal perception for reactive robotic systems.

</details>


### [408] [Grasping by interconnection: robust closing motions from coarse object templates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19228)
*Julien Vanderheyden,Guillaume Drion,Fulvio Forni,Pierre Sacré*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出基于虚拟模型控制的抓取运动规划器，利用粗略物体模板、人类抓取类型、物体中心交互与柔性滑动接触四原则，使闭合运动本身即具备对物体尺寸与位姿误差的容忍度，无需反馈即可稳健抓取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧手抓取时物体的形状、尺寸和位姿往往只能近似已知；现有抓取规划器通常需要精确物体模型或依赖反馈纠错，而闭合运动自身能容忍多大误差尚不明确。

Method: 基于四项原则设计运动规划器：使用物体粗略模板、借鉴人类抓取类型、采用以物体为中心的交互方式、以柔性滑动接触替代预设接触点；并通过虚拟模型控制实现该规划器。

Result: 在Shadow Dexterous Hand上评测：无反馈条件下，规划闭合运动可容忍约1cm尺寸误差及数厘米、数十度的位姿误差，在27种测试条件中的25种优于最先进的数据驱动规划器；成功抓取80个日常物体中的82.5%，并在自主流程中取得成功。

Conclusion: 鲁棒性可被设计进闭合运动本身，而非仅依赖反馈；该规划器为不确定环境下的可靠操作提供了路径，后续将结合物理手上的自适应反馈控制继续推进。

Abstract: Dexterous robot hands must often grasp objects whose shape, size, and pose are known only approximately. Grasp planners typically require accurate object models or correct errors with feedback, but how much inaccuracy a closing motion can tolerate on its own remains unclear. To address this question, we designed a motion planner based on four principles: a coarse template of the object, human grasp types, an object-centric interaction, and compliant, sliding contacts instead of prescribed contact points. This paper presents the planner, implemented through virtual model control, and its evaluation on a Shadow Dexterous Hand. Without feedback, the planned closing motions tolerated size errors of about 1cm and pose errors of several centimeters and tens of degrees, a wider range than a state-of-the-art data-driven planner in 25 of 27 tested conditions. They also grasped 82.5% of 80 everyday objects and succeeded within an autonomous pipeline. Robustness can thus be designed into the closing motion itself, rather than left only to feedback. This planner opens a path toward reliable manipulation in uncertain settings, which we will pursue by combining it with adaptive feedback control on the physical hand.

</details>


### [409] [Learning Safe Humanoid Navigation from Reduced Order Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19272)
*William D. Compton,Zachary Olkin,Ryan Bena,Aaron D. Ames*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RoM-Nav，将人形机器人导航分解为简化动力学导航策略与全阶动力学策略两阶段，实现无地图多楼层导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准单阶段RL导航pipeline难以扩展到多层级、多楼层地形，瓶颈在于复杂人形地形交互（如楼梯）；需要解决复杂地形导航的可扩展性问题。

Method: 两阶段分解：先用简化降阶动力学+完整3D LiDAR观测训练复杂多楼层地形导航策略；再以其导航知识初始化全阶人形动力学策略，并在回路中冻结运动（locomotion）策略。另对导航策略输出施加Poisson安全滤波器，在分布外障碍下恢复安全性且不降低导航成功率。

Result: 在Unitree G1上验证RoM-Nav策略，完成无地图多楼层导航，试验涵盖超过10m垂直位移和超过100m路径长度。Poisson安全滤波器在不损失导航成功率的前提下于分布外障碍中恢复安全性。

Conclusion: 将导航问题分解并结合安全滤波，可有效突破单阶段RL在多楼层地形上的扩展瓶颈，实现长距离、大高差的人形机器人无地图导航。

Abstract: Research in humanoid robotics has achieved rapid progress in locomotion, and recent results have pushed the boundary on autonomous navigation. We demonstrate that a standard single-stage RL navigation pipeline struggles to scale to multi-level and multi-story terrain, limited by the difficulty of complex humanoid terrain interactions such as stairs. To overcome this challenge, we decompose the navigation problem into two pieces. First, we train a policy operating on the reduced order dynamics but with full 3D LiDAR observations to navigate complex, multi-story terrain. We then utilize this navigation knowledge to kickstart a policy operating on the full-order humanoid dynamics, with a frozen locomotion policy in the loop. Additionally, we demonstrate that applying a Poisson safety filter to the navigation policy output recovers safety in the presence of out-of-distribution obstacles, without dropping navigation success rate. We demonstrate the resulting RoM-Nav policy on a Unitree G1, accomplishing mapless multi-floor navigation covering trials with over 10m of vertical displacement and over 100m of path length. Project page with videos https://wdc3iii.github.io/rom-nav/ .

</details>


### [410] [OHRID-Retail: An Open Multimodal Dataset of Human Activity in Retail Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19302)
*Xiangrui Wang,Yuetong Wu,Jalen Beeman,Robert Cook,Yu Gu,Nathanial Pearson,Trevor Smith,Read Hayes,Boyi Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文发布OHRID Retail数据集：16名健康成人分别在无机器人、低速机器人引导、高速机器人引导三种条件下完成模拟货架拣选任务，采用17个Xsens Awinda惯性传感器和10通道Delsys Trigno表面肌电同步采集全身运动学与肌肉活动数据，每条件两试次，并提供原始记录、处理后指标、文档与可复现分析资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 描述人类在与人共享环境的移动机器人场景中行为的数据集仍然有限，尤其是融合行走移动、伸手够取、物体操作与机器人引导运动的零售活动场景缺乏公开数据，制约了相关研究。

Method: 招募16名健康成人，在三种被试内条件（无机器人、低速机器人引导、高速机器人引导）下执行模拟货架拣选任务，每条件完成两个试次；使用17个Xsens Awinda惯性传感器采集全身运动学，使用Delsys Trigno表面肌电传感器在10个部位测量肌肉活动；开展描述性分析并公开原始记录、处理指标、文档与可复现分析资源。

Result: 描述性分析显示，全身运动强度与肌肉激活在不同机器人交互条件和不同身体部位之间存在差异。

Conclusion: OHRID Retail为开放、以人为中心的多模态数据集，可支持人类活动识别、多模态传感器融合、职业生物力学、人体工效学、人感知机器人导航以及零售及相关共享环境中的人机交互研究。

Abstract: Open datasets describing human behavior in environments shared with mobile robots remain limited, particularly for retail activities that combine locomotion, reaching, object handling, and robot guided movement. This paper introduces OHRID Retail, an open, human centered multimodal dataset collected from 16 healthy adults performing a simulated shelf picking task under three within participant conditions: no robot, low speed robot guidance, and high speed robot guidance. Each participant completed two trials per condition. Whole body kinematics were recorded using 17 Xsens Awinda inertial sensors and muscle activity was measured at 10 locations using Delsys Trigno surface electromyography sensors. Descriptive analyses demonstrate variation in whole body movement intensity and muscle activation across robot interaction conditions and body locations. OHRID Retail provides openly available raw recordings, processed measures, documentation, and reproducible analysis resources. The dataset can support research in human activity recognition, multimodal sensor fusion, occupational biomechanics, ergonomics, human aware robot navigation, and human robot interaction in retail and related shared environments.

</details>


### [411] [GAVEL: Graph World Models for Verified and Efficient Long-Horizon LLM Task Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19315)
*Ruiyang Wang,Hao-Lun Hsu,Swarajh Mehta,Jiwoo Kim,Zhihao Dou,Miroslav Pajic*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: GAVEL 通过显式图世界模型对 LLM 长时程规划进行验证与修复，在 BEHAVIOR-1K 上大幅提升单任务与多任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 虽为长时程机器人规划提供灵活接口，但生成的计划常无法满足具身约束、难以从规划错误中恢复，且在部分可观测条件下推理不足。

Method: 构建显式图世界模型，编码对象关系、动作前条件与效果、以及未观测物体位置的概率信念；在执行前预测 LLM 动作后果、检测违规并修复可由世界模型直接推导的修正，仅将需语义推理的错误交由 LLM 重新规划；对多任务指令，基于物体位置的分布重排子任务以最小化期望搜索代价。

Result: 在 BEHAVIOR-1K 的 100 个单长时程任务与 500 条多任务指令上评测：使用 Qwen3-8B 时，单任务成功率由 41.2% 提升至 91.8%，多任务成功率由 19.9% 提升至 92.6%；分布式信念推理相比静态变体减少约 5.4% 的移动距离。

Conclusion: 显式图世界模型可显著提升长时程具身规划的可靠性与效率，适用于紧凑型及前沿托管 LLM 能力。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible interface for long-horizon robot planning, but generated plans often fail to respect embodiment constraints, recover from planning errors, or reason effectively under partial observability. We present GAVEL, a framework for verifying and repairing long-horizon LLM planning built around an explicit graph world model. The graph represents relevant object-relations, action pre-conditions and effects, and probabilistic beliefs over unobserved object locations. This model can predict the consequences of LLM-generated actions before execution, detect violations, and repair those whose corrections follow directly from the world model. This method also reserves LLM replanning solely for errors requiring semantic reasoning. For multi-task instructions, GAVEL reasons over distributions of possible object locations to reorder remaining subtasks and minimize expected search cost. We evaluate GAVEL on BEHAVIOR-1K across 100 single long-horizon tasks and 500 multi-task instructions. With Qwen3-8B, GAVEL improves single-task success from 41.2% to 91.8% and multi-task success from 19.9% to 92.6%. Distributional belief reasoning also reduces travel distance by approximately 5.4% compared with a static variant. These improvements show that an explicit graph world model harness can substantially improve the reliability and efficiency of long-horizon embodied planning across compact and frontier hosted LLM capabilities.

</details>


### [412] [A Morphing Aerial Robot With Thruster-Integrated Flexible Continuum Links for Shape Adaptive Aerial Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19328)
*Eri Sawada,Kazuki Sugihara,Ayano Miyamichi,Kunio Kojima,Kei Okada*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种带柔性连续体连杆与分布式旋翼的变形空中机器人，兼顾形状适应性与扩展力螺旋空间，并通过复合板簧结构与抑振控制实现稳定飞行与多种空中操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空中操作是拓展空中机器人应用的关键。现有研究主要有两个方向：(i) 用软体机械臂获得高环境适应性；(ii) 沿机械臂分布推进器以扩展可行力螺旋空间。但尚无空中机器人能同时满足这两点需求。

Method: 设计变形旋翼分布式空中机器人，采用柔性连续体连杆：连杆作为软体机械臂被动贴合环境形状，沿连杆分布的推进器扩展可行推力力螺旋空间，使末端执行器可施加较大交互力。为抑制轻质连续体连杆的振动，开发了兼具高扭转与垂向刚度的复合板簧结构，并提出抑振控制方法。

Result: 借助上述实现，展示了稳定飞行以及多种空中操作任务。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个使用集成推进器的柔性连杆实现空中操作的工作，同时达成形状适应性与扩展力螺旋空间两项要求。

Abstract: In recent years, aerial manipulation has attracted increasing attention as a key to expand the application of aerial robots. In this work, we focus on two major research directions for achieving versatile aerial manipulation: (i) acquiring high environmental adaptability using soft manipulators, and (ii) expanding the feasible wrench space by distributing thrusters along the manipulator. However, no aerial robot has simultaneously satisfied these two requirements. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a morphing rotor-distributed aerial robot with flexible continuum links that achieves both high shape adaptability and an expanded wrench space. The flexible continuum links function as soft manipulators, passively conforming to the shape of the environment, while the thrusters distributed along the continuum links expand the feasible thrust wrench space and enable the end-effector to exert large interaction forces. To realize the proposed robot, it is essential to suppress vibrations of the lightweight continuum links. Thus, we develop a composite leaf-spring structure that provides both high torsional and vertical stiffness, and vibration-suppressing control methods. Using these implementations, we demonstrate stable flight and a variety of aerial manipulation tasks. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to realize aerial manipulations using flexible links with an integrated thruster.

</details>


### [413] [SemSafe-3DGS: Semantic Risk-Aware Active Navigation in Uncertain 3D Gaussian Splatting Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19330)
*Amirhossein Mollaei Khass,Athanasios Cosse,Nader Motee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出面向属性化3D高斯地图的语义风险感知安全主动感知导航框架，通过类别风险权重调制AVaR碰撞间隙并构建CBF-QP硬约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部分可观测环境中的自主机器人需在安全导航的同时主动获取有利于未来规划的观测。现有安全方法主要基于几何推理，忽略语义差异，导致几何相似但语义后果不同的场景元素产生相近控制响应。

Method: 在属性化3D高斯地图中，用类别相关风险权重调制Average Value-at-Risk（AVaR）碰撞间隙模型，使安全关键高斯基元在复合障碍函数中获得更大影响；加权间隙聚合为控制障碍函数（CBF）。同时构建轨迹相关主动感知障碍函数，促进降低机器人预期运动方向上的几何地图不确定性。二者统一集成于CBF-QP中，语义风险感知避撞作为硬约束，信息获取在冲突时可松弛。

Result: 实验表明：安全约束高效、主动感知提升导航性能、轨迹随语义自适应调整，并在阿克曼动力学实车上完成验证。

Conclusion: 将语义风险纳入CBF安全约束并协调主动感知，可在部分可观测环境中实现语义依赖的安全导航，且具备实机可行性。

Abstract: Autonomous robots operating in partially observed environments must navigate safely while acquiring observations that improve future planning. Existing safety formulations generally reason primarily about geometry. Consequently, geometrically similar scene elements may induce comparable control responses despite having different semantic consequences. We present a semantic risk aware safe-active perception framework for navigation in attributed 3D Gaussian maps. Semantic attributes modulate an Average Value-at-Risk collision clearance model through class dependent risk weights, allowing safety-critical Gaussian primitives to receive greater influence in the composite barrier. The resulting weighted clearances are aggregated into a control barrier function, while a trajectory-relevant active perception barrier promotes observations that reduce geometric map uncertainty along the robot's anticipated motion. Both objectives are integrated in a unified CBF-QP that enforces semantic risk-aware collision avoidance as a hard constraint while relaxing information acquisition when it conflicts with safety or task progress. Experiments demonstrate efficient safety constraint, improved navigation through active perception, semantic dependent trajectory adaptation, and real-robot execution under Ackermann dynamics.

</details>


### [414] [Dynamic-LIVO: A Dynamic-Aware LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry System Using Spatio-Temporal Normals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19336)
*Zhixin Zhang,Samuel Ahiwe,Matthew Hale,Liang Zhao,Pawel Ladosz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Dynamic-LIVO，一种面向动态环境的动态感知LiDAR-惯性-视觉里程计系统，用于鲁棒状态估计与静态彩色建图，核心是时空法线分析与时间延迟估计策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LIVO系统在动态环境中易受动态物体干扰，动态LiDAR点及其关联视觉观测会污染状态估计与建图；同时时空法线估计在新生和空间稀疏区域因观测不足而不可靠。

Method: 采用Spatio-Temporal（S-T）法线分析识别动态LiDAR点，并将分类结果传播至LiDAR-惯性与视觉-惯性更新，避免动态量测影响估计与建图；针对观测不足区域，引入时间延迟S-T法线估计策略，推迟对约束不足点的分类并随新观测补充再评估。

Result: 在公开与自采数据集、多种传感器配置下的大量实验表明，Dynamic-LIVO在挑战性动态环境中提升了定位精度，并生成更干净的静态彩色地图；代码与自采数据集将在录用后公开。

Conclusion: Dynamic-LIVO通过时空一致性动态点识别与延迟分类机制，有效提升动态环境下LIVO的鲁棒性与建图质量，兼顾动态分类可靠性并保留有效静态点用于建图。

Abstract: This paper proposes Dynamic-LIVO, a dynamic-aware LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry (LIVO) system for robust state estimation and static colored mapping in dynamic environments. Dynamic-LIVO employs Spatio-Temporal (S-T) normal analysis to identify dynamic LiDAR points and propagates the resulting classification to both LiDAR-inertial and visual-inertial updates, preventing dynamic LiDAR measurements and their associated visual observations from affecting state estimation and mapping. However, S-T normal estimation can be unreliable in newly observed and spatially sparse regions due to insufficient spatio-temporal observations. To address this issue, we introduce a time-delayed S-T normal estimation strategy that defers the classification of insufficiently constrained points and re-evaluates them as additional observations become available. This strategy improves dynamic classification reliability while preserving valid static points for map construction. Extensive experiments on public and self-collected datasets with diverse sensor configurations demonstrate that Dynamic-LIVO improves localization accuracy and produces cleaner static colored maps in challenging dynamic environments. The source code and self-collected dataset will be publicly released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [415] [ViLoMan: Learning Visual-Proprioceptive Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation Skills for Humanoid Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19340)
*Zejie Tian,Ruibing Hou,Bingpeng Ma,Börje F. Karlsson,Shiguang Shan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ViLoMan：将人类-物体交互的局部运动学演示转化为完整可执行的机器人轨迹，再通过教师-学生蒸馏学习统一全身控制策略，实现人形机器人自主移动操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人的移动操作需要自适应全身协调，以无缝整合 locomotion 与物理交互。但当前学习自主移动操作仍面临两个难点：缺乏多样且物理可执行的机器人-物体交互数据；难以直接从机载观测学习统一的全身控制策略。

Method: ViLoMan 是面向自主人形移动操作的可扩展框架。首先，将人类-物体交互的局部运动学演示转化为完整、物理可执行的机器人轨迹；随后利用这些轨迹，在教师-学生蒸馏框架中学习统一策略，将第一视角深度观测与本体感知测量直接映射为关节级全身动作。部署时策略不需要参考运动或中间指令。

Result: 在仿真和真实世界中，针对多种门配置和机器人初始条件评估关门任务。实验表明，单一策略即可使 Unitree G1 人形机器人仅依赖机载深度感知和本体感知完成完整任务，并在任务变化下稳健泛化，同时有效实现从仿真到现实的迁移。

Conclusion: ViLoMan 通过数据转化与教师-学生蒸馏相结合，实现了无需参考运动与中间指令的自主人形移动操作，并在关门任务上验证了单一策略的泛化性与 sim-to-real 迁移能力。

Abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires adaptive whole-body coordination to seamlessly integrate locomotion and physical interaction. Despite recent advances, learning autonomous loco-manipulation remains challenging due to the scarcity of diverse, physically executable robot-object interaction data and the difficulty of learning unified whole-body control directly from onboard observations. We present ViLoMan, a scalable framework for autonomous humanoid loco-manipulation. ViLoMan first transforms partial kinematic demonstrations of human-object interactions into complete, physically executable robot trajectories. It then leverages these trajectories within a teacher-student distillation framework to learn a unified policy that maps egocentric depth observations and proprioceptive measurements directly to joint-level whole-body actions. During deployment, the policy requires neither reference motions nor intermediate commands. We evaluate ViLoMan on door-closing tasks across diverse door configurations and robot initial conditions in both simulation and the real world. Experimental results demonstrate that a single policy enables a Unitree G1 humanoid to complete the full task using only onboard depth sensing and proprioception, while generalizing robustly across task variations and transferring effectively from simulation to reality. Project page: viloman-anonymous.pages.dev.

</details>


### [416] [Kinematics-Grounded Agentic AI for Robotic Additive Manufacturing Process Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19347)
*Jingzhan Ge,Ruimin Chen,Azadeh Haghighi,Jiong Tang,Farhad Imani*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出A-RAM（agentic robotic additive manufacturing）框架，将LLM用户意图解析与确定性规划代理、领域工具相集成，在六轴机械臂增材制造平台上实现路径生成、放置位姿、逆运动学与挤出的协同预评估，从而生成可执行规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人增材制造使工艺规划依赖于机器人本体。切片器生成的零件坐标系下的规划，在机械臂上可能不可行或运动性能差，因为切片工艺决策与零件方向决定路径，而零件方向与工作空间放置又影响运动学实现。现有AM工具、基于LLM的决策支持与数字孪生系统均缺乏对上述耦合决策的集成式执行前评估。

Method: 提出A-RAM，一种agent-specialist-tool框架：LLM解读制造目标与约束，识别规定变量与可搜索规划变量，并将推理编码为schema约束请求；确定性Planning Agent据此实例化搜索工作流；领域工具量化计算切片、放置、逆运动学、轨迹时序、Joint-6 jerk与挤出等指标。在六轴机械臂AM单元上通过三类案例评估，覆盖专家指定规划、仅目标规划、目标相关填充筛选以及几何相关方向-放置选择。

Result: 在评估的候选集中，所选规划相比最不利的可行候选，最大Joint-6 jerk降低达53.5%，平均绝对Joint-6 jerk降低达48.3%；目标特定填充筛选相比对应最不利筛选模式，运动规划完成时间缩短达40.1%，挤出路径缩短达12.7%。

Conclusion: A-RAM通过将LLM意图解析与确定性规划搜索及领域定量工具结合，实现了机器人增材制造中耦合规划决策的可追溯、可执行前评估，并能在运动学与挤出指标上显著改善所选规划质量。

Abstract: Robotic additive manufacturing (AM) extends material-extrusion printing beyond gantry kinematics but makes process planning robot-dependent. A slicer-generated plan that appears favorable in part coordinates can become infeasible or robotically unfavorable on a manipulator because slicer-process decisions and part orientation determine the generated path, while part orientation and workspace placement affect its kinematic realization. Existing AM tools, large language model (LLM)-based decision-support methods, and digital-shadow systems do not provide integrated pre-execution evaluation of these coupled decisions. This paper presents agentic robotic additive manufacturing (A-RAM), an agent-specialist-tool framework that converts user intent and a part file into traceable, execution-ready plans. The LLM interprets manufacturing objectives and constraints, identifies prescribed and searchable planning variables, and encodes this reasoning in a schema-constrained request; a deterministic Planning Agent instantiates the corresponding search workflow, while domain tools compute quantitative evidence for slicing, placement, inverse kinematics, trajectory timing, Joint-6 jerk, and extrusion. The framework is evaluated on a six-axis robotic-arm AM cell through three case studies covering expert-specified planning, goal-only planning, objective-dependent infill screening, and geometry-dependent orientation-placement selection. Across the evaluated candidate sets, selected plans achieve up to 53.5% lower maximum Joint-6 jerk and 48.3% lower mean absolute Joint-6 jerk than the least favorable valid candidates, while objective-specific infill screening yields motion-plan completion times up to 40.1% shorter and extrusion paths up to 12.7% shorter than the corresponding least favorable screened patterns.

</details>


### [417] [Design and Experimental Validation of a 3D Printed Torsional Series Elastic Actuator for Safe Human Robot Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19367)
*Joel Hidalgo Pisco,Melissa Cobos Condo,Luigi Miranda,Dennys Paillacho*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文设计并验证了一种基于3D打印TPU的低刚度扭簧，用于串联弹性执行器（SEA），结合混合位置控制器实现安全的人机物理交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理人机交互（pHRI）中的本质安全是社交与服务机器人的关键需求。传统金属串联弹性执行器（SEA）虽提供硬件柔顺性，但多部件装配复杂、成本高，亟需一种低成本、易制造且具备柔顺性的替代方案。

Method: 采用3D打印热塑性聚氨酯（TPU）制造低刚度扭簧，并进行有限元分析（FEA）与实验验证；针对位置受限伺服电机，设计了带力矩阈值切换的混合位置控制器。

Result: 扭簧表现出高度线性的力矩-变形响应（Ks = 0.066 Nm/度），与数值预测偏差小于3%（偏差归因于FDM结构各向异性）；系统能精确跟踪非平稳轨迹并安全顺应外部扰动；TPU固有材料阻尼充当被动低通滤波器，抑制控制模式切换时的高频振荡。

Conclusion: 该架构为安全pHRI提供了一种低成本、可靠且易于制造的解决方案。

Abstract: Ensuring intrinsic safety in physical human robot interaction (pHRI) is a critical requirement for social and service robots. While Series Elastic Actuators (SEAs) offer hardware based compliance, traditional metallic designs often require complex, multi part assemblies. This paper presents the design, finite element analysis (FEA), and experimental validation of a low stiffness, torsional spring for SEAs, manufactured via 3D printed thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU). The compliant element exhibits a highly linear torque deformation response (Ks = 0.066 Nm/degree), matching numerical predictions with under 3% deviation, a variance attributed to FDM structural anisotropy. To accommodate external interactions using standard position limited servomotors, a hybrid position controller with torque threshold switching was implemented. Experimental evaluations demonstrate the system ability to accurately track non stationary trajectories and safely yield to external disturbances. Furthermore, the inherent material damping of the TPU acts as a passive low pass filter, preventing high frequency oscillations during control mode transitions. The proposed architecture offers a cost effective, reliable, and easily manufacturable solution for safe pHRI.

</details>


### [418] [Enhancing the Perception of Safety and Comfort during Physical Human-Robot Handshake Interactions by Integrating Flexible Elements into a Robotic Arm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19375)
*Joel Hidalgo,Dennys Paillacho,Melissa Cobos,Luigi Miranda*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究通过实验比较刚性关节与串联弹性驱动器(SEA)机械臂在握手交互中的差异，10名被试的主观问卷表明SEA能提升安全感和舒适度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人机物理交互中的安全与舒适是社交机器人发展的关键问题，握手等自然手势因涉及直接物理接触而具有挑战性，需要一种有利于更安全交互的设计策略。

Method: 提出采用串联弹性驱动器(SEA)吸收冲击的设计方案；实验招募10名志愿者(6男4女)，每人分别与刚性关节机械臂和SEA柔性关节机械臂各完成一次握手交互；采集末端执行器轨迹等客观数据，并通过聚焦安全感、自然度与信任感的主观感知问卷收集信息，实现刚性与弹性的直接对比。

Result: 问卷结果显示，配备SEA的机械臂在安全感和舒适度方面获得更高的感知评分，支持其在促成更安全、更具社会接受度的人机交互方面的潜力。

Conclusion: 在机械臂中引入串联弹性驱动器有助于提升握手交互中的物理安全性与社会接受度，为社交机器人日常场景中的设计提供了实证支持。

Abstract: Safety and comfort in human-robot physical in-teractions are essential aspects in the development of social technologies, where natural gestures, such as handshakes, represent a challenge due to their direct physical contact. The implementation of series elastic actuators (SEA) to absorb impacts is proposed as a design strategy that favors safer interactions. This paper presents an experimental study aimed at evaluating how the incorporation of SEAs in robotic arms influences perceived safety and the interaction experience dur-ing handshaking. The design allows a direct comparison of the effect of rigidity versus the incorporation of elastic elements, in order to identify the advantages of SEAs in improving the physical safety and social acceptance of robotic systems in everyday contexts. The experiment was carried out with 10 volunteers (6 men and 4 women), who performed two interactions with each robotic arm: one with rigid joints and the other with flexible joints using SEA. During testing, objective data on end-effector trajectories were collected, as well as subjective information through a perception survey focused on safety, naturalness, and confidence during the handshake. The survey results show increased perceptions of safety and comfort with the SEA-equipped arm, supporting its potential to facilitate safer and more socially accepted human-robot interactions.

</details>


### [419] [Task-Oriented Active Learning of Residual Dynamics for Model Predictive Path Integral Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19378)
*Nobuaki Aoki,Hojin Lee,Stefan Sosnowski,Sandra Hirche*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出面向任务的主动学习准则ToIA，用于MPPI控制中的在线GP残差学习，通过估计观测对后续状态预测不确定性的降低量并按任务相关性加权，在越野导航中显著提升成功率且支持20Hz在线控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线残差学习可减少预测控制中的模型失配，但被动数据采集难以覆盖任务后期才变得重要的状态；而任务无关的主动学习虽针对不确定或信息丰富的区域，却不一定能提升任务性能。

Method: 提出Task-Oriented Information Acquisition（ToIA）主动学习准则，用于带在线高斯过程（GP）残差学习的模型预测路径积分控制（MPPI）。对每条采样的控制序列，ToIA估计rollout早期获得的观测能在多大程度上降低同一rollout后续状态的预测不确定性，并以该rollout对任务的相关性进行加权。该评分直接在现有MPPI rollout批次上计算，无需采样未来观测，也无需在假设后验更新下重新优化控制。

Result: 在异构地形、留出地图的仿真越野导航中，ToIA较被动GP学习将到达目标成功率提升19.3和27.4个百分点，并在密集与稀疏在线学习间隔下均优于任务无关主动学习基线。消融研究表明，任务相关性在稀疏模型更新时尤为重要。实现支持在NVIDIA RTX 2080 Ti上以20 Hz进行在线控制。

Conclusion: ToIA通过将信息增益与任务相关性结合，弥补了任务无关主动学习信息获取与任务性能脱节的问题，在不增加未来观测采样与重优化开销的前提下有效提升在线MPPI控制的导航成功率，并具备实时性。

Abstract: Online residual learning can reduce model mismatch in predictive control, but passive data collection may fail to adequately cover states that become important later in the task. Task-agnostic active learning targets uncertain or informative regions, but information acquired in such regions does not necessarily improve task performance. This paper introduces Task-Oriented Information Acquisition (ToIA), an active-learning criterion for model predictive path integral control (MPPI) with online Gaussian process (GP) residual learning. For each sampled control sequence, ToIA estimates how much an observation obtained early in the rollout would reduce predictive uncertainty at later states on the same rollout, and weights this reduction by the rollout's relevance to the task. The score is evaluated over the existing MPPI rollout batch without sampling future observations or re-optimizing control under hypothetical posterior updates. In simulated off-road navigation across held-out maps with heterogeneous terrain, ToIA improved the goal-reaching success rate over passive GP learning by 19.3 and 27.4 percentage points and outperformed task-agnostic active-learning baselines across dense and sparse online-learning intervals. An ablation study indicates that task relevance is particularly important under sparse model updates. The implementation supports online control at 20 Hz on an NVIDIA RTX 2080 Ti.

</details>


### [420] [From Rollout to Reset: A Graph-Based Harness for Autonomous Long-Horizon Manipulation Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19413)
*Jing Jiang,Yue Yang,Xinkai Jiang,Gedas Bertasius,Daniel J. Szafir,Rudolf Lioutikov*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HALTER：通过原子重置技能库规划实现长时域任务的自主评估与场景重置，大幅降低人工干预并提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实机器人策略评估依赖人工重置场景，耗时且初始状态分布未明确，导致可复现性差；现有自动化系统 AutoEval 仅支持单步任务，长时域任务终止状态组合爆炸，单一重置策略难以覆盖。

Method: 构建空间场景图（在线点云+视觉基础模型），利用 LLM 基于场景图进行 rollout 评分、重置规划与重置成功验证；通过规划学习到的原子重置技能库恢复场景，使演示成本随技能库规模而非终止状态数增长，无需收集标注成功图像。

Result: 在 Franka 机械臂的四项长时域任务中，HALTER 重置成功率 76%（AutoEval 52%、运动规划重置 65%）；完成技能比例估计准确率 90%（对比 76%）；重置验证正确率 91%（对比 78%）；相比人工重置减少 72% 操作员时间。在三项留出任务上组合泛化重置率达 74.7%（单任务策略仅 1.3%）。并消融了场景表示与图更新频率。

Conclusion: HALTER 通过技能库规划与场景图+LLM 推理，实现了长时域机器人任务的自动化评估与重置，在成功率、验证准确性、泛化能力与人力节省方面均显著优于基线。

Abstract: Robot manipulation policies are improving quickly, and real-robot evaluation remains the standard evidence for that progress. It still relies on a human to reset the scene between rollouts, which consumes operator time and leaves the initial state distribution unspecified, so results reproduce poorly. A recent system, AutoEval, automates both reset and scoring, but only for single-step tasks, because a long-horizon rollout can terminate in combinatorially many configurations that no single learned reset policy covers. We present HALTER, a Harness for Autonomous Long-horizon Task Evaluation and Reset, which restores the scene by planning over a library of learned atomic reset skills, so demonstration cost scales with the size of that library rather than with the number of terminal states. HALTER builds a spatial scene graph online from point clouds and vision foundation models, and an LLM reasons over this graph to score the rollout, plan the reset, and verify that the reset succeeded, without collecting labeled success images for any task. On four long-horizon tasks on a Franka arm, HALTER restores the scene in 76% of episodes, against 52% for AutoEval and 65% for a motion-planning reset, and it estimates the completed-skill fraction correctly in 90% of episodes, against 76%. Its reset-verification verdict is correct in 91% of episodes, compared with 78% for AutoEval. It also cuts the operator time of an evaluation campaign by 72% relative to manual reset. We further measure compositional generalization on three held-out tasks, where HALTER resets 74.7% of episodes against 1.3% for a per-task reset policy, and we ablate the scene representation and the graph update rate.

</details>


### [421] [Predict Before You Deploy: Offline Prediction of Quantization-Induced Task Degradation for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19441)
*Jiuyi Xu,Jinjia Guo,Meida Chen,Jing Du,Yangming Shi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 PreDE 框架：利用离线动作偏差预测世界动作模型(WAM)后训练量化配置是否会导致任务性能退化，从而在部署前决定接受、拒绝或推迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WAM 依赖视频生成骨干，部署时内存与计算开销大；后训练量化可降低内存并加速推理，但位宽、分组与量化器构成庞大配置空间，穷举闭环评估来筛选保性能配置代价高昂。

Method: PreDE 以离线动作偏差为信号，基于小规模开发集的闭环结果校准两个阈值，在给定的观测日志下对新配置做出接受/拒绝/推迟决策；在"标签有序性"假设下，只有当与开发标签一致的所有阈值都同意时才给出决策。框架强调按策略(policy-specific)进行行为校准。

Result: 在 5 个 WAM 和 4 个基准设置上，量化引起的任务损失随配置变化，无法仅由位宽或统一偏差阈值解释。两个策略的 28 个留出配置中，PreDE 在观测闭环结果前给出 21 个决策(75% 覆盖率)，全部与观测的可接受/退化标签一致；推迟项既含可接受结果也含 33 个百分点的损失。450 次 Franka Research 3 真机试验中，测试前被划入高偏差组的配置均显著退化，低偏差组无统计显著退化。真机上 W4A4 实现 1.37 倍动作查询加速与约 44% 峰值内存降低。

Conclusion: 结果支持采用策略特定的行为校准来筛选量化配置，同时能识别出需要闭环评估的候选配置，避免盲目部署。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) rely on video-generation backbones, requiring substantial memory and compute for deployment. Post-training quantization reduces memory and can accelerate inference, but bit width, grouping, and quantizer choice define a large configuration space. Identifying configurations that preserve task performance through exhaustive closed-loop evaluation is costly. We propose PreDE (Predict Before You Deploy), a policy-calibrated framework for predicting quantization-induced task degradation from offline action deviations. Using closed-loop outcomes from a small development set, PreDE calibrates two thresholds and accepts, rejects, or defers new configurations using a fixed observation log. Under a within-setting label-ordering hypothesis, the rule issues decisions where all thresholds consistent with the development labels agree. Across five WAMs and four benchmark settings, quantization produces configuration-dependent task losses that cannot be explained by bit width alone or a shared deviation threshold. Across 28 held-out configurations from two policies, PreDE issued 21 decisions before observing closed-loop outcomes (75% coverage), all matching the observed acceptable or degraded labels. Deferred candidates included both acceptable outcomes and a 33-percentage-point loss. In 450 Franka Research 3 trials across two independently fine-tuned policies, all configurations assigned to high-deviation groups before testing showed significant degradation, while low-deviation comparisons showed no statistically significant degradation. On the real robot, W4A4 achieved a 1.37x action-query speedup and approximately 44% lower peak memory. These results support policy-specific behavioral calibration for quantization configuration selection while identifying candidates that require closed-loop evaluation. The code is available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/PreDE.

</details>


### [422] [From Wizard-of-Oz Human-Robot Dialogue Collection to a Taxonomy of Robot Response Decisions: A Retrospective Analysis of Assistive Pilot Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19447)
*Guangping Liu,Nicholas Hawkins,Tipu Sultan,Flavio Esposito,Madi Dian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究通过分析一项"绿野仙踪"（Wizard-of-Oz）试点实验，构建了面向室内移动操作机器人的层级化响应决策分类体系，涵盖6种响应模式与4类歧义类型，并验证了标注一致性与视觉语言模型微调的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 日常室内环境中的机器人需应对不完整的人类指令，指令常缺失关键信息（如视野外物体身份、目标目的地或用户意图）。现有数据集缺乏真实场景对话，也缺少用于判断机器人应"执行、确认、澄清或拒绝"的实践依据。

Method: 回顾性分析一项试点Wizard-of-Oz研究：5名被试使用轮椅式移动操作机器人完成开门、开抽屉、喂食、饮水、清洁等日常任务，由操作者（wizard）在无正式通信策略下响应。基于40个episode提取出6种响应模式（ANSWER、REPORT_DONE、REFUSE、CONFIRM、CLARIFY、ACT）与4类歧义（intent、referential、spatial、intelligibility）的层级分类体系。两名人类标注者与一名AI标注者依据该体系对试点数据标注，并在此基础上微调LLaVA-1.6-7B。

Result: 干净标签率分别为91%和89%；在决策点、响应模式与歧义层级上，人类-人类与人类-AI比较的Cohen's κ介于0.72至0.95之间。使用分类体系派生的标签对LLaVA-1.6-7B进行ACT与CLARIFY任务的微调，表明利用该体系标注训练视觉语言模型具有可行性。

Conclusion: 决策点识别与REPORT_DONE中仍存在边界案例，需通过约束性协议实现更一致的对话采集。总体而言，该分类体系为机器人处理不完整指令提供了可操作的决策框架，并为视觉语言模型训练奠定基础。

Abstract: Robots that follow natural-language instructions in everyday indoor environments must act on incomplete human utterances. Instructions often omit essential information, such as the identity of an out-of-view object, an intended destination, or the user's goal. Existing datasets contain little real-world situated dialogue and provide few practice-grounded criteria for deciding when a robot should act, confirm, clarify, or refuse. We retrospectively analyze a pilot Wizard-of-Oz study in which five participants performed everyday indoor tasks, including door opening, drawer opening, feeding, drinking, and cleaning, with a wheelchair-mounted mobile manipulator while the wizard responded without a formal communication policy. This preserved authentic user behavior but produced inconsistent robot-side decisions, motivating an explicit decision scheme. From 40 episodes, we derived a hierarchical taxonomy of six response modes (ANSWER, REPORT_DONE, REFUSE, CONFIRM, CLARIFY, ACT) and four ambiguity types (intent, referential, spatial, intelligibility). Two human annotators and an AI annotator applied the scheme to the pilot data. Clean-label rates were 91% and 89%, and Cohen's ranged from 0.72 to 0.95 across decision-point, mode, and ambiguity levels for both human-human and human-AI comparisons. Fine-tuning LLaVA-1.6-7B on taxonomy-derived labels for ACT and CLARIFY indicates the feasibility of training vision-language models using annotations from our taxonomy. Remaining boundary cases in decision-point identification and REPORT_DONE motivate a constrained protocol for more consistent dialogue collection.

</details>


### [423] [Winning a Won Game: Strict Reach-Avoid-Stay Control Barrier Functions for High-Dimensional Black-Box Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19449)
*Donggeon David Oh,Duy P. Nguyen,Gongkai Yuan,Qingchen Li,Jaime Fernández Fisac,Haimin Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向高维黑盒系统的 sRAS Q-control barrier function 安全过滤器，将 stay value 与 reach-avoid value 结合，证明其构成鲁棒离散时间 CBF 并提升为 Q 函数用于运行时干预，无需已知动力学或人工设计屏障，在四足跳跃与 F1TENTH 仿真中验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人需在完成任务的同时保持已达成结果并避免安全失效。严格 reach-avoid-stay (sRAS) 要求安全到达目标并在首次进入后无限期驻留。现有方法多依赖已知动力学、仿射结构、值导数或人工设计屏障，难以适用于高维黑盒系统和有界不确定性场景。

Method: 构建 sRAS Q-CBF 安全过滤器：用 stay value 编码目标子集中的安全永久驻留，用 reach-avoid value 编码该子集的安全可达性并避开无法保证永久驻留的目标状态；证明二者联合构成有效的鲁棒离散时间 CBF，并提升为状态-动作 Q 函数用于运行时干预；采用基于可达性的对抗强化学习进行可扩展值近似，仅依赖黑盒交互。

Result: 在精确值与测度零条件下，过滤器可从几乎所有可获胜初始状态保持 sRAS 可行性，并在首次进入后面对所有可容许不确定性实现仍将系统安全保持在目标内。四足机器人间隙跳跃仿真与硬件实验中成功跨隙、安全着陆并持续保持安全；F1TENTH 仿真竞赛展示安全超车与领跑保持。

Conclusion: 所提框架无需已知动力学、仿射结构、值导数或手工设计屏障，即可完成 sRAS 安全过滤的合成与部署，并在高维黑盒系统与真实硬件上验证其安全性与可行性。

Abstract: Robots must complete their tasks and maintain the achieved outcomes while avoiding safety failures at all times. Strict reach-avoid-stay (sRAS) formalizes this requirement: safely reaching a target and remaining there indefinitely after first entry. We propose an sRAS Q-control barrier function (CBF) safety filter for high-dimensional black-box systems under bounded uncertainty. Our construction combines a stay value encoding safe permanent residence in a target subset with a reach-avoid value encoding safe reachability of this subset while avoiding target states from which safe permanent residence cannot be guaranteed. We prove that these values jointly yield a valid robust discrete-time CBF and lift them to state-action Q-functions for runtime intervention. For exact values and under a measure-zero condition, our filter preserves sRAS feasibility from almost every winnable initial state and keeps the system safely within the target after first entry, against all admissible uncertainty realizations. We adopt reachability-based adversarial reinforcement learning for scalable value approximation using only black-box interactions. Notably, neither synthesis nor deployment of our filter requires known dynamics, affine structure, value derivatives, or hand-designed barriers. We validate our framework in quadruped gap jumping in simulation and hardware, where the robot crosses the gap, lands safely, and remains safe afterward. Simulated F1TENTH races further demonstrate safe overtaking and lead retention.

</details>


### [424] [GLAMDRING: Gait Learning And Morphology co-Design via Reinforcement LearnING of CPGs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19452)
*Amogh Joshi,Kaushik Roy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: GLAMDRING 是一个联合优化四足机器人形态与运动控制器的框架，通过少量强化学习训练 CPG 策略并事后解析连杆与执行器，实现面向运动任务的最优机器人设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人正从结构化工厂走向灾害现场、行星表面、农田等非结构化环境，而这些场景往往尚无合适的现成机器人。由于机身形态与运动方式相互耦合，需要将机器人硬件与控制策略联合设计，而非分开处理。

Method: 给定前进速度范围、每执行器功率预算、执行器库和负载要求等规格，GLAMDRING 返回匹配的四足形态（连杆几何与各关节执行器）以及基于 Hopf 振荡器的中枢模式发生器（CPG）步态策略。方法在候选形态空间上用强化学习训练少量 CPG 策略，使步态与硬件协同学习，再依据策略记录的工作包络事后解析连杆长度与执行器，从而将综合成本降至固定次数的 RL 训练而非每个候选设计各训练一次。可行设计按目标函数（最大速度、最小运输成本 CoT、或最大负载余量）排序。

Result: 实验得到三项关键发现：机身与步态协同设计是满足运动约束的必要条件；决定可实现负载能力的是执行器包络可行性，而不仅是运动成功与否；在大多数设计中，仅由形态与约束即可自然涌现出典型动物步态。真实世界演示进一步验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 联合设计机身与步态对于面向非结构化环境的运动任务至关重要，执行器包络可行性决定负载能力，且自然界动物步态可由形态与约束自发涌现；GLAMDRING 以较低综合成本实现了形态与控制器的协同优化，并通过实物演示得到验证。

Abstract: Robots are moving out of the structured factory floor and into unstructured environments such as disaster sites, planetary surfaces, and agricultural fields, for which the right robot often does not yet exist. We present GLAMDRING, a framework that synthesizes the optimal robot for a locomotion task and, jointly, learns the controller that drives it.
