Method: 采用混合策略 SkipVLA：用经典运动规划器执行自由空间运动，仅对抓取、放置等接触密集技能查询 VLA。方法复用 VLA 冻结的视觉-语言骨干，预测每段规划运动的目标位姿；该预测器不引入额外演示数据，直接利用大 VLA 已学到的知识进行学习。在仿真中对 3 个 VLA、13 个 LIBERO 任务评估，并在物理 6-DoF YAM 机械臂上测试 3 个拾放任务。

Result: 在仿真与真机实验中，SkipVLA 实现了最高 2.5 倍的任务完成加速，能耗显著降低，同时保持与基线相同的任务成功率。

Conclusion: 通过让经典规划器承担自由空间运动、VLA 仅处理接触密集技能，并复用冻结视觉-语言骨干预测目标位姿，SkipVLA 在不牺牲成功率的前提下显著提升 VLA 的推理效率与能效，为长时域机器人任务提供了一种高效混合策略范式。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are a class of generalist robot policies that map camera images and language instructions directly to robot actions. While promising, these models remain slow at test time, particularly for long-horizon tasks that require many queries to the policy. Recent efforts reduce VLA latency by distilling smaller models, overlapping asynchronous action chunks, or pairing the VLA with a fast low-level policy, but still run a learned policy for the entire task. In contrast to VLA, classical motion planners quickly find collision-free motions, but require an explicit goal and have no semantic understanding of the task. In this work, we present SkipVLA, a hybrid policy that combines a pretrained VLA with a classical motion planner, using the planner for free-space motion and querying the VLA only for contact-rich skills such as grasping and placing. SkipVLA reuses the frozen vision-language backbone of the VLA to predict a target pose for each planned motion, and learns this predictor without additional demonstrations introduced into the system by using what was already learnt by the large VLA. We evaluate SkipVLA with three VLAs on 13 LIBERO tasks in simulation and three pick-and-place tasks on a physical 6-DoF YAM arm, demonstrating up to 2.5x faster task completion and significantly lower energy consumption while achieving the same task success rate.

</details>


### [494] [HIL-UMI: Bringing Human-in-the-Loop Post-Training of Vision-Language-Action Models to Universal Manipulation Interface](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20659)
*Zimu Han,Yiming Zeng,Jiyao Zhang,Zihao Zhao,Yuanfei Wang,Yixiang Jin,Shiqi Li,Shuangben Chen,Wei Huang,Ruodai Li,Hui Shen,Hao Dong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 HIL-UMI：一种策略引导、无需真机的 UMI 人在回路 VLA 后训练框架，通过 Energy Score 触发数据采集、在线优势预测精化进度估计器，并用于优势条件行为克隆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模 VLA 模型具备强先验，但适配特定部署仍困难。任务示范上的 SFT 存在两处局限：静态数据对分布外状态覆盖不足；标准模仿目标无法区分推进性行为与低价值数据。交互式后训练可缓解，但通常需在真机上反复执行策略并依赖人工干预。

Method: HIL-UMI 在手持 UMI 示范过程中，对同一观测流查询当前策略但不执行其预测；用 Energy Score 比较人类动作轨迹与策略推理，当差异指示分布外区域时触发采集。另一反馈回路以低在线优势预测识别关键片段，精化基于进度的优势估计器；更新后的估计器以基础示范与新策略数据的均衡混合指导优势条件行为克隆。该设计将数据采集与机器人部署解耦，同时保留人在回路学习的迭代性与策略感知特性。

Result: 在四项真实世界任务（涵盖长时序与精细操作）上，HIL-UMI 相对 SFT 稳定提升，并从定向采集与优势精化中获益；在 Clean Up Table 任务上优于 HG-DAgger，且单帧采集时间更低。

Conclusion: HIL-UMI 为 VLA 后训练提供了一条可跨操作者与地点扩展的路径。

Abstract: Large-scale vision-language-action (VLA) models provide powerful priors for robot manipulation, yet adapting them to a specific deployment remains challenging. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on task-specific demonstrations provides a step toward deployment, but faces two persistent limitations: static data provide limited coverage of out-of-distribution states, and standard imitation objectives do not distinguish progressing behavior from less useful data. Interactive post-training can address these limitations, but typically requires repeated policy execution and human intervention on a physical robot. We introduce HIL-UMI, a policy-guided Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) framework for robot-free human-in-the-loop VLA post-training. During handheld UMI demonstrations, HIL-UMI queries the current policy on the same observation stream without executing its predictions. The Energy Score compares the human action trajectory with policy inference and triggers collection when their discrepancy indicates an out-of-distribution region. In a separate feedback loop, low online advantage predictions identify essential segments for refining a progress-based advantage estimator. The updated estimator then guides advantage-conditioned behavioral cloning using a balanced mixture of base demonstrations and new policy data. This design preserves the iterative and policy-aware nature of human-in-the-loop learning while decoupling data collection from robot deployment. Experiments on four real-world tasks spanning long-horizon and precise manipulation show that HIL-UMI achieves consistent improvement over SFT and benefits from both targeted collection and advantage refinement. Moreover, HIL-UMI outperforms HG-DAgger on Clean Up Table with lower per-frame collection time, suggesting a scalable path for VLA post-training across operators and locations.

</details>


### [495] [MAGNETAR: Multipath-Guided Spatial Posteriors for Transmitter Pose Inference in the Upper Mid-Band](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20670)
*Haozhe Lei,Ruibin Chen,Yuhan Jiang,Ali Rasteh,Aditya Dhananjay,Sundeep Rangan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MAGNETAR 从单次异步 RF 多径快照推断发射机平面位置与朝向的联合后验，采用共享 2D U-Net 按候选朝向条件化并在位置-朝向网格上联合归一化评分，网格化联合后验优于参数化方法且更易迁移到真机测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人定位无线电发射机时，点估计不足：在杂乱房间中单次测量可能与多个发射机位置一致，且因中高频段天线具方向性，也可能对应多个朝向，因此需要联合后验分布。

Method: MAGNETAR 输入房间布局、接收机位姿以及单次异步 RF 多径快照（由到达角与信噪比估计表示），推断平面发射机位置与朝向的联合后验。方法比较五种神经评分器，最终采用共享 2D U-Net，对每个候选朝向进行条件化，并在离散化的位置-朝向网格上联合归一化评分。训练使用经真实到仿真校准的 10 GHz 仿真数据外加少量实测子集。

Result: 在留出仿真上，基于网格的联合后验优于参数化后验；按朝向条件化的评分器在机器人实测数据上迁移效果最佳；融合联合后验优于融合仅位置的边缘后验。

Conclusion: 联合建模位置与朝向并输出网格化后验，能更好刻画单次 RF 多径测量下的多模态不确定性，且具备更好的真机迁移与多测量融合能力。

Abstract: Robots that localize a radio transmitter need more than a point estimate: in cluttered rooms, one measurement is often consistent with several transmitter locations and, because upper-mid-band antennas are directional, several headings. We present MAGNETAR, which infers a joint posterior over planar transmitter position and heading from a single asynchronous radio-frequency (RF) multipath snapshot, represented by angle-of-arrival and signal-to-noise-ratio estimates, given the room layout and receiver pose. Among our five neural scorers, MAGNETAR adopts a shared 2D U-Net conditioned on each candidate heading, jointly normalizing scores over a discretized position-heading grid. Training uses real-to-sim-calibrated 10 GHz simulations and a small measured subset. Grid-based joint posteriors outperform parametric ones on held-out simulations, the heading-conditioned scorer transfers best to robotic measurements, and fusing joint posteriors improves on fusing position-only marginals.

</details>


### [496] [Custom PX4 firmware for autonomous hybrid aerial-marine missions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20691)
*Andrea Capuozzo,Fabio Ruggiero,Vincenzo Lippiello*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文为混合型水空两栖无人机提出PX4固件扩展，集成手动与自主水面航行模式，实现空海任务统一规划与执行，并通过仿真验证水面航行的稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水环境测绘与监测需要无人机兼具飞行与水面航行能力，但现有PX4固件缺乏对水面航行模式的支持，无法在同一任务中统一规划空中与水面航点。

Method: 扩展PX4固件，新增手动与自主水面航行模式，将其接入标准PX4任务流水线与QGroundControl界面，并引入区分空中与水面航点的统一任务规划机制，同时保留原有飞行功能与安全机制。

Result: 通过仿真案例验证了该实现的有效性，表明平台在平静与波浪条件下均能保持稳定的水面航行。

Conclusion: 该框架使水空两栖无人机能够在同一任务中统一规划与执行混合任务，为水环境测绘与监测提供了可行的固件级解决方案。

Abstract: Mapping and monitoring aquatic environments can benefit from hybrid aerial-amphibious drones able to combine flight and water-surface navigation within the same mission. This paper presents a PX4 firmware extension for such platforms, introducing manual and autonomous marine navigation modes integrated with the standard PX4 mission pipeline and QGroundControl interface. The proposed framework preserves existing flight functionalities and safety mechanisms while enabling unified planning and execution of hybrid aerial-marine missions with differentiated aerial and marine waypoints. Simulated case studies validate the implementation and demonstrate stable surface navigation under calm and wavy conditions.

</details>


### [497] [HOPHY: A Hierarchical Hypergraph Representation for Off-Road Path and Mission Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20694)
*Pranay Meshram,Charuvahan Adhivarahan,Prithvi Poddar,Ehsan Tarkesh Esfahani,Chen Wang,Souma Chowdhury,Karthik Dantu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HOPHY是一种可复用的分层越野地形表示，通过几何连通语义区域、连通性保持的粗粒化区域与类型化超边实现高效重规划，在公里级越野场景中以极低代价偏差和显著降低的延迟完成路径规划与多机器人任务分配，并在实车验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾害响应、搜救和战术UGV任务需要在不断变化的地形、智能体类型和目标下反复进行路径与任务规划。像素网格搜索在公里级重复查询中计算代价高昂，而语义抽象方法必须在地形条件变化时仍然保持有效的路径代价与连通性。

Method: 提出HOPHY（基于超图的分层越野规划），构建可复用的分层地形表示：将地图尺度地形组织为几何连通的语义区域（GSNodes）、保持连通性的关键区域（Coarse Regions），以及编码地形、智能体与天气上下文的类型化超边。通过超边交集选取受影响区域与关联边进行状态更新，而无需重建整个层级结构。

Result: 在覆盖公里级区域的真实越野地图上，HOPHY实现100%规划成功率，相比oracle（像素A*）中位代价偏差低于0.01%，查询与重规划延迟显著低于像素与抽象基线。应用于多机器人任务分配（MRTA）问题时，总计算量较像素A*减少79倍，较最快的抽象基线减少7.2倍，任务完工时间与像素A*相当。最终在物理Clearpath Jackal平台上成功执行1.5公里、八任务的混合地表户外任务及一次阻塞触发的重规划路线。

Conclusion: HOPHY证明分层超图地形表示能够在不牺牲路径质量的条件下，大幅降低越野场景中重复查询与重规划的计算开销，并有效支撑多机器人任务分配与实车长距离自主任务执行。

Abstract: Mission-level autonomy for disaster response, search and rescue, and tactical UGV operations requires repeated path and mission planning as terrain conditions, agent types, and objectives change. Pixel-grid search is costly for repeated kilometer-scale queries, while semantic abstractions must maintain valid costs and connectivity as conditions change. We present HOPHY (Hierarchical Off-Road Planning using Hypergraphs), a reusable hierarchical terrain representation that organizes map-scale terrain into geometrically connected semantic regions (GSNodes), connectivity-preserving critical regions (Coarse Regions), and typed hyperedges for terrain, agent, and weather context. Hyperedge intersections select affected regions and incident edges for state updates without rebuilding the hierarchy. Across real off-road maps spanning kilometer-scale areas, HOPHY achieves 100% planning success and less than 0.01% median cost deviation from the oracle (pixel A*), with substantially lower query and replanning latency than the evaluated pixel and abstraction baselines. Applied to a multi-robot task-allocation (MRTA) problem, these gains reduce total computation by 79x over pixel A* and 7.2x over the fastest abstraction baseline, with mission makespan comparable to pixel A*. Finally, we demonstrate HOPHY on a physical Clearpath Jackal that successfully executes a 1.5-km, eight-task mission across mixed-surface outdoor terrain and a blockage-triggered replanned route.

</details>


### [498] [MoWAM: Explicit Future Motion Prediction for Efficient World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20709)
*Jiayu Wang,Bin Zhu,Yue Yu,Jingjing Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出MoWAM，用显式未来运动预测替代未来视频生成，训练时联合学习视觉动态、运动与动作，推理时完全去除视频生成，实现高效且鲁棒的机器人策略学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有World Action Models通过引入未来动态提升机器人策略学习，但推理时显式生成未来视频带来巨大计算开销；若去除未来生成虽提升效率，却使未来动态仅隐式编码于观测特征中，在分布偏移下鲁棒性受限。

Method: MoWAM以结构化机器人运动的紧凑抽象表示未来，而非重建完整未来场景，从而捕捉当前场景与交互约束下机器人的预期演化。采用Mixture-of-Transformer架构，在训练中学习未来视觉动态并联合预测运动与动作，推理时完全移除视频生成但保留显式未来表征。紧凑运动表示支持推理时扩展：采样多组运动-动作候选，并由运动感知的任务进度验证器进行选择。

Result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus及真实世界操作任务上，MoWAM取得强分布内性能、更优的分布外鲁棒性，且平均真实世界成功率高于代表性WAM基线；随候选数量增加性能持续提升。

Conclusion: 显式未来运动是有效且高效的推理时扩展基础，可在去除视频生成的同时兼顾效率、鲁棒性与性能。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot policy learning by incorporating future dynamics, yet explicitly generating future videos at inference introduces substantial computational overhead. Removing future generation improves efficiency, but leaves future dynamics only implicitly encoded in observation features, which can limit robustness under distribution shifts. We propose MoWAM, an efficient WAM that replaces future video generation with explicit future motion prediction. Instead of reconstructing the complete future scene, MoWAM models structured robot motion as a compact abstraction of the future, capturing how the robot is expected to evolve under the current scene and interaction constraints. A Mixture-of-Transformer architecture learns future visual dynamics during training while jointly predicting motion and action, allowing video generation to be removed entirely at inference while retaining an explicit representation of the future. The compact motion representation further enables efficient inference-time scaling by sampling multiple candidates of motion and action pairs and selecting among them with a motion-aware task-progress verifier. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that MoWAM achieves strong in-distribution performance, improved out-of-distribution robustness, and higher average real-world success than representative WAM baselines. In addition, performance improves as more candidates are explored, demonstrating that explicit future motion provides an effective and efficient basis for inference-time scaling.

</details>


### [499] [Underwater Visual Target Tracking with Target-Specific Depth Estimation and Adaptive Model-Fusion Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20731)
*Yuheng Zhou,Haiyang Cheng,Yanqi Feng,Pangkit Fong,Mei Xuan Lee,Marcus Gee,Chongrong Fang,Jianping He*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种面向AUV的立体视觉伺服框架，通过立体图像深度提取与卡尔曼滤波获得稳定3D相对状态，并解耦偏航与平移控制，采用自适应模型融合MPC实现实时水下目标跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于视觉的水下目标跟踪面临深度测量不可靠与目标运动未知两大挑战，现有框架难以兼顾感知鲁棒性与实时控制性能。

Method: 感知端：构建融合颜色、视差和时间线索的目标深度掩码以筛选可靠目标像素，并对深度测量与检测图像中心分别滤波，从立体图像中提取稳定3D相对状态。控制端：将偏航调节与平移控制解耦，避免计算昂贵的耦合多自由度优化，从而实现实时平移MPC；平移控制器采用自适应模型融合预测控制，融合匀速与零速目标模型，依据历史预测误差更新模型权重，并在执行器、跟随距离和视场约束下求解平移指令。

Result: 通过仿真与真实世界实验验证了框架的有效性，并显示其性能优于现有框架。

Conclusion: 该立体视觉伺服框架通过鲁棒感知与解耦自适应控制，有效应对水下深度测量不可靠和未知目标运动问题，实现实时、优于现有方法的水下目标跟踪。

Abstract: Vision-based underwater target tracking is challenged by unreliable depth measurements and unknown target motion. This paper proposes a stereo visual-servoing framework for an autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV). For perception, the framework derives a stable 3D relative state from stereo images through target-specific depth extraction and Kalman filtering. It constructs a target-depth mask from color, disparity, and temporal cues to select reliable target pixels, and then filters the resulting depth measurement and detected image center separately. For control, the framework decouples yaw regulation from translational control, avoiding computationally expensive coupled multi-DOF optimization and enabling real-time translational MPC. The translational controller employs adaptive model-fusion predictive control, combining constant-velocity and zero-velocity target models to accommodate different target-motion patterns. It updates the model weights using historical prediction errors and computes translational commands subject to actuation, following-distance, and field-of-view constraints. Through simulations and real-world experiments, we validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and show it has better performance than existing frameworks.

</details>


### [500] [MILER: Semantic Mid-Level Representation for Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning in Unstructured Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20747)
*Thomas Steinecker,Denis Trescher,Alexander Bienemann,Thorsten Luettel,Mirko Maehlisch*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MILER——一种具备零样本仿真到现实迁移能力的端到端策略框架，用于非结构化环境下的自动驾驶。离线阶段采用自定义语义中层表征（MLR）仿真器训练强化学习策略；部署阶段利用BEVFusion生成一致鸟瞰图表征，并通过轨迹对齐策略实现感知与控制的零样本迁移，在真实车辆上完成17.3 km无人工干预自动驾驶。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习具备超越人类性能与自学习策略的潜力，但在真实世界自动驾驶（尤其是非结构化环境）中应用稀少，核心瓶颈在于非结构化环境的仿真到现实（sim-to-real）迁移困难。

Method: 1）离线训练：构建自定义语义中层表征（MLR）仿真器，用强化学习训练策略网络，控制输出直接作用于自行车模型；2）真实部署：相机与LiDAR数据经BEVFusion处理，生成与MLR仿真器一致的语义鸟瞰图表征；3）不将策略网络动作直接施加于实车，而采用轨迹对齐（trajectory-alignment）策略，实现感知与控制的零样本仿真到现实迁移。

Result: 在包含多种障碍物、发卡弯、最高33.6 km/h车速及越野路段的多样化测试赛道上验证；使用两辆不同车辆、在3.0 km测试赛道上累计行驶17.3 km，全程无人工干预。整个软件栈运行于Jetson AGX Orin平台。

Conclusion: MILER验证了通过语义中层表征仿真器与轨迹对齐策略，能够有效实现非结构化环境下感知与控制的零样本仿真到现实迁移，在真实车辆上达成长时间、无干预的自动驾驶。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning constitutes a promising approach owing to its potential for superhuman performance and self-learned policies. However, its application to real-world autonomous driving remains scarce, particularly in unstructured environments, because of the challenges associated with sim-to-real transfer for unstructured environments. In this work, we present MILER, an end-to-end policy framework with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. During offline training, we employ a custom semantic mid-level representation (MLR) simulator and train the policy network using reinforcement learning, with its control outputs applied directly to a bicycle model. During deployment on the real vehicle, camera and LiDAR data are processed by BEVFusion to generate a semantic bird's-eye-view representation consistent with that of the MLR simulator. The actions generated by the policy network are not applied directly to the real vehicle. Instead, we employ a trajectory-alignment strategy that enables zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of both perception and control. We extensively evaluate the proposed framework on a diverse test track comprising numerous challenges, including various obstacles, hairpin curves, velocities of up to 33.6 km/h, and off-road sections. In total, we drove 17.3 km with two different vehicles on a 3.0 km test track without human intervention, thereby demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach. Furthermore, the entire software stack runs on a Jetson AGX Orin.

</details>


### [501] [Agile-WAM: An Agile Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20761)
*Hanchu Zhou,Brendan Lynch,Raman Goyal,Dechen Gao,Begum Kasap,Boqi Zhao,Junshan Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 TARO——一种轻量级触觉世界动作模型，将视觉与触觉观测编码到共享潜空间，并直接以流匹配生成动作块及未来视觉/触觉潜表示，实现高频接触丰富的机器人控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有触觉世界动作模型（tactile WAMs）依赖大规模预训练生成式骨干网络来建模接触丰富的物理动力学，导致推理效率低、部署不灵活，难以满足高频精确控制需求。

Method: TARO 将视觉与触觉观测编码为共享潜表示，作为"视觉-触觉到动作"流匹配（flow-matching）过程的源，联合生成动作块潜表示与未来视觉/触觉潜表示；针对视觉与触觉信号时间尺度差异（视觉帧间相似、触觉接触时突变），引入多时域多模态预测：对视觉潜表示施加较大时间偏移的监督，而对触觉潜表示预测下一帧以捕捉细粒度接触动力学。

Result: 在 9 个仿真与 5 个真实世界接触丰富操作任务中表现强且稳健；真实实验中总体成功率相对提升 29.4%，推理延迟仅 11.9 ms，优于最强基线。

Conclusion: 多模态世界动作模型可在敏捷架构下实现，适用于精确且高频率的机器人控制。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) advance beyond conventional visuomotor policies by jointly predicting future world states and robot actions, enabling the policy to learn physical dynamics that support effective control. However, recent tactile WAMs often rely on large-scale pretrained generative backbones to capture contact-rich physical dynamics, which limit their inference efficiency and flexible deployment. In this paper, we present \ABBR{}, an agile tactile World Action Model for contact-rich robot control. \ABBR{} encodes visual and tactile observations into a shared latent that serves as the source of a direct vision-tactile-to-action flow-matching process, which can jointly generate latent representations of action chunks and future visual/tactile latents. A key observation is that vision and tactile signals evolve at inherently different timescales: adjacent visual frames are often highly similar, whereas tactile signals can change abruptly upon contact. We therefore introduce multi-horizon multimodal prediction in \ABBR{}, which provides supervision for visual latent at a larger temporal offset while predicting the tactile latent in the next frame to capture fine-grained contact dynamics. Across nine simulated and five real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, \ABBR{} demonstrates strong and robust performance, outperforming the strongest baseline in success rate while maintaining low inference latency. In particular, in five real-world experiments, \ABBR{} yields a relative gain of $\textbf{29.4\%}$ in overall success rates while achieving inference latency of $\textbf{11.9 ms}$. These results demonstrate that multimodal WAM can be achieved with an agile architecture suitable for precise and high-frequency robot control. More details are available on our project page: https://hanchuzhou.github.io/TARO_project_page/.

</details>


### [502] [GeoAAC: Geometry-Based Adaptive Action Chunking from Denoising Trajectories in VLA Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20776)
*Xin Chen,Sen Chen,Yujuan Ding,Jian Liu,Guoqing Wang,Wei Ye,Heng Tao Shen,Yi Bin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出GeoAAC，一种基于几何信息的自适应动作分块方法，利用Flow Matching去噪轨迹的几何信息评估预测可靠性，从而动态确定动作视界，无需额外训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA策略普遍采用固定的动作视界（action horizon），但任务不同阶段对动作连续性、控制精度和闭环反馈的需求不同，固定视界难以适应变化的控制需求。

Method: GeoAAC通过分析Flow Matching去噪轨迹的几何结构，发现动作前缀间的几何变化与预测不确定性正相关；据此构造逐前缀的几何曲线（horizon-wise geometric profile），在单次生成中自适应确定动作视界，无需额外训练。

Result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Pro、RoboCasa365及真实世界操作任务上，使用GR00T N1.5和π0.5进行实验，相比固定视界基线和现有自适应方法取得稳定提升，仿真最高提升8.7个百分点，真实世界平均成功率从53.3%提升至74.4%。

Conclusion: Flow Matching去噪轨迹的几何信息可作为预测可靠性的过程级信号，GeoAAC据此实现无需训练的自适应动作分块，在仿真与真实任务上均优于现有方法。

Abstract: Action chunking is widely used for action generation and execution in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, yet existing approaches commonly use a fixed action horizon. During a rollout, different task stages may require different levels of action continuity, control precision, and closed-loop feedback, making a fixed horizon unable to accommodate changing control requirements. We propose \textbf{GeoAAC}, a geometry-based adaptive action chunking method for flow-based VLA policies that adjusts the action horizon according to the reliability of the current action prediction. We show that the geometry of Flow Matching denoising trajectories provides process-level information for characterizing prediction reliability, with geometric variation across action prefixes remaining positively correlated with predictive uncertainty. GeoAAC uses this prefix-wise geometry to construct a horizon-wise geometric profile and adaptively determine the action horizon from a single generation without additional training. Experiments with GR00T N1.5 and π0.5 on LIBERO, LIBERO-Pro, RoboCasa365, and real-world manipulation tasks show consistent improvements over fixed-action-horizon baselines and existing adaptive methods, including up to 8.7 percentage points in simulation and an increase in average real-world success rate from 53.3\% to 74.4\%.

</details>


### [503] [StageGuard: Learning Stage Transitions for Long-Horizon Robot Tasks via Agentic Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20791)
*Jinbang Huang,Yuanzhao Hu,Zhiyuan Li,Ran Qi,Yixin Xiao,Yangzheng Wu,Tengyue Ba,Zhanguang Zhang,Yingxue Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 StageGuard，一种 agentic 蒸馏框架，用教师模型推理结合示范轨迹生成子任务完成与策略切换的结构化解释，训练轻量学生 VLM 生成简洁自解释，实现准确高效的分阶段转换决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分层规划框架需判断何时终止当前技能并进入下一子任务，但预设计的完成信号检查器在真实执行中难以获取；大规模 VLM 虽推理能力强，但其决策边界与任务完成标准不对齐，且云端部署与冗长推理带来高延迟，难以实时监控。

Method: StageGuard 结合教师模型推理与示范轨迹，生成子任务完成及策略切换的结构化解释；轻量学生 VLM 基于这些解释生成紧凑自解释，并用于监督微调。评估涵盖两个基准上的阶段转换预测，以及在 BEHAVIOR-1K 上集成到分层机器人控制中评估闭环任务成功率，并在真实机器人上进一步验证。

Result: 分阶段转换预测取得显著提升，同时支持高效的在线监控。

Conclusion: StageGuard 通过 agentic 蒸馏将教师推理能力迁移至轻量学生模型，兼顾准确性与效率，为分层机器人控制提供可落地的实时阶段转换决策方案。

Abstract: Hierarchical planning frameworks combine skills from multiple robot control policies for long-horizon task execution, where determining when to terminate the current skill and advance to the next subtask is essential. Existing approaches often rely on pre-designed completion signal checkers that are hard to obtain in real-world execution. Large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) offer strong reasoning capabilities, but their decision boundaries are not inherently aligned with task completion criteria, while cloud deployment and lengthy reasoning introduce substantial latency, limiting real-time monitoring. We propose StageGuard, an agentic distillation framework for accurate and efficient stage-transition decisions. StageGuard combines teacher-model reasoning with demonstration trajectories to generate structured explanations of subtask completion and policy switching. A lightweight student VLM uses these explanations to generate compact self-explanations, which are used for supervised fine-tuning. We evaluate stage-transition prediction on trajectories from two benchmarks and assess closed-loop task success through integration into hierarchical robot control on BEHAVIOR-1K, with further validation on real robots. Results show substantial improvements in stage-transition prediction while supporting efficient online monitoring.

</details>


### [504] [Workspace Models: Lightweight Robotic Memory via Saliency-Driven Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20820)
*Nitish Dashora,Douglas Chen,Idan Shenfeld,John Marangola,Pulkit Agrawal,Max Simchowitz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出 workspace token，通过在训练阶段用 VLM 提取任务相关历史信息并蒸馏成轻量潜在记忆，部署时无需在环 VLM 查询，即可作为观测的替代品支撑记忆密集型机器人操作任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂机器人操作常需对过去事件与动作的长期记忆，但直接以完整历史为条件易导致伪相关并降低性能。现有方法多在策略执行环内调用 VLM 压缩历史信息，计算开销大。

Method: 将昂贵 VLM 查询移至训练阶段：先用 VLM 识别完成任务所需的当前与历史信息，再通过集合重建解码器损失，将这些信息蒸馏进一个轻量潜在记忆表示——workspace token。部署时该 token 可直接替代观测输入。

Result: 在仿真与真实硬件上，workspace token 作为观测的即插即用替代，使策略无需在环 VLM 推理即可解决记忆密集型任务；且相比基线更轻量，同时策略性能更优。

Conclusion: 将 VLM 的繁重推理从部署环移至训练阶段以蒸馏轻量记忆，是兼顾效率与性能的有效方案，workspace token 在记忆密集型机器人操作中既降低开销又提升表现。

Abstract: Complex robotic manipulation tasks frequently require a long-term memory of past events and actions. As conditioning on full histories renders policies prone to spurious correlations and degrades performance, many approaches to policy memory involve compressing historical information through expensive VLM queries in-the-loop to process only task-salient information. In this paper, we propose an alternative approach in which computationally intensive VLM queries are made during train-time to learn a lightweight latent memory that can be efficiently queried at deployment time. Our representation, which we call the \textbf{workspace token}, is trained by (1) using a VLM to identify current and historical information necessary for completing a task, then (2) distilling these into the workspace token using a set-reconstruction decoder loss. In both simulation and hardware, we show that the workspace token can be used as a drop-in replacement for observations during deployment, enabling policies to solve memory-intensive tasks without the need for VLM reasoning in-the-loop. Interestingly, we found that workspace tokens are not only more lightweight but also lead to better policy performance.

</details>


<div id='stat.ML'></div>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [505] [Federated Soft Clustering via Generalized Total Variation Minimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19202)
*Shamsiiat Abdurakhmanova,Alexander Jung*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究联邦软聚类场景下的个性化高斯混合模型（GMM）学习，用广义全变差最小化（GTVMin）通过图正则项耦合本地最大似然问题，并对比三种模型差异度量：欧氏距离、KL散度（蒙特卡洛近似）与MMD（闭式）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习网络中，各设备持有私有本地数据集，需要拟合个性化高斯混合模型。关键设计决策在于如何衡量相连节点模型之间的差异，不同度量方式对组件匹配的依赖程度及鲁棒性不同，因此有必要系统比较。

Method: 以GTVMin为框架，通过图正则项惩罚相连节点模型间的差异，耦合各本地最大似然问题。比较三种差异度量：需要组件匹配的模型参数间平方欧氏距离；无需匹配、直接比较本地模型分布的蒙特卡洛近似KL散度；以及闭式MMD。三种GTVMin实例均采用同步投影梯度更新求解。

Result: 对于光滑的MMD实例，给出了收敛到稳定点的理论保证；同时刻画了三种方法的计算代价，并评估了它们在数据异质性下的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 直接比较分布的度量（KL、MMD）无需组件匹配，MMD实例具备收敛保证；不同度量在计算成本与数据异质性鲁棒性上各有权衡，为联邦个性化软聚类的差异度量选择提供了依据。

Abstract: We study federated soft clustering over federated learning (FL) networks of devices that each hold a private local dataset and fit a personalized Gaussian mixture model (GMM). Generalized total variation minimization (GTVMin) couples the local maximum likelihood problems through a graph regularizer that penalizes a discrepancy between the models of connected nodes. The choice of discrepancy measure is a key design decision: we compare a squared Euclidean distance between model parameters, which requires component matching, with two measures that compare the local model distributions directly and hence need no matching: a Monte-Carlo approximated Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence and a closed-form maximum mean discrepancy (MMD). All three resulting GTVMin instances are optimized by synchronous projected gradient updates; for the smooth MMD instance we provide a convergence guarantee to stationary points. We characterize their computational cost and evaluate their robustness to data heterogeneity.

</details>


### [506] [Learning Submanifolds for Subsequent Inference on Random Dot Product Graphs, Part 1: Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19357)
*Michael W. Trosset,Carey E. Priebe*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出一种针对随机点积图的受限推断框架，利用Isomap流形学习从辅助数据中学习支撑流形，构造半监督决策规则，并证明其风险随辅助样本量增大收敛于oracle规则的风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机点积图的潜在位置位于未知的低维支撑流形上，在此结构下进行受限推断（一般决策问题）需要一种能利用辅助数据学习流形结构的方法，以逼近理想情况下的最优决策性能。

Method: 对一般决策问题提出半监督决策规则：使用Isomap流形学习程序，由辅助数据构造观测图的低维欧氏表示，并在该空间中用等距不变函数将点配置映射为动作；分析规则在辅助样本量增长时的行为。

Result: 理论上证明：随着辅助样本量增大，半监督规则的风险收敛到oracle规则的风险，该oracle规则利用了可从支撑流形中提取的最大量低维欧氏结构。示例、应用与仿真研究留待后续工作。

Conclusion: 该框架为随机点积图上的受限推断提供了具有渐近最优保证的半监督方法，其风险随辅助数据增加而收敛至oracle水平，具体实证验证将另文给出。

Abstract: We propose a framework for restricted inference on random dot product graphs whose latent positions lie on an unknown low-dimensional support manifold. For general decision problems, we propose semisupervised decision rules that use auxiliary data to learn the support manifold. Specifically, our rules use the Isomap manifold learning procedure to construct a low-dimensional Euclidean representation of the observed graph, in which space an isometrically invariant function maps configurations of points to actions. We study the behavior of the proposed rules as the quantity of auxiliary data sampled from the unknown support manifold increases. We show that, as the auxiliary sample size increases, the risk of the semisupervised rule converges to the risk of an oracle rule that relies on the maximal amount of low-dimensional Euclidean structure that can be extracted from the support manifold. Examples, applications, and simulation studies are deferred to a sequel.

</details>


### [507] [Null importance: Disentangling relevance for interpretable machine learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19511)
*Garvesh Raskutti,Kris Sankaran,Jiaxin Ye*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出基于"零重要性"(null importance)的统一视角来刻画特征重要性，区分边缘/条件统计相关性、预测风险、函数不变性与因果效应等不同"相关性"概念，给出各零重要性概念一致的充分条件与反例，刻画不同方法族所针对的目标，并通过模拟与图像、多组学案例研究验证其理论区分及实践后果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 特征重要性是可解释机器学习的核心，但"重要性"一词涵盖若干本质上不同的相关性概念，导致不同方法回答的科学问题不同、结论难以比较。该区分在算法公平性(不同公平准则对应不同零重要性)和基因组扰动建模(不同相关性概念导致关于模型学到了什么的不同结论)中尤为关键。

Method: 以零重要性——在给定相关性概念下特征无关的总体层面刻画——为基础构建统一框架。考察源自边缘与条件统计相关性、预测风险、函数不变性和因果效应的标准零重要性概念；给出零概念重合的充分条件及其失效时的反例；刻画不同方法族(如置换重要性、条件重要性、SHAP等)所针对的零目标，以及其零重要性统计量何时能识别这些目标；并开展覆盖特征依赖、冗余、非线性、隐特征等现象的模拟，以及在图像与多组学数据上的案例研究。

Result: 建立了不同零重要性概念重合的充分条件，并给出其偏离的反例；刻画了各方法族所针对的零目标及其零重要性统计量的识别条件；模拟与图像、多组学案例研究为这些理论区分及其实际后果提供了经验证据，表明不同相关性概念会导致关于模型学到内容的不同结论。

Conclusion: 该框架将特征分析的三方面——定义相关性的科学问题、塑造零概念关系的若干数据与模型假设、以及评估重要性的方法——联系起来，为关联科学问题、数据生成假设与算法提供了统一的统计语言，并澄清了特征重要性分析所能支持的结论边界。

Abstract: Feature importance is central to interpretable machine learning, but the term "importance" encompasses several fundamentally different notions of relevance. We develop a unified perspective based on null importance: a population-level characterization of when a feature is irrelevant under a specified notion of relevance. We consider standard notions of null importance arising from marginal and conditional statistical relevance, predictive risk, functional invariance, and causal effects, and show how these notions answer different scientific questions. We illustrate the framework in two applications in which the distinction is particularly consequential: algorithmic fairness, where common fairness criteria correspond to different notions of null importance, and genomic perturbation modeling, where different notions of relevance lead to different conclusions about what a prediction model has learned. The framework connects three aspects of feature analysis: the scientific question defining relevance, the data and model assumptions that shape how different null notions relate, and the methods used to assess importance. We establish sufficient conditions under which null notions coincide and give counterexamples showing how they diverge when those conditions fail. We then characterize which nulls different method families target and when their zero-importance statistics identify those targets. Finally, simulations spanning feature dependence, redundancy, nonlinearity, hidden features and other standard phenomena, along with case studies on image and multiomics data, provide empirical evidence for these theoretical distinctions and their practical consequences. Taken together, these results provide a common statistical language for relating scientific questions, data-generating assumptions, and algorithms, and clarify the conclusions that feature-importance analyses can support.

</details>


### [508] [Next-token functional estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19529)
*Milind Nakul,Vidya Muthukumar,Ashwin Pananjady*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出留窗口法（leave-a-window-out）估计器，用于估计依赖序列中"下一token泛函"，在平稳β-混合且满足Marton耦合的假设下达到参数速率，并给出混合马尔可夫链上的极小极大下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 观测到长度为n+1的随机变量序列的前n个点，需要估计关于未观测末点与已观测经验测度的泛函（如新token惊奇概率、最小距离尾概率、分类测试误差）。经典留一法（leave-one-out）在时间依赖下不一致，因此需要新的估计方法。

Method: 提出leave-a-window-out估计器：在每个索引后删除长度为τ的窗口再构造经验测度，τ=1时退化为留一法。在平稳β-混合并允许Marton耦合的过程假设下进行理论分析，并推导惊奇概率估计的极小极大下界；通过马尔可夫链、移动平均过程与自回归过程仿真验证。

Result: 证明估计器误差对任意平稳β-混合且具有Marton耦合的过程以参数速率衰减，覆盖多类自然泛函；给出混合马尔可夫链上惊奇概率估计的紧致极小极大下界；仿真显示该估计器在留一法与add-constant基线失效的多种场景中依然有效。

Conclusion: 留窗口法为时间依赖下的下一token泛函估计提供了理论上具参数速率、且经验上优于经典基线的解决方案。

Abstract: Suppose we observe the first $n$ points of a sequence of random variables having length $n+1$, and wish to estimate a functional of the unobserved final point and the empirical measure of the $n$ observed training points. Such next-token functionals include the probability that the next token is novel (also known as the surprise probability), the tail probability of the minimum distance between the next token and training points, and the test error of a classifier trained on the observed points. All of these quantities are classically estimated by the leave-one-out method, which is inconsistent under temporal dependence. We propose a leave-a-window-out estimator, which deletes a window of length $τ$ after each index before forming the empirical measure and reduces to leave-one-out at $τ= 1$. Under natural assumptions, we show that the error of our estimator decays at a parametric rate for any stationary $β$-mixing process that also admits a Marton coupling. Our results thus cover several natural functionals on a large class of stochastic processes. We complement these upper bounds with a sharp minimax lower bound for estimating the surprise probability on mixing Markov chains. Simulations on Markov chains, moving-average processes, and autoregressive processes show that our estimator succeeds in many scenarios where leave-one-out and add-constant baselines fail.

</details>


### [509] [Error bounds in Sobolev norms for approximations with norm constrained ReLU neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19937)
*Xianjun Li,Yunfei Yang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文将ReLU网络在路径范数约束下的光滑函数逼近结果从一致逼近推广到Sobolev范数逼近，分别给出浅层与深层网络的误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究证明了在权重路径范数约束下ReLU网络能良好逼近光滑函数，但仅限于一致逼近。作者希望将此结果推广到Sobolev范数（具体为W^{1,p}范数）下的逼近，以刻画函数及其导数的同时逼近能力。

Method: 分析宽度为W、深度为L、路径范数上界为K的ReLU网络对W^{n,p}中Sobolev函数的逼近能力，误差以W^{1,p}-范数度量。分别考虑浅层网络（L=1）与深层网络两种情形，推导逼近误差上界。

Result: 浅层网络（L=1）：当光滑指数满足n<s=(d+3)/2、输入为d维时，误差界为O(max{W^{-(n-1)/d}, K^{-(n-1)/(s-n)}})。深层网络：当宽度W与深度L充分大时，可去除对光滑性的限制，误差界为O(K^{-(n-1)/(d+d/p+1)})。

Conclusion: 将路径范数约束下ReLU网络的逼近理论从一致逼近扩展到Sobolev范数逼近；深层网络相较浅层网络可摆脱对光滑指数的限制，只要宽度和深度足够大即可获得仅依赖路径范数K的收敛速率。

Abstract: Recent studies have shown that smooth functions can be well approximated by ReLU neural networks with path norm constraint on the weights. We extend these results from uniform approximation to approximation in Sobolev norm. Specifically, we analyze how well Sobolev functions in $W^{n,p}$ can be approximated by neural networks with width $W$, depth $L$ and path norm bounded by $K$, when the approximation error is measured in the $W^{1,p}$-norm. For shallow networks with depth $L=1$, we derive the approximation error bound $\mathcal{O}(\max\{W^{-(n-1)/d}, K^{-(n-1)/(s-n)}\})$, when the smoothness index satisfies $n<s=(d+3)/2$ and the input is $d$-dimensional. For deep networks, we remove the restriction on the smoothness by showing that the approximation bound $\mathcal{O}(K^{-(n-1)/(d+d/p+1)})$ holds if the width $W$ and depth $L$ are sufficiently large.

</details>


### [510] [Model-based Bootstrap for Offline Policy Evaluation in Tabular Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20389)
*Weiwei Wang,Yuqiang Li,Xianyi Wu,Bingyi Jing*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于模型的bootstrap框架，用于有限时域、时间非齐次MDP中离线策略评估(OPE)的误差采样分布估计，实现分布一致性、渐近有效置信区间与一致方差估计，并可处理多种离线数据格式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高风险强化学习应用中，策略部署前需可靠评估，仅有点估计不足，需要置信区间和方差等不确定性量化以支持安全、风险感知决策。统一这些任务的关键是估计评估误差的采样分布，但现有方法在鲁棒性、可扩展性或有限样本有效性方面存在不足。

Method: 提出面向有限时域、时间非齐次MDP的基于模型的bootstrap不确定性量化框架。与传统重采样完整episode的bootstrap不同，该方法从估计的MDP中重新生成轨迹，因而可兼容完整轨迹、转移级观测和轨迹片段等多种离线数据格式，并借此提升有限样本统计效率。

Result: 建立了bootstrap分布一致性、目标策略值的渐近有效置信区间与一致方差估计。大量仿真表明该方法能准确捕捉OPE估计量的采样分布，在多数情形下给出更紧的置信区间和更准确的方差估计。

Conclusion: 基于模型的bootstrap为OPE提供了更通用、有限样本有效的不确定性量化方案，拓宽了适用数据格式并提升统计效率，在仿真中优于现有方法。

Abstract: Offline policy evaluation (OPE) is crucial in high-stakes reinforcement learning applications, where new policies must be assessed reliably before deployment. In such settings, point estimates alone are insufficient; principled uncertainty quantification, such as confidence intervals and variance estimates, is essential for safe and risk-aware decision-making. A comprehensive way to unify these tasks is to estimate the sampling distribution of the evaluation error. Existing approaches, however, often suffer from limited robustness, scalability, or finite-sample validity. In this paper, we propose a model-based bootstrap framework for uncertainty quantification of OPE in finite-horizon, time-inhomogeneous Markov decision processes (MDPs). Unlike classical bootstrap methods that rely on resampling complete episodes, the proposed method regenerates trajectories from an estimated MDP and can therefore accommodate a much broader range of offline data formats, including complete trajectories, transition-level observations, and trajectory fragments. This flexibility further improves finite-sample statistical efficiency. We establish bootstrap distributional consistency, asymptotically valid confidence intervals, and consistent variance estimation for the target policy value. Extensive simulations show that the proposed method accurately captures the sampling distribution of the OPE estimator, yielding tighter confidence intervals and more accurate variance estimates in most settings.

</details>


### [511] [Online Supervised Dimension Reduction with Random Features: Diagnostics and Computational Trade-offs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20454)
*Zhenlin Yao,Wei Xiong*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 精确优化监督谱目标不必然产生精确的总体子空间或更优的预测表示；本文以OKSPCA为对象，将估计器、精确子空间与实用迭代的性能、几何与数值成本分别评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监督谱目标的优化精度常被等同于子空间质量与预测收益，但二者在理论与实践中可能分离。作者试图厘清“目标优化精度”“总体子空间恢复”“预测表示质量”和“数值成本”之间的区别。

Method: 针对在线核监督主成分分析（OKSPCA），在有限随机特征坐标下使用中心化交叉矩，并采用Adam式正交基更新；给出固定映射一致性、集中与扰动结果以刻画估计器及精确子空间；再进行同目标比较、六项预测基准、分类秩模型与受控样本量研究，以及不同数值服务负载下的成本测试。

Result: 六项预测基准中，用精确经验目标替代跟踪器后两个回归缺口基本不变；直接分类秩模型平均捕获几乎全部末端目标能量，但保存的中间状态存在明显几何偏差；样本量研究进一步区分经验精度与总体恢复。数值服务负载中，精确按需计算在测试分类场景更快，Adam相对全薄SVD服务在某些稠密较宽回归请求上省时，同时伴随持续几何误差。

Conclusion: 这些诊断限制了仅以末端优化精度解释性能的做法，并区分数值成本、质量、秩覆盖与新鲜度；既未建立实用跟踪器的收敛性，也未证明基可用性带来预测或部署收益。

Abstract: Accurate optimization of a supervised spectral objective need not produce an accurate population subspace or a better predictive representation. We investigate these distinctions for Online Kernel Supervised Principal Component Analysis (OKSPCA), which combines a centered cross-moment in finite random-feature coordinates with an Adam-style orthonormal basis update for an established objective. Fixed-map consistency, concentration and perturbation results describe the estimator and its exact subspace; same-target comparisons then assess the practical iterate separately. Across six predictive benchmarks, performance depends on the declared pipeline: replacing the tracker with the exact empirical target leaves the two regression deficits largely unchanged. Direct classification-rank models capture nearly all terminal objective energy on average, but a saved intermediate state exhibits substantial geometric deviation; a controlled sample-size study further separates empirical accuracy from population recovery. In distinct numerical-service workloads, exact on-request computation is faster in the tested classification settings, whereas Adam saves time relative to the tested full thin-SVD service for some dense wider-regression requests, alongside persistent geometric error. These diagnostics limit explanations based solely on terminal optimization accuracy and distinguish numerical cost from quality, rank coverage and freshness; they establish neither practical-tracker convergence nor predictive or deployment benefits from basis availability.

</details>


### [512] [TAP Accuracy Below the Fluctuation Scale and Universal Posterior Geometry in Spherical Linear Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20577)
*Jingbo Liu,Zhiyuan Yu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 研究大维比例增长下Bayes最优球面线性模型，在定量Marchenko--Pastur谱正则条件下证明全温度TAP近似、后验几何刻画及后验质量指数阶界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在维数与样本量成比例增长的高维设定下，理解球面线性模型的后验分布与自由能是统计物理与高维统计的核心问题；已有工作多依赖逐元素独立或奇异向量条件，本文希望在更弱的定量谱正则条件下给出定量、最优阶的结果。

Method: 假设设计矩阵满足定量Marchenko--Pastur谱正则条件（涵盖有限四阶矩的标准化i.i.d.设计，但不需要逐元素独立或对奇异向量的限制），在此条件下证明全温度TAP近似并刻画后验几何。

Result: 归一化球面自由能与有限长宽比TAP泛函最优值之差为O_P(p^{-1})；两者各自与显式确定性等价量相差O_P(p^{-1/2})且此涨落阶是紧的；全局TAP最大化点到球面后验均值的归一化平方欧氏距离一致为O_P(p^{-1})；由岭估计确定的数据依赖带外的后验质量有尖锐指数阶：带宽ε小时其对数至多-cpε^2+O_P(1)，几何可行宽度有匹配下界，而宽度ε_p≫p^{-1/2}的带渐近捕获全部后验质量。

Conclusion: 在仅需定量Marchenko--Pastur谱正则的弱条件下，建立了球面线性模型的全温度TAP近似与后验集中/几何的定量刻画，涨落与后验质量指数阶均为最优，并将结果推广至不要求逐元素独立的设计。

Abstract: We study the Bayes-optimal spherical linear model as the ambient dimension and sample size grow proportionally, under a quantitative Marchenko--Pastur spectral-regularity condition on the design. This condition is satisfied by normalized i.i.d. designs with standardized entries of finite fourth moment, but does not require entrywise independence or impose conditions on the singular vectors. Under this condition, we prove a quantitative all-temperature TAP approximation and characterize the posterior geometry. For the natural finite-aspect-ratio TAP functional, the normalized spherical free energy and the TAP optimum differ by $O_P(p^{-1})$. Each is within $O_P(p^{-1/2})$ of its explicit deterministic equivalent, and this fluctuation scale is sharp. Uniformly over all global TAP maximizers, the normalized squared Euclidean distance to the spherical posterior mean is $O_P(p^{-1})$. We also prove that the posterior mass outside a data-dependent band determined by the ridge estimator has sharp exponential order. More precisely, uniformly over sufficiently small band widths $\varepsilon$, the logarithm of this mass is at most $-cp\varepsilon^2+O_P(1)$. For every fixed geometrically admissible width, a spherical-cap construction gives a matching exponential-order lower bound on this mass. For every deterministic sequence of widths $\varepsilon_p\gg p^{-1/2}$, the corresponding bands capture asymptotically all posterior mass.

</details>


### [513] [Prediction-Powered Smoothing and Validation for Disaggregated AI Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20758)
*Sho Kawano,Zehang Richard Li,Paul A. Parker*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 论文提出预测驱动平滑（PP-S）及其跨报告分类借力扩展（PP-TS）的贝叶斯小区域估计工作流，并推导近似无偏的设计型交叉验证分数用于估计器选择，在基准与真实智能体流量上均优于直接估计器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统评估需要按域（如基准任务类型、部署智能体的对话类型）进行分解评估，但穷举测试成本高昂，只能依赖标注单元样本。直接估计器（含PPI）仅使用本域标签，标签稀少时精度不足，因此需要在小样本域上实现准确的点估计与区间估计。

Method: 将评估集视为有限总体，目标为各域均值的点估计与区间估计。估计方法：提出PP-S，对每个域的预测驱动估计拟合贝叶斯模型；扩展PP-TS，在报告分类体系内跨域借力。验证方法：推导新的、近似无偏的设计型交叉验证分数，用于在直接估计器与平滑估计器之间进行选择。

Result: 在具有可验证评分的精选基准和由人工评分的部署智能体流量（两者均观测到全部结果）上，所提估计器在点估计与区间估计上均优于直接估计器，覆盖率接近名义水平。在相同采样预算下，所提分数选择估计器的效果与独立验证样本相当，且对所选估计器误差的估计更为准确。

Conclusion: 小区域估计思想可有效整合进AI系统分解评估流程，PP-S与PP-TS配合设计型交叉验证分数，能在标签稀缺条件下提升各域估计精度与选择可靠性，形成估计与验证一体化的评估工作流。

Abstract: Evaluating an AI system requires disaggregated assessment, as performance varies across domains such as benchmark task types or conversation types in deployed agents. Exhaustive testing is expensive, so evaluation rests on a sample of labeled units. We treat the evaluation set as a finite population and seek accurate point and interval estimates of each domain mean. Direct estimators, including prediction-powered inference (PPI), use only a domain's own labels and are imprecise where labels are few. Small area estimation addresses this problem, and we build on it to develop an integrated workflow for estimation and validation. For estimation, we propose prediction-powered smoothing (PP-S), a Bayesian model fit to each domain's prediction-powered estimate, with an extension that borrows strength across a reporting taxonomy (PP-TS). For validation, we derive a new, approximately unbiased design-based cross-validation score for choosing among direct and smoothed estimators. We study a curated benchmark with verifiable grading and deployed agent traffic graded by humans, each with every outcome observed. In both, the proposed estimators improve on the direct estimators in point and interval estimation, with near-nominal coverage. At the same sampling budget, our score selects as well as an independent validation sample does and estimates the selected estimator's error far more accurately.

</details>
